attributes.name: verifier_name
attributes.description: Full name of the engineer or site supervisor who physically verified and signed off this progress measurement. Retained for audit trail and contractual accountability under FIDIC and ISO 9001 requirements.

attributes.name: work_area
attributes.description: Physical site area, zone, or work front where the measured work is being performed (e.g., Zone A, Block 3, Pier 7). Aligns with site work front definitions used in HCSS HeavyJob and Procore daily logs.

products.name: project_change_order
products.description: Formal change order (CO) record capturing approved scope, schedule, and cost changes to the project baseline. Tracks CO number, description, change type (scope addition, scope reduction, design change, unforeseen condition), cost impact, schedule impact (EOT — Extension of Time), originator, approval status, approval date, and contract reference. SSOT for all approved project changes. Sourced from Procore Change Orders module. [SSOT: distinct source of truth for project domain]

attributes.name: project_change_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the change order record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for the project_change_order data product.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prime contract or subcontract against which this change order is issued. Establishes the contractual basis for the CO.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent project to which this change order belongs. Links the CO to the project master record.

attributes.name: contract_change_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_change_order. Business justification: Required for the Change Order Management process: each project change order must reference the contract change order that amends the agreement, enabling cost/schedule impact tracking.

attributes.name: primary_project_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Change Order Initiated By User ID
attributes.description: Reference to the internal user (project manager, contract administrator, or engineer) who created and submitted the change order in the system.

tag_set.value: Change Order Initiated By User ID

attributes.name: aconex_mail_ref
attributes.description: Aconex correspondence or transmittal reference number for the formal change order submission and approval correspondence. Provides document management traceability.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the change order received final approval from the authorised signatory (client, owner, or engineer). Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the change order. Tracks progression from initial draft through client or owner approval. Only approved COs update the project baseline.

attributes.name: budget_line_item_ref
attributes.description: Reference to the project budget line item or BOQ (Bill of Quantities) item that this change order modifies. Enables budget impact tracking at line-item level.

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the change. Drives cost and schedule impact analysis and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scope_addition|scope_reduction|design_change|unforeseen_condition|client_directive|regulatory_change — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: co_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible sequential identifier for the change order as issued on the project (e.g., CO-00042). Used in all formal correspondence, contract administration, and client reporting.

attributes.name: contingency_drawn_amount
attributes.description: Amount drawn from the project contingency reserve to fund this change order, if applicable. Tracks contingency consumption at the CO level for project financial management.

attributes.name: contract_clause_reference
attributes.description: Specific contract clause or FIDIC sub-clause under which the change order is raised (e.g., 'FIDIC Clause 13.1 — Right to Vary'). Establishes contractual entitlement.

attributes.name: cost_code
attributes.description: Project cost code or cost account to which the change order financial impact is posted. Used for job costing, budget tracking, and financial reporting in Viewpoint Vista and SAP.

attributes.name: cost_impact_amount
attributes.description: Net monetary value of the change order representing the increase (positive) or decrease (negative) to the contract sum. Expressed in the contract currency. Core component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for this transaction.

attributes.name: cost_impact_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost impact amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency project environments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the change order record was first created in the source system (Procore). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: delivery_model
attributes.description: Contract delivery model under which this change order is administered (e.g., EPC — Engineering Procurement Construction, DB — Design-Build, DBB — Design-Bid-Build, PPP — Public-Private Partnership). Affects entitlement rules.

attributes.name: project_change_order_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the scope of work added, reduced, or modified by this change order. Captures the full business justification and technical scope.

attributes.name: direct_cost_amount
attributes.description: Direct labour, material, and equipment cost component of the change order before overhead and profit mark-up. Used for cost breakdown analysis and BOQ reconciliation.

attributes.name: drawing_revision
attributes.description: Drawing revision number or BIM (Building Information Modeling) model version that forms the basis of the change order scope. Ensures design traceability.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the approved change order takes contractual effect, potentially backdated to the date the change work commenced on site.

attributes.name: eot_granted_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days of Extension of Time formally approved and granted by the engineer or owner in response to this change order. May differ from the claimed schedule impact.

attributes.name: is_disputed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the change order is subject to a formal dispute or claim between the contractor and the client/owner. True if disputed; False if agreed.

attributes.name: is_ld_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether Liquidated Damages (LD) provisions are applicable to this change order in the event of delay. Relevant for schedule-impacting COs.

attributes.name: ld_rate_per_day
attributes.description: Daily Liquidated Damages (LD) rate applicable to this change order if the associated milestone or completion date is not met. Expressed in the contract currency.

attributes.name: linked_ncr_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Non-Conformance Report (NCR) associated with this change order, where the CO is issued to remediate a quality non-conformance.

attributes.name: linked_rfi_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Request for Information (RFI) that triggered or is associated with this change order. Provides traceability from design query to contractual change.

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: Party who initiated or originated the change order request. Determines contractual entitlement and responsibility for cost and schedule impacts.

attributes.name: overhead_and_profit_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Change Order Overhead and Profit (OH&P) Amount
attributes.description: Overhead and profit mark-up applied to the direct cost to arrive at the total cost impact. Expressed in the contract currency.

tag_set.value: Change Order Overhead and Profit (OH&P) Amount

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the change order indicating urgency of processing and approval. Critical COs may be on the critical path and require expedited approval.

attributes.name: procore_co_reference
attributes.description: Native change order identifier from the Procore Construction Management system. Used for data lineage, source system traceability, and reconciliation between the lakehouse and Procore.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardised reason code categorising the root cause of the change (e.g., design error, owner-directed, differing site conditions, regulatory). Supports trend analysis and lessons learned. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: design_error|owner_directed|differing_site_conditions|regulatory|scope_gap|value_engineering|force_majeure — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Revision sequence of the change order document. Increments each time the CO is revised prior to final approval. Revision 0 is the original issue.

attributes.name: sap_co_document_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA project system document number generated when the approved change order is posted to the financial ledger. Enables reconciliation between project management and ERP.

attributes.name: schedule_impact_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days of Extension of Time (EOT) claimed or granted as a result of this change order. Positive value indicates delay; negative indicates acceleration. Zero if no schedule impact.

attributes.name: scope_of_work_summary
attributes.business_glossary_term: Change Order Scope of Work Summary
attributes.description: Concise summary of the physical scope of work added, removed, or modified by this change order. Complements the detailed description for executive reporting and CO registers.

tag_set.value: Change Order Scope of Work Summary

attributes.name: submitted_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the change order was formally submitted to the client or owner for review and approval. Triggers contractual response timelines per FIDIC.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title of the change order summarising the nature of the change (e.g., 'Additional Piling Works — Zone B'). Used in registers and dashboards.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording the most recent modification to the change order record. Used for incremental data loading, audit trails, and change tracking in the lakehouse.

attributes.name: wbs_code
attributes.description: WBS element code to which the change order scope and cost are allocated. Enables cost control and EVM (Earned Value Management) tracking at the WBS level.

products.name: cost_account
products.description: Project cost account (control account) representing the intersection of WBS element and cost code for job costing and budget control. Captures cost account code, description, cost type (labor, material, equipment, subcontract, overhead), original budget, approved budget (including COs), committed cost, actual cost to date, forecast cost at completion, and variance. SSOT for project-level cost control. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Project Systems and Viewpoint Vista Job Costing.
products.reference: Cost Account / Control Account — SAP PS / Viewpoint Vista Job Costing

attributes.name: cost_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the project cost account (control account) record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent construction project to which this cost account belongs. Links cost account to the project master record for project-level cost roll-up and reporting.

attributes.name: responsible_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Cost account manager employee is required for financial accountability and reporting.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element at which this cost account is positioned. The cost account represents the intersection of a WBS node and a cost code, enabling granular budget control per WBS deliverable.

attributes.name: account_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the cost account scope, such as 'Structural Concrete — Foundation Works' or 'MEP Subcontract — Electrical Rough-In'. Used in cost reports, BOQ reconciliation, and EVM reporting.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost account. Active accounts accept cost postings; on_hold accounts are temporarily frozen pending review; closed accounts are complete and locked; cancelled accounts are voided; pending_approval accounts await PMO authorization before activation.

attributes.name: actual_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total actual cost incurred and posted to this cost account to date, including paid invoices, posted labor timesheets, and equipment charges. Equivalent to Actual Cost of Work Performed (ACWP) in EVM. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI/CO and Viewpoint Vista job cost ledger.

attributes.name: approved_budget_amount
attributes.description: Current approved budget for this cost account inclusive of all approved Change Orders (COs). Equivalent to Budget at Completion (BAC) in EVM terminology. Updated each time a CO is approved and posted to the cost account. The primary budget control figure used by project cost controllers.

attributes.name: baseline_finish_date
attributes.description: Planned completion date for the scope of work associated with this cost account as established in the approved project baseline schedule. Used for schedule performance tracking and Earned Value Management (EVM) analysis.

attributes.name: baseline_start_date
attributes.description: Planned start date for the scope of work associated with this cost account as established in the approved project baseline schedule. Used for Planned Value (PV) calculation and schedule variance analysis in EVM reporting.

attributes.name: budget_unit_rate
attributes.description: Budgeted cost per unit of measure for this cost account (Approved Budget divided by Budgeted Quantity). Used for unit rate benchmarking, bid analysis, and productivity monitoring. Expressed in the cost account currency per unit of measure.

attributes.name: change_order_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative value of all approved Change Orders (COs) posted to this cost account. Represents the delta between the original budget and the current approved budget. Tracked separately to support contract administration and CO impact analysis.

attributes.name: cost_account_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the cost account within the project. Derived from the job cost coding structure in Viewpoint Vista and SAP PS. Used on timesheets, purchase orders, and subcontract invoices for cost allocation.

attributes.name: committed_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total value of contractual commitments against this cost account, including issued Purchase Orders (POs) and subcontract awards not yet invoiced. Represents financial obligations that will become actual costs. Critical for cash flow forecasting and cost-to-complete analysis.

attributes.name: contingency_amount
attributes.description: Contingency budget allocated to this cost account to cover identified risks and uncertainties within the defined scope. Managed separately from the base budget and released by the project manager upon risk materialization. Supports risk-adjusted cost forecasting.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP Cost Center code associated with this cost account, representing the organizational unit responsible for the costs. Used for overhead allocation, departmental P&L reporting, and internal charge-back processes.

attributes.name: cost_code
attributes.description: Standardized cost code from the company's master cost code library, representing the work activity or resource category (e.g., '03300' for cast-in-place concrete, '16000' for electrical). Used for cross-project benchmarking and historical cost analysis. Aligns with CSI MasterFormat or company-specific coding structure.

attributes.name: cost_to_complete_amount
attributes.description: Estimated remaining cost required to complete the scope of work for this cost account. Calculated as Forecast Cost at Completion minus Actual Cost to Date. Used by cost controllers to project future cash requirements and update project financial forecasts.

attributes.name: cost_type
attributes.description: Primary classification of the cost account by resource type: labor (direct workforce), material (permanent and consumable materials), equipment (plant and machinery), subcontract (third-party subcontractor scope), or overhead (indirect project costs). Drives cost segregation in EVM and P&L reporting.

attributes.name: cost_variance_amount
attributes.description: Variance between the approved budget and the forecast cost at completion for this cost account (Approved Budget minus Forecast Cost at Completion). A negative value indicates a cost overrun; positive indicates an underspend. Key metric for project cost control reporting and PMO governance.

attributes.name: cpi
attributes.description: Earned Value Management (EVM) Cost Performance Index for this cost account, calculated as Earned Value divided by Actual Cost (EV/AC). A CPI below 1.0 indicates cost overrun; above 1.0 indicates cost efficiency. Stored at the cost account level to support drill-down analysis from project-level CPI reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost account record was first created in the source system or ingested into the Silver Layer. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this cost account (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, AUD). Supports multi-currency project reporting for international EPC and JV projects.

attributes.name: earned_value_amount
attributes.description: Budgeted cost of work performed (BCWP) for this cost account, representing the value of completed work expressed in budget terms. Core EVM metric used to calculate Cost Performance Index (CPI) and Schedule Performance Index (SPI) at the cost account level.

attributes.name: forecast_cost_at_completion
attributes.description: Project cost controller's current best estimate of the total cost to complete this cost account, including actual costs to date plus estimated cost to complete (ETC). Equivalent to Estimate at Completion (EAC) in EVM. Updated periodically during project cost reviews.

attributes.name: forecast_finish_date
attributes.description: Current forecast completion date for the scope of work associated with this cost account. Updated during project schedule reviews. Used to assess Extension of Time (EOT) impacts and project completion forecasting.

attributes.name: forecast_start_date
attributes.description: Current forecast start date for the scope of work associated with this cost account, updated during project schedule reviews. Compared against the baseline start date to identify schedule slippage and its cost impact.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP General Ledger (GL) account code to which costs posted against this cost account are mapped for financial reporting. Ensures alignment between project cost control and the corporate chart of accounts. Required for IFRS/GAAP financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: is_lump_sum
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost account is priced on a lump sum basis (True) rather than a unit rate or reimbursable basis (False). Lump sum accounts are managed differently in terms of progress measurement and payment certification.

attributes.name: is_subcontract_scope
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scope of work for this cost account is executed by a subcontractor (True) or by the General Contractor's (GC) own forces (False). Drives subcontract management workflows, retention tracking, and payment certification processes.

attributes.name: original_budget_amount
attributes.description: The baseline budget amount for this cost account as established at project sanction or Notice to Proceed (NTP). Represents the original authorized cost plan before any Change Orders (COs). Immutable once the baseline is locked. Used as the denominator for variance analysis and EVM performance measurement.

attributes.name: percent_complete
attributes.description: Physical percent complete of the scope of work associated with this cost account, as assessed by the project team or quantity surveyor. Expressed as a value between 0.00 and 100.00. Used to calculate Earned Value and assess progress against the baseline schedule.

attributes.name: phase_code
attributes.description: Project phase or stage code associated with this cost account (e.g., 'DESIGN', 'PROCURE', 'CONSTRUCT', 'COMMISSION'). Enables cost tracking and reporting by EPC phase. Sourced from Viewpoint Vista and HCSS HeavyJob phase coding.

attributes.name: planned_value_amount
attributes.description: Budgeted cost of work scheduled (BCWS) for this cost account as of the reporting data date. Represents the cumulative planned spend per the project baseline schedule. Used with Earned Value to compute Schedule Variance (SV) and SPI.

attributes.name: quantity_actual
attributes.description: Actual quantity of work completed and posted against this cost account to date. Compared against budgeted quantity to assess production efficiency and unit cost performance. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob production entries and field daily logs.

attributes.name: quantity_budgeted
attributes.description: Original budgeted quantity of work for this cost account as derived from the Bill of Quantities (BOQ) or Material Take-Off (MTO). Expressed in the unit of measure applicable to the cost type (e.g., m3 for concrete, tonnes for steel, hours for labor). Enables unit rate analysis and productivity benchmarking.

attributes.name: reporting_period_date
attributes.description: The data date or cut-off date as of which the cost account financial figures (actual cost, earned value, planned value, forecast) are reported. Aligns with the project monthly cost report cycle and EVM data date in Oracle Primavera P6.

attributes.name: retention_percentage
attributes.description: Contractual retention percentage applied to payments against this cost account, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5%). Retention is withheld from subcontractor and supplier payments until practical completion or Defects Liability Period (DLP) expiry.

attributes.name: spi
attributes.description: Earned Value Management (EVM) Schedule Performance Index for this cost account, calculated as Earned Value divided by Planned Value (EV/PV). An SPI below 1.0 indicates schedule slippage on the associated scope; above 1.0 indicates ahead of schedule. Supports integrated cost-schedule performance analysis.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the budgeted and actual quantities on this cost account (e.g., HR for hours, M3 for cubic metres, TON for tonnes, LM for linear metres, EA for each, LS for lump sum). Aligns with the BOQ and MTO unit conventions.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this cost account record, whether from a source system refresh, cost controller update, or Change Order posting. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit compliance.

products.name: project_budget_revision
products.description: Budget revision record capturing approved changes to the project budget at cost account or WBS level. Tracks revision number, revision date, revision type (original budget, CO incorporation, re-forecast, management reserve release), amount before revision, amount after revision, approving authority, and justification narrative. Maintains full audit trail of budget evolution throughout the project lifecycle.
products.reference: Budget Revision — SAP S/4HANA Project Systems

attributes.name: project_budget_revision_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each budget revision record within the project lifecycle. Primary key for the project_budget_revision data product.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent project to which this budget revision belongs. Links the revision to the core project master record.

attributes.name: primary_project_employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the person who formally approved this budget revision in the ERP or project management system. Provides a traceable link to the approver's user record for audit and governance purposes.

attributes.name: project_change_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved Change Order (CO) that triggered this budget revision, where applicable. Null for revisions not driven by a formal CO (e.g., management reserve releases, re-forecasts).

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element or cost account at which this budget revision is applied. Enables granular budget tracking at the WBS node level.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the budget revision was formally approved in the system. Distinct from revision_date (the business effective date) — captures the precise system approval event for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: approving_authority
attributes.description: Name or role title of the individual or governance body that formally approved this budget revision (e.g., Project Director, CFO, Project Control Board). Supports delegation-of-authority compliance and audit requirements.

attributes.name: base_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the project's base reporting currency to which all revision amounts are converted for consolidated financial reporting.

attributes.name: budget_after_revision
attributes.description: The approved budget amount at the cost account or WBS level immediately after this revision is applied. Equals budget_before_revision plus revision_amount. Represents the current approved budget at this node post-revision.

attributes.name: budget_before_revision
attributes.description: The approved budget amount at the cost account or WBS level immediately prior to this revision being applied. Provides the baseline for calculating the revision delta and supports audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: budget_category
attributes.description: High-level cost category to which the budget revision applies. Enables cost category-level budget variance analysis across labour, materials, equipment, subcontract, indirect costs, contingency, and management reserve. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: labour|materials|equipment|subcontract|indirect|contingency|management_reserve — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: client_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the client or owner formally approved this budget revision. Populated only when client_approved_flag is True. Used for contract administration and LD (Liquidated Damages) exposure tracking.

attributes.name: client_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the budget revision has been formally approved by the client or owner, as distinct from internal project approval. Relevant for contract variations under FIDIC or GMP (Guaranteed Maximum Price) contracts where client sign-off is required.

attributes.name: contingency_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the revised budget allocated as contingency reserve within this revision. Tracked separately from the base budget to support risk-adjusted cost reporting and contingency drawdown analysis.

attributes.name: contract_budget_impact
attributes.description: The portion of the budget revision amount that has a direct impact on the contract value (i.e., is recoverable from the client under the contract terms). Distinguishes between client-recoverable and internally-absorbed budget changes.

attributes.name: control_account_manager
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the Control Account Manager (CAM) responsible for the WBS element or cost account affected by this revision. The CAM is accountable for budget performance under EVM (Earned Value Management) governance.

attributes.name: cost_account_code
attributes.description: The cost account or cost code identifier from the project cost breakdown structure at which the budget revision is applied. Aligns with the project's chart of accounts used in job costing systems such as Viewpoint Vista.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this budget revision record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the budget revision amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency project reporting for international EPC projects.

attributes.name: delivery_model
attributes.description: The project delivery model under which this budget revision is governed (e.g., EPC – Engineering Procurement Construction, DB – Design-Build, DBB – Design-Bid-Build, PPP – Public-Private Partnership, BOT – Build-Operate-Transfer, GMP – Guaranteed Maximum Price). Affects the approval authority and client-recoverability rules.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the revised budget amount becomes effective for cost control and financial reporting purposes. May differ from revision_date (approval date) when retroactive adjustments are applied.

attributes.name: evm_baseline_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earned Value Management (EVM) Performance Measurement Baseline Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revision updates the Performance Measurement Baseline (PMB) used for EVM (Earned Value Management) calculations including CPI and SPI. True if the revision is incorporated into the PMB; False if it is held outside (e.g., management reserve).

tag_set.value: Earned Value Management (EVM) Performance Measurement Baseline Flag

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the revision amounts to the project's base reporting currency at the time of revision. Relevant for international projects with multi-currency contracts.

attributes.name: external_revision_reference
attributes.description: The revision identifier or budget version number as recorded in the originating source system (e.g., SAP budget document number, Primavera P6 budget version ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and traceability.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal year and month (YYYY-MM) in which this budget revision is recorded for financial reporting and period-close purposes. Aligns with the project's financial calendar in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: internal_budget_impact
attributes.description: The portion of the budget revision amount absorbed internally by the contractor (not recoverable from the client). Represents the P&L (Profit and Loss) impact of the revision on the project's financial performance.

attributes.name: justification_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing the business rationale and supporting context for the budget revision. Required for audit trail compliance and PMO governance review. Captures scope changes, risk events, commercial decisions, or management directives driving the revision.

attributes.name: management_reserve_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the budget revision attributed to management reserve — funds held outside the Performance Measurement Baseline (PMB) for unforeseen scope. Tracked separately per EVM governance requirements.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments associated with this budget revision record. Used for supplementary information not captured in the structured fields, such as interim approvals, pending items, or cross-references to related revisions.

attributes.name: revision_amount
attributes.description: The net change amount applied by this revision. Positive values indicate a budget increase; negative values indicate a budget reduction. Used to reconcile budget_before_revision to budget_after_revision.

attributes.name: revision_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the budget revision was formally approved and recorded. Used for period-based budget reporting and trend analysis.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision number for the budget at the project or WBS level, starting at 0 for the original approved budget. Increments with each approved revision to maintain a complete audit trail of budget evolution.

attributes.name: revision_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle status of the budget revision record. Tracks progression from draft through approval or rejection, and flags superseded revisions replaced by a later version.

attributes.name: revision_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reason or mechanism driving the budget revision. Distinguishes between the original approved budget, Change Order (CO) incorporations, re-forecasts, management reserve releases, contingency draws, and scope adjustments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: original_budget|co_incorporation|re_forecast|management_reserve_release|contingency_draw|scope_adjustment — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: risk_event_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the risk register entry or risk event that triggered this budget revision, where applicable. Links budget revisions to the project risk management framework for risk-cost correlation analysis.

attributes.name: scope_change_description
attributes.description: Structured description of the scope change or event that necessitated this budget revision. Distinct from justification_narrative — this field captures the technical scope impact (e.g., additional earthworks volume, design change to structural steel) rather than the commercial rationale.

attributes.name: source_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the source document authorising this budget revision (e.g., Change Order number, Board approval minute reference, RFI number, internal memo reference). Provides traceability to the originating business document.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this budget revision record originated (e.g., SAP_PS for SAP S/4HANA Project Systems, PRIMAVERA_P6 for Oracle Primavera P6). Supports data lineage and reconciliation across integrated systems.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the budget revision was submitted for approval. Used to measure approval cycle time and support PMO governance reporting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this budget revision record was last modified in the data platform. Used to detect changes for incremental processing and audit trail maintenance.

products.name: deliverable
products.description: Project deliverable record representing a contractually or technically required output (engineering deliverable, construction deliverable, commissioning package, handover document). Captures deliverable code, title, discipline, deliverable type, responsible party, planned issue date, forecast issue date, actual issue date, revision status, and acceptance status. Supports handover and DLP (Defects Liability Period) tracking.

attributes.name: deliverable_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the project deliverable record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: activity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Oracle Primavera P6 schedule activity linked to the production of this deliverable. Enables earned value management (EVM) and schedule performance index (SPI) calculation at the deliverable level.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contract under which this deliverable is required. Supports contractual obligation tracking and FIDIC compliance.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent project to which this deliverable belongs. Links the deliverable to the project lifecycle and Work Breakdown Structure (WBS).

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to material.material_master. Business justification: Ensures Deliverable Material Specification ties deliverable to the exact material master record for compliance.

attributes.name: responsible_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.contact. Business justification: Deliverable responsibility is assigned to a client contact to manage approvals and handover per Deliverable Acceptance process.

attributes.name: responsible_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Deliverable ownership tracked for QA sign‑off and client handover accountability.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the WBS element under which this deliverable is classified. Enables hierarchical project decomposition and earned value tracking.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the deliverable was formally accepted by the client or approving authority. Used for handover milestone tracking and DLP commencement.

attributes.name: acceptance_status
attributes.description: Client or reviewer acceptance status of the deliverable following formal review. Indicates whether the deliverable has been accepted, accepted with comments, or rejected and requires resubmission.

attributes.name: actual_issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the deliverable was actually issued or transmitted. Populated upon completion and used to calculate schedule variance and support DLP (Defects Liability Period) tracking.

attributes.name: bim_model_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this deliverable to the corresponding BIM model or element in Autodesk BIM 360. Supports clash detection, design coordination, and digital handover.

attributes.name: deliverable_category
attributes.description: High-level category grouping the deliverable within the EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) project phases. Supports phase-based reporting and PMO governance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: engineering|procurement|construction|commissioning|handover|safety|quality — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: change_order_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Change Order (CO) that introduced or modified this deliverable. Links scope changes to affected deliverables for contract administration and cost control.

attributes.name: deliverable_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the deliverable within the project document control system. Typically assigned by the document management system (e.g., Aconex or Procore) and used for transmittal and correspondence tracking.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing reviewer comments, rejection reasons, or clarification notes associated with the deliverable review cycle. Supports QA/QC tracking and resubmission guidance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the deliverable record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: deliverable_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the deliverable within the review and approval workflow. Tracks progression from initiation through approval or rejection in the document control system. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_started|in_progress|under_review|approved|rejected|superseded|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: deliverable_type
attributes.description: Classification of the deliverable by its output category. Distinguishes engineering drawings, specifications, reports, calculations, procedures, commissioning packages, handover documents, and Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: engineering_drawing|specification|report|calculation|procedure|commissioning_package|handover_document|inspection_test_plan|method_statement|data_sheet — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: discipline
attributes.description: Engineering or construction discipline responsible for producing the deliverable (e.g., Civil, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Piping, Architectural, MEP). Aligns with Autodesk BIM 360 discipline classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: civil|structural|mechanical|electrical|instrumentation|piping|architectural|geotechnical|environmental|commissioning|process|HSE — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Formal document control number assigned by the document management system (e.g., Aconex or Procore). Used as the primary reference in transmittals, correspondence, and the document register.

attributes.name: eot_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether an Extension of Time (EOT) claim has been applied to the planned issue date of this deliverable. Supports contract administration and schedule delay analysis.

attributes.name: forecast_issue_date
attributes.description: Current forecast date for issuing the deliverable, updated during project progress reviews. Reflects schedule changes and is compared against the planned issue date to identify delays.

attributes.name: is_contractual
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deliverable is a contractually mandated output as defined in the contract scope of work or BOQ (Bill of Quantities). Distinguishes contractual obligations from internally generated technical documents.

attributes.name: is_dlp_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Defects Liability Period (DLP) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deliverable is subject to the Defects Liability Period (DLP) obligations under the contract. Enables DLP tracking and defect notification management.

tag_set.value: Is Defects Liability Period (DLP) Applicable Flag

attributes.name: is_handover_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deliverable must be included in the project handover package to the client. Supports commissioning and handover completeness tracking.

attributes.name: itp_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) associated with this deliverable. Links the deliverable to its quality inspection requirements and hold/witness points.

attributes.name: native_file_format
attributes.description: File format of the deliverable document (e.g., PDF, DWG, DXF, REVIT, IFC, XLSX). Supports document management, BIM coordination, and digital handover requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PDF|DWG|DXF|REVIT|IFC|XLSX|DOCX|XML|CSV — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ncr_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of any Non-Conformance Report (NCR) raised against this deliverable. Links quality non-conformances to the affected deliverable for QA/QC tracking and corrective action management.

attributes.name: percent_complete
attributes.description: Current percentage completion of the deliverable production, ranging from 0.00 to 100.00. Used in Earned Value Management (EVM) calculations and progress reporting.

attributes.name: planned_issue_date
attributes.description: Baseline planned date on which the deliverable is scheduled to be issued to the client or for construction use. Established at project baseline and used for schedule performance tracking (SPI).

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the deliverable indicating its criticality to the project schedule and construction activities. Critical deliverables are on the Critical Path Method (CPM) schedule.

attributes.name: review_due_date
attributes.description: Contractually or procedurally defined date by which the reviewer must return comments or approval. Supports contract administration and review cycle management.

attributes.name: review_return_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the reviewer returned comments or approval decision. Compared against review due date to track reviewer compliance and contract obligations.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Current revision identifier of the deliverable (e.g., A, B, C, 0, 1, 2). Tracks the version history of the document through the review and approval cycle in the document management system.

attributes.name: revision_status_code
attributes.description: Industry-standard document issue purpose code indicating the intent of the current revision: IFR (Issued for Review), IFC (Issued for Construction), IFI (Issued for Information), IFB (Issued for Bid), AFC (Approved for Construction), AFD (Approved for Design), ASB (As-Built). Critical for construction document control. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IFR|IFC|IFI|IFB|AFC|AFD|ASB — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: storage_location_url
attributes.description: URL or path to the deliverable file stored in the document management system (e.g., Aconex, Autodesk BIM 360, or SharePoint). Provides direct access to the source document.

attributes.name: submission_number
attributes.description: Sequential count of the number of times this deliverable has been submitted for review. Tracks resubmission cycles and supports quality performance analysis.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Full descriptive title of the deliverable as defined in the contract, scope of work, or engineering register. Used for identification in reports, transmittals, and handover packages.

attributes.name: transmittal_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the transmittal through which the deliverable was formally issued or submitted. Links to the Aconex transmittal register for correspondence traceability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the deliverable record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data loading in the Databricks silver layer.

attributes.name: weight_factor
attributes.description: Relative weighting of this deliverable within the project progress measurement system. Used to calculate weighted progress and Earned Value (EV) contributions at the project or WBS level.

products.name: commissioning_package
products.description: Commissioning and handover package grouping systems, sub-systems, and equipment for pre-commissioning, commissioning, and handover activities. Captures package number, system description, package type (mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, civil, HVAC), commissioning sequence, priority tag, FAT (Factory Acceptance Test) status, SAT (Site Acceptance Test) status, punch list summary (total items, Category A/B/C counts, closure percentage), handover certificate reference, and DLP (Defects Liability Period) start and end dates. Supports system-by-system turnover tracking, commissioning schedule integration, and operational readiness verification.

attributes.name: commissioning_package_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the commissioning package record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent construction project to which this commissioning package belongs. Links the package to the project lifecycle managed in Oracle Primavera P6 and SAP S/4HANA Project Systems.

attributes.name: responsible_engineer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Commissioning engineer is recorded for safety sign‑off and system acceptance documentation.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which all commissioning activities for this package were completed and the package was declared ready for handover. Compared against planned completion for schedule variance analysis.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which commissioning activities for this package commenced on site. Used for schedule performance tracking and SPI (Schedule Performance Index) calculation at the commissioning phase.

attributes.name: area_location
attributes.description: Physical area, zone, or location on the project site where the systems and equipment within this commissioning package are installed (e.g., 'Substation Block C', 'Pump House Level 2', 'North Terminal Building').

attributes.name: client_representative
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the client's authorised representative who witnesses commissioning activities and signs off on the handover certificate for this package.

attributes.name: commissioning_contractor
attributes.description: Name of the specialist commissioning contractor or subcontractor responsible for executing the commissioning activities for this package, where commissioning is subcontracted rather than performed by the GC (General Contractor).

attributes.name: commissioning_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric sequence order in which this commissioning package is to be executed relative to other packages on the project. Drives the commissioning schedule integration with Oracle Primavera P6 CPM (Critical Path Method) scheduling.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commissioning package record was first created in the system, providing the audit trail creation marker for data lineage and governance purposes.

attributes.name: dlp_duration_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Defects Liability Period (DLP) Duration in Days
attributes.description: Contractually agreed duration of the DLP (Defects Liability Period) in calendar days for this commissioning package, as specified in the contract conditions. Typically 365 or 730 days for major infrastructure projects.

tag_set.value: Defects Liability Period (DLP) Duration in Days

attributes.name: dlp_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the DLP (Defects Liability Period) for this commissioning package, after which the contractor's obligation to rectify defects under the contract expires. Calculated from DLP start date plus the contractually agreed DLP duration.

attributes.name: dlp_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the DLP (Defects Liability Period) for this commissioning package, typically coinciding with the handover date. During the DLP the contractor is obligated to rectify any defects that emerge.

attributes.name: fat_date
attributes.description: Date on which the FAT (Factory Acceptance Test) was conducted or is scheduled to be conducted for the equipment within this commissioning package.

attributes.name: fat_status
attributes.description: Current status of the FAT (Factory Acceptance Test) for the equipment or systems within this commissioning package. FAT is conducted at the manufacturer's facility prior to shipment to verify equipment meets specification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_required|pending|scheduled|in_progress|passed|failed|conditionally_passed — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: handover_certificate_ref
attributes.description: Document reference number of the formal handover certificate issued upon successful completion of commissioning and acceptance of this package by the client or operations team. Registered in Aconex document management.

attributes.name: handover_date
attributes.description: Date on which the commissioning package was formally handed over to the client or operations team, as evidenced by the signed handover certificate. Marks the start of the DLP (Defects Liability Period).

attributes.name: itp_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number for the ITP (Inspection and Test Plan) governing the quality inspection and testing activities for this commissioning package, as registered in Aconex or Procore document management.

attributes.name: mechanical_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which mechanical completion was achieved for this commissioning package, confirming that all physical construction and installation works are complete and the system is ready for pre-commissioning activities.

attributes.name: ncr_count
attributes.description: Total number of open NCRs (Non-Conformance Reports) raised against this commissioning package. Open NCRs must be resolved before handover can be approved. Tracked in Procore QA/QC module.

attributes.name: om_documentation_ref
attributes.description: Document reference number for the O&M (Operations and Maintenance) manual package associated with this commissioning package, as registered in Aconex. Required for handover gate approval.

attributes.name: operational_readiness_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether operational readiness has been formally verified for this commissioning package, confirming that O&M (Operations and Maintenance) documentation, spare parts, and trained operators are in place prior to handover.

attributes.name: package_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the commissioning package describing the system or sub-system grouping (e.g., 'Cooling Water System – Train A', 'HV Switchgear Room 3B').

attributes.name: package_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the commissioning package, used across project documentation, Procore submittals, and Aconex transmittals. Follows the project-defined numbering convention (e.g., CP-MEC-001).

attributes.name: package_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the commissioning package tracking progression from planning through pre-commissioning, active commissioning, readiness for handover, formal handover, and final closure. Used for PMO (Project Management Office) governance reporting and turnover tracking.

attributes.name: package_type
attributes.description: Discipline classification of the commissioning package indicating the engineering domain covered: mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, civil, or HVAC (Heating Ventilation and Air Conditioning). Drives assignment of specialist commissioning teams and applicable ITPs (Inspection and Test Plans).

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: Baseline planned date on which all commissioning activities for this package are scheduled to be completed and the package is ready for handover, per the approved commissioning schedule.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Baseline planned date on which commissioning activities for this package are scheduled to commence, as established in the approved commissioning schedule in Oracle Primavera P6.

attributes.name: pre_commissioning_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether all pre-commissioning activities (mechanical completion checks, loop checks, flushing, pressure testing) for this package have been formally completed and signed off, enabling progression to active commissioning.

attributes.name: priority_tag
attributes.description: Priority classification assigned to the commissioning package indicating its criticality to the overall project commissioning schedule and operational readiness. Critical packages are on the commissioning critical path.

attributes.name: punch_list_cat_a_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Punch List Category A Item Count
attributes.description: Number of Category A punch list items for this commissioning package. Category A items are safety-critical or operationally blocking deficiencies that must be resolved before the system can be energised or operated.

tag_set.value: Punch List Category A Item Count

attributes.name: punch_list_cat_b_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Punch List Category B Item Count
attributes.description: Number of Category B punch list items for this commissioning package. Category B items are non-safety-critical deficiencies that must be resolved before final handover but do not prevent initial commissioning.

tag_set.value: Punch List Category B Item Count

attributes.name: punch_list_cat_c_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Punch List Category C Item Count
attributes.description: Number of Category C punch list items for this commissioning package. Category C items are minor observations or improvements that may be resolved during the DLP (Defects Liability Period) after handover.

tag_set.value: Punch List Category C Item Count

attributes.name: punch_list_closed_count
attributes.description: Number of punch list items that have been formally closed and verified as resolved for this commissioning package. Used to track closure progress and calculate closure percentage.

attributes.name: punch_list_closure_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total punch list items that have been formally closed for this commissioning package, calculated as (closed items / total items) × 100. Key KPI for commissioning readiness and handover gate reviews.

attributes.name: punch_list_total_items
attributes.description: Total number of punch list items (deficiencies, outstanding works, and snag items) identified during commissioning inspections for this package. Includes all Category A, B, and C items.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or contextual information relevant to the commissioning package status, outstanding actions, or special conditions not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: sat_date
attributes.description: Date on which the SAT (Site Acceptance Test) was conducted or is scheduled to be conducted for the systems within this commissioning package.

attributes.name: sat_status
attributes.description: Current status of the SAT (Site Acceptance Test) for the systems within this commissioning package. SAT is conducted on-site after installation to verify the system operates correctly in its installed environment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_required|pending|scheduled|in_progress|passed|failed|conditionally_passed — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: subsystem_number
attributes.description: Engineering sub-system tag or number providing finer granularity within the parent system, used to sequence commissioning activities at the sub-system level and track partial turnover.

attributes.name: system_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the system, sub-system, or equipment grouping covered by this commissioning package, including functional purpose and physical boundaries as defined in the engineering design documentation and BIM (Building Information Modeling) model.

attributes.name: system_number
attributes.description: Engineering system tag or number identifying the process or facility system to which this commissioning package belongs, aligned with the plant/facility numbering scheme and P&ID (Piping and Instrumentation Diagram) references.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commissioning package record was last modified, supporting audit trail requirements and change tracking for PMO governance and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: wbs_code
attributes.description: WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) code linking this commissioning package to the project schedule hierarchy in Oracle Primavera P6. Enables cost and schedule integration at the commissioning phase level.

products.name: risk_register
products.description: Project risk register entry capturing identified risks and opportunities at project or WBS level. Tracks risk ID, description, risk category (technical, commercial, schedule, HSE, regulatory, force majeure), probability, impact (cost, schedule, quality), risk score, mitigation strategy, contingency plan, risk owner, status (open, mitigated, closed, realized), and residual risk assessment. Supports PMO governance and contingency management.
products.reference: Risk Register — PMI PMBOK / Oracle Primavera Risk Analysis

attributes.name: risk_register_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each risk register entry in the project risk register. Primary key for the risk_register data product.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent construction project to which this risk register entry belongs. Links the risk to the project master record for PMO governance and EPC execution tracking.

attributes.name: primary_risk_raised_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce member who originally identified and raised this risk entry in the register. Supports accountability tracking and risk identification trend analysis.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element at which this risk is identified. Enables risk attribution at sub-project or work-package level for granular PMO reporting.

attributes.name: affected_discipline
attributes.description: Construction or engineering discipline most affected by this risk (e.g., Civil, Structural, MEP, Geotechnical, Electrical, Procurement). Supports discipline-level risk reporting and resource allocation for mitigation.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the risk entry was formally closed, either because the risk window has passed, the risk was fully mitigated, or the risk was realized and the contingency plan executed.

attributes.name: contingency_cost_amount
attributes.description: Monetary contingency reserve allocated to this risk entry, expressed in the project currency. Feeds into the project contingency budget managed through SAP S/4HANA Project Systems and PMO cost control.

attributes.name: contingency_plan
attributes.description: Description of the fallback actions to be executed if the risk event is realized despite mitigation efforts. Defines trigger conditions, response steps, and responsible parties for contingency activation.

attributes.name: contract_clause_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific contract clause (e.g., FIDIC Clause 17.3, GMP provision, LD clause) that governs the allocation or treatment of this risk. Supports contract administration and legal risk management.

attributes.name: cost_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated monetary value of the cost impact if the risk event is realized, expressed in the project currency. Used for contingency reserve sizing, Earned Value Management (EVM) risk exposure, and project P&L forecasting.

attributes.name: cost_impact_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative rating of the potential cost impact if the risk event is realized, using the standard five-point PMO scale. Used in risk matrix scoring and contingency reserve determination.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk register record was first created in the data platform. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED for this entity. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost impact amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency international EPC projects.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk has been escalated to senior management or the PMO for executive attention due to its high risk score, proximity, or strategic significance to the project.

attributes.name: hse_risk_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Risk Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk has a Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) dimension requiring notification to the HSE team and potential entry into the Intelex HSE management system for regulatory compliance.

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Risk Flag

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the risk or opportunity was first identified and entered into the project risk register. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) for this entity. Used for risk ageing analysis and PMO reporting.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk is covered by an existing insurance policy (e.g., Contractors All Risk, Professional Indemnity, Public Liability). Supports risk transfer tracking and insurance portfolio management.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this risk entry was most recently reviewed and updated by the risk owner or PMO. Used to identify overdue reviews and stale risk entries.

attributes.name: mitigation_response_type
attributes.description: Standard risk response strategy type applied to this risk: avoid (eliminate the risk), transfer (shift to another party via contract/insurance), mitigate (reduce probability/impact), accept (acknowledge and monitor), exploit (maximise opportunity), or enhance (increase opportunity probability/impact).

attributes.name: mitigation_strategy
attributes.description: Detailed description of the planned or implemented actions to reduce the probability or impact of the risk event. Includes engineering controls, contractual protections, procurement strategies, and HSE measures.

attributes.name: probability_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative probability rating of the risk event occurring, using the standard five-point PMO scale. Complements the quantitative probability score for risk matrix visualisation and executive reporting.

attributes.name: probability_score
attributes.description: Quantitative probability of the risk event occurring, expressed as a decimal between 0.0000 and 1.0000 (e.g., 0.3500 = 35%). Used in risk scoring calculations and Monte Carlo simulation inputs for contingency management.

attributes.name: quality_impact_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative rating of the potential quality impact if the risk event is realized. Supports QA/QC risk assessment and Non-Conformance Report (NCR) prevention planning.

attributes.name: regulatory_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk involves a regulatory or permitting dimension (e.g., EPA environmental permits, OSHA compliance, IBC building code, LEED certification requirements). Triggers regulatory compliance review.

attributes.name: residual_probability_score
attributes.description: Quantitative probability of the risk event occurring after mitigation actions have been applied, expressed as a decimal between 0.0000 and 1.0000. Measures the effectiveness of the risk response strategy.

attributes.name: residual_risk_score
attributes.description: Composite risk score remaining after mitigation actions have been applied. Compared against the pre-mitigation risk score to demonstrate risk reduction effectiveness and support PMO governance reporting.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this risk entry by the risk owner and PMO. Ensures risks are regularly reassessed and not left stale in the register.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Classification of the risk into a standard PMO risk category: technical (design, engineering, construction method), commercial (cost, contract, financial), schedule (programme, critical path), hse (Health Safety and Environment), regulatory (permits, compliance), or force_majeure (natural events, geopolitical). Drives risk reporting by category.

attributes.name: risk_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric risk identifier used across project documentation, PMO registers, and Procore/Primavera P6 risk modules. Follows the project risk numbering convention (e.g., RSK-PRJ001-0042). BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this entity.

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the risk or opportunity event, its cause, and potential consequence. Captures the full context required for risk assessment and mitigation planning.

attributes.name: risk_proximity
attributes.description: Indicates the time horizon within which the risk event is expected to occur: immediate (within 30 days), near_term (30–90 days), medium_term (90–180 days), or long_term (beyond 180 days). Supports prioritisation of risk response actions.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Composite risk score calculated as the product of probability and impact ratings, typically on a 1–25 scale (5x5 risk matrix). Used to prioritise risks in the PMO risk register and determine escalation thresholds.

attributes.name: risk_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the risk register entry: open (active, being monitored), mitigated (response actions applied), closed (no longer applicable), realized (risk event has occurred), or transferred (risk transferred to another party via contract/insurance). LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this entity.

attributes.name: risk_title
attributes.description: Short, human-readable title summarising the risk or opportunity. Used as the primary display label in PMO dashboards, risk reports, and executive summaries. IDENTITY_LABEL for this entity.

attributes.name: risk_trigger
attributes.description: Description of the early warning indicators or conditions that signal the risk event is about to occur or has been triggered. Used to activate contingency plans and alert the risk owner.

attributes.name: risk_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the register entry represents a threat (negative impact) or an opportunity (positive impact) to the project. Supports balanced risk and opportunity management per PMO governance.

attributes.name: schedule_impact_days
attributes.description: Estimated number of calendar days of schedule delay if the risk event is realized. Used for Extension of Time (EOT) exposure analysis and Critical Path Method (CPM) schedule risk assessment in Oracle Primavera P6.

attributes.name: schedule_impact_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative rating of the potential schedule impact if the risk event is realized, using the standard five-point PMO scale. Informs Extension of Time (EOT) exposure analysis and Critical Path Method (CPM) schedule risk assessment.

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this risk record in the originating operational system (e.g., Procore risk ID, Primavera P6 risk code). Enables traceability from the silver layer back to the source system for reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this risk register record was most recently modified in the data platform. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED for this entity. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data processing in the Databricks silver layer.

products.name: phase
products.description: Structured phase definition within a construction project lifecycle (feasibility, pre-construction, FEED, detailed engineering, procurement, construction, pre-commissioning, commissioning, handover, DLP). Captures phase code, name, sequence, planned and actual start/finish dates, phase status, phase weight for EVM rollup, gate review criteria, gate approval status, gate approval date, and phase deliverables checklist. Supports lifecycle governance, phase-gate approval workflows, and earned value rollup by phase across EPC, DB, DBB, and PPP delivery models.
products.reference: Project Phase / Stage Gate — PMI PMBOK / EPC Lifecycle

attributes.name: phase_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a construction project lifecycle phase record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the phase data product.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent construction project to which this phase belongs. Links the phase to the core project master record.

attributes.name: responsible_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Phase gate approvals require a designated manager employee for reporting and audit.

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: Total actual costs incurred for work performed within this phase to date, representing the Actual Cost of Work Performed (ACWP) in EVM terminology. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA and Viewpoint Vista job costing modules.

attributes.name: actual_finish_date
attributes.description: The date on which all work within this phase was physically completed and accepted. Populated upon phase gate approval or formal handover documentation sign-off.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which work on this phase actually commenced on site or in the engineering office. Populated upon NTP (Notice to Proceed) issuance or first activity progress update in Primavera P6.

attributes.name: baseline_duration_days
attributes.description: Approved baseline duration of the phase in calendar days, derived from the original project schedule. Used as the denominator for schedule performance measurement and variance reporting.

attributes.name: budgeted_cost
attributes.description: The approved budget allocated to this phase, representing the Budgeted Cost of Work Scheduled (BCWS) or Planned Value (PV) in EVM terminology. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Project Systems cost planning and used for cost variance analysis.

attributes.name: phase_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the phase within the project (e.g., FEED, PROC, CONST, COMM). Used as the business identifier in Oracle Primavera P6 and SAP PS phase structures.

attributes.name: contingency_budget
attributes.description: Contingency reserve allocated to this phase to cover identified and unidentified risks. Managed separately from the base budget in SAP S/4HANA Project Systems and released upon formal risk event occurrence.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this phase record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for data governance and lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary values within this phase record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, AED). Supports multi-currency EPC projects and IFRS financial reporting.

attributes.name: deliverables_checklist
attributes.description: Structured list or description of mandatory deliverables required for phase completion (e.g., IFC drawings, BOQ, ITP, commissioning dossier). Stored as a delimited string or JSON-serialized list. Supports phase-gate governance and QA/QC compliance.

attributes.name: deliverables_completion_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of mandatory phase deliverables that have been completed and accepted as of the latest update (0.00–100.00). Supports phase gate readiness assessment and PMO reporting.

attributes.name: delivery_model
attributes.description: The contractual delivery model under which this phase is executed (e.g., EPC - Engineering Procurement Construction, DB - Design-Build, DBB - Design-Bid-Build, PPP - Public-Private Partnership, BOT - Build-Operate-Transfer, GMP - Guaranteed Maximum Price). Determines phase-gate governance rules and contract administration requirements.

attributes.name: phase_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the scope of work, objectives, and key activities encompassed within this project phase. Used in project documentation, client reporting, and PMO governance records.

attributes.name: earned_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earned Value (EV) / Budgeted Cost of Work Performed (BCWP)
attributes.description: The budgeted value of work actually performed to date (BCWP), calculated as phase budget multiplied by percent complete. Core EVM metric used to derive CPI (Cost Performance Index) and SPI (Schedule Performance Index) at the phase level.

tag_set.value: Earned Value (EV) / Budgeted Cost of Work Performed (BCWP)

attributes.name: eot_days_granted
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days of Extension of Time (EOT) formally granted by the client or contract administrator for this phase. Adjusts the contractual completion date and mitigates LD (Liquidated Damages) exposure.

attributes.name: evm_weight_pct
attributes.description: Weighting factor assigned to this phase for EVM (Earned Value Management) rollup to the project level, expressed as a percentage of total project value (0.00–100.00). All phase weights must sum to 100 per project. Drives CPI and SPI calculations.

attributes.name: float_days
attributes.description: Total float (slack) available for this phase in calendar days, as calculated by CPM (Critical Path Method) analysis in Oracle Primavera P6. Negative float indicates a schedule overrun. Used for schedule risk assessment and EOT (Extension of Time) claims.

attributes.name: forecast_finish_date
attributes.description: Current best estimate of the phase completion date based on progress to date and remaining work. Updated periodically in Primavera P6 schedule updates and used for EOT (Extension of Time) analysis.

attributes.name: gate_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the phase gate was formally approved by the authorized approver, permitting progression to the next project phase. Recorded in the PMO governance register and Aconex document management system.

attributes.name: gate_approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the phase gate review. Controls authorization to proceed to the next phase. Managed through PMO governance workflows and documented in Aconex or Procore approval workflows.

attributes.name: gate_approver_name
attributes.description: Name or role title of the individual or authority who approved the phase gate (e.g., Project Director, Client Representative, PMO Head). Provides audit trail for governance accountability.

attributes.name: gate_review_criteria
attributes.description: Textual description of the mandatory completion criteria and deliverables that must be satisfied before the phase gate can be approved and the next phase authorized. Aligned with PMO governance and FIDIC contract requirements.

attributes.name: hse_plan_approved
attributes.business_glossary_term: HSE (Health Safety and Environment) Plan Approved
