attributes.name: weighted_pipeline_value
attributes.description: Estimated contract value multiplied by the probability of win percentage, representing the risk-adjusted contribution of this opportunity to the revenue forecast. Key metric for executive pipeline reporting.

attributes.name: win_loss_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of the opportunity after the bid process concludes. Won = contract awarded to company; Lost = awarded to competitor; Withdrawn = company withdrew bid; No_award = client cancelled procurement. Drives win rate analytics and BD performance reporting.

products.name: interaction
products.description: Log of all formal and informal interactions between the organization and client stakeholders, including meetings, site visits, calls, presentations, entertainment events, and formal correspondence. Captures interaction type, date, duration, participants (internal and external), topics discussed, action items with owners, follow-up due date, interaction outcome, sentiment indicator, and linked opportunity or project reference. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Activity/Task/Event objects. Supports relationship history tracking, account review preparation, and BD activity KPI reporting (interactions per account per quarter).

attributes.name: interaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each client interaction record in the silver layer. Primary key for the client_interaction data product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account (owner, developer, or sponsor) associated with this interaction. Maps to the Salesforce CRM Account object.

attributes.name: client_opportunity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the business development opportunity linked to this interaction, if applicable. Supports pipeline tracking and BD activity KPI reporting. Maps to Salesforce CRM Opportunity object.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active construction project linked to this interaction, if applicable. Supports relationship history tracking against live project engagements.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary client-side stakeholder contact who participated in this interaction. Maps to the Salesforce CRM Contact object.

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee (account manager, BD lead, or project director) who owns and logged this interaction. Maps to SAP SuccessFactors employee record.

attributes.name: action_item_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person (internal or client-side) responsible for completing the primary action item arising from this interaction.

attributes.name: action_items
attributes.description: Free-text description of agreed action items arising from the interaction, including the responsible party and expected completion date. Supports follow-up tracking and accountability management.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Medium through which the interaction was conducted. Distinguishes in-person, virtual (video conference), hybrid, or phone-only engagements. Supports channel mix analytics for BD strategy.

attributes.name: client_seniority_level
attributes.description: Highest seniority level of client-side attendees present at the interaction (e.g., C-Suite, VP/Director, Manager). Supports executive engagement tracking and account strategy analytics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interaction record was first created in the source CRM system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: crm_activity_code
attributes.description: External identifier from the Salesforce CRM Activity, Task, or Event object that is the source of record for this interaction. Enables traceability back to the originating system.

attributes.name: crm_record_type
attributes.description: Salesforce CRM object type from which this interaction record was sourced (Task, Event, Call Log, or Email Log). Supports data lineage and source system traceability.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the entertainment cost amount (e.g., USD, AUD, GBP). Supports multi-currency expense reporting.

attributes.name: interaction_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the interaction including agenda, topics discussed, key decisions made, and context. Supports account review preparation and relationship history tracking.

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the interaction in minutes as recorded by the interaction owner. May be entered directly or derived from start/end timestamps. Supports engagement intensity analysis.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the interaction concluded. Used in conjunction with start timestamp to derive interaction duration for BD activity analytics.

attributes.name: entertainment_cost
attributes.description: Monetary cost incurred for client entertainment events associated with this interaction (e.g., business dinners, hospitality). Subject to anti-bribery and gifts policy compliance. Stored in the organisation's base currency.

attributes.name: external_attendee_count
attributes.description: Total number of client-side or third-party participants in the interaction. Supports stakeholder engagement breadth analysis.

attributes.name: external_attendees
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of client-side or third-party attendees (names and organisations) who participated in the interaction. Supports stakeholder mapping and relationship history tracking.

attributes.name: followup_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required follow-up action arising from this interaction has been completed. Supports BD activity compliance and pipeline hygiene reporting.

attributes.name: followup_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the follow-up action or next interaction should be completed. Used for BD pipeline management and relationship cadence monitoring.

attributes.name: gifts_hospitality_declared
attributes.description: Indicates whether any gifts or hospitality provided during this interaction have been formally declared in accordance with the organisation's anti-bribery and corruption policy. Supports compliance and audit requirements.

attributes.name: interaction_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the interaction took place or is scheduled to take place. Used for BD activity KPI reporting (interactions per account per quarter).

attributes.name: interaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the interaction record. Indicates whether the interaction was planned, successfully completed, cancelled, rescheduled, or resulted in a no-show.

attributes.name: interaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the interaction channel or format. Distinguishes formal meetings, site visits, phone calls, presentations, entertainment events, and formal correspondence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: meeting|site_visit|phone_call|presentation|entertainment|correspondence|video_call|email|workshop|conference — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: internal_attendee_count
attributes.description: Total number of internal employees who participated in the interaction. Supports BD resource allocation analysis and engagement intensity KPIs.

attributes.name: internal_attendees
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of internal employees (names or employee IDs) who participated in the interaction. Supports account review preparation and engagement coverage analysis.

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the time or cost associated with this interaction is billable to the client or project. Relevant for reimbursable contract types (e.g., cost-plus, EPC reimbursable).

attributes.name: is_executive_engagement
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interaction involved C-suite or executive-level participants from either the internal organisation or the client side. Supports executive engagement KPI reporting and account strategy reviews.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interaction record was last updated in the source CRM system. Supports incremental data loading and change data capture in the silver layer.

attributes.name: linked_co_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the Change Order (CO) discussed during this interaction, if applicable. Supports contract administration and commercial dispute tracking.

attributes.name: linked_rfp_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the Request for Proposal (RFP) associated with this interaction, if applicable. Supports bid pursuit tracking and BD pipeline management.

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location where the interaction took place (e.g., client head office address, project site name, video conference platform). Maps to Salesforce CRM Event Location field.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or observations recorded by the interaction owner that supplement the main description. May include informal observations, relationship nuances, or contextual background not captured elsewhere.

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Overall result or conclusion of the interaction as assessed by the interaction owner. Indicates whether the engagement moved the relationship or opportunity forward, was neutral, or raised concerns requiring escalation.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Primary business purpose or intent of the interaction. Distinguishes relationship-building activities from bid pursuit, project review, issue resolution, contract negotiation, or commissioning and handover discussions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: relationship_building|bid_pursuit|project_review|issue_resolution|contract_negotiation|handover|technical_review|commercial_discussion — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sentiment_indicator
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the client's sentiment or disposition observed during the interaction, as recorded by the interaction owner. Supports relationship health monitoring and account review preparation.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the interaction commenced. Supports duration calculation and scheduling analytics. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Event start datetime.

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Brief title or subject line summarising the purpose of the interaction (e.g., 'Q3 Project Review Meeting', 'RFP Clarification Call'). Maps to Salesforce CRM Activity Subject field.

attributes.name: topics_discussed
attributes.description: Structured or free-text list of key topics covered during the interaction (e.g., contract scope, change orders, project schedule, new bid opportunities, relationship concerns). Supports thematic analysis of client engagement.

products.name: project_engagement
products.description: Bridge record linking a client account to a specific construction project they commission, sponsor, or fund. Captures client role (owner, co-sponsor, JV lead, funding agency, end-user), engagement start and end dates, primary client representative, contract reference, engagement status, and satisfaction indicators. SSOT for which clients are involved in which projects from the client domain perspective. Does not duplicate project master data owned by the project domain.

attributes.name: project_engagement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the client project engagement record. Primary key for this bridge entity linking a client account to a specific construction project.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account (owner, developer, sponsor, or funding agency) involved in this engagement. Links to the client master record.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary contract governing this client-project engagement (e.g., EPC, FIDIC, GMP, DB, DBB, or PPP/BOT contract). Links to the contract master record.

attributes.name: client_opportunity_id
attributes.description: The opportunity identifier from the Salesforce CRM system that tracks the sales pipeline record associated with this engagement. Enables traceability from opportunity pursuit through to active project delivery.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project that this client is commissioning, sponsoring, or funding. Links to the project master record.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary contact person designated by the client to represent their interests on this project. Typically the client-side project manager or authorized representative.

attributes.name: project_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Each project engagement is assigned a project manager (HR employee), essential for schedule, cost, and risk reporting.

attributes.name: advance_payment_amount
attributes.description: The value of any advance payment made by the client to the contractor at the commencement of this engagement, typically secured by an advance payment guarantee. Expressed in the contract currency.

attributes.name: approved_variation_value
attributes.description: The cumulative value of all approved Change Orders (CO) / variations issued by the client on this engagement to date. Reflects the net adjustment to the original contract value due to scope changes.

attributes.name: bid_reference_number
attributes.description: The reference number assigned to the original bid or tender submission (RFP/RFQ response) that led to this engagement being awarded. Links the engagement back to the opportunity pipeline in the CRM.

attributes.name: bim_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has mandated Building Information Modeling (BIM) as a contractual deliverable requirement for this engagement. Drives BIM execution plan obligations and Autodesk BIM 360 usage.

attributes.name: client_role
attributes.description: The functional role the client plays in this project engagement. Distinguishes between the primary owner, co-sponsor in a joint venture (JV), lead JV partner, funding agency (e.g., government body), end-user of the completed asset, or developer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: owner|co_sponsor|jv_lead|funding_agency|end_user|developer|ppp_authority|bot_concessionaire — promote to reference product if additional roles are needed]

attributes.name: communication_preference
attributes.description: The client's preferred channel for formal project communications and correspondence on this engagement. Determines how RFIs, submittals, transmittals, and official notices are delivered.

attributes.name: contract_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the contract value and financial commitments in this engagement (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, AED). Required for multi-currency project reporting and IFRS/GAAP compliance.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: The externally-known contract number or agreement reference assigned to the governing contract for this engagement. Used for cross-referencing with contract administration systems and client correspondence.

attributes.name: contract_value
attributes.description: The total awarded contract value for this client-project engagement as agreed at contract execution. Represents the baseline financial commitment from the client. Expressed in the contract currency.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this client-project engagement record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for data governance and lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current status of any formal contractual dispute between the client and the contractor on this engagement. Tracks the dispute resolution lifecycle from initial notice through negotiation, adjudication, or arbitration to resolution.

attributes.name: dlp_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Defects Liability Period (DLP) expires, after which the contractor's obligation to rectify defects at no cost to the client ceases. Critical for contract close-out and final account settlement.

attributes.name: engagement_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the client's formal involvement in the project is expected to conclude or has concluded. Typically aligned with project handover, Defects Liability Period (DLP) expiry, or BOT concession end date. Nullable for open-ended engagements.

attributes.name: engagement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing qualitative notes, special conditions, or contextual information relevant to this client-project engagement that are not captured in structured fields. Used by account managers and project directors.

attributes.name: engagement_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to this client-project engagement. Used in correspondence, transmittals, and CRM tracking to uniquely identify the engagement across systems.

attributes.name: engagement_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the client's formal involvement in the project commenced. Typically aligned with the Notice to Proceed (NTP) date or the contract execution date.

attributes.name: engagement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the client-project engagement. Tracks whether the engagement is actively ongoing, pending formal commencement (awaiting NTP), on hold, completed at project handover, terminated early, or cancelled prior to commencement.

attributes.name: engagement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contractual or commercial arrangement type governing this engagement. Reflects the delivery model: EPC (Engineering Procurement and Construction), Design-Build (DB), Design-Bid-Build (DBB), Public-Private Partnership (PPP), Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT), Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP), framework agreement, or direct award. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: epc|design_build|design_bid_build|ppp|bot|gmp|framework|direct_award — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: eot_days_granted
attributes.description: The total number of calendar days of Extension of Time (EOT) formally granted by the client to the contractor on this engagement to date. Adjusts the contractual completion date and affects LD exposure.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: Classification of the primary funding mechanism used by the client to finance this project engagement. Supports financial risk assessment and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: government_grant|private_equity|bank_loan|bond_issuance|multilateral|internal_budget|mixed|ppp_concession — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: handover_date
attributes.description: The actual or planned date on which the completed project asset was or is expected to be handed over to the client. Marks the transition from construction to the Defects Liability Period (DLP) or Operations and Maintenance (O&M) phase.

attributes.name: hse_requirements_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Requirements Classification
attributes.description: Classification of the HSE (Health, Safety and Environment) requirements imposed by the client for this engagement. Reflects the risk profile and regulatory environment: standard (baseline OSHA/ISO 45001), enhanced (client-specific elevated requirements), or critical (high-hazard environments such as nuclear, offshore, or major infrastructure).

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Requirements Classification

attributes.name: insurance_compliance_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contractor's required insurance policies (e.g., professional indemnity, public liability, contractor's all-risk) have been verified as compliant with the client's contractual requirements for this engagement.

attributes.name: jv_participation_percentage
attributes.description: The client's ownership or participation share percentage in a Joint Venture (JV) arrangement for this project. Applicable when the client role is co-sponsor or JV lead. Null for sole-owner engagements.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this client-project engagement record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: leed_certification_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has mandated LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) certification for the project deliverable as a contractual requirement in this engagement.

tag_set.value: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Required

attributes.name: liquidated_damages_rate
attributes.description: The contractually agreed daily or weekly Liquidated Damages (LD) rate payable by the contractor to the client in the event of project delay beyond the agreed completion date. Expressed in the contract currency per day.

attributes.name: ntp_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Notice to Proceed (NTP) was formally issued by the client to the contractor, authorizing commencement of construction works. A critical contractual milestone in the engagement lifecycle.

attributes.name: performance_bond_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has required the contractor to provide a performance bond as a financial security instrument for this engagement. Affects contract financial structuring and risk management.

attributes.name: procurement_method
attributes.description: The procurement route used by the client to award this engagement. Indicates whether the contract was awarded through open tender, selective tender, direct negotiation, Request for Proposal (RFP), Request for Quotation (RFQ), or a framework call-off.

attributes.name: relationship_tier
attributes.description: Segmentation tier assigned to this client engagement based on strategic importance, revenue contribution, and long-term relationship value. Drives account management priority and resource allocation.

attributes.name: repeat_client
attributes.description: Indicates whether this client has previously engaged the construction company on one or more prior projects. Supports client relationship analytics, win-rate reporting, and strategic account management.

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: The agreed frequency at which formal project progress reports are submitted to the client for this engagement. Governs the reporting cadence for schedule, cost, and HSE performance updates.

attributes.name: retention_percentage
attributes.description: The contractually agreed retention percentage withheld by the client from each progress payment as a performance security. Typically released in two tranches: at practical completion and at DLP expiry.

attributes.name: satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Numeric score representing the client's satisfaction with the construction company's performance on this engagement, typically captured through formal client satisfaction surveys. Scored on a standardized scale (e.g., 1.00–5.00 or 0.00–10.00).

attributes.name: satisfaction_survey_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent client satisfaction survey was conducted for this engagement. Used to track the currency of satisfaction data and schedule follow-up surveys.

attributes.name: sector
attributes.description: Sector classification of the client for this engagement: public-sector (government/municipal), private-sector (commercial developer or corporation), or PPP (Public-Private Partnership arrangement). Supports client segmentation and reporting.

products.name: client_prequalification
products.description: Records prequalification and due diligence assessments that client organizations apply to the construction firm before issuing RFPs or RFQs. Captures prequalification reference number, client account, category (civil, MEP, EPC, marine, tunneling), submission date, expiry date, status (approved, conditional, rejected, expired), conditions imposed, approving authority, and required renewal actions. Critical for bid eligibility tracking — the firm cannot bid on work from a client without active prequalification in the relevant category. [SSOT: distinct source of truth for client domain]

attributes.name: client_prequalification_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each client prequalification record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: bid_prequalification_id
attributes.description: SSOT reference to canonical bid.bid_prequalification resolving cross-domain duplicate.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client/owner organization that issued this prequalification assessment. Links to the master client account record.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee or business development manager responsible for managing and maintaining this prequalification relationship with the client.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the client organization formally approved or conditionally approved the prequalification. Null if not yet approved or if rejected.

attributes.name: approving_authority
attributes.description: Name or designation of the client-side authority (individual, committee, or department) that reviewed and approved or rejected the prequalification submission.

attributes.name: client_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary client contact responsible for this prequalification. Used for submission correspondence and renewal notifications.

attributes.name: client_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person at the client organization responsible for managing this prequalification process.

attributes.name: condition_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date by which all imposed conditions must be resolved or evidenced to the client to convert a conditional approval to full approval.

attributes.name: conditions_imposed
attributes.description: Free-text description of any conditions, restrictions, or requirements imposed by the client as part of a conditional prequalification approval. Null if unconditionally approved.

attributes.name: contract_delivery_method
attributes.description: The project delivery method for which this prequalification applies: Engineering Procurement and Construction (EPC), Design-Build (DB), Design-Bid-Build (DBB), Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP), Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT), or Public-Private Partnership (PPP).

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary jurisdiction in which this prequalification is applicable.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this prequalification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the maximum project value and any financial thresholds in this prequalification record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, AED).

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the prequalification submission document package as stored in the document management system (e.g., Aconex transmittal number or document register ID).

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which the prequalification becomes valid and the firm is eligible to bid on work from this client in the specified category.

attributes.name: environmental_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires ISO 14001 or equivalent environmental management certification as part of the prequalification criteria.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the prequalification ceases to be valid. After this date, the firm is no longer eligible to bid unless renewed. Critical for bid eligibility tracking.

attributes.name: financial_audit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires submission of audited financial statements as part of the prequalification documentation package.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic region, country, or territory for which this prequalification is valid. Prequalification may be limited to specific jurisdictions or project locations.

attributes.name: hse_certification_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Certification Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires valid HSE certifications (e.g., ISO 45001, OSHA compliance) as a mandatory condition of prequalification in this category.

attributes.name: insurance_verification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires proof of adequate insurance coverage (professional indemnity, public liability, workers compensation) as a prequalification condition.

attributes.name: leed_certification_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires LEED certification or demonstrated LEED project experience as a prequalification criterion for sustainable construction projects.

tag_set.value: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Required

attributes.name: max_project_value
attributes.description: The maximum single-project contract value (in the specified currency) for which the firm is prequalified by this client. Bids exceeding this threshold require separate approval or re-prequalification.

attributes.name: minimum_passing_score
attributes.description: The minimum score threshold set by the client that the construction firm must achieve to receive an approved prequalification status in this category.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, internal observations, or strategic notes related to this prequalification record. Confidential as it may contain competitive intelligence.

attributes.name: prequalification_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned by the client organization to this prequalification submission. Used in all correspondence and bid eligibility checks.

attributes.name: prequalification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the prequalification record. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: approved|conditional|rejected|expired|pending|withdrawn — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: procurement_category
attributes.description: Classification of the client procurement arrangement type: public sector, private sector, Public-Private Partnership (PPP), Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT), or Joint Venture (JV). Drives compliance and reporting requirements.

attributes.name: quality_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client mandates a valid ISO 9001 or equivalent quality management system certification as a prequalification requirement.

attributes.name: reference_projects_required
attributes.description: Minimum number of comparable completed projects the client requires the firm to demonstrate as part of the prequalification submission.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided by the client for rejecting the prequalification submission. Populated only when prequalification_status is 'rejected'. Used for gap analysis and resubmission planning.

attributes.name: renewal_actions_required
attributes.description: Free-text description of specific actions, documentation updates, or re-submissions required by the client to successfully renew this prequalification.

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the firm must initiate the renewal process to maintain uninterrupted prequalification status. Typically set before the expiry date to allow processing time.

attributes.name: renewal_period_months
attributes.description: The duration in months of each prequalification validity period before renewal is required. Typically 12, 24, or 36 months depending on client policy.

attributes.name: renewal_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this prequalification requires periodic renewal to remain valid, as opposed to a one-time permanent approval.

attributes.name: rfp_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the firm is currently eligible to receive and respond to RFPs from this client in the specified work category, based on active prequalification status.

attributes.name: rfq_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the firm is currently eligible to receive and respond to RFQs from this client in the specified work category, based on active prequalification status.

attributes.name: score
attributes.description: Numeric score assigned by the client during the prequalification evaluation, typically on a 0–100 scale. Used to rank and compare contractors. Confidential as it reflects competitive assessment.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the construction firm formally submitted its prequalification documentation package to the client organization.

attributes.name: submitted_trir
attributes.description: The firm's actual TRIR value submitted as part of the prequalification documentation, typically based on the most recent 12-month or 3-year rolling average.

attributes.name: trir_threshold

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: work_category

attributes.name: years_experience_required

attributes.name: rfp_issuance_id

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client/owner account that issued this solicitation. Links to the master client account record in the CRM. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Account Management.

attributes.name: client_opportunity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the linked sales opportunity in the CRM pipeline that this RFP issuance is associated with. Enables traceability from solicitation to bid pursuit. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Opportunity Tracking.

attributes.name: rfp_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: RFP issuance is owned by a procurement employee, needed for accountability and audit trails.

attributes.name: addendum_count
attributes.description: The total number of addenda (amendments) issued by the client against this RFP since original issuance. Each addendum modifies the original RFP terms, scope, or schedule. Used to track document version history.

attributes.name: anticipated_award_date
attributes.description: The client's indicative target date for issuing the Notice to Proceed (NTP) or contract award, as stated in the RFP. Used for resource planning, bid team scheduling, and pipeline forecasting in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: anticipated_completion_date
attributes.description: The client's required or indicative project completion date as stated in the RFP. Defines the overall programme duration and is a key input to CPM (Critical Path Method) scheduling and resource planning.

attributes.name: anticipated_start_date
attributes.description: The client's indicative target date for project commencement (Notice to Proceed / NTP) as stated in the RFP. Used for resource mobilisation planning and schedule baseline development in Oracle Primavera P6.

attributes.name: bid_bond_percentage
attributes.description: The bid bond (tender guarantee) value expressed as a percentage of the estimated contract value, as required by the client in the RFP. Typically ranges from 1% to 5% of contract value. Null if bid bond is not required.

attributes.name: bid_bond_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires a bid bond (tender guarantee) to be submitted with the proposal (True) or not (False). Bid bonds protect the client against bidder withdrawal after award.

attributes.name: bid_validity_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days from the submission deadline during which the bidder's proposal must remain valid and binding, as specified in the RFP. Typically 60 to 180 days. Impacts financial exposure and resource commitment.

attributes.name: bim_level
attributes.description: The BIM maturity level required by the client in the RFP: level_1 (CAD-based), level_2 (collaborative BIM with federated models), or level_3 (fully integrated open BIM). Null if BIM is not required.

attributes.name: bim_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client mandates the use of BIM (Building Information Modeling) for design and construction delivery as specified in the RFP (True) or not (False). Impacts technology requirements and Autodesk BIM 360 platform usage.

attributes.name: client_sector
attributes.description: Classification of the client/owner by sector: public (government/public authority), private (private developer/corporation), ppp (Public-Private Partnership arrangement), or jv (Joint Venture client entity). Drives compliance, reporting, and bid strategy.

attributes.name: commercial_score_weight
attributes.description: The percentage weighting assigned to the commercial/price component of the bid evaluation, as specified in the RFP (e.g., 40.00 for 40%). Combined with technical_score_weight to total 100%. Null for quality-only evaluations.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: The pricing and risk-sharing mechanism for the contract as specified in the RFP: lump_sum (fixed price), unit_rate (BOQ-based), cost_plus (reimbursable), target_cost (incentivised), or framework (call-off arrangement). Directly influences bid strategy and cost estimation.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country where the project is located (e.g., USA, GBR, AUS). Used for regulatory compliance, currency, and jurisdictional reporting.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the contract value and financial terms stated in the RFP (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR, AUD). Required for multi-currency financial reporting and IFRS/GAAP compliance.

attributes.name: defects_liability_period_days
attributes.description: The duration of the Defects Liability Period (DLP) in calendar days as specified in the RFP, commencing from the date of practical completion. Typically 365 or 730 days. Impacts warranty provisioning and post-completion resource planning.

attributes.name: delivery_model
attributes.description: The contractual delivery model specified in the RFP: DBB (Design-Bid-Build), DB (Design-Build), EPC (Engineering Procurement and Construction), GMP (Guaranteed Maximum Price), PPP (Public-Private Partnership), BOT (Build-Operate-Transfer), EPCM (Engineering Procurement Construction Management), or CM (Construction Management). Determines risk allocation and bid structure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DBB|DB|EPC|GMP|PPP|BOT|EPCM|CM — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: estimated_contract_value
attributes.description: Client's published or internally estimated value of the contract in the nominated currency. Used for bid/no-bid decision-making, bonding requirements, and pipeline forecasting. May be client-disclosed or internally estimated.

attributes.name: evaluation_criteria
attributes.description: The overall evaluation methodology specified in the RFP for assessing and ranking bids: price_only (lowest price wins), price_quality (weighted price and technical), quality_only (technical merit), best_value (whole-life cost), or pass_fail (compliance-based). Drives bid strategy.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the RFP/RFQ/ITT was formally issued and released to prospective bidders by the client. Represents the principal business event date for this solicitation record.

attributes.name: issued_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this RFP issuance record was first created in the data platform. Represents the audit creation time, distinct from the business issue_date. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp of the most recent modification to this RFP issuance record. Used for change tracking, data synchronisation, and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: latest_addendum_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent addendum issued by the client against this RFP. Null if no addenda have been issued. Used to ensure bidders are working from the latest version of the solicitation document.

attributes.name: leed_certification_level
attributes.description: The minimum LEED certification level required by the client as stated in the RFP: certified, silver, gold, or platinum. Null if LEED certification is not required.

attributes.name: leed_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has specified a LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) certification requirement for the project in the RFP (True) or not (False). Impacts design, materials, and cost estimation.

attributes.name: liquidated_damages_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RFP specifies that Liquidated Damages (LD) will apply for delays or non-performance (True) or not (False). LD clauses are a key risk factor in bid pricing and schedule planning.

attributes.name: liquidated_damages_rate
attributes.description: The daily Liquidated Damages (LD) rate specified in the RFP, expressed in the contract currency. Applied for each calendar day of delay beyond the contractual completion date. Null if LD is not applicable.

attributes.name: local_content_requirement_pct
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of local workforce, materials, or subcontractors required by the client as specified in the RFP. Common in public-sector and government-funded projects. Impacts procurement and subcontractor strategy.

attributes.name: performance_bond_percentage
attributes.description: The performance bond value expressed as a percentage of the contract value, as specified in the RFP. Typically ranges from 5% to 10% of contract value. Null if performance bond is not required.

attributes.name: performance_bond_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires a performance bond to be provided upon contract award (True) or not (False). Performance bonds guarantee the contractor will fulfil contractual obligations.

attributes.name: pre_bid_meeting_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time of the mandatory or optional pre-bid conference/site visit where the client clarifies scope and answers bidder questions. Attendance may be a prerequisite for bid eligibility.

attributes.name: pre_bid_meeting_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether attendance at the pre-bid meeting is mandatory for bid eligibility (True) or optional (False). Mandatory attendance is a common client requirement for complex infrastructure projects.

attributes.name: project_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the project scope, works, and deliverables as outlined in the RFP. Includes key scope elements such as civil works, MEP systems, infrastructure type, and geographic extent.

attributes.name: project_location
attributes.description: Geographic location or address of the proposed project site as stated in the RFP. Used for site visit planning, logistics assessment, and regional market analysis.

attributes.name: project_sector
attributes.description: The industry sector classification of the project as described in the RFP. Used for market segmentation, capability matching, and portfolio analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: infrastructure|energy|commercial|residential|industrial|transport|water|healthcare|education|defence — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: project_title
attributes.description: The official name or title of the project as stated in the RFP document. Provides the primary human-readable description of the work being solicited (e.g., 'Highway 45 Expansion Phase 2', 'Airport Terminal C Construction').

attributes.name: rfp_document_reference
attributes.description: The document control reference number or URL/path to the official RFP package in the document management system (Aconex or Autodesk BIM 360). Enables direct retrieval of the source solicitation document.

attributes.name: rfp_number
attributes.description: Externally-known reference number assigned by the client to uniquely identify this solicitation document (RFP, RFQ, or ITT). Used in all correspondence and bid submissions. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Bid Management or Aconex Document Management.

attributes.name: rfp_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the RFP issuance: draft (being prepared), issued (released to market), amended (addendum issued), closed (submission deadline passed), cancelled (withdrawn by client), or awarded (contract awarded). Drives workflow and reporting.

attributes.name: solicitation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the solicitation document type: RFP (Request for Proposal), RFQ (Request for Quotation), ITT (Invitation to Tender), EOI (Expression of Interest), or RFI (Request for Information). Determines the formality and evaluation process applied.

attributes.name: submission_deadline
attributes.description: The exact date and time by which all bid/proposal submissions must be received by the client. Late submissions are typically disqualified. Critical for bid planning and scheduling in Oracle Primavera P6.

attributes.name: technical_score_weight
attributes.description: The percentage weighting assigned to the technical/quality component of the bid evaluation, as specified in the RFP (e.g., 60.00 for 60%). Combined with commercial_score_weight to total 100%. Null for price-only evaluations.

products.name: account_credit_profile
products.description: Financial creditworthiness and payment behavior profile for each client account, supporting contract terms negotiation and financial risk management. Captures credit limit, approved payment terms (net 30/60/90), average payment days (DSO), overdue balance, external credit rating (D&B, S&P), internal credit score, last credit review date, payment history rating, credit hold status, special payment arrangements (retention release schedules, milestone-based payments), and sovereign risk indicator for government clients. Updated periodically by finance with input from BD for relationship context.

attributes.name: account_credit_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the account credit profile record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account for which this credit profile applies. Links to the master client account entity in the client domain.

attributes.name: credit_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Credit Approved By Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Credit approval workflow tracks the approving HR employee, enabling audit and compliance reports.

tag_set.value: Credit Approved By Employee Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: approved_payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractually approved payment terms for this client account, governing the number of days within which invoices must be settled or the basis on which payments are triggered. Milestone-based and retention-release terms are common in EPC and FIDIC contracts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: net_30|net_45|net_60|net_90|milestone_based|retention_release|advance_payment|progress_claim — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: bd_relationship_context
attributes.description: Business Development (BD) team's qualitative assessment of the strategic importance and relationship health of this client account, used as input to the internal credit scoring process. Strategic key accounts may receive more favourable credit terms.

attributes.name: client_segment
attributes.description: Business segment classification of the client account for credit risk segmentation and portfolio analysis. Supports differentiated credit policies for Public-Private Partnership (PPP), Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT), Joint Venture (JV), and private developer clients. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: public_sector|private_sector|ppp|bot|jv_partner|developer|utility|epc_owner|multilateral — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credit profile record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: credit_approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current credit limit and payment terms were formally approved by the authorised finance approver.

attributes.name: credit_hold_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credit hold was applied to this client account. Null if no credit hold is currently active.

attributes.name: credit_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this client account is currently placed on credit hold, blocking the issuance of new contracts, purchase orders, or progress claims until the hold is resolved. True = credit hold active; False = normal trading.

attributes.name: credit_hold_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the credit hold was applied to this client account. Populated only when credit_hold_flag is True. Supports root-cause analysis and escalation workflows.

attributes.name: credit_insurance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether trade credit insurance has been obtained to cover the financial exposure to this client account. True = credit insurance in place; False = no credit insurance.

attributes.name: credit_insurance_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum insured amount covered by the trade credit insurance policy for this client account. Populated only when credit_insurance_flag is True.

attributes.name: credit_insurance_provider
attributes.description: Name of the trade credit insurance provider covering the exposure to this client account (e.g., Euler Hermes, Coface, Atradius). Populated only when credit_insurance_flag is True.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum approved credit exposure the business is willing to extend to this client account at any point in time, expressed in the profile currency. Used in contract terms negotiation and financial risk management.

attributes.name: credit_limit_change_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of the reason for the most recent change to the credit limit, such as improved payment history, new contract award, rating upgrade, or financial distress. Supports audit trail and governance requirements.

attributes.name: credit_review_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which this client account's credit profile is formally reviewed. 'triggered' indicates review is event-driven (e.g., new contract award, overdue threshold breach) rather than calendar-based.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the credit limit, overdue balance, and all monetary fields on this profile are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, AED, AUD).

attributes.name: current_exposure_amount
attributes.description: Total current financial exposure to this client account, comprising all open invoices (billed but unpaid), unbilled certified work, and retention receivables. Used to assess utilisation against the approved credit limit.

attributes.name: dso_days
attributes.description: Average number of days this client account takes to pay invoices, calculated over the trailing review period. DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) is a key accounts receivable metric used to assess payment behaviour and cash flow risk. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA AR aging analysis.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which the current credit profile terms (credit limit, payment terms, rating) became effective. Supports temporal tracking of credit profile changes over time.

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date until which the current credit profile terms are valid. Null for open-ended profiles. Triggers a review workflow when the current date approaches this date.

attributes.name: external_credit_rating
attributes.description: Credit rating assigned to the client by an external credit rating agency such as Dun & Bradstreet (D&B), Standard & Poor's (S&P), Moody's, or Fitch. Examples: AAA, AA+, BBB-, Ba1, 5A1 (D&B PAYDEX). Null if no external rating is available.

attributes.name: external_rating_agency
attributes.description: Name of the external credit rating agency that issued the external_credit_rating for this client account. Enables multi-agency comparison and source traceability.

attributes.name: external_rating_date
attributes.description: Date on which the external credit rating was issued or last confirmed by the rating agency. Used to assess the currency and relevance of the external rating.

attributes.name: internal_credit_score
attributes.description: Internally calculated credit score assigned to this client account by the finance team, typically on a scale of 0–100 or 0–1000, reflecting payment history, financial strength, project delivery track record, and relationship context provided by Business Development (BD). Higher scores indicate lower credit risk.

attributes.name: last_credit_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent formal credit review was completed by the finance team. Triggers periodic reassessment workflows and ensures credit profiles remain current.

attributes.name: liquidated_damages_exposure_amount
attributes.description: Maximum financial exposure to Liquidated Damages (LD) that the client could apply against the business under active contracts, based on contractual LD rates and project delay risk. Informs credit risk and P&L exposure assessments.

attributes.name: next_credit_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic credit review of this client account. Supports proactive credit management and ensures timely reassessment before contract renewals or new bid submissions.

attributes.name: overdue_balance_amount
attributes.description: Total outstanding invoice balance that has exceeded the approved payment terms due date as of the last credit review or system refresh. A key indicator for credit hold decisions and risk escalation.

attributes.name: payment_history_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative rating of the client's historical payment behaviour based on analysis of invoice settlement patterns, frequency of late payments, and dispute history. Derived from AR aging data in SAP S/4HANA and Viewpoint Vista.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Numeric representation of the approved payment terms expressed as the number of calendar days from invoice date to due date (e.g., 30 for net-30, 60 for net-60). Complements the approved_payment_terms field for precise DSO calculation and aging analysis.

attributes.name: previous_credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Credit limit that was in effect prior to the most recent credit review. Enables trend analysis and audit trail of credit limit changes over time.

attributes.name: profile_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to this credit profile, used in correspondence with finance teams and credit agencies. Format: CP- followed by 6-12 alphanumeric characters.

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the credit profile. 'active' indicates normal trading terms apply; 'credit_hold' indicates all new work or invoicing is blocked pending resolution of overdue balances or risk concerns; 'under_review' indicates a periodic or triggered reassessment is in progress.

attributes.name: retention_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of each progress claim withheld by the client as retention money under the contract, typically released upon practical completion and expiry of the Defects Liability Period (DLP). Standard construction retention rates range from 5% to 10%.

attributes.name: retention_release_terms
attributes.description: Terms governing when withheld retention money is released by the client. Common construction arrangements include 50% on practical completion and 50% on Defects Liability Period (DLP) expiry, or full release on a specific milestone.

attributes.name: sovereign_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the sovereign government entity when sovereign_risk_flag is True. Used for country-level risk aggregation and geopolitical exposure reporting.

attributes.name: sovereign_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this client account is a government entity or state-owned enterprise subject to sovereign risk considerations, including political risk, currency controls, and delayed payment due to public procurement cycles. True = sovereign/government client; False = private sector client.

attributes.name: special_payment_arrangement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a special payment arrangement has been agreed with this client account, such as a retention release schedule, milestone-based payment plan, advance payment structure, or deferred payment agreement. True = special arrangement in place; False = standard terms apply.

attributes.name: special_payment_arrangement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific terms of the special payment arrangement, including key milestones, retention percentages, release conditions, or deferred payment schedules agreed with the client.

attributes.name: special_payment_arrangement_type
attributes.description: Type of special payment arrangement in place for this client account. Populated only when special_payment_arrangement_flag is True. Retention release schedules and milestone-based payments are standard in FIDIC and EPC contracts.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credit profile record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.

products.name: survey
products.description: Structured satisfaction surveys and relationship health assessments administered to client stakeholders at key project milestones (post-award, mid-project, post-handover) and periodic account reviews. Captures survey reference, client account, project reference, survey type (milestone, periodic, ad-hoc), administration date, respondent contact, overall satisfaction score, NPS (Net Promoter Score), relationship health score, strategic importance rating, category scores (quality, schedule, communication, safety), key risks to relationship, verbatim feedback, recommended engagement actions, and follow-up status. SSOT for all client relationship health measurement. Feeds proactive account management, early identification of at-risk relationships, executive account reviews, and continuous improvement programs.

attributes.name: survey_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each client satisfaction survey record. Primary key for the client_survey data product.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account (project owner, developer, or sponsor) against whom this survey is administered. Links to the master client account record in the CRM.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project associated with this survey. Enables project-level relationship health tracking and milestone-based survey correlation.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal account manager or relationship owner responsible for administering this survey and managing the client relationship. Links to the workforce/employee master record.

attributes.name: respondent_contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual stakeholder contact at the client organisation who completed or responded to this survey.

attributes.name: administration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the survey was formally administered or distributed to the client respondent. Principal business event date for this transaction.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The channel or method through which the survey was administered to the client respondent (e.g., email link, online portal, telephone interview, face-to-face meeting, or structured workshop).

attributes.name: client_sector
attributes.description: Sector classification of the client at the time of survey, distinguishing between public-sector, private-sector, Public-Private Partnership (PPP), Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT), and Joint Venture (JV) arrangements. Enables sector-level satisfaction benchmarking.

attributes.name: communication_score
attributes.description: Client-rated score for the quality, frequency, and clarity of communication from the construction company, including reporting, RFI (Request for Information) responses, and stakeholder engagement.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: The type of construction contract under which the associated project is delivered (e.g., EPC – Engineering Procurement and Construction, DB – Design-Build, DBB – Design-Bid-Build, GMP – Guaranteed Maximum Price, FIDIC). Provides commercial context for interpreting satisfaction scores. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: epc|db|dbb|gmp|fidic|cost_plus|lump_sum — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cost_management_score
attributes.description: Client-rated score for the construction company's transparency, accuracy, and control of project costs, including change order (CO) management and budget reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the client survey record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and record provenance.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the client respondent is expected to complete and return the survey. Used for follow-up scheduling and response rate monitoring.

attributes.name: escalation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the survey results have triggered an escalation to senior management or executive leadership due to critically low scores or identified relationship risks.

attributes.name: follow_up_completed_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which all recommended follow-up engagement actions were completed and closed. Used to measure responsiveness and account management effectiveness.

attributes.name: follow_up_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the recommended follow-up engagement actions must be completed. Used for account management task scheduling and overdue action reporting.

attributes.name: follow_up_status
attributes.description: Current status of the follow-up actions identified from this survey. Tracks whether recommended engagement actions have been initiated, completed, or escalated to senior management.

attributes.name: innovation_score
attributes.description: Client-rated score for the construction company's contribution of innovative solutions, value engineering, and use of technologies such as BIM (Building Information Modeling) on the project.

attributes.name: is_anonymous
attributes.description: Indicates whether the survey response was collected anonymously, without recording the respondent's identity. When True, respondent_contact_id must be null. Affects how feedback can be used in account management discussions.

attributes.name: key_risks_summary
attributes.description: Structured summary of the primary risks identified to the client relationship from this survey cycle, including commercial, delivery, communication, and reputational risk themes. Informs account management action planning.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code indicating the language in which the survey was administered and completed (e.g., en, fr, ar, zh-CN). Supports multilingual client engagement in global construction programmes.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the client survey record was most recently modified. Supports incremental data loading in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: nps_category
attributes.description: Derived classification of the respondent based on their NPS score: Promoter (score 9-10), Passive (score 7-8), or Detractor (score 0-6). Used for segmentation in account management and relationship risk reporting.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score (NPS) rating provided by the client respondent on a scale of 0 to 10, indicating likelihood to recommend the construction company to others. Classifies respondents as Promoters (9-10), Passives (7-8), or Detractors (0-6). Key relationship health KPI.

attributes.name: overall_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Numeric rating representing the client's overall satisfaction with the construction company's performance, typically on a scale of 1.00 to 10.00 or 1.00 to 5.00. Primary quantitative outcome of the survey. Feeds executive account reviews and continuous improvement programs.

attributes.name: project_milestone
attributes.description: The specific project lifecycle milestone at which this survey was triggered. Aligns with key construction delivery phases including Notice to Proceed (NTP), practical completion, and Defects Liability Period (DLP) end. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: contract_award|design_completion|construction_start|mid_construction|practical_completion|dlp_end|post_handover — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: Client-rated score for the construction company's quality of workmanship, materials, and deliverables on the associated project. Aligns with QA/QC (Quality Assurance/Quality Control) performance measurement.

attributes.name: recommended_engagement_actions
attributes.description: Documented recommended actions for the account management team to address identified risks, improve satisfaction, and strengthen the client relationship based on survey findings.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to the survey for tracking and correspondence purposes, following the format SVY-YYYY-NNNNNN. Used in Salesforce CRM and client communications.

attributes.name: relationship_health_score
attributes.description: Composite numeric score assessing the overall health of the client relationship, incorporating satisfaction, engagement frequency, issue resolution, and strategic alignment dimensions. Used for proactive account management and early identification of at-risk relationships.

attributes.name: relationship_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessed risk level for the client relationship based on survey outcomes and qualitative feedback. Drives escalation protocols and proactive account management interventions. Critical risk triggers executive review.

attributes.name: repeat_client_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client is a repeat client with prior completed projects with the construction company at the time of survey. Used to contextualise satisfaction trends and loyalty analysis.

attributes.name: respondent_role
attributes.description: The organisational role or title of the client stakeholder who responded to the survey. Used to segment feedback by decision-maker level and ensure appropriate seniority of respondents. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: project_director|project_manager|commercial_manager|technical_lead|executive_sponsor|procurement_manager — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: response_date
attributes.description: The date on which the client respondent submitted their completed survey response. Used to calculate response turnaround time and track engagement timeliness.

attributes.name: safety_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Performance Score
attributes.description: Client-rated score for the construction company's HSE (Health, Safety and Environment) performance on site, including compliance with OSHA standards, incident management, and safety culture visibility.

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Performance Score

attributes.name: schedule_score
attributes.description: Client-rated score for the construction company's adherence to project schedule and milestone delivery commitments. Reflects client perception of Schedule Performance Index (SPI) outcomes.

attributes.name: score_scale_max
attributes.description: The maximum possible value on the scoring scale used for this survey (e.g., 5.00 or 10.00). Required to normalise and compare scores across surveys using different rating scales.

attributes.name: strategic_importance_rating
attributes.description: Internal classification of the client's strategic importance to the business at the time of survey, reflecting revenue contribution, repeat business potential, and market positioning. Informs prioritisation of follow-up actions and executive engagement.

attributes.name: survey_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the survey record. Tracks progression from draft preparation through distribution, response collection, and final completion or cancellation.

attributes.name: survey_type
attributes.description: Classification of the survey by its trigger or cadence. Milestone surveys are administered at defined project lifecycle events (post-award, mid-project, post-handover); periodic surveys follow a fixed calendar schedule; ad-hoc surveys are triggered by specific relationship events. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: milestone|periodic|ad_hoc|post_award|mid_project|post_handover — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: verbatim_feedback
attributes.description: Free-text verbatim comments and qualitative feedback provided by the client respondent. Captures unstructured insights not covered by scored categories. Used for sentiment analysis and continuous improvement programs.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the survey template or questionnaire used for this administration. Ensures comparability of scores across survey cycles and supports longitudinal trend analysis when templates are updated.

products.name: master_services_agreement

domains.name: contract

products.name: agreement
products.description: Master contract record representing the authoritative SSOT for all contractual agreements in the construction domain. Captures FIDIC-based EPC, GMP (Guaranteed Maximum Price), lump-sum, unit-rate, DB (Design-Build), DBB (Design-Bid-Build), PPP (Public-Private Partnership), and BOT (Build-Operate-Transfer) contract types via a type classification attribute. Stores contract identity, scope narrative, detailed scope of works including WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) reference, deliverable descriptions, technical specifications reference, BOQ (Bill of Quantities) linkage, geographic boundaries, and exclusions. Records execution dates, NTP (Notice to Proceed) date, contract value, currency, governing law, dispute resolution mechanism, contract status lifecycle from award through close-out, and particular/special conditions that modify standard form terms. Maintains status transition history for audit and lifecycle analytics. Records all formal amendments including supplemental agreements, deed of variations, and novation agreements with amendment number, type, effective date, revised contract value, revised completion date, and execution status. Serves as the authoritative scope baseline against which change orders and EOT claims are evaluated.

products.name: payment_schedule
products.description: Defines the contractual payment schedule governing when and how much the employer is obligated to pay the contractor, including full advance payment (mobilization payment) lifecycle management. products.name: payment_milestone
products.description: Tracks contractually obligated milestones, key dates, and DLP (Defects Liability Period) obligations within a contract. attributes.description: Identifier of the payment certificate that triggered the retention calculation.

attributes.name: recorded_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Logs the employee entering retention ledger data; needed for financial control and traceability.

attributes.name: contract_milestone_code
attributes.description: Code representing the contract milestone tied to this retention entry.

attributes.name: contract_retention_ledger_status

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: cumulative_retention_balance

attributes.name: effective_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: release_amount

attributes.name: release_date

attributes.name: release_reason

attributes.name: retention_adjustment_amount

attributes.name: retention_adjustment_reason

attributes.name: retention_amount

attributes.name: retention_bond_amount

attributes.name: retention_bond_currency

attributes.name: retention_bond_substituted_flag

attributes.name: retention_entry_number

attributes.name: retention_hold_expiry_date

attributes.name: retention_hold_flag

attributes.name: retention_hold_reason

attributes.name: retention_percentage

attributes.name: retention_release_percentage

attributes.name: retention_release_sequence

attributes.name: retention_release_type

attributes.name: retention_source

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the ledger record.

products.name: scope_of_work
products.description: Defines the detailed scope of works attached to a contract agreement, including WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) reference, deliverable descriptions, technical specifications reference, BOQ (Bill of Quantities) linkage, geographic boundaries, and exclusions. Serves as the authoritative scope baseline against which change orders and EOT (Extension of Time) claims are evaluated. [SSOT: distinct source of truth for contract domain]

attributes.name: scope_of_work_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contract scope record.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Each contract scope belongs to a single agreement; adding agreement_id creates a parent link and eliminates the silo.

attributes.name: boq_id
attributes.description: Reference to the BOQ that quantifies the scope items.

attributes.name: design_scope_id
attributes.description: Reference to canonical single source of truth design.design_scope.design_scope_id

attributes.name: technical_specification_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the technical specification linked to the scope.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the WBS element that the scope aligns to.

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: Actual date work on the scope was completed.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date work on the scope began.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the scope was formally approved.

attributes.name: attachments_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether supporting documents are attached to the scope record.

attributes.name: change_order_count

attributes.name: city

attributes.name: compliance_requirements

attributes.name: country_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the scope record was first created.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: dlp_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the defects liability period expires.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the scope ceases to be binding (nullable for open‑ended scopes).

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: eot_entitlement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scope includes entitlement to extensions of time.

attributes.name: exclusions

attributes.name: geographic_area
attributes.description: Textual description of the geographic boundaries covered by the scope.

attributes.name: inclusions
attributes.description: Text describing work items explicitly included in the scope.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the primary site for the scope.

attributes.name: liquidated_damages_amount

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the primary site for the scope.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: Planned completion date for the scope.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Planned start date for execution of the scope.

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the total quantity (e.g., cubic meters, kilograms).

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Region or state within the country for the scope location.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision number for the scope document.

attributes.name: risk_level

attributes.name: scope_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the scope of works.

attributes.name: scope_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name or title of the scope of works.

attributes.name: scope_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the scope.

attributes.name: scope_type
attributes.description: Classification of the scope (e.g., design, construction, procurement).

attributes.name: site_address
attributes.description: Full postal address of the construction site.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the scope before taxes and adjustments.

attributes.name: total_quantity

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: version_number

attributes.name: wbs_reference

domains.name: site
domains.description: Owns daily site execution data including daily logs, production tracking, work fronts, crew assignments, site logistics, mobilization/demobilization, concrete pours, earthworks volumes, and field progress measurements.
