Integrates with HCSS HeavyJob for cost coding and production tracking and Procore for daily logs and field management. Supports earned value computation feeding the project domain.

products.name: work_front
products.description: Master record for each active work front (zone, area, or face) on a construction site where concurrent work activities are executed. Tracks work front identity, location coordinates (GPS/grid reference), zone classification, active/inactive status, assigned foreman, mobilization date, demobilization date, current phase, associated WBS element, and parent site reference. Serves as the primary spatial and organizational anchor for all site-level transactional records — every operational product in this domain holds a mandatory or optional FK to work_front. The work_front-centric topology enables spatial aggregation of production, cost, progress, and resource data by zone.

attributes.name: work_front_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the work front record. Primary key for the work_front master entity in the site domain.

attributes.name: design_scope_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.design_scope. Business justification: Each work front operates under a defined design scope package; linking supports scope‑freeze and change‑control processes.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce record of the foreman assigned as the primary supervisor responsible for day-to-day execution at this work front.

attributes.name: finance_cost_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_code. Business justification: Cost allocation reports require each work front to reference the central cost code for budgeting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: firm_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subcontractor entity responsible for executing work at this work front when is_subcontracted is True. Null for self-performed work fronts.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_party. Business justification: Each work front is assigned a primary contract party (sub‑contractor or client) for responsibility, invoicing and performance tracking.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.site. Business justification: A work front belongs to a single construction site; adding work_front.site_id creates the required parent relationship and eliminates site isolation.

attributes.name: subcontract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.subcontract. Business justification: Work fronts are executed under specific subcontract contracts; linking enables schedule, cost and risk integration.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element that governs the scope of work executed at this work front. Aligns spatial execution with the project schedule hierarchy.

attributes.name: work_construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent project under which this work front is executed. Enables roll-up of work front data to project-level reporting and earned value computation.

attributes.name: work_site_construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent construction site to which this work front belongs. Every work front must be anchored to a site.

attributes.name: access_restriction
attributes.description: The access control classification for this work front. 'permit_required' indicates a Permit to Work (PTW) is mandatory before entry; 'restricted_zone' limits access to authorised personnel; 'exclusion_zone' prohibits all non-essential access. Supports HSE compliance.

attributes.name: actual_crew_size
attributes.description: The actual number of direct labour workers present at this work front on the most recent reporting day. Compared against planned_crew_size to identify under-manning and productivity risks.

attributes.name: actual_production_qty
attributes.description: Cumulative actual production quantity achieved at this work front to date, expressed in the production_unit. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob production tracking and field measurements. Used to compute earned value.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which work commenced at this work front. Compared against planned_start_date to compute schedule variance. Sourced from Procore daily logs or HCSS HeavyJob time tracking.

attributes.name: area_sqm
attributes.description: Total plan area of the work front in square metres. Used as the principal quantitative measure of the resource for production rate calculations, crew density planning, and progress measurement.

attributes.name: bim_model_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this work front to the corresponding spatial object or zone in the Autodesk BIM 360 model. Enables clash detection results and design revisions to be associated with the correct work front.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this work front record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for data lineage and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: current_phase
attributes.description: The current construction phase being executed at this work front (e.g., 'Earthworks', 'Foundation', 'Structural', 'MEP Rough-In', 'Finishing', 'Commissioning'). Aligns with the project schedule phase hierarchy in Oracle Primavera P6. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: earthworks|foundation|structural|mep_rough_in|finishing|commissioning|handover — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: demobilization_date
attributes.description: The date on which all resources were demobilized from this work front and active work ceased. Null if the work front is still active. Used to calculate work front duration and close out cost codes.

attributes.name: drawing_reference
attributes.description: The primary engineering drawing number(s) or revision reference applicable to the work front. Used to ensure field execution aligns with the current approved-for-construction (AFC) drawings managed in Aconex or Autodesk BIM 360.

attributes.name: elevation_m
attributes.description: Reference elevation of the work front above mean sea level in metres. Critical for earthworks volume calculations, drainage design, and structural level control.

attributes.name: environmental_sensitivity
attributes.description: Classification of the environmental sensitivity of the work front location. 'sensitive' and 'protected' areas require additional environmental controls and monitoring per ISO 14001 and EPA requirements. 'remediation_required' indicates contaminated ground conditions.

attributes.name: forecast_finish_date
attributes.description: Current forecast date for completion of all work at this work front, updated based on actual progress and remaining work. Supports look-ahead scheduling and early warning of delays.

attributes.name: front_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the work front within the project or site. Used in daily logs, production reports, and cost coding in HCSS HeavyJob and Procore.

attributes.name: front_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the work front (e.g., 'Zone A – Pile Cap Excavation', 'North Abutment Face'). Used in daily logs, progress reports, and field management interfaces.

attributes.name: front_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the work front. 'mobilizing' indicates resources are being deployed; 'active' indicates concurrent work is in progress; 'suspended' indicates a temporary hold; 'demobilized' indicates resources have been withdrawn; 'completed' indicates all planned work is finished.

attributes.name: front_type
attributes.description: Classification of the spatial unit represented by this work front. Distinguishes between zone (broad area), area (defined boundary), face (excavation or structural face), sector, corridor, level (floor/elevation), or bay. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: zone|area|face|sector|corridor|level|bay — promote to reference product if additional types are required]

attributes.name: grid_reference
attributes.description: Site-specific grid reference or chainage notation (e.g., 'Grid E5-F6', 'CH 1+200 to CH 1+450') used in engineering drawings and BIM models to locate the work front. Complements GPS coordinates for internal site navigation.

attributes.name: heavyjob_cost_center
attributes.description: The cost center identifier in HCSS HeavyJob associated with this work front. Used for field-level cost allocation, equipment hour tracking, and production rate reporting.

attributes.name: hse_risk_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Risk Level
attributes.description: The assessed HSE risk level for this work front based on the activities being performed, proximity to hazards, and environmental conditions. Drives frequency of safety inspections and toolbox meetings (TBM) requirements.

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Risk Level

attributes.name: is_critical_path
attributes.description: Indicates whether this work front contains activities on the project critical path as determined by the CPM schedule in Oracle Primavera P6. Critical path work fronts receive priority resource allocation and daily progress monitoring.

attributes.name: is_subcontracted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the work at this work front is executed by a subcontractor rather than the general contractor's own workforce. Drives subcontractor management workflows and contract administration processes.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this work front record was most recently modified. Used for incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate of the work front centroid or reference point in decimal degrees (WGS84). Enables spatial aggregation and GIS-based reporting of production and progress data.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate of the work front centroid or reference point in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used alongside latitude for spatial mapping and IoT sensor integration.

attributes.name: mobilization_date
attributes.description: The date on which resources (crew, equipment, materials) were first mobilized to this work front and active work commenced. Marks the start of the work front lifecycle for scheduling and cost tracking.

attributes.name: percent_complete
attributes.description: Current physical percent complete of all planned work at this work front, expressed as a value between 0.00 and 100.00. Sourced from field progress measurements and used as input to earned value computation in the project domain.

attributes.name: planned_crew_size
attributes.description: The planned number of direct labour workers assigned to this work front per shift as defined in the resource-loaded schedule. Used for crew density analysis and productivity benchmarking.

attributes.name: planned_finish_date
attributes.description: Baseline-scheduled finish date for all work activities at this work front as defined in the project schedule. Used for schedule performance index (SPI) calculation and look-ahead planning.

attributes.name: planned_production_qty
attributes.description: Total planned production quantity for this work front expressed in the production_unit. Derived from the Bill of Quantities (BOQ) and used as the budget quantity for earned value computation.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Baseline-scheduled start date for work activities at this work front as defined in the project schedule (Oracle Primavera P6). Used for schedule variance analysis and earned value computation.

attributes.name: procore_location_reference
attributes.description: The location identifier assigned to this work front in the Procore construction management system. Used to link daily logs, RFIs, submittals, and change orders to the correct spatial location.

attributes.name: production_unit
attributes.description: The primary unit of measure used to track production output at this work front (e.g., 'm3' for earthworks, 'LM' for piling, 'm2' for formwork, 'tonnes' for steel erection). Aligns with the Bill of Quantities (BOQ) unit for earned value computation.

attributes.name: quality_itp_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number of the Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) applicable to the primary activities at this work front. Links field execution to the QA/QC management system and NCR tracking.

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: The shift working pattern applied at this work front. Determines daily productive hours available for scheduling and cost rate calculations.

attributes.name: swms_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number of the approved Safe Work Method Statement (SWMS) applicable to the primary activities at this work front. Links field execution to the HSE management system in Intelex.

attributes.name: weather_sensitivity
attributes.description: Classification of how sensitive the work activities at this work front are to adverse weather conditions. 'high' sensitivity work fronts (e.g., concrete pours, earthworks) require weather monitoring and contingency planning.

attributes.name: zone_classification
attributes.description: Discipline-based classification of the work front zone indicating the primary trade or engineering discipline active at this location. Supports resource planning and subcontractor assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: civil|structural|mep|architectural|earthworks|piling|finishing|commissioning — promote to reference product]

products.name: daily_log
products.description: Official daily site log (header + line-item structure) capturing all field activities for a given project site and date. The header records weather conditions (temperature, precipitation, wind), site access status, manpower headcount by trade, equipment on site, work performed narrative, superintendent sign-off, and overall site status. Embedded line-item events capture each notable occurrence including delay events, weather stoppages, utility strikes, design holds, access restrictions, and safety observations — each with event type, start/end time, duration, affected work fronts, root cause classification, responsible party, and EOT/cost impact flags. This is the SSOT for all site event data — no separate event entity exists. Sourced from Procore Daily Logs module. Serves as the legal and operational record of site activity and the primary evidence base for delay claims and EOT substantiation.

attributes.name: daily_log_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the daily site log record. Primary key for the daily_log data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: activity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to schedule.activity. Business justification: Daily Log records activities performed each day; linking to schedule.activity enables daily progress reports and variance analysis.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Daily logs are billed to the governing contract; linking enables cost allocation and compliance reporting per agreement.

attributes.name: compliance_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Daily logs must reference the active permit governing that day's work to satisfy HSE audit trails and permit compliance verification.

attributes.name: daily_construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the project this daily log belongs to. Links the site log to the master project record for earned value and cost control reporting.

attributes.name: daily_site_construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical construction site or work front location where this daily log was recorded. Supports multi-site project tracking.

attributes.name: drawing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.drawing. Business justification: Daily Log reports reference the specific design drawing used for the day's work; required for progress audit and compliance.

attributes.name: incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.incident. Business justification: REQUIRED: Daily logs capture any incident that occurred that day; the FK enables quick incident lookup from the log.

attributes.name: primary_daily_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the site superintendent responsible for completing and signing off this daily log. The accountable party for the legal and operational record of site activity.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the daily log was formally approved by the project manager or designated reviewer. Marks the transition from submitted to approved status in the log lifecycle.

attributes.name: concrete_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total volume of concrete poured on site for the log date in cubic metres. Critical production metric for structural progress tracking, QA/QC compliance (ITP), and earned value computation. Sourced from Procore and HCSS HeavyJob.

attributes.name: cost_code
attributes.description: HCSS HeavyJob cost code assigned to the primary work activity recorded in this daily log. Enables direct integration between field production data and job costing in Viewpoint Vista and SAP S/4HANA Project Systems.

attributes.name: cost_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any event recorded in this daily log has been flagged as having a potential cost impact requiring a Change Order (CO) or variation claim. True triggers cost impact assessment and contract administration workflow.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this daily log record was first created in the system. Audit trail timestamp for data lineage and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: direct_labour_count
attributes.description: Number of direct (GC-employed) workers on site for the log date, excluding subcontractor personnel. Used for workforce planning, payroll reconciliation, and labour productivity benchmarking.

attributes.name: earthworks_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total volume of earthworks (cut, fill, or excavation) completed on site for the log date in cubic metres. Key production quantity for earned value computation, BOQ progress measurement, and HCSS HeavyJob production tracking.

attributes.name: eot_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any event recorded in this daily log has been flagged as having a potential Extension of Time (EOT) impact on the project programme. True initiates EOT substantiation documentation under FIDIC Clause 8.4 or applicable contract conditions.

attributes.name: equipment_count
attributes.description: Total number of major equipment units (plant and machinery) present and operational on site for the log date. Used for equipment utilisation tracking, cost coding in HCSS HeavyJob, and mobilisation/demobilisation records.

attributes.name: event_count
attributes.description: Total number of embedded line-item events (delay events, weather stoppages, utility strikes, design holds, access restrictions, safety observations) recorded within this daily log header. Supports event density analytics and claim complexity assessment.

attributes.name: has_delay_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more delay events were recorded in the embedded line-item events for this daily log. True triggers downstream delay analysis workflows and EOT claim tracking. Key filter for delay analytics.

attributes.name: has_safety_observation
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more HSE safety observations or incidents were recorded in the embedded line-item events for this daily log. True triggers integration with Intelex HSE management for incident reporting and corrective action workflows.

attributes.name: hcss_log_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this daily log to the corresponding field operations record in HCSS HeavyJob. Supports production tracking reconciliation and cost code validation between Procore and HCSS.

attributes.name: log_date
attributes.description: The calendar date for which this daily site log records field activities. The principal business event date — one log per project site per calendar day. Drives schedule performance and delay analysis.

attributes.name: log_number
attributes.description: Externally-known sequential log number assigned by the construction management system (Procore) for this daily log. Used as the human-readable business identifier in correspondence, delay claims, and EOT substantiation. Format: DL-{ProjectCode}-{Year}-{Sequence}.

attributes.name: log_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the daily log record. Draft indicates in-progress field entry; submitted indicates superintendent sign-off pending review; approved indicates accepted by project management; rejected indicates returned for correction; void indicates cancelled/superseded entry.

attributes.name: lti_occurred_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Lost Time Injury (LTI) occurred on site on this log date. True triggers mandatory incident reporting to Intelex HSE system, regulatory notification under OSHA, and TRIR (Total Recordable Incident Rate) calculation update.

attributes.name: ncr_raised_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Non-Conformance Report (NCR) was raised on this log date. True triggers integration with the QA/QC management workflow and requires corrective action documentation per ISO 9001.

attributes.name: overall_site_status
attributes.description: High-level classification of site productivity for the log date. Productive indicates full operations; partially_productive indicates reduced output due to delays or restrictions; non_productive indicates no billable work performed; shutdown indicates planned or emergency site closure.

attributes.name: permit_to_work_count
attributes.description: Number of active Permits to Work (PTW) issued and in force on site for the log date. Supports HSE compliance monitoring, Intelex PTW tracking, and regulatory audit evidence for high-risk work activities.

attributes.name: planned_activities_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text description of the construction activities that were planned for the log date per the project schedule. Compared against work_performed_narrative to identify schedule variances and support look-ahead planning.

attributes.name: precipitation_mm
attributes.description: Total rainfall or precipitation recorded at the site in millimetres for the log date. Key metric for weather delay claims, earthworks productivity assessment, and EOT substantiation under FIDIC Clause 8.4.

attributes.name: procore_log_reference
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this daily log record in the Procore Construction Management platform. Enables traceability and reconciliation between the Silver Layer data product and the operational system of record.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional free-text remarks or notes entered by the superintendent for items not captured in structured fields or the work performed narrative. Provides supplementary context for project management review and legal record completeness.

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Type of work shift recorded in this daily log. Distinguishes day, night, double-shift, or split-shift operations. Relevant for overtime cost tracking, HSE fatigue management, and productivity benchmarking.

attributes.name: site_access_status
attributes.description: Operational access status of the construction site for the log date. Closed or restricted access directly impacts productivity and supports delay claim documentation. Partial indicates some work fronts accessible.

attributes.name: subcontractor_count
attributes.description: Number of subcontractor personnel on site for the log date. Supports subcontractor performance monitoring, site coordination, and contract administration.

attributes.name: superintendent_sign_off_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the site superintendent formally signed off and submitted the daily log. Establishes the legal record timestamp for the site activity log. Critical for delay claim and EOT substantiation timelines.

attributes.name: tbm_conducted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Toolbox Meeting (TBM) was conducted on site for the log date. Mandatory HSE compliance indicator. True confirms daily safety briefing was held per SWMS (Safe Work Method Statement) requirements.

attributes.name: temperature_high_c
attributes.description: Highest recorded ambient temperature at the site in degrees Celsius for the log date. Used for concrete pour suitability assessment, HSE heat stress monitoring, and weather delay substantiation.

attributes.name: temperature_low_c
attributes.description: Lowest recorded ambient temperature at the site in degrees Celsius for the log date. Used for cold weather concreting assessment, frost protection requirements, and weather delay substantiation.

attributes.name: total_delay_duration_hrs
attributes.description: Aggregate duration in hours of all delay events recorded in the embedded line-item events for this daily log. Used for schedule impact quantification, EOT claim substantiation, and SPI (Schedule Performance Index) computation.

attributes.name: total_manpower_count
attributes.description: Total number of workers (all trades combined) present on site for the log date. Includes direct labour and subcontractor personnel. Key input for productivity analysis, earned value computation, and labour cost reconciliation against HCSS HeavyJob cost codes.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this daily log record was last modified. Supports incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer and audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: visitor_count
attributes.description: Number of authorised visitors (client representatives, inspectors, auditors, regulatory officials) on site for the log date. Supports site access management, HSE induction compliance, and client engagement tracking.

attributes.name: wbs_code
attributes.description: Primary WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) code associated with the dominant work activity performed on this log date. Links site production data to the project schedule in Oracle Primavera P6 for earned value and progress reporting.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Observed general weather condition at the site for the log date. Used to substantiate weather-related delay claims, EOT applications, and force majeure events under FIDIC contract provisions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|partly_cloudy|overcast|rain|heavy_rain|snow|fog|storm|extreme_heat — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: wind_speed_kmh
attributes.description: Recorded wind speed at the site in kilometres per hour for the log date. Used to assess crane and elevated work restrictions, HSE compliance, and weather-related work stoppages.

attributes.name: work_performed_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text superintendent narrative describing all construction activities performed on site during the log date. Serves as the primary operational record and legal evidence base for progress claims, delay substantiation, and EOT applications. Sourced from Procore Daily Logs.

products.name: production_entry
products.description: Granular production tracking record capturing quantities of work completed per activity, cost code, and work front for a specific date. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob production tracking module. Stores installed quantity, unit of measure, production rate (units/hour), budgeted quantity, percent complete, crew size, equipment hours consumed, and cost code. Feeds earned value computation and progress billing in the project and finance domains.

attributes.name: production_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each granular production tracking record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the production_entry data product.

attributes.name: activity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled activity (Work Breakdown Structure task) against which production quantities are being reported. Sourced from Oracle Primavera P6 activity planning module.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.asset. Business justification: Production reports require linking installed quantities to the specific equipment used for cost allocation and utilization analysis.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project under which this production entry is recorded. Links production quantities to the project domain for earned value computation.

attributes.name: cost_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost code used to classify and track the financial dimension of this production entry. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob cost coding module and aligned with SAP S/4HANA job costing.

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Reference to the crew or gang assigned to execute the production work for this entry. Links to workforce domain for labor cost and productivity analysis.

attributes.name: daily_log_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.daily_log. Business justification: production_entry contains a daily_log_reference string that points to a daily log; adding a proper FK (daily_log_id) normalizes the model and eliminates the redundant column.

attributes.name: foreman_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Production entry must record the foreman responsible for the work; required for safety audit and accountability in daily production reports.

attributes.name: technical_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.technical_specification. Business justification: Production entries track installed quantities against technical specifications to ensure quality and contractual compliance.

attributes.name: work_front_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific work front or work zone on site where production was executed. Enables spatial breakdown of production progress across the site.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the site engineer, superintendent, or project manager who approved this production entry. Required for audit trail and progress billing authorization.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this production entry was formally approved by the authorized reviewer. Marks the transition from submitted to approved status and triggers downstream earned value and billing computations.

attributes.name: budgeted_production_rate
attributes.description: The planned or budgeted production rate for this activity and cost code expressed as units per labor-hour. Sourced from the project estimate and HCSS HeavyJob budget. Used to compute production efficiency variance against actual production_rate.

attributes.name: budgeted_quantity
attributes.description: The total budgeted or planned quantity for this activity and cost code as established in the project budget and BOQ (Bill of Quantities). Used as the denominator for percent complete calculation and EVM (Earned Value Management) analysis.

attributes.name: change_order_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the approved Change Order (CO) that authorized a scope or quantity revision reflected in this production entry. Links production tracking to contract administration for cost and schedule impact analysis.

attributes.name: cost_code
attributes.description: The alphanumeric cost code string from HCSS HeavyJob used to classify the type of work for job costing and budget tracking. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA cost element structure.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this production entry record was first created in the source system (HCSS HeavyJob). Serves as the audit trail creation marker for data lineage and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: crew_size
attributes.description: The number of workers (headcount) assigned to this production activity on the entry date. Used for labor productivity analysis, crew efficiency benchmarking, and workforce planning.

attributes.name: cumulative_quantity
attributes.description: The total quantity of work installed to date for this activity and cost code, inclusive of the current entry. Represents the running total used for percent complete and progress billing milestone verification.

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the production quantities were recorded. Represents the actual field execution date, not the data entry date. Core dimension for daily progress reporting and schedule performance analysis.

attributes.name: entry_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for this production entry as assigned by the source system (HCSS HeavyJob). Used for cross-system traceability and field reference. Format: PE-[YYYYMMDD]-[SEQ].

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the production entry record. Drives approval routing and determines whether quantities are included in earned value and progress billing computations.

attributes.name: equipment_hours
attributes.description: Total equipment operating hours consumed on this production activity for the entry date. Aggregated across all equipment units deployed. Used for equipment cost allocation, utilization analysis, and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: installed_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of work physically installed or completed during the entry date for this activity and cost code. This is the primary production measurement used to compute earned value and progress billing. Expressed in the unit of measure defined by unit_of_measure.

attributes.name: is_baseline_revision
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production entry reflects a revision to the baseline budgeted quantity due to an approved Change Order (CO) or scope change. When true, the budgeted_quantity reflects the revised baseline.

attributes.name: is_rework
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production entry represents rework (corrective re-execution of previously completed work) rather than new production. Rework quantities are tracked separately for quality cost analysis and NCR (Non-Conformance Report) linkage.

attributes.name: itp_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) checkpoint associated with this production entry. Confirms that quality hold points or witness points have been satisfied before production quantities are accepted for earned value credit.

attributes.name: labor_hours
attributes.description: Total labor hours expended by the crew on this production activity for the entry date. Includes all direct labor hours charged to this cost code. Used as the denominator for production rate calculation and labor cost analysis.

attributes.name: ncr_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the Non-Conformance Report (NCR) associated with this production entry when is_rework is true. Enables traceability between rework production and quality non-conformances for QA/QC reporting.

attributes.name: percent_complete
attributes.description: The percentage of the total budgeted quantity that has been physically installed as of this entry date, calculated as (cumulative_quantity / budgeted_quantity) × 100. Feeds schedule performance index (SPI) and earned value computation in the project domain.

attributes.name: production_rate
attributes.description: The measured production rate for this entry expressed as units of work completed per labor-hour (e.g., CY/hr, LF/hr). Calculated from installed_quantity divided by total labor hours. Used for productivity benchmarking, crew efficiency analysis, and future bid estimation.

attributes.name: production_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of construction production activity being tracked. Enables domain-specific productivity benchmarking and reporting across earthworks, concrete, structural, MEP (Mechanical Electrical and Plumbing), and other work categories. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: earthworks|concrete|structural_steel|paving|MEP|formwork|rebar|masonry|finishing|demolition|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for field supervisors or engineers to record contextual notes about the production entry, including reasons for production variances, site conditions, delays, or other relevant observations not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: The work shift during which this production was executed. Enables shift-based productivity analysis and supports overtime cost tracking and labor compliance reporting.

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The native primary key or record identifier of this production entry in the originating source system (e.g., HCSS HeavyJob internal ID). Enables reverse traceability from the lakehouse silver layer back to the operational system of record.

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this production entry was submitted for approval by the field team. Used for workflow SLA tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: temperature_c
attributes.description: Recorded ambient temperature in degrees Celsius at the work front on the entry date. Used to assess weather-related productivity impacts, validate concrete pour conditions per ACI standards, and support EOT (Extension of Time) claims.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure applicable to the installed_quantity and budgeted_quantity fields (e.g., CY for cubic yards, LF for linear feet, SF for square feet, EA for each, TON, M3, M2). Sourced from the BOQ (Bill of Quantities) and HCSS HeavyJob. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CY|LF|SF|EA|TON|M3|M2|LM|KG|HR — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this production entry record was last modified. Tracks revisions to production quantities, status changes, or corrections. Used for data lineage and change audit trail.

attributes.name: wbs_code
attributes.description: The Work Breakdown Structure code identifying the hierarchical position of the work item within the project scope. Enables roll-up of production quantities to WBS summary levels for EVM reporting.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: The prevailing weather condition on site during the production entry date. Recorded to support analysis of weather impacts on productivity, substantiate Extension of Time (EOT) claims, and validate production rate variances. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|cloudy|rain|heavy_rain|snow|fog|extreme_heat|wind — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: work_front_location
attributes.description: Descriptive location identifier for the work front or zone where production was executed (e.g., 'Zone A — Grid 1-5', 'Pier 3 Foundation', 'Runway 2 Subbase'). Supports spatial analysis and site logistics planning.

attributes.name: work_item_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the specific work item or scope of work being tracked in this production entry (e.g., 'Concrete pour — Column Grid A1-A5', 'Earthworks cut — Zone 3'). Sourced from BOQ (Bill of Quantities) or activity description.

products.name: crew_deployment
products.description: Daily assignment record linking a named crew or gang to a specific work front, activity, and cost code for a given date. Captures crew type (civil, MEP, concrete, steel erection), crew size, lead foreman, shift start/end times, overtime flag, productivity notes, and planned vs actual hours. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob time tracking. Holds mandatory FK to work_front for spatial allocation. Distinct from workforce domain employee records — this entity tracks the operational deployment of crews to site activities, not individual labor records.

attributes.name: crew_deployment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each daily crew deployment record. Primary key for the crew_deployment data product in the site domain Silver layer.

attributes.name: activity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled activity (Work Breakdown Structure task) from Oracle Primavera P6 to which this crew is assigned. Enables schedule performance tracking and earned value computation.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.asset. Business justification: Crew deployment plans include equipment assigned to each crew; needed for resource planning and equipment utilisation tracking.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project under which this crew deployment is recorded. Links deployment records to project-level earned value and cost control.

attributes.name: daily_log_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.daily_log. Business justification: crew_deployment records reference a daily log via the string field daily_log_reference; converting to a proper FK (daily_log_id) enforces referential integrity and removes the redundant string column.

attributes.name: finance_cost_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_code. Business justification: Crew deployment cost tracking uses finance cost codes to aggregate labor costs per activity for payroll and project costing.

attributes.name: firm_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subcontractor entity if this crew is supplied by a subcontractor rather than the general contractor's direct workforce. Null for self-performed work. Supports subcontractor cost tracking and performance management.

attributes.name: lead_foreman_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the lead foreman from the workforce system (SAP SuccessFactors). Enables linkage to workforce domain records without duplicating personal data.

attributes.name: work_front_id
attributes.description: Mandatory reference to the work front (spatial zone or work face) to which this crew is deployed. Establishes the spatial allocation of the crew on site for the given date.

attributes.name: actual_hours
attributes.description: Total man-hours actually worked by the crew on this deployment date, as recorded in HCSS HeavyJob time tracking. Compared against planned_hours to compute productivity variance and feed EVM calculations.

attributes.name: actual_production_qty
attributes.description: Actual quantity of work output achieved by the crew on this deployment date, as recorded in HCSS HeavyJob production tracking. Compared against planned_production_qty for productivity analysis and earned value computation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this crew deployment record was first created in the data platform. Audit trail field for data governance and lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: crew_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric business identifier for the crew or gang as defined in HCSS HeavyJob (e.g., 'CIV-A', 'CONC-03'). Used for cost coding and production tracking lookups.

attributes.name: crew_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation of the crew or gang being deployed (e.g., 'Civil Gang A', 'Concrete Pour Crew 3', 'Steel Erection Team North'). Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob crew master.

attributes.name: crew_size
attributes.description: Total number of workers (headcount) in the deployed crew or gang for this date. Used for productivity analysis, labour cost coding, and HSE compliance checks.

attributes.name: crew_type
attributes.description: Classification of the crew by trade discipline. Drives resource planning, productivity benchmarking, and cost code allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: civil|mep|concrete|steel_erection|earthworks|finishing|specialist|formwork|rebar|waterproofing — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: delay_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardised code identifying the primary reason for any production delay or underperformance on this deployment (e.g., WEATHER, MATERIAL_SHORTAGE, EQUIPMENT_BREAKDOWN, DESIGN_CHANGE, PERMIT_DELAY). Supports delay analysis and EOT claims. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WEATHER|MATERIAL_SHORTAGE|EQUIPMENT_BREAKDOWN|DESIGN_CHANGE|PERMIT_DELAY|LABOUR_SHORTAGE|REWORK|SAFETY_STOP — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: deployment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the crew is deployed to the work front. The principal business event date for this daily deployment record. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: deployment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this crew deployment record, typically generated by HCSS HeavyJob (e.g., CD-2024-00123). Used for cross-system referencing and field reporting.

attributes.name: deployment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the crew deployment record. Tracks whether the deployment is planned, actively in progress, completed, cancelled, or suspended due to site conditions.

attributes.name: hse_toolbox_meeting_held
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Toolbox Meeting (TBM) Held Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Toolbox Meeting (TBM) was conducted with this crew prior to commencing work on this deployment date (True) or not (False). Mandatory HSE compliance check per OSHA and ISO 45001 requirements.

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Toolbox Meeting (TBM) Held Flag

attributes.name: is_overtime
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crew deployment involved overtime work (True) or was a standard shift (False). Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob. Used for payroll flagging and cost escalation alerts.

attributes.name: is_subcontractor_crew
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crew is supplied by a subcontractor (True) or is part of the general contractor's direct workforce (False). Drives cost segregation between self-performed and subcontracted labour.

attributes.name: is_weather_impacted
attributes.description: Indicates whether adverse weather conditions materially impacted crew productivity or caused a work stoppage on this deployment date (True) or not (False). Supports Extension of Time (EOT) and delay claim substantiation.

attributes.name: lead_foreman_name
attributes.description: Full name of the lead foreman or gang leader responsible for supervising this crew deployment. Captured from HCSS HeavyJob time tracking. Classified confidential as it identifies a named employee in a supervisory role.

attributes.name: mobilization_status
attributes.description: Indicates the mobilization lifecycle stage of the crew relative to the project site. Tracks whether the crew is in the process of mobilizing, fully on site, demobilizing, or has fully demobilized. Supports site logistics planning.

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of overtime hours worked by the crew beyond the standard shift duration on this deployment date. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob payroll records. Feeds Viewpoint Vista payroll and job costing.

attributes.name: permit_to_work_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Permit to Work (PTW) issued for this crew deployment, where the work activity requires a formal permit (e.g., hot work, confined space, excavation). Sourced from Intelex HSE management system.

attributes.name: planned_hours
attributes.description: Total man-hours planned for this crew deployment on the given date, as scheduled in Oracle Primavera P6. Used as the baseline for earned value computation and productivity variance analysis.

attributes.name: planned_production_qty
attributes.description: Target quantity of work output planned for this crew deployment (e.g., cubic metres of concrete, linear metres of pipe, tonnes of steel). Defined in HCSS HeavyJob production tracking against the cost code.

attributes.name: ppe_compliance
attributes.description: Indicates whether all crew members were observed to be wearing required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) at the start of this deployment (True) or a non-compliance was recorded (False). Sourced from Procore or Intelex field inspection.

attributes.name: production_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the planned and actual production quantities (e.g., m3, LM, tonne, m2, EA). Sourced from the HCSS HeavyJob cost code definition and aligned with the Bill of Quantities (BOQ).

attributes.name: productivity_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing foreman or site supervisor observations about crew productivity, constraints, delays, or notable events during this deployment. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob or Procore daily log narrative.

attributes.name: productivity_rate
attributes.description: Actual production output per man-hour achieved by this crew on this deployment date (actual_production_qty / actual_hours). Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob production tracking. Used for benchmarking and Schedule Performance Index (SPI) analysis.

attributes.name: shift_end_time
attributes.description: Actual date and time the crew shift ended on site. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob time tracking. Used in conjunction with shift_start_time to compute actual hours worked. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: shift_start_time
attributes.description: Actual date and time the crew shift commenced on site. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob time tracking. Used for hours calculation, overtime determination, and HSE compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the work shift for this deployment (day, night, swing, or weekend). Drives overtime calculations, HSE fatigue management, and payroll processing.

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (HCSS HeavyJob or Procore) for this crew deployment entry. Enables reverse traceability from the Silver layer back to the operational system of record.

attributes.name: swms_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number of the Safe Work Method Statement (SWMS) applicable to this crew deployment and work activity. Confirms that the required HSE documentation was in place before work commenced.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this crew deployment record was last modified in the data platform. Supports incremental data processing, audit trails, and change detection in the Silver layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: wbs_code
attributes.description: Work Breakdown Structure code from Oracle Primavera P6 identifying the project deliverable or work package to which this crew deployment is charged. Supports earned value management (EVM) computation.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Prevailing weather condition recorded on site for this deployment date, as captured in the Procore daily log. Impacts productivity analysis, delay claims, and Extension of Time (EOT) documentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|cloudy|rain|heavy_rain|wind|fog|snow|extreme_heat — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: concrete_pour
products.description: Detailed record of each concrete pour event on site, capturing pour date, pour location (structure element, grid reference), mix design code, specified compressive strength (MPa/PSI), volume poured (m³/yd³), batch plant source, delivery docket numbers, pour start/end time, ambient temperature, slump test results, number of test cylinders cast, and QC hold status. Integrates with quality domain ITP records and material domain batch traceability.

attributes.name: concrete_pour_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each concrete pour event on site. Primary key for the concrete_pour data product.

attributes.name: activity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Primavera P6 schedule activity associated with this concrete pour, enabling earned value computation and schedule performance tracking.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.asset. Business justification: Each concrete pour is performed with a concrete pump or mixer; linking to the asset enables equipment performance and maintenance reporting.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project under which this concrete pour event is executed.

attributes.name: drawing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.drawing. Business justification: Concrete pour records must be linked to the structural drawing defining pour locations for inspection and handover.

attributes.name: finance_cost_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_code. Business justification: Concrete pour entries are charged to specific cost codes; linking enables accurate cost tracking and progress billing.

attributes.name: itp_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) record in the quality domain governing the quality hold and inspection requirements for this pour.

attributes.name: pour_supervisor_craft_worker_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pour Supervisor Craft Worker Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.craft_worker. Business justification: REQUIRED: Concrete pour supervision is assigned to a qualified foreman; FK supports QC, safety audit trails and traceability of pour responsibility.

tag_set.value: Pour Supervisor Craft Worker Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: pour_supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Concrete pour supervision is a safety‑critical role; linking to employee satisfies HSE compliance and incident investigation.

attributes.name: procore_daily_log_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the Procore daily log entry in which this pour event was recorded. Enables cross-system traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the Procore source system.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element under which this pour activity is tracked for cost and schedule control.

attributes.name: ambient_temperature_c
attributes.description: Recorded ambient air temperature in degrees Celsius at the time of the pour. Critical for hot and cold weather concreting compliance, curing regime decisions, and QA/QC records.

attributes.name: batch_plant_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the concrete batching plant that supplied the concrete for this pour. Used for supplier traceability, quality audits, and material domain batch traceability.

attributes.name: concrete_temperature_c
attributes.description: Temperature of the fresh concrete measured at point of delivery (truck discharge), in degrees Celsius. Must comply with specification limits for hot/cold weather concreting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this concrete pour record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: curing_method
attributes.description: Method applied to cure the concrete after placement to ensure adequate hydration and strength development. Compliance with specified curing method is a QA/QC requirement.

attributes.name: curing_start_time
attributes.description: Date and time when curing operations commenced after completion of the pour. Used to calculate curing duration compliance against specification requirements.

attributes.name: cylinder_set_reference
attributes.description: Unique reference number or label assigned to the set of test cylinders cast from this pour, used to track specimens through the laboratory testing process and link results back to the pour event.

attributes.name: delivery_docket_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of concrete delivery docket (batch ticket) numbers associated with this pour event. Provides full traceability from batch plant to placement location per QA/QC requirements.

attributes.name: formwork_drawing_ref
attributes.description: Reference number of the approved formwork or structural drawing used for this pour, as registered in Autodesk BIM 360 or Aconex document management. Provides design traceability.

attributes.name: grid_reference
attributes.description: Structural grid reference (e.g., 'A3-B4') or coordinate reference identifying the precise location of the pour on the site drawing or BIM model. Enables spatial traceability and clash detection correlation.

attributes.name: hcss_production_code
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the HCSS HeavyJob production tracking record associated with this pour event. Enables cross-system traceability for cost coding and production rate analysis.

attributes.name: mix_design_code
attributes.description: Approved mix design code referencing the specific concrete formulation used for this pour, as registered in the material domain batch traceability records. Links to approved mix design submittals.

attributes.name: ncr_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Non-Conformance Report (NCR) raised against this pour event if a quality non-conformance was identified. Null if no NCR has been raised.

attributes.name: placement_method
attributes.description: Method used to place the concrete into the formwork. Affects production rate, quality, and equipment resource planning. Examples: pump (boom pump or line pump), crane and bucket, conveyor belt, direct chute.

attributes.name: pour_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the concrete pour was executed on site. Used for daily log correlation, schedule progress reporting, and curing period calculations.

attributes.name: pour_end_time
attributes.description: Date and time when the last concrete delivery was placed and finishing operations completed, marking the end of the pour event. Used for duration calculation and curing start time.

attributes.name: pour_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier for the pour event, used in daily logs, QA/QC records, and delivery dockets. Sourced from Procore daily logs and HCSS HeavyJob production tracking.

attributes.name: pour_start_time
attributes.description: Date and time when the first concrete delivery was placed into the formwork, marking the official start of the pour event. Used for duration calculation and ambient condition correlation.

attributes.name: pour_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the concrete pour event. 'on_hold' indicates a QC hold has been applied pending inspection release. Drives QA/QC workflow and earned value computation.

attributes.name: pour_type
attributes.description: Classification of the structural element type being poured. Used for production benchmarking, resource planning, and QA/QC ITP selection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: slab|column|beam|wall|footing|pile_cap|bridge_deck|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: qc_hold_status
attributes.description: Quality Control (QC) hold status for this pour event. 'hold_applied' means the pour is under QC review pending inspection or test results. 'hold_released' means the hold has been cleared by the QA/QC engineer. 'rejected' means the pour has been condemned and remediation is required.

attributes.name: qc_inspector
attributes.description: Name of the Quality Control (QC) inspector who witnessed the pour, conducted slump tests, and cast test cylinders. Required for QA/QC traceability and ITP sign-off.

attributes.name: relative_humidity_pct
attributes.description: Recorded relative humidity percentage at the pour location at time of placement. Relevant for evaporation rate calculations and plastic shrinkage cracking risk assessment per ACI 305R.

attributes.name: slump_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the measured slump result falls within the specified minimum and maximum limits. True = compliant; False = non-compliant, triggering QC review or NCR.

attributes.name: slump_specified_max_mm
attributes.description: Maximum allowable slump value in millimetres as specified in the concrete mix design or project specification. Exceedance triggers rejection or NCR issuance.

attributes.name: slump_specified_min_mm
attributes.description: Minimum allowable slump value in millimetres as specified in the concrete mix design or project specification. Used for QC acceptance/rejection decisions.

attributes.name: slump_test_result_mm
attributes.description: Measured slump value in millimetres from the slump cone test performed on a representative sample of fresh concrete at point of delivery. Indicates workability and water-cement ratio compliance.

attributes.name: specified_strength_mpa
attributes.description: Design-specified characteristic compressive strength of the concrete in megapascals (MPa) at 28 days, as defined in the structural drawings and specification. Used for QC acceptance criteria.

attributes.name: structure_element
attributes.description: Name or designation of the structural element being poured, such as 'Pile Cap PC-01', 'Column C3', 'Slab Level 4', 'Retaining Wall RW-02'. Provides traceability to design drawings and BIM model elements.

attributes.name: test_cylinders_cast
attributes.description: Number of concrete test cylinders (or cubes) cast from this pour for compressive strength testing at specified curing ages (e.g., 7-day, 28-day). Minimum count is governed by specification and ACI/ASTM standards.

attributes.name: truck_load_count
attributes.description: Total number of ready-mix concrete truck loads (agitator trucks) delivered and placed during this pour event. Used for logistics planning, docket reconciliation, and production rate analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this concrete pour record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: volume_poured_m3
attributes.description: Total volume of concrete placed during this pour event, measured in cubic metres (m³). Derived from delivery docket quantities and used for earned value computation, material reconciliation, and production tracking in HCSS HeavyJob.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Prevailing weather condition recorded at the time of the pour. Used for hot/cold weather concreting compliance assessment and daily log documentation.

attributes.name: wind_speed_kmh
attributes.description: Recorded wind speed in kilometres per hour at the pour location at time of placement. Used in evaporation rate nomograph calculations to assess plastic shrinkage cracking risk.

products.name: earthwork_volume
products.description: Earthworks measurement record capturing cut, fill, and spoil volumes for a defined area and reporting period. Stores survey method (GPS, drone photogrammetry, total station), measurement date, cut volume (m³), fill volume (m³), net movement, compaction factor, material classification (topsoil, rock, clay), disposal site reference, and surveyor sign-off. Supports earthworks progress billing and subcontractor quantity verification.

attributes.name: earthwork_volume_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each earthwork volume measurement record. Primary key for the earthwork_volume data product in the site domain.

attributes.name: activity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to schedule.activity. Business justification: Earthwork volume measurements are tied to earthwork activities in the schedule; linking supports earned‑value and quantity tracking.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project under which this earthwork volume measurement was recorded. Links earthwork progress to project-level earned value computation.

attributes.name: firm_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subcontractor responsible for executing the earthwork activity. Used for subcontractor quantity verification and progress billing reconciliation.

attributes.name: procore_daily_log_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this earthwork volume measurement to the corresponding daily log entry in Procore Construction Management system. Supports traceability between field measurements and daily site records.

attributes.name: surveyor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Survey data must be attributed to the responsible surveyor employee for QA/QC and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element under which this earthwork activity is classified. Enables cost coding and earned value management (EVM) at the WBS level.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the engineer or quantity surveyor who approved the earthwork volume measurement record for progress billing and earned value reporting.

attributes.name: boq_item_code
attributes.description: Reference code linking this earthwork volume measurement to the corresponding Bill of Quantities (BOQ) line item in the contract. Enables direct reconciliation between measured quantities and contracted quantities for progress billing.

attributes.name: change_order_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the approved Change Order (CO) or variation order authorising earthwork quantities beyond the original contracted scope. Populated only when is_variation_order is true.

attributes.name: compaction_factor
attributes.description: Dimensionless ratio representing the degree of compaction applied to fill material, expressed as the ratio of compacted volume to loose volume. Used to convert loose measure volumes to compacted measure for billing and quality compliance. Typical range 0.70–1.00.

attributes.name: contracted_volume_m3
attributes.description: The total earthwork volume (m³) contracted for this work area and material classification as per the BOQ (Bill of Quantities). Used as the baseline for progress measurement and earned value computation.

attributes.name: coordinate_easting
attributes.description: Easting coordinate (X-axis) of the centroid or reference point of the measured earthwork area in the project coordinate system. Supports GIS (Geographic Information System) integration and spatial reporting.

attributes.name: coordinate_northing
attributes.description: Northing coordinate (Y-axis) of the centroid or reference point of the measured earthwork area in the project coordinate system. Supports GIS (Geographic Information System) integration and spatial reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this earthwork volume measurement record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for data lineage and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: cumulative_cut_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total cut volume measured from project commencement to the end of the current reporting period, in cubic metres (m³). Used for progress billing certificates and earned value management (EVM) calculations.

attributes.name: cumulative_fill_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total fill volume measured from project commencement to the end of the current reporting period, in cubic metres (m³). Used for progress billing certificates and earned value management (EVM) calculations.

attributes.name: cut_volume_m3
attributes.description: Volume of material excavated or cut from the natural ground level, measured in cubic metres (m³). Used in earthworks progress billing, BOQ (Bill of Quantities) reconciliation, and subcontractor quantity verification.

attributes.name: disposal_distance_km
attributes.description: Average haul distance in kilometres from the excavation area to the designated spoil disposal site. Used for mass haul cost estimation and subcontractor haulage billing verification.

attributes.name: disposal_site_reference
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the approved spoil disposal site where surplus or unsuitable excavated material is transported. Required for environmental compliance, EPA reporting, and spoil tracking under ISO 14001.

attributes.name: engineer_approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the resident engineer or project engineer formally approved the earthwork volume measurement for inclusion in the progress payment certificate.

attributes.name: fill_volume_m3
attributes.description: Volume of material placed and compacted as fill to raise ground levels, measured in cubic metres (m³). Used in earthworks progress billing and subcontractor quantity verification.

attributes.name: heavyjob_cost_code
attributes.description: Cost code from HCSS HeavyJob used to classify this earthwork production activity for job costing, production tracking, and earned value computation. Aligns field production data with financial cost control.

attributes.name: is_variation_order
attributes.description: Indicates whether this earthwork volume measurement relates to a Change Order (CO) / variation order outside the original contracted scope. When true, the measurement must be linked to an approved variation for billing purposes.

attributes.name: itp_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) under which this earthwork volume measurement was conducted. Links the measurement to the applicable QA/QC (Quality Assurance/Quality Control) inspection regime.

attributes.name: material_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the earthwork material type being measured. Drives compaction factors, disposal requirements, and unit rates for progress billing. Common values: topsoil, clay, rock, sand, gravel, mixed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: topsoil|clay|rock|sand|gravel|mixed|silt|fill_material|contaminated — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: measurement_accuracy_m
attributes.description: Stated positional accuracy of the survey measurement in metres, as reported by the survey instrument or method. Used to assess measurement reliability and compliance with project QA/QC (Quality Assurance/Quality Control) tolerances.

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the earthwork volume survey measurement was physically conducted on site. Represents the real-world event date, distinct from record creation timestamp.

attributes.name: measurement_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to this earthwork volume measurement record, used in field reports, progress billing certificates, and subcontractor payment applications.

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the earthwork volume measurement record. Tracks the lifecycle from initial field capture through surveyor submission, engineer review, approval, and payment certification. Values: draft, submitted, under_review, approved, rejected, certified.

attributes.name: ncr_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of any Non-Conformance Report (NCR) raised against this earthwork volume measurement. Populated when measurement results fall outside specified tolerances or acceptance criteria.

attributes.name: net_movement_m3
attributes.description: Net earthwork volume movement calculated as cut volume minus fill volume, measured in cubic metres (m³). A positive value indicates net cut (more excavation than fill); negative indicates net fill. Supports mass haul planning and earthworks balance analysis.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for rejecting a submitted earthwork volume measurement. Populated when measurement_status is set to 'rejected'. Supports NCR (Non-Conformance Report) tracking and re-measurement workflows.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or qualifications recorded by the surveyor or engineer regarding this earthwork volume measurement. May include site conditions, anomalies, or instructions for re-measurement.

attributes.name: reporting_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the reporting period covered by this earthwork volume measurement. Paired with reporting_period_start to define the billing and progress measurement window.

attributes.name: reporting_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the reporting period covered by this earthwork volume measurement. Used for periodic progress billing and earned value reporting cycles.

attributes.name: spoil_volume_m3
attributes.description: Volume of excavated material classified as spoil (surplus or unsuitable material) that must be removed from site and disposed of, measured in cubic metres (m³). Drives disposal cost tracking and environmental compliance reporting.

attributes.name: survey_instrument_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the survey instrument or equipment (e.g., total station serial number, drone registration ID, GPS unit ID) used to conduct the measurement. Supports equipment calibration traceability and QA/QC compliance.

attributes.name: survey_method
attributes.description: The technique used to measure earthwork volumes on site. Accepted values include GPS (Global Positioning System), drone photogrammetry, total station, LiDAR, manual survey, and cross-section method. Affects measurement accuracy and acceptance criteria. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GPS|drone_photogrammetry|total_station|LiDAR|manual_survey|cross_section|RTK_GPS|BIM_model_comparison — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: surveyor_license_number
attributes.description: Professional license or registration number of the surveyor who conducted the measurement. Required for regulatory compliance and quality assurance sign-off validation.

attributes.name: surveyor_signoff_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the surveyor formally signed off on the earthwork volume measurement, confirming the accuracy of recorded quantities. Critical for audit trail and payment certification.

attributes.name: swell_factor
attributes.description: Dimensionless ratio representing the increase in volume of excavated material compared to its in-situ volume (bank measure). Used to calculate haul volumes and truck load quantities for mass haul planning.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this earthwork volume measurement record was last modified. Supports audit trail, data lineage tracking, and incremental data loading in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.

attributes.name: weather_conditions
attributes.description: Prevailing weather conditions at the time of the earthwork survey measurement. Relevant for assessing measurement reliability, site productivity, and HSE (Health Safety and Environment) compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|cloudy|rain|heavy_rain|fog|wind|storm|snow — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: work_area_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the defined site area or work front where the earthwork activity was performed. Aligns with site logistics zoning and HCSS HeavyJob cost coding.

attributes.name: work_area_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the site area or work front where the earthwork measurement was taken, providing geographic and operational context for field teams and quantity surveyors.

products.name: field_progress
products.description: Periodic field progress measurement record capturing percent complete and installed quantities for a WBS activity or BOQ line item as physically measured in the field. Stores measurement date, measurement method (visual estimate, quantity survey, milestone completion, 3D scan comparison), reported percent complete, previous percent complete, incremental progress delta, field engineer name, and approval status. Feeds EVM (Earned Value Management) calculations including BCWP, CPI, and SPI in the project domain. Provides the ground-truth measurement that reconciles against schedule domain planned progress.

attributes.name: field_progress_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each field progress measurement record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the field_progress data product.

attributes.name: bid_boq_line_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bill of Quantities (BOQ) Line Item ID
attributes.description: Reference to the BOQ line item from the contract or estimate against which installed quantities are measured. Enables reconciliation of field-installed quantities against contracted scope.

tag_set.value: Bill of Quantities (BOQ) Line Item ID

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent project under which this field progress measurement is captured. Enables project-level aggregation of earned value and progress reporting.

attributes.name: cost_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the HCSS HeavyJob cost code associated with this progress measurement. Enables cost-to-progress reconciliation and production rate analysis by cost code.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: System identifier for the field engineer who performed the measurement, referencing the workforce/employee master. Enables linkage to SAP SuccessFactors workforce records for competency and certification validation.

attributes.name: itp_line_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) Checkpoint ID
attributes.description: Reference to the ITP (Inspection and Test Plan) checkpoint that must be satisfied before this progress measurement can be approved. Ensures QA/QC hold points are cleared prior to progress being recognised in EVM.

tag_set.value: Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) Checkpoint ID

attributes.name: procore_daily_log_id
attributes.description: The source system identifier of the Procore daily log entry from which this field progress measurement was derived or linked. Enables traceability back to the originating daily log record in Procore for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: production_entry_id
attributes.description: The source system identifier of the HCSS HeavyJob production tracking record associated with this field progress measurement. Enables reconciliation between field production data and cost coding in HeavyJob.
