attributes.name: wbs_activity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the WBS activity or schedule activity in Oracle Primavera P6 against which this field progress measurement is recorded. Links field measurement to the schedule domain for EVM computation.

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: The construction discipline or work type category of the WBS activity being measured (e.g., earthworks, concrete, structural steel, MEP). Enables discipline-level progress aggregation and resource productivity benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: earthworks|concrete|structural_steel|mep|civil|finishing|commissioning|piling|roofing|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the field progress measurement record. Controls whether the measurement is eligible to feed EVM (Earned Value Management) calculations in the project domain. Draft and rejected records are excluded from BCWP computation.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the field progress measurement was formally approved by the designated approver. Marks the record as eligible for inclusion in EVM calculations. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the supervisor, project engineer, or quantity surveyor who reviewed and approved the field progress measurement. Required for audit trail and QA/QC compliance.

attributes.name: bcwp
attributes.description: The Budgeted Cost of Work Performed (BCWP), also known as Earned Value, computed as reported_percent_complete multiplied by the budget at completion for the activity. Expressed in project currency. Feeds CPI and SPI calculations in the project domain EVM module.

attributes.name: bim_element_reference
attributes.description: The BIM (Building Information Modeling) element or object identifier from Autodesk BIM 360 corresponding to the physical work being measured. Enables 4D BIM progress visualization by linking field measurements to the 3D model.

attributes.name: budget_at_completion
attributes.description: The total approved budget allocated to the WBS activity or BOQ line item as of this measurement date. Used as the basis for BCWP computation. Classified as confidential as it contains project financial data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this field progress measurement record was first created in the system. Audit trail timestamp for data lineage and silver layer ingestion tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: crew_size
attributes.description: The number of workers deployed on the work front for the activity during the measurement period. Used to compute production rates per worker and benchmark crew productivity against planned norms in HCSS HeavyJob.

attributes.name: data_date
attributes.description: The official schedule data date or progress cut-off date as defined in Oracle Primavera P6 for the reporting period in which this measurement falls. Aligns field measurements with the schedule baseline for SPI computation.

attributes.name: equipment_hours
attributes.description: Total equipment operating hours logged against this activity during the measurement period. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob equipment hour tracking. Used for equipment productivity analysis and cost-to-progress reconciliation.

attributes.name: field_engineer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the field engineer or site engineer who physically performed and recorded the progress measurement. Provides accountability and traceability for the measurement. Classified as confidential PII as it identifies an individual employee.

attributes.name: installed_quantity
attributes.description: The cumulative physical quantity of work installed or completed as measured in the field at the time of this measurement (e.g., cubic metres of concrete poured, linear metres of pipe installed, tonnes of steel erected). Reconciles against the BOQ planned quantity.

attributes.name: is_critical_path
attributes.description: Indicates whether the WBS activity is on the Critical Path Method (CPM) schedule critical path (True) or has float (False). Critical path activities require priority attention as delays directly impact project completion date.

attributes.name: is_milestone
attributes.description: Indicates whether the WBS activity associated with this progress measurement is a contract or schedule milestone (True) or a regular work activity (False). Milestone completion triggers contractual notifications and potential payment events.

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the physical field progress measurement was taken by the field engineer or surveyor. This is the principal real-world event date used for EVM period calculations and schedule reconciliation.

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: The technique used to determine the percent complete or installed quantity in the field. Drives confidence weighting in EVM calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: visual_estimate|quantity_survey|milestone_completion|3d_scan_comparison|weighted_steps|engineering_estimate — promote to reference product if additional methods are added]

attributes.name: measurement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for the field engineer to record observations, constraints, or qualifications relevant to the progress measurement (e.g., partial pour due to rain, access restriction, rework in progress). Supports contextual interpretation of progress data.

attributes.name: measurement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this progress measurement record, typically formatted as a sequential reference number (e.g., FPM-2024-00123) used in Procore daily logs and field management reports.

attributes.name: measurement_period_type
attributes.description: The reporting frequency or period type for this progress measurement (e.g., daily, weekly, monthly). Determines how the measurement aligns with project reporting cycles and EVM period cut-offs in Oracle Primavera P6.

attributes.name: ncr_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of any active Non-Conformance Report (NCR) associated with the work being measured. If an NCR is open, the progress measurement may be withheld from EVM until the NCR is closed and rework is verified.

attributes.name: period_installed_quantity
attributes.description: The incremental quantity of work physically installed during the current measurement period only (not cumulative). Used for production rate tracking and period-over-period productivity analysis in HCSS HeavyJob.

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: The total planned or budgeted quantity for the WBS activity or BOQ line item as per the approved schedule and BOQ. Used as the denominator for quantity-based percent complete calculations and production rate analysis.

attributes.name: previous_percent_complete
attributes.description: The cumulative percent complete recorded in the immediately preceding measurement period for the same WBS activity or BOQ line item. Used to compute the incremental progress delta and validate that progress is monotonically increasing.

attributes.name: progress_delta
attributes.description: The incremental percent complete gained in this measurement period, calculated as reported_percent_complete minus previous_percent_complete. Represents the period productivity for the activity and is used in period-based EVM reporting.

attributes.name: quantity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure applicable to the installed_quantity field (e.g., m3 for concrete, lm for linear metres of pipe, tonne for structural steel). Must align with the BOQ line item unit of measure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: m3|m2|lm|tonne|kg|nr|ls|hr|m — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the approver when a field progress measurement is rejected (approval_status = rejected). Documents the basis for rejection to guide the field engineer in correcting and resubmitting the measurement.

attributes.name: reported_percent_complete
attributes.description: The cumulative percent complete for the WBS activity or BOQ line item as physically measured and reported by the field engineer at the time of this measurement. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). This is the ground-truth value used to compute BCWP in EVM.

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential revision counter for this field progress measurement record. Increments each time the measurement is revised and resubmitted after rejection. Enables version tracking and audit trail of measurement history.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the field engineer submitted the progress measurement record for review and approval. Used to track measurement reporting timeliness and workflow cycle time.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this field progress measurement record was last modified. Supports incremental data loading in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer and audit trail requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: The prevailing weather condition on site at the time of the field progress measurement. Used to contextualise productivity rates and support EOT (Extension of Time) claims where adverse weather impacted progress. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|cloudy|rain|heavy_rain|storm|snow|fog|extreme_heat — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: work_front
attributes.description: The physical work front, zone, or area of the site where the measured work is being executed (e.g., Zone A, Pier 3, Level 2 North Wing). Enables spatial disaggregation of progress for site logistics and crew assignment analysis.

products.name: site_mobilization
products.description: Master record tracking the mobilization and demobilization lifecycle of a construction site or major work package. Captures planned mobilization date, actual mobilization date, NTP (Notice to Proceed) date, site establishment milestones (fencing, laydown area, site office, utilities), demobilization plan date, actual demobilization date, and site closure sign-off. Provides the temporal and logistical anchor for all site operations.

attributes.name: site_mobilization_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the site mobilization record. Primary key for the site_mobilization data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.account. Business justification: Mobilization Cost & Schedule reports are generated per client account; linking site_mobilization to client.account enables billing and performance tracking.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contract under which this site mobilization is authorized. Ties mobilization activities to the governing contractual instrument.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.asset. Business justification: Site mobilization records which equipment is moved to the site; essential for mobilization cost accounting and asset location management.

attributes.name: compliance_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Site mobilization is contingent on a mobilization permit; linking tracks permit approval status against mobilization schedule.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent project for which this site mobilization record is created. Links site mobilization lifecycle to the overarching project entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce record of the Site Manager responsible for overseeing mobilization and site operations. Accountable for HSE compliance, daily logs, and progress reporting.

attributes.name: primavera_activity_id
attributes.description: Activity identifier from Oracle Primavera P6 corresponding to the mobilization WBS activity. Enables direct traceability between this mobilization record and the project schedule baseline.

attributes.name: procurement_framework_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_framework_agreement. Business justification: REQUIRED: Mobilisation activities are often covered under a framework agreement with a vendor; linking enables compliance and spend tracking.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: FK to site.site

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.bid_submission. Business justification: Mobilization plans are executed only after a bid is awarded; linking to the winning bid_submission enables cost tracking and audit of mobilization against the awarded contract.

attributes.name: access_road_established
attributes.description: Indicates whether the primary site access road and entry/exit gates have been constructed and are operational for heavy vehicle and workforce ingress/egress.

attributes.name: actual_demobilization_date
attributes.description: Date on which site demobilization was physically completed and the site was vacated. Compared against planned_demobilization_date to assess demobilization schedule performance.

attributes.name: actual_mobilization_date
attributes.description: Date on which site mobilization physically commenced (first crew or equipment on site). Compared against planned_mobilization_date to compute mobilization schedule variance.

attributes.name: building_permit_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the building or construction permit issued by the local authority. Required before commencement of structural works and tracked for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: cost_actual
attributes.description: Actual costs incurred for site mobilization activities as recorded in the job costing system (Viewpoint Vista / SAP S/4HANA). Used for cost variance analysis against mobilization_cost_budget.

attributes.name: cost_budget
attributes.description: Approved budget allocated for site mobilization activities including site establishment, temporary facilities, equipment transport, and initial workforce deployment. Expressed in the project currency.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country in which the construction site is located (e.g., USA, AUS, GBR, ARE). Drives regulatory compliance framework selection and reporting jurisdiction.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this site mobilization record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values on this mobilization record (e.g., USD, AUD, GBP, AED). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency international projects.

attributes.name: dlp_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Defects Liability Period (DLP) for site establishment works expires. After this date, the contractor is no longer obligated to rectify defects in temporary site infrastructure.

attributes.name: environmental_permit_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the primary environmental permit issued by the regulatory authority (e.g., EPA NPDES permit number). Required for regulatory compliance tracking and audit.

attributes.name: environmental_permit_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required environmental permits and approvals (e.g., EPA stormwater NPDES permit, land disturbance permit) have been obtained prior to ground disturbance.

attributes.name: hse_plan_approval_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Plan Approval Date
attributes.description: Date on which the site HSE plan was formally approved by the HSE Manager and client representative. Required for regulatory compliance and Intelex HSE management system records.

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Plan Approval Date

attributes.name: hse_plan_approved
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Plan Approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site-specific HSE plan has been reviewed and approved prior to mobilization commencement. Mandatory pre-mobilization gate per ISO 45001 and OSHA requirements.

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Plan Approved

attributes.name: laydown_area_established
attributes.description: Indicates whether the designated materials laydown and storage area has been prepared, demarcated, and made operational for receiving deliveries and storing equipment.

attributes.name: leed_certification_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Target
attributes.description: Target LEED certification level for the project site as specified in the contract or client brief. Influences site establishment requirements for waste management, stormwater control, and sustainable practices.

tag_set.value: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) Certification Target

attributes.name: mobilization_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this mobilization record, used in correspondence, Procore daily logs, and Aconex transmittals. Follows the enterprise MOB-XXXXXX numbering convention.

attributes.name: mobilization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the site mobilization record: planned (NTP received, not yet started), in_progress (site establishment underway), completed (fully mobilized and operational), demobilized (site closed and handed back), cancelled (mobilization voided), on_hold (temporarily suspended).

attributes.name: mobilization_type
attributes.description: Classification of the mobilization scope: full_site (complete site establishment), work_package (specific WBS package), temporary_camp (workforce accommodation), equipment_only (plant and machinery deployment), or partial (phased mobilization). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: full_site|work_package|temporary_camp|equipment_only|partial|phased — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, constraints, special conditions, or observations related to the site mobilization that are not captured in structured fields (e.g., access restrictions, community liaison requirements).

attributes.name: ntp_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Notice to Proceed (NTP) was issued by the client or engineer, authorizing the contractor to commence site mobilization and construction activities. Critical contractual milestone.

attributes.name: peak_workforce_actual
attributes.description: Maximum number of workers (direct and subcontractor) actually recorded on site simultaneously during the mobilization period, as tracked in HCSS HeavyJob time records.

attributes.name: peak_workforce_planned
attributes.description: Maximum number of workers (direct and subcontractor) planned to be on site simultaneously at peak mobilization, as per the resource-loaded schedule in Oracle Primavera P6.

attributes.name: planned_demobilization_date
attributes.description: Baseline-scheduled date on which site demobilization was planned to be completed, as per the approved project schedule. Used for resource release planning and contract completion forecasting.

attributes.name: planned_mobilization_date
attributes.description: Baseline-scheduled date on which site mobilization activities were planned to commence, as recorded in Oracle Primavera P6. Used for schedule variance analysis and earned value management (EVM).

attributes.name: procore_project_reference
attributes.description: External system identifier for this site in Procore Construction Management platform. Used for cross-system reconciliation of daily logs, RFIs, and field management records.

attributes.name: schedule_variance_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days difference between actual_mobilization_date and planned_mobilization_date. Positive value indicates delay; negative value indicates early mobilization. Used for schedule performance reporting.

attributes.name: site_address
attributes.description: Physical street address or location description of the construction site. Used for logistics coordination, regulatory notifications, and emergency response planning.

attributes.name: site_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total area of the construction site in square metres as defined in the site establishment plan. Used for site logistics planning, laydown area allocation, and HSE zone management.

attributes.name: site_closure_signoff_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal site closure sign-off was completed by the client, engineer, and contractor, confirming all demobilization obligations have been fulfilled and the site has been restored.

attributes.name: site_fencing_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether site perimeter fencing and hoarding have been fully erected as part of site establishment. Key safety milestone required before workforce deployment.

attributes.name: site_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the construction site centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84). Supports GIS-based site mapping, logistics routing, and spatial analytics.

attributes.name: site_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the construction site centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84). Supports GIS-based site mapping, logistics routing, and spatial analytics.

attributes.name: site_office_established
attributes.description: Indicates whether the temporary site office (including communications, IT infrastructure, and welfare facilities) has been established and is operational.

attributes.name: temporary_utilities_connected
attributes.description: Indicates whether temporary site utilities (power, water, telecommunications, sewage) have been connected and are operational. Prerequisite for sustained site operations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this site mobilization record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: wbs_code
attributes.description: WBS element code from SAP S/4HANA or Oracle Primavera P6 assigned to the mobilization cost centre. Enables cost allocation and earned value management (EVM) reporting at the mobilization level.

products.name: logistics_plan
products.description: Master logistics plan for a construction site defining traffic management routes, laydown areas, material staging zones, crane lift zones, temporary access roads, welfare facilities, emergency egress paths, and temporary works arrangements. Stores plan version, effective date, expiry date, site layout drawing reference, approved-by details, and revision history. Governs how materials, equipment, and personnel move safely and efficiently across the site. Typically versioned as site conditions evolve through construction phases.

attributes.name: logistics_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the site logistics plan record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.account. Business justification: Client approval is required for site logistics plans; the FK ties the plan to the responsible client account for compliance and invoicing.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Logistics plan approval requires a responsible manager; employee link provides accountability and audit of plan changes.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project this logistics plan governs. Links to the project master entity.

attributes.name: aconex_document_reference
attributes.description: Document number assigned in the Aconex Document Management system for this logistics plan, used for formal transmittal, correspondence tracking, and revision control across project stakeholders.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the logistics plan was formally approved by the designated authority (e.g., HSE Manager, Project Manager, or Client Representative).

attributes.name: bim_model_ref
attributes.description: Reference to the BIM 360 model or federated model file that contains the 3D site logistics layout, including crane positions, laydown areas, and temporary works modeled in the BIM environment.

attributes.name: client_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this logistics plan requires formal approval from the client or client's representative before implementation, as stipulated in the contract (e.g., FIDIC Engineer's consent).

attributes.name: client_approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the client or client's representative formally approved this logistics plan. Populated only when client_approval_required is True.

attributes.name: concrete_washout_area_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether a designated concrete washout and truck washdown area is included in this logistics plan. Required for concrete pour operations to prevent cement slurry from entering stormwater drains.

attributes.name: construction_phase
attributes.description: The construction phase or stage this logistics plan applies to (e.g., 'Mobilization', 'Substructure', 'Superstructure', 'MEP Fit-Out', 'Commissioning', 'Demobilization'). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mobilization|substructure|superstructure|mep_fit_out|finishing|commissioning|demobilization — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: crane_lift_zone_count
attributes.description: Number of designated crane lift zones defined in this logistics plan. Crane lift zones are exclusion and operating areas for tower cranes, mobile cranes, and other lifting equipment, governed by lift plans.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this site logistics plan record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: delivery_time_window_end
attributes.description: Latest permitted time for material and equipment deliveries to the site gate, in HH:MM 24-hour format. Deliveries outside this window require special approval and may incur liquidated damages (LD) under planning conditions.

attributes.name: delivery_time_window_start
attributes.description: Earliest permitted time for material and equipment deliveries to the site gate, in HH:MM 24-hour format. Restricts deliveries to avoid peak traffic periods and comply with local authority conditions.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this version of the site logistics plan becomes the governing document on site. Personnel and subcontractors must comply from this date forward.

attributes.name: emergency_egress_route_count
attributes.description: Number of designated emergency egress and evacuation routes defined in this logistics plan. Must comply with fire safety and emergency response regulations and be communicated via site induction.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this version of the logistics plan ceases to be valid and must be reviewed or superseded. Nullable for open-ended plans that remain valid until explicitly superseded.

attributes.name: first_aid_facility_count
attributes.description: Number of first aid stations and medical response points defined in this logistics plan. Must meet OSHA minimum ratios relative to peak site workforce headcount.

attributes.name: fuel_storage_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether this logistics plan includes a designated fuel storage and bunded refuelling area for plant and equipment on site. Triggers additional environmental and fire safety controls.

attributes.name: hoarding_perimeter_m
attributes.description: Total length in metres of site hoarding (perimeter security fencing and public protection barriers) defined in this logistics plan. Used for cost estimation and compliance with public safety requirements.

attributes.name: hse_risk_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Risk Level
attributes.description: Overall HSE risk classification assigned to this logistics plan based on the complexity of site movements, proximity to live traffic, overhead hazards, and concurrent operations. Drives the frequency of logistics plan reviews.

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Risk Level

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this site logistics plan record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads in the Databricks Silver Layer, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: laydown_area_count
attributes.description: Number of designated material laydown and staging zones defined in this logistics plan. Each laydown area is a controlled zone for temporary storage of materials and equipment awaiting installation.

attributes.name: material_staging_zones
attributes.description: Narrative description of the designated material staging zones on site, including their locations, intended materials (e.g., rebar, formwork, precast elements), and capacity constraints as defined in the logistics plan.

attributes.name: max_vehicle_speed_kmh
attributes.description: Maximum permitted vehicle speed in kilometres per hour within the site boundary as defined in this logistics plan. Typically 10–15 km/h on construction sites to protect pedestrian workers.

attributes.name: peak_workforce_headcount
attributes.description: Maximum number of workers (direct and subcontractor) expected on site simultaneously during the period covered by this logistics plan. Drives welfare facility sizing, emergency egress capacity, and traffic management intensity.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to this logistics plan, used in correspondence, transmittals, and document control systems such as Aconex and Procore.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the logistics plan. 'draft' indicates initial preparation; 'under_review' means submitted for approval; 'approved' is the active governing version; 'superseded' means replaced by a newer revision; 'void' means cancelled.

attributes.name: plan_title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the site logistics plan, typically referencing the construction phase or area it covers (e.g., 'Phase 2 Substructure Logistics Plan').

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the logistics plan by its purpose or trigger. 'initial' covers site mobilization; 'phase_specific' covers a defined construction phase; 'emergency' addresses unplanned site conditions; 'temporary_works' focuses on temporary structures; 'revised' reflects a major re-plan.

attributes.name: prepared_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who authored and prepared this version of the logistics plan, typically the Site Engineer or HSE Coordinator.

attributes.name: procore_submittal_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the submittal record in Procore Construction Management system through which this logistics plan was submitted for review and approval. Enables traceability to the source system workflow.

attributes.name: revision_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the changes made in this revision compared to the previous version, capturing the reason for revision (e.g., crane relocation, new access road, phase transition).

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Alphanumeric revision identifier for this version of the logistics plan (e.g., 'A', 'B', '01', 'Rev3'). Increments each time the plan is formally revised and reissued.

attributes.name: site_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total area of the construction site in square metres covered by this logistics plan. Used for planning material staging density, welfare facility ratios, and emergency egress capacity.

attributes.name: site_gate_count
attributes.description: Number of controlled access gates defined in this logistics plan for entry and exit of personnel, vehicles, and materials. Includes separate pedestrian and vehicle gates where applicable.

attributes.name: site_layout_drawing_ref
attributes.description: Document reference number or BIM 360 / Aconex document ID for the site layout drawing that accompanies this logistics plan, showing the physical arrangement of zones, routes, and facilities.

attributes.name: swms_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number for the Safe Work Method Statement (SWMS) associated with this logistics plan. The SWMS details the high-risk construction work activities and controls for site logistics operations.

attributes.name: temp_access_road_count
attributes.description: Number of temporary access roads established within the site logistics plan for movement of vehicles, plant, and personnel. Includes haul roads, delivery routes, and internal circulation roads.

attributes.name: temporary_works_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether this logistics plan includes temporary works arrangements such as shoring, hoarding, temporary bridges, or scaffolding that require a separate temporary works design and approval.

attributes.name: temporary_works_ref
attributes.description: Document reference number for the temporary works design package associated with this logistics plan. Populated only when temporary_works_included is True.

attributes.name: traffic_management_scheme
attributes.description: Type of traffic management arrangement implemented on site to separate pedestrian and vehicle movements. 'segregated' means fully separated pedestrian and vehicle routes; 'controlled_crossing' uses marshalled crossing points.

attributes.name: waste_management_zone_count
attributes.description: Number of designated waste segregation and skip areas defined in this logistics plan for construction waste, hazardous materials, and recyclables. Supports compliance with EPA and ISO 14001 waste management requirements.

attributes.name: welfare_facility_count
attributes.description: Number of welfare facility units (site offices, canteens, toilets, first aid rooms, drying rooms) included in this logistics plan. Welfare provision must meet regulatory minimums per workforce headcount.

products.name: equipment_deployment
products.description: Daily or period-based record of construction equipment deployed to a specific work front or activity on site. Captures equipment ID (FK to equipment domain), deployment date, release date, operating hours, idle hours, cost code, operator name, fuel consumption, and breakdown flag. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob equipment hours module. Distinct from equipment domain master records — this entity tracks the operational utilization of equipment at the site level.

attributes.name: equipment_deployment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each equipment deployment record in the site domain. Primary key for the equipment_deployment data product.

attributes.name: activity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled activity or Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element in the project schedule to which this equipment deployment is assigned.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment master record in the equipment domain. Identifies the specific piece of construction equipment (e.g., excavator, crane, compactor) deployed to site.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the project master record. Links the equipment deployment to the construction project under which the equipment is being utilized.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce record of the equipment operator assigned to this deployment. Links to the workforce domain for operator qualification and certification tracking.

attributes.name: finance_cost_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_code. Business justification: Equipment usage charges are posted to finance cost codes; linking enables equipment cost reporting and asset depreciation.

attributes.name: hcss_equipment_hours_id
attributes.description: The source system record identifier from HCSS HeavyJob equipment hours module. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and incremental load processing from the operational system of record.

attributes.name: procore_daily_log_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the Procore daily log entry from which this equipment deployment record was sourced. Enables traceability back to the source construction management system.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: REQUIRED: Equipment rental or purchase orders are linked to each deployment for cost allocation and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: work_front_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific work front or work zone on site where the equipment is deployed. A work front represents a distinct area of concurrent construction activity.

attributes.name: breakdown_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the nature of the equipment breakdown or mechanical failure, as recorded by the site supervisor or equipment operator. Populated only when breakdown_flag is True.

attributes.name: breakdown_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment experienced a mechanical breakdown or unplanned failure during this deployment period. True = breakdown occurred; False = no breakdown. Triggers maintenance workflow in SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance.

attributes.name: breakdown_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the equipment was unavailable due to mechanical breakdown or unplanned maintenance during the shift or reporting period. Feeds into equipment reliability and maintenance KPI reporting.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the hourly rate and cost values recorded in this deployment record (e.g., USD, AUD, GBP, AED).

attributes.name: deployment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the equipment was mobilized and deployed to the designated work front or activity. Represents the start of the deployment period for daily or period-based tracking.

attributes.name: deployment_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for this equipment deployment record, as assigned in HCSS HeavyJob or the site daily log system. Used for cross-system traceability and field reporting.

attributes.name: deployment_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the equipment deployment record. 'active' indicates equipment is in productive use; 'idle' indicates on-site but not producing; 'breakdown' indicates mechanical failure; 'demobilized' indicates equipment has left site; 'standby' indicates awaiting assignment; 'transferred' indicates moved to another work front or project.

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the equipment by functional category (e.g., Excavator, Bulldozer, Crane, Compactor, Concrete Pump, Dump Truck, Grader). Sourced from the equipment master but denormalized here for site-level reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: excavator|bulldozer|crane|compactor|concrete_pump|dump_truck|grader|loader|paver|roller|generator|pump|forklift|drill_rig — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_liters
attributes.description: Total fuel consumed by the equipment during the shift or reporting period, measured in liters. Used for cost tracking, environmental reporting, and fuel efficiency benchmarking.

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Type of fuel consumed by the equipment. Used for environmental emissions reporting and fuel cost categorization.

attributes.name: hourly_rate
attributes.description: The contracted or internal charge rate for the equipment per operating hour, in the project currency. Used for job costing and cost-to-complete calculations. Confidential as it reflects commercial pricing.

attributes.name: hse_permit_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Permit Number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Permit to Work (PTW) or HSE permit associated with this equipment deployment, where required by site safety regulations (e.g., crane lifts, confined space operations). Links to the Intelex HSE management system.

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Permit Number

attributes.name: idle_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the equipment was on-site but not in productive operation (e.g., waiting for materials, weather delays, operator breaks). Idle hours are tracked separately from operating hours for utilization analysis.

attributes.name: maintenance_order_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the corrective maintenance work order raised in SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance as a result of a breakdown during this deployment. Links field breakdown events to the maintenance management system.

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the equipment was in productive operation during the shift or reporting period. Used for earned value computation, equipment cost allocation, and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: operator_license_number
attributes.description: The certification or license number of the equipment operator, required for regulated equipment types (e.g., crane operators, forklift operators). Supports OSHA and ISO 45001 compliance verification.

attributes.name: operator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the equipment operator assigned to this deployment record, as recorded in the daily field log. Retained for field-level traceability and OSHA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the deployed equipment is company-owned, rented from an external supplier, leased under a finance or operating lease, or provided by a subcontractor. Affects cost coding and financial treatment.

attributes.name: planned_production_quantity
attributes.description: The target or budgeted production quantity for the equipment during this shift or reporting period, as derived from the project schedule and production plan. Enables variance analysis against actual production.

attributes.name: pre_start_check_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a pre-start safety inspection was completed for the equipment prior to commencement of operations on this shift. True = pre-start check completed; False = not completed. Required for ISO 45001 and OSHA compliance.

attributes.name: production_quantity
attributes.description: The measured quantity of work produced by the equipment during the shift or reporting period (e.g., cubic meters of earth moved, linear meters of paving laid, cubic meters of concrete poured). The unit is defined by production_unit_of_measure.

attributes.name: production_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the production quantity recorded in this deployment (e.g., m3 for earthworks, lm for linear paving, tonne for material placement). Aligns with the cost code and activity unit of measure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: m3|m2|lm|tonne|each|load|hour — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this equipment deployment record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this equipment deployment record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports incremental data processing and audit trail requirements in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the equipment was released from the work front or activity and demobilized or reassigned. Null if the equipment is still actively deployed.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for site supervisor or equipment manager to record additional observations, instructions, or notes relevant to this equipment deployment record (e.g., special operating conditions, partial shift reasons, safety observations).

attributes.name: rental_order_number
attributes.description: The Purchase Order (PO) or rental agreement reference number for externally rented or leased equipment. Links the deployment record to the procurement and accounts payable process.

attributes.name: shift_date
attributes.description: The specific working date (shift date) for which this equipment utilization record is reported. Enables daily granularity within a multi-day deployment period.

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: The work shift during which the equipment was operated. Distinguishes day, night, swing, or double shifts for accurate labor and equipment cost allocation.

attributes.name: site_location_description
attributes.description: Descriptive reference to the physical location on site where the equipment is deployed (e.g., 'Zone A — North Embankment', 'Pier 3 Foundation', 'Runway 2 Subbase'). Supports spatial tracking and site logistics management.

attributes.name: standby_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the equipment was on standby — available and ready but not assigned to active work. Relevant for contract billing where standby rates differ from operating rates.

attributes.name: supplier_name
attributes.description: Name of the external equipment supplier, rental company, or subcontractor providing the equipment, when ownership_type is rented, leased, or subcontractor. Null for company-owned equipment.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Prevailing weather condition at the site during the equipment deployment shift. Recorded to support analysis of weather-related productivity impacts and Extension of Time (EOT) claims. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|cloudy|rain|heavy_rain|fog|wind|storm|snow — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: material_delivery
products.description: Site-level record of material deliveries received at the construction site gate or designated laydown area. Captures delivery date, supplier name, PO reference (FK to procurement domain), delivery docket number, material description, quantity delivered, unit of measure, receiving location (laydown zone per site_logistics_plan), condition on receipt (accepted/rejected/partial), receiver name, temperature-sensitive storage flag, and discrepancy notes. Distinct from procurement domain PO records — this entity captures the physical receipt event at the site and triggers material domain stock updates.

attributes.name: material_delivery_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each material delivery receipt event recorded at the construction site. Primary key for this entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.

attributes.name: activity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to schedule.activity. Business justification: Material deliveries are scheduled against specific construction activities; the FK enables material‑to‑activity traceability for cost and progress.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.asset. Business justification: Material deliveries are executed by specific vehicles; tracking the asset supports logistics, cost, and compliance audits.

attributes.name: compliance_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Delivery of hazardous or regulated materials requires a specific permit; linking validates compliance before receipt.

attributes.name: design_submittal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.design_submittal. Business justification: Deliveries are matched to approved design submittals to verify material compliance before acceptance.

attributes.name: finance_cost_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_code. Business justification: Material delivery records must map to finance cost codes for material cost allocation and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: firm_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.firm_profile. Business justification: Materials are frequently delivered by subcontractors; linking delivery to the subcontractor enables accountability, invoicing and quality traceability.

attributes.name: material_construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project to which this material delivery belongs. Links the physical receipt event to the project context for cost coding and earned value computation.

attributes.name: material_site_construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction site where the material delivery was physically received. Supports site-level logistics and laydown area management.

attributes.name: primary_material_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor who delivered the materials. Links to the procurement domain supplier master for vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the procurement domain Purchase Order (PO) against which this delivery was made. Enables reconciliation between the physical receipt event and the contractual procurement record.

attributes.name: receiver_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee record of the site personnel who received and signed off on the delivery. Links to the workforce domain for accountability and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The manufacturer's batch or lot number for the delivered material. Critical for quality traceability, enabling recall or investigation of specific production batches if non-conformance is identified post-installation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this material delivery record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the delivery value and unit rate are expressed (e.g., USD, AUD, GBP). Required for multi-currency project financial management and IFRS/GAAP reporting.

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the material physically arrived at the site gate or designated laydown area. This is the principal real-world event date for the delivery transaction, distinct from the PO expected delivery date.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the material delivery receipt event. Indicates whether the delivery was fully accepted, rejected at the gate, partially accepted, pending quality inspection, or placed on hold pending resolution of a discrepancy.

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the delivery vehicle arrived at the site gate or laydown area. Supports site logistics scheduling, gate management, and time-stamped audit trails.

attributes.name: delivery_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the accepted delivery, calculated as quantity_accepted multiplied by unit_rate. Used for goods receipt posting, cost accrual, and three-way matching against the supplier invoice. Expressed in the project currency.

attributes.name: discrepancy_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing details of any discrepancy identified at the point of receipt, including quantity shortfalls, damage descriptions, specification mismatches, or incorrect materials. Used to support NCR (Non-Conformance Report) creation and supplier claims.

attributes.name: docket_number
attributes.description: The externally-issued delivery docket or delivery note number provided by the supplier on the physical delivery documentation. Used as the primary business identifier for the delivery event and for three-way matching against the PO and invoice.

attributes.name: driver_name
attributes.description: The name of the delivery driver as recorded on the delivery docket or site gate register. Captured for site security, access control, and delivery audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: expected_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which the delivery was originally scheduled or expected to arrive at site as per the Purchase Order (PO) or procurement schedule. Used to calculate delivery schedule variance and supplier on-time delivery performance.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA Goods Receipt (GR) document number generated upon posting of the material receipt in the ERP system. Provides the formal financial and inventory accounting reference for the delivery event.

attributes.name: hazardous_material
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivered material is classified as hazardous under applicable regulations (e.g., chemicals, solvents, fuels, asbestos-containing materials). When True, triggers HSE compliance protocols including MSDS verification and segregated storage.

attributes.name: itp_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) hold or witness point associated with this material delivery. Links the receipt event to the project quality plan to confirm that required inspections were completed before material acceptance.

attributes.name: laydown_zone
attributes.description: The designated receiving location or laydown area on the site logistics plan where the delivered material was stored upon receipt (e.g., 'Zone A - Steel Yard', 'Zone C - Concrete Batching Area'). Supports site logistics management and material traceability.

attributes.name: material_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the material type delivered. Supports site logistics planning, laydown zone assignment, and HSE compliance for hazardous materials. MEP refers to Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing materials. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: concrete|steel|timber|aggregates|MEP|civil|finishing|hazardous|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: material_code
attributes.description: The internal material catalogue code or SAP material number identifying the type of material delivered. Used for stock updates in the materials domain and reconciliation with the Bill of Quantities (BOQ).

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the material delivered as stated on the delivery docket. Captures the specific grade, specification, or product name (e.g., 'Ready-Mix Concrete 40MPa', 'Structural Steel Grade 350', 'HDPE Pipe DN200').

attributes.name: msds_verified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) Verified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) or Safety Data Sheet (SDS) was verified and on file at the time of receipt for hazardous materials. Required for OSHA HazCom compliance and site HSE management.

tag_set.value: Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) Verified Flag

attributes.name: ncr_reference
attributes.description: The reference number of the Non-Conformance Report (NCR) raised as a result of a rejected or non-conforming delivery. Links the physical receipt event to the quality management process for corrective action tracking.

attributes.name: po_line_number
attributes.description: The specific line item number on the Purchase Order (PO) to which this delivery relates. Enables precise three-way matching at the line level between the PO, goods receipt, and supplier invoice.

attributes.name: procore_log_reference
attributes.description: The reference identifier of the associated Procore daily log entry in which this material delivery was recorded. Enables traceability back to the source system of record for field management and audit purposes.

attributes.name: quantity_accepted
attributes.description: The quantity of material formally accepted after inspection at the point of receipt. May be less than quantity_delivered in cases of partial acceptance due to damage, non-conformance, or specification mismatch. Triggers stock update in the materials domain.

attributes.name: quantity_delivered
attributes.description: The actual quantity of material physically received at the site as measured or counted at the point of receipt. This is the principal quantitative fact for the delivery event and is used to update material stock records and reconcile against the PO quantity.

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: The quantity of material that was ordered on the associated Purchase Order (PO) line for this delivery. Enables immediate over/under delivery variance calculation at the point of receipt without requiring a join to the procurement domain.

attributes.name: quantity_rejected
attributes.description: The quantity of material rejected at the point of receipt due to damage, non-conformance with specification, or incorrect material. Triggers a Non-Conformance Report (NCR) and return-to-supplier process.

attributes.name: receipt_condition
attributes.description: The physical condition of the material as assessed at the point of receipt. Drives the acceptance/rejection decision and informs quality control processes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: good|damaged|wet|contaminated|incorrect_spec|short_delivered — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: receiving_inspector
attributes.description: The full name of the site personnel who physically received and inspected the delivery at the site gate or laydown area. This individual is accountable for the acceptance/rejection decision recorded on the delivery docket.

attributes.name: temperature_sensitive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivered material requires temperature-controlled storage conditions (e.g., epoxy resins, certain adhesives, bituminous products, or cold-chain materials). When True, triggers special handling and storage protocols on site.

attributes.name: test_certificate_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the material test certificate or mill certificate provided by the supplier with the delivery. Confirms that the material meets the specified engineering standards and is required for quality assurance sign-off.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which the delivered quantity is expressed (e.g., cubic metres for concrete, tonnes for steel, each for prefabricated elements). Must align with the unit specified on the Purchase Order (PO) for reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: m3|tonne|kg|m|m2|EA|L|bag|roll|set — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_rate
attributes.description: The agreed unit price for the material as per the Purchase Order (PO), expressed in the project currency. Used to calculate the value of the delivery for goods receipt posting and cost accrual in the project financial management system.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this material delivery record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: vehicle_registration
attributes.description: The registration plate number of the delivery vehicle. Recorded at the site gate for security, access control, and logistics tracking purposes.

attributes.name: wbs_code
attributes.description: The Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) code to which the cost of this material delivery is allocated. Enables project cost control, earned value management (EVM), and cost performance index (CPI) computation at the WBS element level.

products.name: instruction
products.description: Formal site instruction issued by the engineer or client representative directing the contractor to carry out specific work, vary a method, or address a site condition. Captures instruction number, issue date, issuing authority, instruction description, affected work front, urgency classification, contractor acknowledgment date, and cost/time impact flag. Feeds the contract administration and change order process in the contract domain.

attributes.name: instruction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the site instruction record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: activity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to schedule.activity. Business justification: Site Instructions are issued for specific scheduled activities (e.g., change orders); the link supports instruction tracking against the activity schedule.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contract under which this site instruction is issued. Feeds the contract administration and change order process in the contract domain.

attributes.name: change_notice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.change_notice. Business justification: Site instructions often stem from formal change notices; linking tracks the originating change for audit.

attributes.name: compliance_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Site instructions often stem from permit conditions; linking ties each instruction to its governing permit for traceability.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project under which this site instruction was issued. Links to the project domain for earned value and cost control context.

attributes.name: firm_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.firm_profile. Business justification: Site instructions are issued to a designated subcontractor to carry out the work; essential for work‑order control and cost allocation.

attributes.name: issuing_authority_craft_worker_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Issuing Authority Craft Worker Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.craft_worker. Business justification: REQUIRED: Site instructions must be issued by a responsible craft worker (foreman/supervisor); FK provides accountability and audit trail for instruction enforcement.

tag_set.value: Issuing Authority Craft Worker Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: issuing_authority_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Internal site instructions are issued by a designated employee; linking records the issuer for traceability and compliance.

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.bid_submission. Business justification: Site instructions (change orders) are issued against the awarded bid; linking provides traceability of instruction impact to the original bid submission.

attributes.name: work_front_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific work front or site zone affected by this instruction. Supports site operations tracking and resource allocation.

attributes.name: aconex_mail_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the formal correspondence or transmittal in the Aconex Document Management system through which this site instruction was officially transmitted to the contractor.

attributes.name: affected_drawing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number(s) of the engineering drawings or BIM model elements affected by this site instruction, enabling traceability to design documents and supporting RFI and submittal processes.

attributes.name: affected_wbs_code
attributes.description: Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) code identifying the specific work package or activity affected by this site instruction. Enables cost and schedule impact traceability within the project control framework.

attributes.name: contractor_acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contractor formally acknowledged receipt of the site instruction. Contractually significant as it starts the clock for contractor response obligations and EOT notice periods under FIDIC.

attributes.name: contractor_dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contractor has formally disputed the validity, scope, or commercial basis of this site instruction, triggering the contract dispute resolution process.

attributes.name: contractor_response_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the contractor submitted their formal response or cost/time claim in relation to this site instruction. Used to assess compliance with contractual response obligations.

attributes.name: contractor_response_due_date
attributes.description: Contractually required date by which the contractor must submit a formal response, cost estimate, or notice of claim in relation to this site instruction, calculated from the acknowledgment date per contract conditions.

attributes.name: cost_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site instruction is expected to result in a cost variation to the contract. When true, triggers the change order (CO) valuation process in the contract domain.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this site instruction record was first created in the data platform, providing the audit trail creation marker for data governance and lineage purposes.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the estimated cost impact amount, aligned with the contract currency for financial reporting and EVM calculations.

attributes.name: instruction_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the work, method change, or site condition to be addressed as directed by the issuing authority. This is the primary contractual content of the instruction.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the contractor's stated grounds for disputing this site instruction, captured for contract administration and potential adjudication or arbitration proceedings.

attributes.name: document_revision
attributes.description: Revision identifier of the site instruction document, tracking amendments or superseding versions issued after the original. Supports document control and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: estimated_cost_impact_amount
attributes.description: Preliminary estimated monetary value of the cost variation associated with this site instruction, expressed in the contract currency. Used for budget forecasting and change order (CO) initiation prior to formal valuation.

attributes.name: estimated_time_impact_days
attributes.description: Preliminary estimate of the number of calendar days by which this site instruction may extend the contract completion date, used for Extension of Time (EOT) assessment and CPM schedule analysis.

attributes.name: hse_implication_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Implication Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this site instruction has Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) implications requiring a Safe Work Method Statement (SWMS) update, permit to work review, or HSE authority notification before execution.

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Implication Flag

attributes.name: implementation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contractor completed execution of all work directed by the site instruction, enabling closure of the instruction and final cost/time impact confirmation.

attributes.name: implementation_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contractor commenced execution of the work directed by the site instruction. Used for progress tracking and earned value computation.

attributes.name: instruction_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to the site instruction by the issuing authority. Used for correspondence, filing, and cross-referencing with contract documents and RFIs. Format: SI-[ProjectCode]-[SequenceNumber].

attributes.name: instruction_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle status of the site instruction from issuance through contractor acknowledgment to implementation and closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|issued|acknowledged|under_review|implemented|closed|disputed|cancelled — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: instruction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature and purpose of the site instruction, determining the downstream contractual and commercial treatment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: variation_order|method_change|safety_directive|quality_directive|access_instruction|suspension|acceleration|remedial_work — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the site instruction was formally issued by the engineer or client representative to the contractor. This is the principal business event date for the instruction.

attributes.name: issued_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the site instruction was formally transmitted or published to the contractor, capturing the exact moment of issuance for audit and contractual timeline purposes.

attributes.name: issuing_authority_role
attributes.description: Contractual role or designation of the person who issued the site instruction, determining the authority level and contractual validity of the instruction under the applicable contract conditions.

attributes.name: issuing_organisation
attributes.description: Name of the organisation (client, engineer, or consultant firm) on behalf of which the site instruction was issued. Relevant for joint venture and multi-party project structures.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this site instruction record was most recently modified in the data platform, supporting change tracking, data quality monitoring, and incremental ETL processing.

attributes.name: linked_change_order_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the formal Change Order (CO) raised in the contract domain as a result of this site instruction, enabling traceability between field directives and contractual variations.

attributes.name: linked_rfi_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Request for Information (RFI) that preceded or triggered this site instruction, providing traceability from field queries to formal directives.

attributes.name: ncr_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the Non-Conformance Report (NCR) that triggered this site instruction, where the instruction is issued as a corrective action directive in response to a quality non-conformance.

attributes.name: physical_location_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the specific physical location, chainage, grid reference, or site zone where the instructed work is to be carried out, supporting field crew navigation and site logistics.

attributes.name: procore_instruction_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of this site instruction record in the Procore Construction Management system, used for data lineage, reconciliation, and integration with the source system of record.

attributes.name: quality_hold_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a quality hold point or inspection is required before or after execution of the work directed by this site instruction, triggering an Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) checkpoint.

attributes.name: specification_clause_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the relevant contract specification clause, standard, or technical requirement that the site instruction relates to or invokes, supporting contractual compliance and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: superseded_by_instruction_number
attributes.description: Instruction number of the subsequent site instruction that supersedes or replaces this one, enabling version chain traceability in the instruction register.

attributes.name: time_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site instruction is expected to result in a schedule delay or Extension of Time (EOT) claim. When true, triggers schedule impact assessment in the project domain.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title summarising the subject matter of the site instruction, used for quick identification in registers and dashboards.

attributes.name: urgency_classification
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the site instruction indicating the required response timeframe. Emergency instructions may require immediate contractor action to address safety or critical path impacts.

products.name: lift_plan
products.description: Engineered lift plan record for crane and rigging operations on site. Captures lift plan number, lift date, crane type and capacity, load weight, lift radius, pick and set points, rigging configuration, ground bearing pressure check, exclusion zone dimensions, appointed person name, approval status, and permit-to-lift reference. Required under OSHA and ASME B30 standards for critical and complex lifts.

attributes.name: lift_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the engineered lift plan record. Primary key for the lift_plan data product in the site domain.

attributes.name: activity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to schedule.activity. Business justification: Lift Plans are prepared for a scheduled lift activity; associating them with schedule.activity enables lift‑safety coordination and critical‑path analysis.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific crane asset record in the equipment register. Links to crane certification, inspection history, and rated capacity documentation.

attributes.name: compliance_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Lift plans are authorized by a lift permit; linking ensures the plan is executed under the correct regulatory permit.

attributes.name: crane_operator_craft_worker_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Crane Operator Craft Worker Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.craft_worker. Business justification: REQUIRED: Crane operators are skilled craft workers; linking enables equipment‑operator assignment, certification tracking and labor cost allocation.

tag_set.value: Crane Operator Craft Worker Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: firm_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.firm_profile. Business justification: Lift plans are prepared/executed by a specific subcontractor providing crane services; required for safety compliance, cost tracking, and contract billing.

attributes.name: lift_construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project under which this lift plan is executed. Links the lift plan to project cost, schedule, and WBS context.

attributes.name: lift_site_construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical construction site where the crane and rigging operation is to be performed.

attributes.name: primary_lift_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce record of the appointed person responsible for the lift plan. Used to verify competency certification and training records.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: REQUIRED: Lift plans reference crane rental purchase orders; the link is needed for safety permits and financial tracking.

attributes.name: swms_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.swms. Business justification: REQUIRED: Lift plans are executed only when a Safe Work Method Statement is approved; the FK ties the plan to its SWMS.

attributes.name: tertiary_lift_rigger_in_charge_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce record of the qualified rigger-in-charge responsible for rigging the load and directing the lift operation.

attributes.name: appointed_person_name
attributes.description: Full name of the appointed person (lift supervisor or lift director) who is responsible for planning and supervising the crane lift operation. Required under ASME P30.1 and OSHA regulations.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the lift plan through the review and approval lifecycle. Approved status is required before any lift operation may commence.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the lift plan was formally approved by the authorising person. Establishes the validity window for the permit-to-lift.

attributes.name: boom_length_m
attributes.description: Configured boom length in metres used for the lift operation. Together with lift radius, determines the applicable rated capacity from the manufacturer load chart.

attributes.name: capacity_utilisation_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the crane rated capacity utilised by the planned load weight at the specified radius and boom configuration. Lifts exceeding 75% trigger critical lift classification per ASME P30.1.

attributes.name: crane_make
attributes.description: Manufacturer name of the crane equipment (e.g., Liebherr, Manitowoc, Terex). Used for load chart reference and manufacturer-specific operating procedures.

attributes.name: crane_model
attributes.description: Model designation of the crane equipment as specified by the manufacturer. Required for load chart identification and rated capacity verification.

attributes.name: crane_rated_capacity_t
attributes.description: Maximum rated lifting capacity of the crane in metric tonnes as specified in the manufacturer load chart for the configured boom length and radius. Basis for critical lift classification.

attributes.name: crane_type
attributes.description: Classification of the crane equipment to be used for the lift operation. Determines applicable ASME B30 volume and OSHA regulatory requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mobile_crawler|mobile_rough_terrain|mobile_all_terrain|tower_luffing|tower_hammerhead|overhead_bridge|gantry|derrick|knuckle_boom — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the lift plan record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: exclusion_zone_radius_m
