products.name: sourcing_plan
products.description: Project-level procurement execution plan defining the sourcing strategy, procurement milestones, long-lead item identification, packaging strategy, expediting requirements, and planned award dates for all major material and service categories. Captures plan version, project reference, procurement category, sourcing method (competitive bid, sole source, framework agreement), planned RFQ date, planned award date, planned delivery date, expediting frequency and method, responsible procurement manager, and critical path material flags. Integrates with Primavera P6 schedule milestones to ensure procurement activities align with construction sequencing.

attributes.name: sourcing_plan_id
attributes.description: Primary key for sourcing_plan

attributes.name: bid_opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.bid_opportunity. Business justification: Procurement planning aligns with a specific bid opportunity; the link supports schedule and budget integration.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the project for which this sourcing plan is created. Links procurement planning to the project execution context.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the procurement manager or buyer responsible for executing this sourcing plan.

attributes.name: purchase_requisition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_requisition. Business justification: Link sourcing plan to purchase requisition to tie planning to actual requisitions.

attributes.name: approval_authority_level
attributes.description: Required approval authority level for this sourcing plan based on estimated value and risk classification.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved this sourcing plan version.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when this sourcing plan version was formally approved for execution.

attributes.name: budget_code
attributes.description: Project budget code or cost center against which this procurement will be charged. Links to project financial control structure.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Type of contract to be used for this procurement (e.g., lump sum, unit rate, cost-plus, GMP).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sourcing plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated procurement value (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: Site address or warehouse location where materials are to be delivered. May reference a site operations location.

attributes.name: estimated_value
attributes.description: Estimated total value of the procurement covered by this sourcing plan. Used for budget allocation and approval authority determination.

attributes.name: expediting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency of expediting reviews and supplier progress checks (e.g., weekly, monthly, milestone-based).

attributes.name: expediting_method
attributes.description: Primary method used for expediting and progress monitoring (e.g., site visits to vendor facility, video conference, third-party inspection).

attributes.name: expediting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether active expediting and progress monitoring of the supplier is required due to schedule criticality or complexity.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms defining the delivery point and risk transfer between buyer and seller (e.g., FOB, CIF, DDP). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: inspection_requirements
attributes.description: Description of quality inspection and testing requirements for the procured materials or equipment (e.g., FAT, SAT, third-party certification, mill test certificates).

attributes.name: is_critical_path
attributes.description: Indicates whether the materials or services covered by this plan are on the project critical path and require expedited procurement to avoid schedule delays.

attributes.name: is_long_lead_item
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sourcing plan covers long-lead items requiring early procurement action due to extended manufacturing or delivery lead times.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sourcing plan record was last updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, assumptions, constraints, or special instructions related to this sourcing plan.

attributes.name: packaging_strategy
attributes.description: Description of how procurement scope is bundled or split into packages for tendering (e.g., single package, split by trade, split by project phase, geographic split).

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms to be applied for this procurement (e.g., Net 30, progress payments, milestone-based, letter of credit).

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the sourcing plan. Externally visible reference number used in procurement documentation and communications.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the sourcing plan indicating its approval state and execution readiness.

attributes.name: plan_version
attributes.description: Version number of the sourcing plan. Incremented when the plan is revised to track changes over the project lifecycle.

attributes.name: planned_award_date
attributes.description: Target date for awarding the purchase order or contract to the selected supplier. Critical milestone for procurement lead time calculation.

attributes.name: planned_bid_closing_date
attributes.description: Target date by which vendor bids or proposals are due for evaluation.

attributes.name: planned_delivery_date
attributes.description: Target date for material or equipment delivery to site. Must align with construction schedule requirements and site readiness.

attributes.name: planned_installation_date
attributes.description: Target date for installation or commissioning of the procured materials or equipment. Drives backward scheduling of procurement activities.

attributes.name: planned_rfq_date
attributes.description: Target date for issuing the RFQ or RFP to potential suppliers. Aligns with project procurement schedule milestones.

attributes.name: preferred_supplier_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of preferred or prequalified supplier names or codes to be invited for this procurement.

attributes.name: procurement_category
attributes.description: Classification of the procurement scope covered by this plan (e.g., Structural Steel, MEP Equipment, Concrete Materials, Construction Services). Aligns with project WBS and material classification hierarchy.

attributes.name: procurement_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Total lead time in days from purchase order award to site delivery, including manufacturing, inspection, and logistics time.

attributes.name: retention_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of payment to be retained until completion or end of defects liability period. Typical range 5-10%.

attributes.name: risk_classification
attributes.description: Risk level associated with this procurement based on factors such as value, complexity, lead time, supplier market, and schedule impact.

attributes.name: sourcing_method
attributes.description: Procurement strategy and method to be used for acquiring the materials or services (e.g., competitive bidding, sole source negotiation, call-off from framework agreement).

attributes.name: special_requirements
attributes.description: Any special procurement requirements such as local content mandates, sustainability certifications (LEED), HSE requirements, or regulatory compliance needs.

attributes.name: supplier_prequalification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether suppliers must be prequalified before being invited to bid for this procurement.

attributes.name: warranty_period_months
attributes.description: Required warranty or defects liability period in months for the procured materials or equipment.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: WBS element code that this sourcing plan supports. Links procurement to project work packages and schedule activities.

products.name: delivery_schedule
products.description: Planned and actual material delivery schedule records coordinating vendor delivery commitments with project construction milestones. Captures schedule line, PO reference, material, required-on-site date, vendor committed delivery date, actual delivery date, delivery point (site gate, laydown area, warehouse), delivery status (on-track, at-risk, delayed), delay reason code, and schedule variance in days. Integrates with Primavera P6 project schedule.
products.reference: Material Delivery Schedule — Supply Chain Management

attributes.name: delivery_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the delivery schedule record. Primary key for the delivery schedule entity.

attributes.name: activity_id
attributes.description: Primavera P6 activity identifier that requires this material delivery. Links delivery schedule to construction activity on the critical path.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to material.material_master. Business justification: Delivery schedule lines need to reference the material master to validate delivery quantities against approved specifications and to support logistics planning.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Link delivery schedule to purchase order for schedule alignment; po_number becomes redundant.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the material was delivered to the site. Populated upon goods receipt confirmation. Null if delivery has not yet occurred.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the material delivery was received at the site gate or delivery point. Captured from site daily logs or gate entry system.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the logistics carrier or freight forwarder responsible for transporting the material from vendor to site.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delivery schedule record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: critical_path_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the associated activity is on the project critical path per CPM (Critical Path Method) analysis. True if on critical path, False otherwise. Drives prioritization of delivery tracking.

attributes.name: delay_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for delivery delay (e.g., vendor production delay, logistics issue, customs clearance, weather, site access restriction). Null if no delay.

attributes.name: delay_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the delay reason, including root cause analysis and corrective actions taken.

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: Vendor-issued delivery note or packing slip number accompanying the shipment. Used for cross-referencing physical delivery with schedule record.

attributes.name: delivery_point_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific delivery location on site (e.g., site gate, laydown area, warehouse, tower crane zone). References site location master data.

attributes.name: delivery_point_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the delivery point location, including access instructions and unloading requirements.

attributes.name: delivery_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material scheduled for delivery in this schedule line. Must align with PO line item quantity and unit of measure.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current status of the delivery schedule indicating whether the delivery is progressing as planned or experiencing issues. Updated based on vendor updates and schedule variance analysis.

attributes.name: expedite_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery has been flagged for expedited processing due to critical path impact or schedule risk. True if expedited, False otherwise.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: SAP MM goods receipt document number generated upon physical receipt and acceptance of the material. Null if goods receipt has not been posted.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity received and accepted during goods receipt. May differ from delivery quantity due to shortages, damages, or over-delivery.

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms code defining the delivery terms and transfer of risk between vendor and buyer (e.g., EXW, FOB, CIF, DDP).

attributes.name: inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material requires QA/QC (Quality Assurance/Quality Control) inspection upon delivery before acceptance. True if inspection required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last updated this delivery schedule record. Supports accountability and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delivery schedule record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change for audit and synchronization purposes.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Total number of days from PO issuance to required on-site date. Used for procurement planning and schedule risk analysis.

attributes.name: planned_delivery_time
attributes.description: Specific time window planned for material delivery, including hour and minute. Critical for coordinating site logistics and crane availability.

attributes.name: project_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the construction project to which this material delivery is assigned. Links delivery to project schedule and WBS (Work Breakdown Structure).

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to the delivery schedule. Captures ad-hoc information not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: required_on_site_date
attributes.description: Date by which the material must be available on the construction site to support the project schedule. Derived from Primavera P6 activity start dates and material lead times.

attributes.name: schedule_line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the purchase order identifying this specific delivery schedule. Allows multiple delivery schedules per PO line item.

attributes.name: schedule_variance_days
attributes.description: Number of days variance between vendor committed date and required on-site date. Positive values indicate early delivery, negative values indicate delay. Used for SPI (Schedule Performance Index) calculation.

attributes.name: shipment_tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier tracking number or bill of lading number for the shipment. Used for real-time logistics tracking and delivery confirmation.

attributes.name: site_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the site personnel responsible for coordinating and accepting the delivery. Typically site engineer or materials coordinator.

attributes.name: site_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the site contact person for delivery coordination and issue resolution.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Specific instructions for handling, unloading, or storing the material upon delivery (e.g., crane required, temperature-sensitive, hazardous material, fragile).

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the warehouse or laydown area where the material will be stored after delivery until required for installation.

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation used for the delivery (road, rail, sea, air, or multimodal combination).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the delivery quantity (e.g., EA for each, TON for tons, M3 for cubic meters, KG for kilograms).

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier or vendor responsible for delivering the material. References vendor master data.

attributes.name: vendor_committed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor has committed to deliver the material to the designated delivery point. Captured from PO acknowledgment or vendor confirmation.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Specific WBS element within the project structure where the material will be consumed. Enables cost allocation and progress tracking at granular level.

products.name: vendor_evaluation
products.description: Unified vendor assessment records covering both pre-qualification (AVL entry, financial health, technical capability, HSE ratings, quality certifications, bonding limits, insurance verification) and ongoing periodic performance evaluation (on-time delivery rate, quality acceptance rate, NCR count, HSE incident count, responsiveness score, commercial compliance score, overall KPI rating). Captures qualification status, evaluation type (pre-qualification, periodic review, project-specific), evaluation period, evaluating manager, corrective action flags, and qualification expiry dates. Feeds vendor approval decisions, bid invitation eligibility, and continuous improvement programs. Sourced from Procore, SAP MM, and Intelex.

attributes.name: vendor_evaluation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for vendor_evaluation

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the senior manager or procurement director who approved the evaluation outcome.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the project for which this vendor evaluation was conducted. Applicable for project-specific evaluations tied to bid eligibility.

attributes.name: primary_vendor_evaluator_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the procurement manager or project manager who conducted the vendor evaluation.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor being evaluated. Links to the vendor master record in the procurement system.

attributes.name: avl_entry_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor was added to the AVL (Approved Vendor List) following successful pre-qualification. Null for vendors not yet approved.

attributes.name: bid_invitation_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) determining whether the vendor is currently eligible to receive bid invitations for RFP (Request for Proposal) and RFQ (Request for Quotation) based on evaluation outcome and qualification status.

attributes.name: bonding_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum contract value (in USD) for which the vendor can provide performance and payment bonds. Critical for pre-qualification and determines eligibility for large-scale EPC (Engineering Procurement and Construction) projects.

attributes.name: commercial_compliance_score
attributes.description: Numerical score (0-100) evaluating the vendor's adherence to contract terms, invoicing accuracy, payment terms compliance, and commercial documentation completeness.

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of corrective actions required from the vendor to address performance gaps, quality issues, HSE violations, or compliance deficiencies identified during evaluation.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the vendor must complete and demonstrate closure of required corrective actions. Failure to meet this date may result in suspension or disqualification.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) signaling that the vendor must implement corrective actions to address identified deficiencies before qualification can be maintained or upgraded.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor evaluation record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: Date when the evaluation was formally completed and scored. Represents the business event timestamp for the assessment.

attributes.name: evaluation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing additional observations, strengths, weaknesses, and contextual information from the evaluator that supplements the quantitative scores.

attributes.name: evaluation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the vendor evaluation record. Format: VE-YYYYMMDD followed by sequence number.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance evaluation period. For periodic reviews, defines the close of the assessment window.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance evaluation period. For periodic reviews, defines the beginning of the assessment window. For pre-qualification, represents the date evaluation commenced.

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor evaluation. Tracks progression from draft through approval or rejection.

attributes.name: evaluation_type
attributes.description: Type of vendor evaluation being conducted. Pre-qualification for new vendors entering AVL (Approved Vendor List), periodic review for ongoing performance assessment, project-specific for bid eligibility, re-qualification for expired certifications, or incident-triggered for corrective action follow-up.

attributes.name: financial_health_score
attributes.description: Numerical score (0-100) assessing the vendor's financial stability based on credit rating, liquidity ratios, debt-to-equity, and financial statement analysis. Critical for pre-qualification and bonding capacity assessment.

attributes.name: hse_incident_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Incident Count
attributes.description: Total number of HSE (Health Safety and Environment) incidents (including LTI, near-misses, and safety violations) involving the vendor during the evaluation period.

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Incident Count

attributes.name: hse_rating_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Rating Score
attributes.description: Numerical score (0-100) assessing the vendor's HSE (Health Safety and Environment) performance including TRIR (Total Recordable Incident Rate), LTI (Lost Time Injury) frequency, safety certifications (ISO 45001), and HSE management system maturity.

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Rating Score

attributes.name: insurance_verified_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) confirming that the vendor's general liability, professional indemnity, and workers' compensation insurance policies have been verified and meet project requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor evaluation record was last updated. Audit trail for change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: ncr_count
attributes.description: Total number of NCR (Non-Conformance Report) incidents raised against the vendor during the evaluation period. Lower counts indicate better quality performance.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate
attributes.description: Percentage (0-100) of deliveries completed on or before the scheduled delivery date during the evaluation period. Key KPI for schedule performance and reliability.

attributes.name: overall_kpi_rating
attributes.description: Composite numerical score (0-100) representing the weighted average of all evaluation dimensions (financial, technical, HSE, quality, delivery, responsiveness, commercial). Determines overall vendor performance grade.

attributes.name: performance_grade
attributes.description: Letter grade (A through F) assigned based on overall KPI rating. A=Excellent (90-100), B=Good (80-89), C=Satisfactory (70-79), D=Marginal (60-69), F=Unsatisfactory (<60). Drives vendor tier classification and bid invitation priority.

attributes.name: qualification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor's qualification status expires and requires renewal through re-evaluation. Typically set 12-24 months from evaluation date for qualified vendors.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Resulting qualification status of the vendor based on evaluation outcome. Determines vendor eligibility for bid invitations and PO (Purchase Order) issuance.

attributes.name: quality_acceptance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage (0-100) of delivered materials or services that passed quality inspection on first submission without NCR (Non-Conformance Report) during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: quality_certification_score
attributes.description: Numerical score (0-100) evaluating the vendor's quality management certifications (ISO 9001), QA/QC (Quality Assurance/Quality Control) processes, inspection capabilities, and adherence to ITP (Inspection and Test Plan) requirements.

attributes.name: responsiveness_score
attributes.description: Numerical score (0-100) assessing the vendor's responsiveness to RFI (Request for Information), RFQ (Request for Quotation), change orders, and issue resolution. Measures communication effectiveness and turnaround time.

attributes.name: technical_capability_score
attributes.description: Numerical score (0-100) evaluating the vendor's technical competence, equipment availability, workforce skills, past project experience, and ability to meet technical specifications.

products.name: purchase_requisition
products.description: Internal purchase requisition raised by project or site teams to initiate procurement of materials, equipment, or services. Captures requisition number, requesting department, project and WBS element, material or service description, required quantity, unit of measure, required delivery date, estimated cost, budget availability flag, approval workflow status (pending, approved, rejected), approver, urgency classification, and conversion status (converted to RFQ or PO). Sourced from SAP MM PR process. Entry point for all formal procurement activity.

attributes.name: purchase_requisition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchase requisition. Primary key for the purchase requisition entity.

attributes.name: approval_workflow_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the approval workflow instance assigned to this purchase requisition based on value thresholds, project authority matrix, and organizational approval rules.

attributes.name: bid_opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.bid_opportunity. Business justification: Requisitions generated to support a bid opportunity need the opportunity reference for cost tracking and approval workflow.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.account. Business justification: Requisition originates from a client account; FK allows allocation of requisition spend to the correct client entity.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the construction project for which this purchase requisition is raised. Links the requisition to the project master data for cost tracking and budget control.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to material.material_master. Business justification: Purchase requisitions are created for specific materials; linking to material master enables accurate budgeting, inventory checks, and compliance with approved material lists.

attributes.name: requestor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Identifies the employee who raised the PR; needed for requisition approval workflow and spend accountability.

attributes.name: sustainability_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_plan. Business justification: Procurement requisitions are evaluated against the project’s sustainability plan to ensure purchases meet carbon‑reduction and waste‑diversion targets.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase requisition received final approval and became eligible for conversion to RFQ or PO.

attributes.name: budget_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether sufficient budget is available in the assigned WBS element or cost center to cover the estimated cost of this requisition. True if budget is available, False if insufficient.

attributes.name: budget_variance_amount
attributes.description: Difference between available budget and the estimated total cost. Positive value indicates surplus budget, negative indicates deficit requiring approval override.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase requisition was administratively closed after full conversion to procurement documents or cancellation, marking the end of its active lifecycle.

attributes.name: conversion_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase requisition was converted to an RFQ or PO document.

attributes.name: conversion_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether and how the approved purchase requisition has been converted into downstream procurement documents (RFQ for competitive bidding or direct PO for known vendors).

attributes.name: converted_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the RFQ or PO that was created from this purchase requisition, establishing traceability through the procurement lifecycle.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center to which the requisition cost is allocated, used when the requisition is not project-specific or for indirect procurement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the purchase requisition record was first created in the ERP system. Used for audit trail and process cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated cost amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, AED).

attributes.name: current_approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual currently responsible for reviewing and approving the purchase requisition in the workflow sequence.

attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: Site address, warehouse, or specific location where the materials or equipment should be delivered. Critical for logistics planning and site coordination.

attributes.name: estimated_total_cost
attributes.description: Total estimated cost for the requisition line, calculated as quantity multiplied by estimated unit cost. Used for budget availability verification.

attributes.name: estimated_unit_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost per unit of the requested material or service, used for budget checking and preliminary cost estimation.

attributes.name: justification_notes
attributes.description: Business justification and rationale for the purchase requisition, including project need, schedule impact, and any special circumstances requiring expedited processing.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the purchase requisition record was last updated, capturing any changes to status, approvals, or requisition details.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the material, equipment, or service being requested. Includes specifications, grade, dimensions, and any special requirements.

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: Classification code grouping similar materials or services for procurement strategy, vendor assignment, and reporting (e.g., concrete, steel, electrical, MEP services).

attributes.name: mto_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Material Take-Off document or line item from which this requisition was derived, linking procurement to engineering quantity estimates.

attributes.name: pr_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the purchase requisition, externally visible and used in procurement workflows and communications.

attributes.name: pr_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchase requisition in the approval and conversion workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|rejected|converted|cancelled|closed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: pr_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchase requisition based on procurement category: standard materials, subcontract services, general services, stock transfers between sites, consignment arrangements, or equipment rental.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_code
attributes.description: Vendor code of the preferred or suggested supplier for this requisition, if the requester has a specific vendor recommendation based on prior performance or technical requirements.

attributes.name: procurement_strategy
attributes.description: Sourcing approach to be used for fulfilling this requisition based on value, complexity, vendor availability, and time constraints.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the material or service being requested, expressed in the unit of measure specified.

attributes.name: rejection_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase requisition was rejected by an approver in the workflow, if applicable.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided by the approver for rejecting the purchase requisition, including corrective actions required for resubmission.

attributes.name: requester_email
attributes.description: Email address of the requester for communication regarding the purchase requisition status, clarifications, and approvals.

attributes.name: requester_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who created and submitted the purchase requisition.

attributes.name: requesting_department
attributes.description: Name or code of the department or functional unit that originated the purchase requisition (e.g., Site Operations, Engineering, Procurement, MEP).

attributes.name: required_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date by which the requested materials, equipment, or services must be delivered to the project site or requesting location to meet project schedule requirements.

attributes.name: requisition_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase requisition was created and submitted by the requesting party. Principal business event timestamp for the requisition.

attributes.name: technical_specification_attached
attributes.description: Indicates whether detailed technical specifications, drawings, or engineering documents are attached to support the requisition evaluation and vendor quotation process.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit in which the requested quantity is measured (e.g., EA for each, M for meter, M3 for cubic meter, KG for kilogram, HR for hour). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|M|M2|M3|KG|TON|L|HR|DAY|SET|LOT — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: urgency_classification
attributes.description: Priority level of the purchase requisition based on project schedule impact and delivery timeline requirements. Emergency requisitions bypass standard approval workflows.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Specific WBS element within the project structure to which this requisition is charged. Enables granular cost control and tracking at the work package level.

products.name: po_amendment
products.description: Change order and amendment records against issued purchase orders capturing amendment number, amendment type (scope change, quantity change, price adjustment, delivery date change, CO — Change Order), original value, amended value, value delta, reason for amendment, approval status, and amendment date. Maintains full audit trail of PO commercial changes throughout the procurement lifecycle.
products.reference: PO Change Order / Amendment — SAP MM (EKKO revision)

attributes.name: po_amendment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchase order amendment record. Primary key for the po_amendment product.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master contract or framework agreement under which this purchase order and amendment are governed. Links to contractual terms and conditions.

attributes.name: approval_workflow_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the approval workflow instance used to process this amendment. Tracks the routing and authorization path.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project for which this purchase order amendment applies. Links procurement changes to project context.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent purchase order being amended. Links this amendment to the original PO document.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor associated with the purchase order being amended. Tracks vendor-specific amendment history.

attributes.name: amended_delivery_date
attributes.description: The revised delivery or completion date after this amendment. New scheduled milestone post-change.

attributes.name: amended_po_value
attributes.description: The revised total monetary value of the purchase order after this amendment is applied. New committed amount post-change.

attributes.name: amended_quantity

domains.name: material
domains.description: Materials management domain tracking inventory, stock levels, material receipts, consumption, transfers between sites, and material traceability (batch/lot tracking for concrete, steel, MEP components). Manages BOQ (Bill of Quantities) reconciliation, material specifications, FAT/SAT records, material conformance certificates, and warehouse operations for construction materials and consumables.

products.name: master
products.description: Authoritative master record for all construction materials and consumables used across projects. Captures material identity, detailed technical specifications (applicable standards — ASTM, BS, ISO, ACI, AISC — grade/class, minimum performance criteria, specification code, specification revision), classification (concrete, steel, MEP components, aggregates, timber, formwork, etc.), unit of measure, approved equivalent substitutes with engineering justification, LEED compliance flags, LEED credit applicability, hazardous material indicators, shelf life, storage requirements, and supplier cross-references. Manages specification lifecycle (draft, approved, superseded) and material qualification status. Records approved substitutions with reason, client/engineer approval reference, cost impact, and affected BOQ lines. This is the SSOT for material identity, technical specifications, and approved substitutes in the construction enterprise — all transactions reference this record.

domains.name: equipment
domains.description: Construction equipment and fleet management domain tracking heavy machinery (cranes, excavators, concrete pumps), tools, generators, and fleet vehicles. Owns asset master data, utilization tracking, maintenance schedules, equipment hours, mobilization/demobilization records, rental vs. owned classification, and asset lifecycle management via SAP PM and HCSS HeavyJob.

products.name: asset
products.description: Core master record for every piece of construction equipment and fleet vehicle owned, long-term leased, or rented by the company. Captures asset identity, classification (crane, excavator, concrete pump, generator, fleet vehicle, small tool), make, model, serial number, year of manufacture, acquisition date, acquisition cost, ownership type (owned/rented/leased), current status (active, idle, under maintenance, disposed), SAP PM equipment number, HCSS HeavyJob asset ID, regulatory compliance class, and asset lifecycle stage. For disposed assets: captures disposal method (sale, auction, scrap, write-off, trade-in), disposal date, disposal proceeds, buyer details, reason for disposal, and authorizing approver. This is the SSOT for all equipment identity and lifecycle data across the enterprise, from commissioning through disposal.
