attributes.name: current_book_value
attributes.description: Net book value of the asset after accumulated depreciation. Updated periodically based on depreciation schedule and impairment assessments.

attributes.name: disposal_approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the manager or executive who authorized the asset disposal. Required for governance and audit compliance.

attributes.name: disposal_buyer_name
attributes.description: Name of the party who purchased or received the disposed asset. Required for audit trail and warranty transfer documentation.

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was disposed of or removed from active fleet. Triggers final depreciation calculation and asset retirement accounting entries.

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: Method used to dispose of the asset at end of life. Populated only for disposed assets. Impacts accounting treatment and tax reporting.

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Amount received from disposal of the asset through sale, auction, or trade-in. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal for financial reporting.

attributes.name: disposal_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for disposing of the asset (e.g., end of useful life, excessive maintenance costs, fleet optimization, project completion, regulatory non-compliance).

attributes.name: emissions_tier
attributes.description: EPA emissions tier classification (e.g., Tier 4 Final, Tier 3). Determines regulatory compliance for site operations and environmental permitting.

attributes.name: hcss_heavyjob_asset_code
attributes.description: Asset identifier in HCSS HeavyJob field operations system. Used for time tracking, production tracking, and equipment hour logging.

attributes.name: home_yard_location
attributes.description: Primary equipment yard or depot where the asset is based when not deployed to a project site. Used for logistics planning and idle asset management.

attributes.name: insurance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of current insurance coverage. Equipment cannot operate without valid insurance.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number for equipment insurance coverage. Required for risk management and claims processing.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory or safety inspection. Required for OSHA compliance and equipment certification tracking.

attributes.name: last_meter_reading_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent operating hours meter reading. Used to validate meter reading frequency and detect anomalies.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to any field in the asset master record. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the asset lifecycle from acquisition through disposal. Used for lifecycle cost analysis and replacement planning.

attributes.name: make
attributes.description: Manufacturer or brand name of the equipment (e.g., Caterpillar, Komatsu, Liebherr, Volvo, John Deere).

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: Manufacturer model designation for the equipment. Used for parts compatibility, operator training, and maintenance procedure lookup.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next regulatory inspection must be completed. Equipment cannot operate on site after this date without recertification.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the next planned preventive maintenance service. Calculated based on operating hours, calendar time, or manufacturer recommendations.

attributes.name: operating_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total operating weight of the equipment in kilograms. Used for transportation planning, site access evaluation, and ground bearing pressure calculations.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the company controls the asset. Owned assets are capitalized, rented assets are expensed, leased assets follow lease accounting standards.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_class
attributes.description: Regulatory classification determining inspection frequency, operator certification requirements, and safety standards (e.g., OSHA crane certification class, EPA emissions tier).

attributes.name: sap_pm_equipment_number
attributes.description: Equipment master record number in SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance module. System of record identifier for maintenance planning and execution.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned serial number for the equipment unit. Critical for warranty claims, parts ordering, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: tag_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique identifier physically affixed to the equipment. Used for field identification and tracking across sites.

attributes.name: total_operating_hours
attributes.description: Cumulative operating hours recorded on the equipment meter. Used for maintenance scheduling, utilization analysis, and residual value estimation.

attributes.name: year_of_manufacture
attributes.description: Calendar year the equipment was manufactured. Used for depreciation calculations, regulatory compliance age limits, and resale value estimation.

products.name: asset_category
products.description: Reference classification hierarchy for construction equipment and fleet assets. Defines the taxonomy of equipment types used across the enterprise: major categories (heavy earthmoving, lifting, concrete, MEP, fleet, small tools, generators), sub-categories, and equipment class codes aligned with HCSS HeavyJob cost coding and SAP PM functional location structures. Drives cost coding, depreciation rules, maintenance strategy assignment, and utilization benchmarking.
products.reference: HCSS HeavyJob Equipment Class / SAP PM Equipment Category

attributes.name: asset_category_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset category. Primary key for the asset category reference hierarchy.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Asset category default cost center ensures new assets inherit correct cost center for accounting.

attributes.name: parent_category_asset_category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent category in the asset classification hierarchy. Enables multi-level taxonomy (e.g., Heavy Equipment > Earthmoving > Excavators). Null for top-level categories.

attributes.name: asset_category_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the asset category in the master taxonomy: active (in use for classification), inactive (no longer used but retained for historical data), deprecated (being phased out), pending (awaiting approval for activation).

attributes.name: asset_class_sap
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Asset Accounting asset class code for assets in this category. Determines account determination, depreciation keys, and asset master data screen layout in SAP FI-AA module.

attributes.name: benchmark_utilization_rate
attributes.description: Target utilization rate percentage for assets in this category, used for fleet optimization and equipment productivity benchmarking. Represents industry-standard or company target for equipment hours versus available hours.

attributes.name: capitalization_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum acquisition cost threshold for capitalizing assets in this category as fixed assets versus expensing as consumables. Aligns with company capitalization policy and GAAP/IFRS materiality thresholds.

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the asset category. Aligned with HCSS HeavyJob cost coding structure and SAP PM functional location classification. Used for cost allocation, reporting, and system integration.

attributes.name: category_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the asset category scope, typical equipment types included, and business purpose. Provides context for classification decisions and user guidance.

attributes.name: category_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the asset category hierarchy. Level 1 represents top-level categories (e.g., Heavy Equipment), Level 2 represents sub-categories (e.g., Earthmoving), Level 3 represents equipment classes (e.g., Excavators).

attributes.name: category_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the asset category (e.g., Heavy Earthmoving Equipment, Lifting and Hoisting, Concrete Placement, MEP Tools, Fleet Vehicles, Small Tools, Generators and Power).

attributes.name: category_type
attributes.description: Classification of the category node type within the taxonomy: major (top-level grouping), sub (intermediate grouping), class (equipment class), specialty (niche/specialized equipment).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset category record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Standard depreciation method applied to owned assets in this category for financial reporting: straight_line (equal annual depreciation), declining_balance (accelerated depreciation), units_of_production (usage-based depreciation for heavy equipment), none (non-depreciable or rental assets).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this asset category was retired or deprecated. Null for currently active categories. Supports historical reporting and taxonomy evolution tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this asset category became active and available for asset classification. Supports temporal validity and historical taxonomy tracking.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this category are subject to environmental compliance tracking (emissions monitoring, fuel consumption reporting, EPA regulations). True for generators, diesel equipment, and vehicles; False for non-powered tools.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Default General Ledger account code for asset capitalization and depreciation expense posting in SAP S/4HANA Finance. Aligns with chart of accounts structure for fixed asset accounting.

attributes.name: hcss_equipment_type
attributes.description: HCSS HeavyJob equipment type classification for field operations time tracking and production reporting. Maps asset category to HeavyJob cost coding and equipment hour tracking structure.

attributes.name: inspection_frequency_days
attributes.description: Standard inspection interval in days for assets in this category, aligned with manufacturer recommendations and regulatory requirements. Used to generate preventive maintenance schedules in SAP PM. Null for categories not requiring periodic inspection.

attributes.name: insurance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this category require dedicated insurance coverage beyond general liability. True for high-value equipment (cranes, excavators, specialized machinery); False for low-value consumable tools.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset category record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit trail for taxonomy governance.

attributes.name: maintenance_strategy_code
attributes.description: Default maintenance strategy code assigned to assets in this category, aligned with SAP PM maintenance strategy master data. Defines preventive maintenance frequency, inspection intervals, and service requirements (e.g., HVYEQ for heavy equipment, LTTOOL for light tools).

attributes.name: mobilization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this category require formal mobilization and demobilization tracking when deployed to project sites. True for heavy equipment requiring transport logistics; False for small portable tools.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system account that last modified this asset category record. Supports accountability and audit trail for master data governance.

attributes.name: operator_certification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether operation of assets in this category requires certified/licensed operators per OSHA regulations and company HSE policy. True for cranes, forklifts, and heavy machinery; False for hand tools and general equipment.

attributes.name: ownership_classification
attributes.description: Default ownership model for assets in this category: owned (company-owned assets), rented (short-term rental), leased (long-term lease), mixed (category contains both owned and rented assets). Drives depreciation and cost allocation rules.

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric sort order for displaying asset categories in user interfaces and reports. Enables custom sequencing independent of alphabetical or hierarchical order.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Standard useful life in years for assets in this category, used for depreciation calculation and lifecycle planning. Null for rental/leased assets or categories with variable lifespans.

attributes.name: utilization_tracking_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this category require detailed utilization tracking (equipment hours, production tracking) via HCSS HeavyJob or SAP PM. True for high-value equipment requiring cost recovery and productivity analysis; False for low-value consumable tools.

products.name: fleet_assignment
products.description: Transactional record capturing the assignment of a specific piece of equipment or fleet vehicle to a project, site, or work front for a defined period. Tracks assignment start and end dates, assigned project, site location, responsible operator or driver, mobilization status, cost allocation code (WBS element), and applicable internal hire rate (ownership rate, operating rate, standby rate per hour/day/week). Supports equipment utilization tracking, inter-project cost allocation, internal charge-back to projects, and site logistics planning. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob and SAP PS project systems.

attributes.name: fleet_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fleet assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Equipment lease/assignment to a project is governed by a contract; linking records the contract that authorizes each assignment.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific equipment or fleet vehicle being assigned. Links to the equipment master data.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project to which the equipment is assigned.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operator or driver responsible for operating the equipment during this assignment.

attributes.name: rental_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the rental company or vendor supplying the equipment, if applicable. Null for owned equipment.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific site or work location where the equipment is deployed.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the WBS element for cost allocation and project accounting. Used for internal charge-back to projects.

attributes.name: work_front_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific work front or activity area within the site where the equipment is operating.

attributes.name: actual_utilization_hours
attributes.description: Actual cumulative equipment operating hours recorded during this assignment. Updated from daily logs and equipment hour meters.

attributes.name: assignment_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the equipment assignment ends or is planned to end. Nullable for open-ended assignments. Marks the end of cost allocation for this assignment.

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments related to this equipment assignment. Captures special instructions, constraints, or operational considerations.

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the fleet assignment. Externally visible reference number used in mobilization documents and site logistics planning.

attributes.name: assignment_priority
attributes.description: Business priority level of this equipment assignment. Used for resource allocation decisions and conflict resolution when equipment is in high demand.

attributes.name: assignment_purpose
attributes.description: Business description of the purpose or scope of work for this equipment assignment. Describes the specific activities or tasks the equipment will perform.

attributes.name: assignment_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the equipment assignment begins. Marks the start of cost allocation and utilization tracking for this assignment.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the equipment assignment. Tracks progression from planning through mobilization, active use, and demobilization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|mobilizing|active|standby|demobilizing|completed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the equipment ownership or procurement method for this assignment. Determines applicable cost rates and billing rules.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_code
attributes.description: Cost center or cost allocation code for internal charge-back and financial reporting. Used to route equipment costs to the appropriate project budget line.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assignment record was first created in the source system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: daily_rate
attributes.description: Internal daily cost rate for equipment assignment. Alternative to hourly rates for equipment charged on a daily basis.

attributes.name: demobilization_cost
attributes.description: Actual or estimated cost of demobilizing the equipment from the site, including transportation, cleaning, and inspection. One-time cost allocated to the project.

attributes.name: demobilization_date
attributes.description: The date when the equipment was demobilized from the site. Actual date of equipment removal and return to fleet pool or rental company.

attributes.name: idle_hours
attributes.description: Cumulative hours the equipment was on site but not actively operating during this assignment. Used for standby cost allocation and utilization analysis.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Insurance policy number covering the equipment during this assignment. Required for high-value equipment and rental assets.

attributes.name: mobilization_cost
attributes.description: Actual or estimated cost of mobilizing the equipment to the site, including transportation, permits, and setup. One-time cost allocated to the project.

attributes.name: mobilization_date
attributes.description: The date when the equipment was physically mobilized to the site. Actual date of equipment arrival and readiness for work.

attributes.name: mobilization_status
attributes.description: Current physical mobilization status of the equipment. Tracks whether equipment is in transit, on site, or has been demobilized.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this assignment record in the source system.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assignment record was last modified in the source system. Audit trail for record updates.

attributes.name: operating_rate_per_hour
attributes.description: Internal hourly operating cost rate including fuel, maintenance, and operator costs. Used for project cost allocation when equipment is actively operating.

attributes.name: ownership_rate_per_hour
attributes.description: Internal hourly ownership cost rate for owned equipment. Used for project cost allocation and internal charge-back calculations.

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: Regulatory permit or authorization number required for operating this equipment on the site. Applicable for cranes, heavy lifts, and specialized machinery.

attributes.name: planned_utilization_hours
attributes.description: Planned or estimated total equipment operating hours for this assignment. Used for capacity planning and utilization forecasting.

attributes.name: rate_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all rate amounts in this assignment record.

attributes.name: rental_contract_number
attributes.description: External rental contract or purchase order number for rented equipment. Used for vendor billing reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this assignment record in the source system. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and incremental updates.

attributes.name: standby_rate_per_hour
attributes.description: Internal hourly standby cost rate when equipment is on site but not actively operating. Lower rate than operating rate, used for idle time cost allocation.

attributes.name: weekly_rate
attributes.description: Internal weekly cost rate for equipment assignment. Alternative to hourly or daily rates for equipment charged on a weekly basis.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who created this assignment record in the source system.

products.name: hours
products.description: Daily or shift-level transactional record of equipment operating hours, idle hours, standby hours, and downtime events captured from HCSS HeavyJob field time tracking. Includes cost code, operator ID, project and WBS reference, fuel consumption, meter reading (odometer or hour meter), shift date, production quantity achieved. For non-productive time: captures downtime start/end timestamps, duration, downtime category (breakdown, awaiting parts, awaiting operator, weather hold, scheduled maintenance), root cause code, resolution action, and impact assessment. Foundational for equipment utilization rate calculation, cost-per-hour analysis, MTTR (Mean Time To Repair), MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures), availability rate reporting, and CPI/SPI reporting under EVM. SSOT for all equipment time and downtime recording. Primary source: HCSS HeavyJob daily time entry.
products.reference: HCSS HeavyJob Equipment Hours / SAP PM Measurement Document

attributes.name: hours_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the equipment hours transaction record. Primary key for daily or shift-level equipment operating time entries.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Equipment usage hours are charged to the project contract; linking supports progress billing and utilization reporting.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific equipment unit (crane, excavator, concrete pump, generator, vehicle) for which hours are being recorded.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project where the equipment was deployed and operated during this time period.

attributes.name: finance_cost_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_code. Business justification: Equipment operating hour costs are posted to cost codes for labor and equipment cost tracking.

attributes.name: primary_hours_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supervisor or project manager who approved this equipment hours record for cost posting and payroll processing.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific WBS element or work package where equipment hours were charged for granular cost tracking and EVM reporting.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status of the equipment hours record. Tracks progression from field entry through supervisor approval to final posting for cost allocation.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the equipment hours record was approved by the authorized supervisor. Used for audit trail and approval cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: cost_per_hour
attributes.description: Calculated or allocated cost per operating hour for this equipment during the shift. Includes ownership cost, fuel, operator labor, and maintenance allocation. Used for job costing and CPI calculation.

attributes.name: downtime_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the downtime event cause (breakdown, awaiting parts, awaiting operator, weather hold, scheduled maintenance, unscheduled repair). Used for downtime root cause analysis.

attributes.name: downtime_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when equipment downtime event ended and equipment returned to service. Used for MTTR and downtime duration calculation.

attributes.name: downtime_hours
attributes.description: Total hours the equipment was unavailable due to breakdown, maintenance, repair, or other non-productive events. Sum of all downtime event durations for the shift.

attributes.name: downtime_impact_assessment
attributes.description: Business assessment of the downtime events impact on project schedule, cost, and critical path activities. Used for prioritizing maintenance and resource allocation.

attributes.name: downtime_resolution_action
attributes.description: Free-text description of the corrective action taken to resolve the downtime event and return equipment to service. Includes repair details, parts replaced, or workaround applied.

attributes.name: downtime_root_cause_code
attributes.description: Detailed alphanumeric code identifying the specific root cause of the downtime event (e.g., hydraulic failure, tire puncture, electrical fault). Used for MTBF and failure pattern analysis.

attributes.name: downtime_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when equipment downtime event began. Used for MTTR (Mean Time To Repair) and availability rate calculations.

attributes.name: equipment_availability_rate
attributes.description: Calculated percentage of scheduled time that equipment was available for use (not in downtime). Formula: ((total_hours - downtime_hours) / total_hours) * 100. Used for maintenance effectiveness and reliability analysis.

attributes.name: equipment_utilization_rate
attributes.description: Calculated percentage of available time that equipment was productively operating. Formula: (operating_hours / (operating_hours + idle_hours + standby_hours + downtime_hours)) * 100. Key performance indicator for fleet management.

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_liters
attributes.description: Total fuel consumed by the equipment during the shift, measured in liters. Used for fuel efficiency analysis, cost allocation, and environmental reporting.

attributes.name: idle_hours
attributes.description: Hours the equipment was powered on but not performing productive work (waiting for materials, operator break, minor delays). Excludes scheduled downtime.

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether these equipment hours are billable to the client under the contract terms. Used for revenue recognition and client invoicing.

attributes.name: is_overtime
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether these equipment hours were logged during overtime shift periods, affecting cost rates and operator compensation.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific work location or area within the project site where equipment was deployed (e.g., North Excavation Zone, Building A Foundation, Access Road KM 12).

attributes.name: meter_reading_end
attributes.description: Equipment hour meter or odometer reading at the end of the shift. Used to validate reported hours and track cumulative equipment usage for maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: meter_reading_start
attributes.description: Equipment hour meter or odometer reading at the start of the shift. Used to validate reported hours and track cumulative equipment usage for maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, observations, or context about the equipment hours entry. May include operational notes, safety observations, or special conditions.

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Total hours the equipment was actively operating and performing productive work during the shift. Core metric for utilization rate calculation and cost-per-hour analysis.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Classification of equipment ownership model (owned, rented, leased, subcontractor-supplied). Affects cost allocation method and asset management responsibility.

attributes.name: production_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of work output achieved during the shift (e.g., cubic meters excavated, tons hauled, square meters paved). Used for productivity rate calculation and earned value analysis.

attributes.name: production_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the production quantity achieved (cubic meters, tons, square meters, linear meters, each, kilograms, liters). Aligns with project quantity takeoff and BOQ units. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: m3|ton|m2|linear_m|each|kg|liter — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this equipment hours record was first created in the source system. Audit field for data lineage and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: record_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this equipment hours record was last modified in the source system. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: rental_invoice_reference
attributes.description: External rental company invoice number or reference for rented equipment hours. Used for rental cost reconciliation and accounts payable matching.

attributes.name: shift_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the equipment hours were recorded. Primary business event date for daily time tracking and utilization reporting.

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the work shift during which equipment hours were logged (day, night, swing, weekend, holiday, emergency). Used for shift differential costing and scheduling analysis.

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the equipment hours record in the source operational system. Used for data lineage traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: standby_hours
attributes.description: Hours the equipment was on-site, available for use, but not powered on or actively deployed. Includes weather holds and awaiting instructions.

attributes.name: total_equipment_cost
attributes.description: Total cost charged to the project for this equipment hours record. Calculated as operating_hours * cost_per_hour plus any additional charges. Used for project cost control and EVM.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Prevailing weather condition during the shift that may have affected equipment operation and productivity. Used for weather impact analysis and EOT claims. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|rain|snow|wind|extreme_heat|extreme_cold|fog — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: maintenance_plan
products.description: Master record defining the preventive maintenance strategy and schedule for a class of equipment or individual asset. Captures maintenance plan type (time-based, meter-based, condition-based), service intervals (e.g., every 250 engine hours, every 6 months), maintenance task list reference, responsible maintenance team, estimated duration, parts and materials required, and compliance requirements (e.g., crane certification intervals, OSHA inspection schedules). Sourced from SAP PM Maintenance Plan.

attributes.name: maintenance_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the maintenance plan record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Maintenance plans are defined in equipment service contracts; linking supports schedule and financial tracking per agreement.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment asset or equipment class covered by this maintenance plan.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project to which this equipment and its maintenance plan are assigned.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Maintenance plan budgeting is tracked against a cost center to align planned expenses with financial budgets.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Maintenance planning system records the planner (employee) who creates each plan, needed for accountability and cost allocation.

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance crew or team responsible for executing this maintenance plan.

attributes.name: functional_location_id
attributes.description: add column functional_location_id (BIGINT) with FK to equipment.functional_location.functional_location_id - maintenance plans attach to functional locations

attributes.name: certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether completion of this maintenance plan requires formal certification or inspection sign-off by a qualified authority.

attributes.name: compliance_requirement_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the regulatory or compliance requirement driving this maintenance plan (e.g., OSHA crane certification, EPA emissions inspection, manufacturer warranty requirement).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this maintenance plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: downtime_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment must be taken out of service to perform the maintenance activities in this plan.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the maintenance plan expires or is scheduled to be deactivated. Nullable for open-ended plans.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the maintenance plan becomes active and begins generating scheduled maintenance tasks.

attributes.name: environmental_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this maintenance plan includes activities required for environmental compliance (emissions testing, fluid disposal, spill prevention).

attributes.name: estimated_downtime_hours
attributes.description: Estimated duration in hours that the equipment will be unavailable during maintenance execution.

attributes.name: estimated_duration_hours
attributes.description: Estimated time in hours required to complete the maintenance activities defined in this plan.

attributes.name: estimated_labor_cost
attributes.description: Estimated labor cost in base currency for executing one cycle of this maintenance plan.

attributes.name: estimated_material_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost of parts, materials, and consumables required for one maintenance cycle.

attributes.name: interval_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the maintenance interval (hours, days, weeks, months, years, kilometers, cycles). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hours|days|weeks|months|years|kilometers|cycles — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: interval_value
attributes.description: Numeric value defining the service interval (e.g., 250 for every 250 engine hours, 6 for every 6 months).

attributes.name: last_execution_date
attributes.description: Date when the maintenance plan was last executed, used to calculate the next scheduled maintenance date.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required before the scheduled maintenance date to allow for planning, parts procurement, and resource allocation.

attributes.name: manufacturer_recommendation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this maintenance plan follows the equipment manufacturer's recommended service schedule.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this maintenance plan record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this maintenance plan record was last updated.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_date
attributes.description: Calculated date for the next scheduled maintenance activity based on the interval and last execution date.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional instructions, special considerations, or operational notes related to the execution of this maintenance plan.

attributes.name: parts_list_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the bill of materials (BOM) or parts list defining the spare parts and materials required for this maintenance plan.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the maintenance plan for human identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the maintenance plan, externally visible and used in operational communications.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the maintenance plan indicating whether it is generating work orders.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the maintenance strategy: time-based (calendar intervals), meter-based (usage hours/kilometers), condition-based (sensor thresholds), predictive (AI/ML forecasting), or statutory (regulatory compliance).

attributes.name: priority_level

products.name: maintenance_order

products.name: inspection_record
products.description: Transactional record of a statutory, regulatory, or internal safety inspection performed on a piece of equipment, and the master register of all resulting compliance certificates issued. Captures inspection type (pre-start check, periodic statutory inspection, OSHA compliance check, crane load test, lifting gear inspection, pressure vessel test, FAT/SAT), inspection date, inspector name and certification, pass/fail outcome, defects identified, corrective actions required, next inspection due date. For certificates: captures certificate type (crane load test certificate, pressure vessel certificate, lifting gear certificate, OSHA compliance certificate, insurance certificate), certificate number, issuing authority, issue date, expiry date, and document storage reference. SSOT for all equipment inspection events AND asset-level compliance certificates. Supports OSHA compliance, insurance requirements, equipment fitness-for-use certification, pre-mobilization compliance checks, and regulatory audit trails. Distinct from quality ITP inspections (owned by quality domain) and operator certifications (which track people, not assets).
