attributes.description: Total committed cost for the rental agreement including minimum hire period charges, mobilization, and demobilization. Used for budget commitment and accrual.

attributes.name: wbs_element_code
attributes.description: WBS element code for detailed project cost allocation and tracking. Links rental costs to specific work packages.

attributes.name: weekly_hire_rate
attributes.description: Agreed weekly rental rate for the equipment in the contract currency. Used when billing is on a weekly basis.

products.name: equipment_mobilization
products.description: Transactional record capturing the mobilization or demobilization event of a piece of equipment to or from a project site. Tracks event type (mobilization, demobilization, inter-site transfer), planned and actual transport dates, origin and destination locations, transport contractor, transport cost, permits required (oversize load, road permits), equipment condition at dispatch and receipt, and sign-off by site manager. Supports site logistics planning, cost allocation, and equipment tracking across the fleet.

attributes.name: equipment_mobilization_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the equipment mobilization or demobilization event.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Mobilization costs are billed to equipment mobilization contracts; the FK ties each mobilization event to its contract agreement.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment asset being mobilized or demobilized.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project associated with this mobilization event.

attributes.name: dispatch_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Logistics dispatch is performed by a specific employee; tracking supports operational reporting and liability management.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subcontractor or vendor responsible for transporting the equipment.

attributes.name: actual_arrival_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the equipment arrived at the destination location.

attributes.name: actual_dispatch_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the equipment departed from the origin location.

attributes.name: actual_transit_hours
attributes.description: Actual duration in hours that the equipment was in transit from origin to destination.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_code
attributes.description: Cost center or Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) code to which the mobilization cost is allocated.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the mobilization record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: destination_location
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the location to which the equipment is being mobilized (project site, yard, storage facility).

attributes.name: destination_site_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the destination site or facility.

attributes.name: dispatch_condition
attributes.description: Assessed physical and operational condition of the equipment at the time of dispatch from the origin location.

attributes.name: dispatch_condition_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes or observations regarding the equipment condition at dispatch, including any pre-existing damage or defects.

attributes.name: dispatch_signature_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the dispatch sign-off was completed.

attributes.name: distance_km
attributes.description: Total distance in kilometers between the origin and destination locations.

attributes.name: estimated_transit_hours
attributes.description: Estimated duration in hours for the equipment to be transported from origin to destination.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Type of equipment movement event: mobilization (to site), demobilization (from site), inter-site transfer, or relocation.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment is covered by insurance during the mobilization transport.

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the insurance coverage applicable to this mobilization event.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the mobilization record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: mobilization_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the mobilization event, typically formatted as MOB-YYYYNNNN.

attributes.name: mobilization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the mobilization event in the workflow.

attributes.name: origin_location
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the location from which the equipment is being mobilized (yard, warehouse, previous site).

attributes.name: origin_site_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the origin site or facility.

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: Official permit number(s) issued by the governing authority for this transport.

attributes.name: permit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether special permits (oversize load, road permits, environmental permits) are required for this mobilization.

attributes.name: permit_type
attributes.description: Type of permit(s) required for the transport, such as oversize load permit, road use permit, or environmental permit. Multiple permits may be listed.

attributes.name: planned_arrival_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when the equipment is expected to arrive at the destination location.

attributes.name: planned_dispatch_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when the equipment is planned to depart from the origin location.

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Business justification or reason for the mobilization event, such as project start, equipment replacement, or maintenance requirement.

attributes.name: receipt_condition
attributes.description: Assessed physical and operational condition of the equipment upon receipt at the destination location.

attributes.name: receipt_condition_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes or observations regarding the equipment condition at receipt, including any damage incurred during transport.

attributes.name: receipt_signature_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the receipt sign-off was completed.

attributes.name: receipt_signed_by
attributes.description: Name of the site manager or authorized personnel who signed off on the equipment receipt at the destination.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional comments, notes, or special instructions related to the mobilization event.

attributes.name: transport_cost
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for transporting the equipment, including freight, permits, and handling charges.

attributes.name: transport_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transport cost.

attributes.name: transport_method
attributes.description: Method or mode of transportation used to move the equipment.

products.name: fuel_transaction
products.description: Transactional record of fuel issued to a piece of equipment or fleet vehicle. Captures fuel type (diesel, petrol, LPG), quantity issued (litres), unit cost, total cost, issuing fuel point or bowser, date and time of issue, hour meter or odometer reading at fueling, project and cost code allocation, and operator confirmation. Enables fuel consumption tracking, cost-per-hour analysis, carbon emissions reporting (ISO 14001), and detection of fuel wastage or theft.
products.reference: HCSS HeavyJob Fuel Entry / SAP MM Goods Issue

attributes.name: fuel_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fuel transaction record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Fuel supply is frequently contracted; associating each transaction with the governing agreement enables expense allocation and audit.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the equipment or fleet vehicle that received fuel. Links to the equipment master data.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the construction project to which this fuel transaction is allocated for cost tracking.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the equipment operator who confirmed or authorized the fuel transaction. Links to workforce or employee master data.

attributes.name: finance_cost_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_code. Business justification: Fuel consumption is charged to a cost code for cost allocation and EVM reporting.

attributes.name: firm_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.firm_profile. Business justification: Fuel transactions for equipment used by Subcontractor are billed to that Subcontractor, needed for cost recovery and fuel consumption reporting.

attributes.name: fuel_point_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the fuel point, fuel station, or bowser from which the fuel was issued. May be an on-site fuel depot or external vendor station.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to material.material_master. Business justification: Links fuel transactions to the material master for standardized fuel type, pricing, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the construction site or location where the equipment was operating at the time of fueling.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the external fuel vendor or supplier if fuel was purchased from a third-party station. Null for internal fuel depots.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the WBS element for detailed project cost allocation and tracking.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the fuel transaction. Indicates whether the transaction has been reviewed and approved by a supervisor or cost controller.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fuel transaction was approved. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved the fuel transaction. Null if auto-approved or pending approval.

attributes.name: carbon_emission_kg
attributes.description: Estimated carbon dioxide emissions in kilograms resulting from the fuel consumed. Calculated based on fuel type and quantity for ISO 14001 environmental reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fuel transaction record was first created in the system. Represents the audit trail creation time.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: fuel_card_number
attributes.description: Fuel card or fleet card number used for the transaction. Masked or tokenized for security. Used for reconciliation with vendor invoices.

attributes.name: hour_meter_reading
attributes.description: Hour meter reading of the equipment at the time of fueling. Used to calculate fuel consumption per operating hour and detect anomalies.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Vendor invoice number associated with the fuel transaction. Used for accounts payable reconciliation.

attributes.name: is_emergency_refuel
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this was an emergency or unplanned refueling event. True indicates emergency; False indicates scheduled refueling.

attributes.name: is_theft_suspected
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether fuel theft or wastage is suspected based on consumption patterns or anomaly detection. True indicates suspected theft; False indicates normal transaction.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fuel transaction record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: odometer_reading
attributes.description: Odometer reading of the fleet vehicle at the time of fueling. Used for mileage-based fuel consumption analysis. Applicable to vehicles with odometers.

attributes.name: operator_name
attributes.description: Name of the equipment operator who received the fuel on behalf of the equipment.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number if the fuel transaction was part of a formal procurement process. Used for contract compliance and spend tracking.

attributes.name: quantity_issued
attributes.description: Quantity of fuel issued to the equipment in the specified unit of measure. Typically measured in litres or gallons.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the fuel transaction in the source system. Used for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: tank_capacity_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the equipment fuel tank capacity filled during this transaction. Used to detect partial fills and optimize refueling schedules.

attributes.name: total_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of the fuel transaction calculated as quantity issued multiplied by unit cost. Expressed in the transaction currency.

attributes.name: transaction_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the fuel transaction. May include reasons for emergency refueling, discrepancies, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique transaction number or receipt number issued at the time of fueling. Used for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current status of the fuel transaction in its lifecycle. Completed indicates finalized and posted; pending indicates awaiting approval; cancelled indicates voided; disputed indicates under review.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fuel was issued to the equipment. Represents the actual business event time of fueling.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit of fuel at the time of transaction. Expressed in the transaction currency.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the fuel quantity issued. Common units include litres, gallons, or kWh for electric charging.

products.name: operator_certification
products.description: Master record of an equipment operator's certification, licence, or competency qualification for a specific equipment type or class. Captures operator reference (linked to workforce domain), equipment category certified for (e.g., tower crane, mobile crane, excavator, forklift), certifying body, certificate number, issue date, expiry date, certification status (valid, expired, suspended), and renewal requirements. Supports OSHA compliance, HSE pre-start checks, and operator-to-equipment assignment validation. Owned by equipment domain as it governs equipment operation rights.
products.reference: OSHA Operator Certification / Crane Operator Licence

attributes.name: operator_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the operator certification record. Primary key for the operator certification entity.

attributes.name: asset_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.asset_category. Business justification: Operator certification is tied to an equipment category; replace free‑text category with FK to asset_category to enforce consistency.

attributes.name: craft_worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment operator in the workforce domain who holds this certification. Links to the workforce master data to identify the individual operator.

attributes.name: document_register_id
attributes.description: Reference to the digital document or scanned copy of the physical certification document stored in the document management system. Links to Aconex or BIM 360 document repository.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the operator completed the certification assessment or examination. Represents the formal evaluation event.

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Name of the qualified assessor or examiner who conducted the certification assessment and validated the operators competency.

attributes.name: capacity_rating
attributes.description: The maximum capacity or tonnage rating of equipment the operator is certified to operate, such as cranes up to 100 tons or forklifts up to 5 tons. Defines operational limits for equipment assignment.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate or license number issued by the certifying body. This is the externally-known identifier for the certification document.

attributes.name: certification_level
attributes.description: The proficiency or skill level represented by the certification, such as basic, intermediate, advanced, or master operator. Indicates the complexity of equipment and operations the operator is qualified to perform. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: basic|intermediate|advanced|master|trainee|journeyman|supervisor — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certification. Indicates whether the certification is valid and active, expired, suspended, revoked, or pending renewal. Critical for HSE pre-start checks and operator assignment validation.

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: The type or nature of the certification, such as operator license, competency card, safety certification, or manufacturer-specific certification.

attributes.name: certifying_body
attributes.description: Name of the organization, authority, or institution that issued the certification. Examples include NCCCO, OSHA-approved training providers, manufacturer training centers, or government licensing authorities.

attributes.name: certifying_body_accreditation_number
attributes.description: Accreditation or registration number of the certifying body, validating that the issuing organization is authorized to provide certifications.

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: The total cost incurred to obtain or renew this certification, including training fees, examination fees, and administrative charges. Used for workforce development cost tracking.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the certification cost amount. Enables multi-currency cost tracking for international operations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this certification record was first created in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: endorsements
attributes.description: Additional endorsements, specializations, or restrictions associated with the certification, such as night operations, confined spaces, or specific attachment types. Comma-separated list of endorsement codes or descriptions.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification expires and is no longer valid. Operators must renew or recertify before this date to maintain valid certification status.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was originally issued to the operator. Represents the start of the certification validity period.

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country in which the certification was issued. Important for cross-border projects and international operator mobility.

attributes.name: issuing_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or regional jurisdiction within the issuing country where the certification was granted. Relevant for jurisdictions with state-level licensing requirements.

attributes.name: last_renewal_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the certification was renewed or recertified. Tracks the certification maintenance history.

attributes.name: medical_clearance_date
attributes.description: The date on which the operator received medical clearance or passed the required health examination for this certification. Nullable if medical clearance is not required.

attributes.name: medical_clearance_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the medical clearance expires and must be renewed. Nullable if medical clearance is not required or does not expire.

attributes.name: medical_clearance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a medical examination or health clearance is required as part of the certification or renewal process. True if medical clearance is mandatory, false otherwise.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this certification record. Provides audit trail for data changes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this certification record was last modified in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: next_renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the operator must complete renewal requirements to maintain continuous certification. Used for proactive renewal planning and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to the certification. Captures contextual information not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: practical_assessment_score
attributes.description: Score or grade achieved by the operator in the practical hands-on assessment component of the certification. Typically expressed as a percentage or numeric score.

attributes.name: reciprocity_agreements
attributes.description: List of countries, states, or jurisdictions where this certification is recognized under reciprocity or mutual recognition agreements. Enables cross-jurisdictional operator deployment.

attributes.name: renewal_requirement
attributes.description: Description of the requirements the operator must fulfill to renew the certification, such as refresher training hours, re-assessment, continuing education credits, or medical examination.

attributes.name: restrictions
attributes.description: Any limitations or restrictions placed on the certification, such as daylight operations only, supervised operation required, or specific site conditions. Defines operational boundaries for the operator.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this certification record in the source operational system. Enables traceability and reconciliation with source systems.

attributes.name: sponsor_organization
attributes.description: Name of the organization that sponsored or paid for the operators certification training and examination. May be the construction company, a subcontractor, or the operator themselves.

attributes.name: theory_assessment_score
attributes.description: Score or grade achieved by the operator in the theoretical or written examination component of the certification. Typically expressed as a percentage or numeric score.

attributes.name: training_hours_completed
attributes.description: Total number of training hours completed by the operator to achieve this certification. Demonstrates the depth of training and preparation.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was last verified with the certifying body or through an independent verification process.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the certification verification process, indicating whether the certification has been independently verified with the issuing body. Critical for compliance and audit purposes.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person, system, or organization that performed the certification verification. Provides audit trail for verification activities.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who created this certification record in the system. Provides audit trail for data entry.

products.name: telematics_reading
products.description: IoT/telemetry transactional record capturing real-time or near-real-time data transmitted from GPS and telematics devices fitted to heavy equipment and fleet vehicles, aligned with ISO 15143-3 (AEMP telematics standard) and OEM-agnostic integration patterns. Captures timestamp, GPS coordinates (latitude, longitude, elevation), engine hours, engine RPM, fuel level, idle time, fault codes (DTC/J1939), speed, geofence status, and asset operational state. Sourced from onboard telematics units (e.g., Caterpillar Product Link, Komatsu KOMTRAX, John Deere JDLink) integrated via IoT platform or AEMP API. Enables real-time fleet tracking, utilization monitoring, predictive maintenance triggers, geofence compliance, and theft detection.

attributes.name: telematics_reading_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the telematics reading record. Primary key for this IoT/telemetry transactional event.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the heavy equipment or fleet vehicle that generated this telematics reading. Links to the equipment master data asset.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project to which this equipment is currently assigned. Derived from fleet assignment or geofence mapping. Enables project-level utilization and cost allocation.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operator assigned to this equipment at the time of reading, if operator identification is captured via RFID, keypad, or mobile app login. Enables operator performance tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction site where this equipment is currently located. Derived from GPS coordinates and geofence mapping. Enables site-level fleet visibility.

attributes.name: battery_voltage
attributes.description: Current battery voltage of the equipment. Low voltage may indicate battery health issues or electrical system faults.

attributes.name: coolant_temperature_c
attributes.description: Engine coolant temperature in degrees Celsius. High temperatures may indicate overheating or cooling system faults.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or OEM telematics platform that provided this reading (e.g., Caterpillar Product Link, Komatsu KOMTRAX, John Deere JDLink, AEMP API, IoT Platform). Enables multi-vendor telematics integration and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: elevation_m
attributes.description: Elevation above sea level in meters at the time of reading. Useful for terrain analysis and site operations in mountainous or variable-elevation projects.

attributes.name: engine_hours
attributes.description: Cumulative engine operating hours recorded by the equipment at the time of this reading. Critical metric for utilization tracking, maintenance scheduling, and asset lifecycle management.

attributes.name: engine_rpm
attributes.description: Engine revolutions per minute at the time of reading. Indicates operational intensity and can signal abnormal operating conditions or maintenance needs.

attributes.name: fault_code
attributes.description: Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC) or J1939 fault code reported by the equipment at the time of reading. Empty if no fault detected. Enables predictive maintenance and early fault detection.

attributes.name: fault_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the fault code, if available from the OEM telematics system. Assists maintenance teams in diagnosing issues.

attributes.name: fault_severity
attributes.description: Severity level of the reported fault code. Critical faults may trigger immediate maintenance alerts or equipment shutdown protocols.

attributes.name: fuel_consumed_liters
attributes.description: Cumulative fuel consumed in liters since the last reset or equipment initialization. Used for cost tracking and environmental reporting.

attributes.name: fuel_level_percent
attributes.description: Current fuel tank level as a percentage of total capacity. Enables fuel consumption monitoring, refueling planning, and theft detection.

attributes.name: geofence_code
attributes.description: Reference to the geofence zone that the equipment is currently within, if applicable. Null if equipment is outside all defined geofences. Enables site boundary compliance and theft detection.

attributes.name: geofence_status
attributes.description: Status of the equipment relative to the assigned geofence at the time of reading. Triggers alerts for unauthorized movement or equipment theft.

attributes.name: gps_accuracy_m
attributes.description: Estimated accuracy of the GPS coordinates in meters. Lower values indicate higher precision. Used to assess reliability of location data for geofence and tracking analytics.

attributes.name: hydraulic_pressure_bar
attributes.description: Hydraulic system pressure in bar. Applicable to equipment with hydraulic systems (excavators, cranes, concrete pumps). Abnormal pressure may indicate system faults.

attributes.name: idle_time_minutes
attributes.description: Cumulative idle time in minutes (engine running but equipment not performing work). Key metric for utilization optimization and fuel efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: ingestion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this telematics reading was ingested into the lakehouse platform. Used for data pipeline monitoring and latency analysis.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the equipment at the time of reading, in decimal degrees. Enables real-time fleet tracking and geofence compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the equipment at the time of reading, in decimal degrees. Enables real-time fleet tracking and geofence compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: odometer_km
attributes.description: Cumulative distance traveled in kilometers. Applicable to mobile equipment and fleet vehicles. Used for maintenance scheduling and asset utilization tracking.

attributes.name: operational_state
attributes.description: Current operational state of the equipment at the time of reading. Derived from engine status, movement, and sensor data. Enables real-time fleet status dashboards.

attributes.name: payload_weight_kg
attributes.description: Current payload weight in kilograms, if the equipment is equipped with onboard weighing systems (e.g., haul trucks, loaders). Used for production tracking and overload prevention.

attributes.name: reading_quality
attributes.description: Quality indicator for this telematics reading. Suspect or invalid readings may result from sensor faults, connectivity issues, or data transmission errors. Used for data quality filtering in analytics.

attributes.name: reading_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the telematics reading was captured by the onboard device. Represents the real-world event time of the measurement, distinct from transmission or ingestion timestamps.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this reading in the source telematics system or IoT platform. Used for data reconciliation and deduplication.

attributes.name: speed_kmh
attributes.description: Current speed of the equipment in kilometers per hour at the time of reading. Used for safety monitoring, route optimization, and geofence compliance.

attributes.name: telematics_device_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the onboard telematics unit or IoT device that transmitted this reading (e.g., Caterpillar Product Link, Komatsu KOMTRAX, John Deere JDLink device serial number).

attributes.name: transmission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the telematics reading was transmitted from the device to the IoT platform or AEMP API gateway. May differ from reading_timestamp due to connectivity delays.

products.name: asset_valuation
products.description: Master record tracking the financial valuation and depreciation profile of owned equipment assets over their lifecycle from an equipment management perspective. Captures acquisition cost, current book value, accumulated depreciation, depreciation method (straight-line, reducing balance), useful life (years), residual value, last revaluation date, revaluation amount, insurance replacement value, and disposal proceeds (if disposed). Serves equipment-domain decisions: fleet replacement planning, rent-vs-buy analysis, insurance renewal valuations, and asset disposal timing. Finance domain owns the authoritative GL entries and fixed asset subledger (SAP FI-AA) — this product provides the equipment managers operational view of asset value for fleet management decisions.
products.reference: SAP FI-AA Asset Valuation / Fixed Asset Register

attributes.name: asset_valuation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset valuation record.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment asset being valued. Links to the equipment master record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for posting asset valuation depreciation to the correct cost center in financial statements.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Needed to allocate asset valuation entries to the appropriate GL account for depreciation expense tracking.

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation expense recognized from acquisition date through the valuation date. Represents the cumulative reduction in asset value due to wear, tear, and obsolescence.

attributes.name: accumulated_operating_hours
attributes.description: Total operating hours logged by the equipment from acquisition through the valuation date. Used for units-of-production depreciation and lifecycle analysis.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Original purchase price or capitalized cost of the equipment asset at the time of acquisition, including delivery, installation, and commissioning costs.

attributes.name: appraisal_report_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the external appraisal report document. Used to trace valuation back to supporting documentation.

attributes.name: appraiser_name
attributes.description: Name of the professional appraiser or valuation firm that conducted the most recent independent valuation. Null if no external appraisal has been performed.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Financial accounting classification of the asset for reporting and tax purposes (e.g., heavy equipment, vehicles, tools, generators). Aligns with chart of accounts and fixed asset subledger structure.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this valuation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: current_book_value
attributes.description: Net book value of the asset as of the valuation date, calculated as acquisition cost minus accumulated depreciation. This is the carrying amount on the balance sheet.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: The accounting method used to calculate periodic depreciation expense. Straight-line allocates cost evenly over useful life, reducing balance applies a fixed percentage to declining book value, units of production bases depreciation on actual usage hours.

attributes.name: depreciation_rate_percent
attributes.description: Annual depreciation rate expressed as a percentage, applicable for reducing balance and other rate-based depreciation methods. Null for straight-line method.

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was sold, scrapped, or otherwise disposed of. Null if the asset is still in service.

attributes.name: disposal_method
attributes.description: The method by which the asset was disposed. Sale indicates sold to third party, trade-in exchanged for new equipment, scrap sold for parts/metal value, donation given to charity, write-off removed with no proceeds.

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Actual amount received from the sale or disposal of the asset. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal. Null if asset has not been disposed.

attributes.name: fair_market_value
attributes.description: Current estimated market value of the asset if sold in an arms-length transaction. Used for insurance, disposal decisions, and rent-vs-buy analysis. May differ from book value.

attributes.name: impairment_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the asset shows signs of impairment (carrying amount exceeds recoverable amount). True triggers impairment testing per accounting standards.

attributes.name: impairment_loss
attributes.description: Amount by which the carrying amount of the asset exceeds its recoverable amount. Recognized as an expense when impairment is identified. Null if no impairment.

attributes.name: insurance_replacement_value
attributes.description: The cost to replace the asset with a new equivalent unit at current market prices. Used for insurance coverage determination and renewal valuations.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this valuation record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this valuation record was last modified.

attributes.name: next_revaluation_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic revaluation or impairment review. Used for fleet management planning and compliance with revaluation policies.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Classification of asset ownership. Owned assets are capitalized and depreciated, leased assets may be capitalized under IFRS 16, rented assets are expensed and not valued here.

attributes.name: remaining_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated remaining economic life of the asset in years from the valuation date. Used for fleet replacement planning and rent-vs-buy decisions.

attributes.name: residual_value
attributes.description: Estimated salvage or scrap value of the asset at the end of its useful life. The amount expected to be recovered through sale or disposal after full depreciation.

attributes.name: revaluation_amount
attributes.description: The adjustment amount applied during the most recent revaluation. Positive values indicate upward revaluation, negative values indicate impairment. Null if no revaluation has occurred.

attributes.name: revaluation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent revaluation event, if the asset has been revalued to fair market value. Null if no revaluation has occurred since acquisition.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this valuation record in the source system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: tax_depreciation_method
attributes.description: Depreciation method used for tax reporting purposes, which may differ from book depreciation. MACRS (Modified Accelerated Cost Recovery System) is common in the US, Section 179 allows immediate expensing.

attributes.name: tax_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Useful life in years for tax depreciation purposes, as defined by tax regulations. May differ from book useful life.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected economic life of the asset in years, used to calculate depreciation. Determined based on manufacturer specifications, industry standards, and organizational experience.

attributes.name: valuation_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this valuation record (acquisition cost, book value, depreciation, etc.).

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The effective date of this valuation snapshot. Represents the point in time when this valuation is applicable.

attributes.name: valuation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, assumptions, or special considerations affecting this valuation (e.g., major overhaul capitalized, damage affecting value, market conditions).

attributes.name: valuation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the valuation record, typically system-generated or following organizational numbering convention.

attributes.name: valuation_source
attributes.description: The source or method used to determine the current valuation. Acquisition uses original cost, appraisal uses third-party professional valuation, market index uses industry pricing data, insurance quote from carrier, internal estimate by equipment managers.

attributes.name: valuation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the valuation record. Draft indicates preliminary valuation, active is current book value, superseded indicates replaced by newer valuation, archived for historical records.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this valuation record.

products.name: insurance_policy
products.description: Master record of insurance policies covering owned and rented construction equipment and fleet vehicles. Captures insurer name, policy number, policy type (all-risk plant, third-party liability, fleet motor, marine transit), coverage amount, premium amount, policy start and end dates, deductible amount, covered asset scope, and renewal status. Supports risk management, mobilization pre-checks, and regulatory compliance. Owned by equipment domain as it directly governs asset coverage — distinct from corporate insurance managed by finance.
products.reference: Equipment Insurance Policy / Plant All-Risk Policy

attributes.name: insurance_policy_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the insurance policy record. Primary key for the insurance policy entity.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Equipment insurance policies are procured under contracts; linking allows compliance monitoring and claim tracking per agreement.

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.asset. Business justification: Insurance policy is issued for a specific asset; linking policy to asset captures ownership and removes need for policy number fields on asset.

attributes.name: construction_project_id

attributes.name: broker_name
attributes.description: The name of the insurance broker or intermediary who arranged the policy on behalf of the construction company. Nullable if policy was purchased directly.

attributes.name: certificate_issue_date
attributes.description: The date when the Certificate of Insurance was issued. Nullable if certificate has not been issued. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: certificate_of_insurance_issued
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a Certificate of Insurance has been issued for this policy. COIs are required for equipment mobilization and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: claims_contact_email
attributes.description: The email address for submitting claims documentation and correspondence with the claims adjuster.

attributes.name: claims_contact_name
attributes.description: The name of the claims adjuster or contact person at the insurer for reporting and processing claims under this policy.

attributes.name: claims_contact_phone
attributes.description: The phone number to reach the claims contact for reporting incidents and tracking claim status.

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting specific regulatory requirements met by this policy, any compliance gaps, or special conditions required by clients or governing bodies.

attributes.name: coverage_amount
attributes.description: The maximum monetary amount the insurer will pay for covered losses under this policy. This is the policy limit or sum insured.

attributes.name: coverage_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the coverage amount and premium (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: coverage_scope
attributes.description: Detailed description of what assets, risks, and perils are covered under this policy. Includes covered equipment types, geographic scope, and specific inclusions or exclusions.

attributes.name: covered_asset_category
attributes.description: The category of construction equipment and assets covered by this policy. Heavy equipment includes cranes and excavators, light equipment includes smaller machinery, fleet vehicles includes trucks and cars, tools includes hand and power tools, generators includes power generation equipment, and all equipment covers comprehensive asset types.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this insurance policy record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: The amount the policyholder must pay out-of-pocket before the insurer pays a claim. This is the self-insured retention or excess.

attributes.name: geographic_coverage
attributes.description: The geographic regions or territories where the insurance coverage is valid. May specify countries, states, or project sites where equipment is covered.

attributes.name: insurer_contact_email
attributes.description: The email address of the insurer contact for policy correspondence, claims submission, and documentation exchange.

attributes.name: insurer_contact_name
attributes.description: The name of the primary contact person or account manager at the insurance company for policy administration and claims.

attributes.name: insurer_contact_phone
attributes.description: The primary phone number to reach the insurer contact for policy inquiries, claims reporting, and emergency notifications.

attributes.name: insurer_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the insurance company or underwriter providing the coverage. This is the carrier responsible for claims payment.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who last modified this insurance policy record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this insurance policy record was last modified in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: ownership_classification
attributes.description: Specifies whether this policy covers only company-owned equipment, only rented equipment, or both owned and rented assets.

attributes.name: policy_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the full policy document, terms and conditions, and endorsements stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: policy_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the insurance policy coverage expires or terminates. Nullable for open-ended policies. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: policy_notes
attributes.description: General free-text notes about the policy including special terms, exclusions, endorsements, or internal administrative information.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique policy number issued by the insurer. This is the business identifier used in all correspondence and claims.

attributes.name: policy_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the insurance policy coverage becomes effective and binding. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the insurance policy. Active policies provide coverage, pending policies are awaiting approval, expired policies have passed their end date, cancelled policies were terminated early, suspended policies are temporarily inactive, and renewed policies have been extended.

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the insurance policy coverage type. All-risk plant covers comprehensive equipment damage, third-party liability covers legal claims, fleet motor covers vehicle insurance, marine transit covers equipment in transport, builders risk covers construction projects, and equipment breakdown covers mechanical failure.

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: The total premium cost paid to the insurer for this policy coverage period. This is the price of the insurance.

attributes.name: premium_payment_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which premium payments are made to the insurer (annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly, or one-time lump sum).

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this policy meets all regulatory and contractual insurance requirements for equipment operation and mobilization.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_date
attributes.description: The date by which the policyholder must notify the insurer of intent to renew or cancel. Critical for mobilization planning and compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy will automatically renew at expiration, requires manual renewal action, is non-renewable, or is currently under renewal review.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this insurance policy record in the source operational system, used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who created this insurance policy record in the system.

Each record links one asset to one activity and stores assignment‑specific data such as quantities, dates, and the role of the asset in the activity.. Existence Justification: Construction projects assign multiple equipment assets to a single schedule activity, and each asset can be scheduled for multiple activities over its lifecycle. The assignment is actively managed by planners and includes quantities, dates, and role information, making the relationship a distinct business entity.

domains.name: workforce
domains.description: Construction workforce management domain tracking labor resources, crew assignments, time tracking, production rates, skill certifications, labor cost coding, field personnel deployment, and site access records. Manages craft labor, supervision, and project-based staffing distinct from corporate HR functions. Integrates with HCSS HeavyJob for timesheets and SAP SuccessFactors for HCM.

products.name: craft_worker
products.description: Master record for all craft labor personnel deployed on construction projects including hourly trade workers and working foremen/supervisors. Captures worker identity, trade classification (from skill_trade taxonomy), employment type (direct hire, agency, union referral), union affiliation and local, craft code, supervisory role flag, home project assignment, mobilization status, security clearance level, and field deployment history. SSOT for individual field worker identity in the workforce domain. Workers may hold multiple trade classifications and rotate between craft and supervisory roles across projects. Integrates with SAP SuccessFactors for HCM master data and HCSS HeavyJob for field time tracking.

attributes.name: craft_worker_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the craft worker record. Primary key for the craft worker entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.account. Business justification: Payroll & compliance reports require each worker to be linked to the employing client account for tax, insurance and HSE reporting.

attributes.name: compliance_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Each permit designates a responsible worker (permit holder) to ensure compliance; linking enables accountability audits.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary construction project to which the craft worker is currently assigned as their home base.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Payroll & benefits integration: linking each craft worker to their HR employee record ensures accurate salary, tax, and benefits processing.

attributes.name: firm_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.firm_profile. Business justification: Employer assignment: linking each craft worker to the subcontractor firm that employs them, required for labor cost allocation and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_party. Business justification: REQUIRED: Workers are employed by a contract party (contractor/sub‑contractor); linking supports payroll, insurance, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: skill_trade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.skill_trade. Business justification: Standardize trade information by referencing skill_trade; remove redundant primary_trade_code and primary_trade_name from craft_worker.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: REQUIRED: Vendor‑Supplied Labor Tracking – each subcontractor worker must be linked to the vendor that supplies them for compliance and cost allocation.

attributes.name: craft_code
attributes.description: Standardized craft classification code used for cost coding and labor reporting in project management systems.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the craft worker record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the worker's compensation (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).

attributes.name: demobilization_date
attributes.description: Date the craft worker was demobilized from their project assignment, if applicable.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for the craft worker used for communication and system access.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone

attributes.name: emergency_contact_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the emergency contact to the craft worker (e.g., spouse, parent, sibling, friend).

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the worker's employment relationship with the organization: direct hire (permanent employee), agency (temporary staffing), union referral (union hall dispatch), or subcontractor (independent contractor).

attributes.name: first_name

attributes.name: hire_date

attributes.name: hourly_base_rate

attributes.name: mobilization_status

products.name: crew
products.description: Master record for a named field crew or gang deployed on a construction project. Captures crew name, crew type (civil, MEP, structural, concrete, etc.), foreman assignment, home cost code, project assignment, crew size, and active status. A crew is the primary unit of field labor organization in construction operations. Distinct from individual worker records.

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the construction crew. Primary key for the crew entity.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: REQUIRED: Crew allocation is planned per contract agreement; linking allows crew costs and productivity to be attributed to the agreement.

attributes.name: assigned_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.asset. Business justification: Needed for Crew Equipment Allocation report, assigning primary equipment to a crew for cost allocation, scheduling, and safety compliance.

attributes.name: compliance_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Hot‑work permits assign a specific crew; tracking crew per permit is required for safety compliance reports.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project to which this crew is currently assigned. A crew may be reassigned between projects over its lifecycle.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for crew cost allocation reports that roll crew labor costs to the project's cost center, enabling accurate budgeting and variance analysis per cost center.

attributes.name: cost_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the home cost code for this crew. Used for labor cost allocation and job costing when crew time is not charged to a specific activity cost code.

attributes.name: craft_worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the worker record of the foreman or crew lead responsible for supervising this crew. The foreman is accountable for crew productivity, safety, and quality.

attributes.name: firm_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.firm_profile. Business justification: Crew ownership: crews are supplied by subcontractors; linking enables crew billing and performance tracking per subcontractor.

attributes.name: supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Crew safety oversight: crew supervisor (an employee) is responsible for safety briefings and incident reporting for the crew.

attributes.name: average_hourly_rate
attributes.description: Blended average hourly labor rate for the crew, calculated across all crew members. Used for cost estimation and Earned Value Management (EVM) calculations. Currency is USD unless otherwise specified in project configuration.

attributes.name: crew_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the crew used in field operations and timekeeping systems. Typically alphanumeric and unique within a project or division.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this crew record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: crew_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the crew in its lifecycle. Active crews are deployed and working; inactive crews are not currently assigned; mobilizing/demobilizing crews are in transition; standby crews are available but not deployed; disbanded crews are permanently closed.

attributes.name: crew_type
attributes.description: Classification of the crew based on trade or discipline. Defines the primary craft or work scope the crew is organized to perform. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: civil|structural|concrete|mep|electrical|plumbing|hvac|finishing|earthworks|piling — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: days_since_last_incident
attributes.description: Number of calendar days since the last recordable safety incident for this crew. Used for safety milestone recognition and Total Recordable Incident Rate (TRIR) tracking. Null if no incidents have occurred.

attributes.name: demobilization_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date when the crew will be or was demobilized from the current project. Null for active crews with no planned demobilization.

attributes.name: home_location
attributes.description: Primary site, yard, or facility where this crew is based or reports to. May be a project site, equipment yard, or regional office.

attributes.name: is_union_crew
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is a union crew subject to collective bargaining agreements and union work rules. True if union, false if non-union or open shop.

attributes.name: size

attributes.name: union_affiliation

products.name: crew_assignment

attributes.name: wbs_element_id

attributes.name: assignment_notes

attributes.name: assignment_reason

attributes.name: assignment_start_date

attributes.name: assignment_status

attributes.name: assignment_type

attributes.name: billable_flag

attributes.name: craft_type

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: crew_role

attributes.name: demobilization_date

attributes.name: hse_orientation_completed_flag

attributes.name: labor_rate

attributes.name: ppe_issued_flag

attributes.name: shift_type

attributes.name: site_access_badge_number

attributes.name: work_location

products.name: timesheet
products.description: Daily field timesheet record capturing hours worked by a craft worker on a specific project, cost code, and WBS element. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob. Captures regular hours, overtime hours, double-time hours, shift type, work classification, pay type, equipment operated, and approval status. Core transactional record for labor cost coding and payroll processing in field operations.

attributes.name: timesheet_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the timesheet record. Primary key for the timesheet entity.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: REQUIRED: Timesheet entries must be billed to the correct contract agreement; the FK enables accurate invoicing and milestone payment tracking.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the construction project where the work was performed.

attributes.name: cost_code_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost code used for labor cost allocation and job costing. Enables tracking of labor costs by activity type.

attributes.name: craft_worker_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the craft worker who performed the work. Links to the workforce master data.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supervisor or foreman responsible for overseeing the work performed. Used for approval workflow and accountability.

attributes.name: firm_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.firm_profile. Business justification: Timesheet billing: associate each timesheet with the subcontractor of the worker for accurate payroll and contract invoicing.

attributes.name: labor_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.labor_rate. Business justification: Timesheets capture the rate applied; referencing labor_rate provides the authoritative rate definition and removes the duplicated hourly_rate column.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the WBS element to which the labor hours are charged. Enables project cost control at the work package level.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the timesheet entry in the workflow. Determines whether the timesheet can be processed for payroll and job costing.

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the timesheet was approved. Critical for payroll processing cutoff and audit compliance.

attributes.name: craft_classification

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the timesheet record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the labor cost amount. Enables multi-currency project cost tracking.

attributes.name: double_time_hours

attributes.name: equipment_operated
attributes.description: Description or identifier of equipment operated by the worker during this timesheet period. Used for equipment utilization tracking and operator certification validation.

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the labor hours are billable to the client or are non-billable overhead. Critical for revenue recognition and client invoicing.

attributes.name: labor_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total labor cost for this timesheet entry, calculated from hours worked and applicable pay rates. Core metric for job costing and project financial management.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific site location or work area where the labor was performed. Enables location-based cost tracking and site access control.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the timesheet record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the work performed, issues encountered, or special circumstances. Provides context for time entries.

attributes.name: overtime_hours

attributes.name: pay_type

attributes.name: payroll_period
attributes.description: Identifier of the payroll period to which this timesheet belongs. Used for grouping timesheets for payroll processing.

attributes.name: production_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of work units produced during the timesheet period. Used for productivity rate calculation and earned value analysis.

attributes.name: production_unit

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Number of regular hours worked during the standard work period. Typically up to 8 hours per day or 40 hours per week.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided when a timesheet is rejected. Enables corrective action and quality improvement in time tracking.

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: The type of work shift during which the labor was performed. Affects pay rates and scheduling.

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the timesheet was submitted for approval. Marks the transition from draft to submitted status in the workflow.

attributes.name: total_hours
attributes.description: Total hours worked across all categories (regular, overtime, double-time). Sum of all hour types for the timesheet entry.

attributes.name: union_local

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Weather conditions during the work period. Impacts productivity rates and may justify schedule delays or Extension of Time (EOT) claims.

attributes.name: work_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the work activity type. Distinguishes between productive work, non-productive time, rework, standby, and travel time for productivity analysis.

attributes.name: work_date

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the work order or task assignment associated with this timesheet. Links labor hours to specific work packages.

products.name: timesheet_line
products.description: Individual line item within a daily timesheet record, capturing granular labor allocation to a specific cost code, activity, WBS element, or equipment unit within a single shift. Supports split-coding of hours across multiple cost centers in a single day. Enables detailed job costing and EVM (Earned Value Management) labor tracking at the activity level.

attributes.name: timesheet_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the timesheet line item. Primary key for granular labor allocation tracking within a daily timesheet.

attributes.name: activity_id

attributes.name: asset_id

attributes.name: construction_project_id

attributes.name: craft_worker_id

attributes.name: primary_timesheet_employee_id

attributes.name: timesheet_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent daily timesheet record. Links this line item to the overall timesheet submission for a worker on a specific date.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the WBS element where labor was applied. Enables activity-level labor tracking for Earned Value Management (EVM) and Critical Path Method (CPM) scheduling.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow state for this timesheet line. Tracks progression from field entry through supervisor approval to payroll posting.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp

attributes.name: craft_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this timesheet line record was first created in the system. Audit trail timestamp for record creation tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for labor cost amount. Supports multi-currency projects and international joint ventures.

attributes.name: double_time_hours
attributes.description: Number of double-time labor hours allocated to this cost code and activity. Compensated at 2x regular rate, typically for holidays or extended overtime per union agreements.

attributes.name: is_billable

attributes.name: is_rework
attributes.description: Indicates whether this labor was performed to correct defective work or address a Non-Conformance Report (NCR). Used for quality cost tracking and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: labor_cost_amount

attributes.name: line_number

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

products.name: labor_cost_code
products.description: Unified reference master for labor cost codes and trade/skill classifications used to classify and allocate field labor expenditure and define workforce competency categories. Captures cost code identifier, description, trade code, trade name, craft discipline (ironworker, pipefitter, electrician, carpenter, etc.), union jurisdiction, prevailing wage classification, required certification types, budget category, SAP PS (Project Systems) WBS mapping, and active status. Serves as the single source of truth for both cost allocation and trade/skill classification — the authoritative taxonomy of construction trades and their cost coding. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA Project Systems and HCSS HeavyJob cost coding structures. Referenced by timesheets, labor rates, agency orders, and staffing plans for consistent trade and cost classification.

products.name: craft_certification
products.description: Master record for a specific trade certification, license, or qualification held by a craft worker. Captures certification type (OSHA 10/30, NCCER credentials, rigger, scaffolder, welder qualification, crane operator NCCCO, confined space, etc.), issuing body, issue date, expiry date, certification number, verification status, and renewal requirements. Supports site access control (workers cannot badge in without valid certs), workforce competency management, and compliance with project-specific qualification requirements. Distinct from apprenticeship_progression which tracks cumulative hours and level advancement — this product tracks discrete credentials already earned.
