attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: The category or type of certification held by the worker. Defines the specific trade skill, safety qualification, or competency credential. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OSHA 10|OSHA 30|NCCER Core|NCCER Craft|Rigger|Scaffolder|Welder|Crane Operator|Confined Space|Fall Protection|Forklift|Electrical|HVAC|Plumbing|First Aid|CPR|Hazmat|Asbestos|Lead Abatement — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this certification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the scanned or digital copy of the certification document stored in the document management system. Supports audit and verification workflows.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification expires and is no longer valid. Nullable for certifications that do not expire.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was originally issued to the worker.

attributes.name: issuing_body
attributes.description: The organization or authority that issued the certification. Examples include OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration), NCCER (National Center for Construction Education and Research), NCCCO (National Commission for the Certification of Crane Operators), AWS (American Welding Society), or state licensing boards.

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO country code representing the country in which the certification was issued. Used for international workforce management and cross-border project assignments.

attributes.name: issuing_state_province
attributes.description: The state or province in which the certification was issued. Relevant for certifications that are jurisdiction-specific, such as state contractor licenses or provincial trade qualifications.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this certification record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: next_renewal_date
attributes.description: The date by which the certification must be renewed to remain valid. Used for proactive workforce planning and compliance alerts.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, special conditions, or remarks related to the certification. May include details on restrictions, endorsements, or verification challenges.

attributes.name: project_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is required by specific project contracts or client specifications. True if the certification is a project-specific qualification requirement, False if it is a general workforce credential.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is required to meet federal, state, or local regulatory requirements. True if the certification is mandated by law or regulation, False if it is voluntary or company-specific.

attributes.name: renewal_frequency_months
attributes.description: The number of months between required renewals for this certification. Nullable if renewal is not required.

attributes.name: renewal_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification requires periodic renewal. True if renewal is required, False if the certification is permanent or does not expire.

attributes.name: site_access_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is mandatory for site access control. True if workers cannot badge in without a valid certification of this type, False otherwise. Supports HSE (Health Safety and Environment) compliance and access control integration.

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the worker completed the training program associated with this certification.

attributes.name: training_hours_required
attributes.description: The total number of training hours required to obtain or renew this certification. Used for workforce development planning and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was last verified by the company or issuing body. Used to track compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: The current verification state of the certification. Indicates whether the credential has been validated by the issuing body or internal compliance team, and whether it is currently active and valid for site access and work assignment.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the person or system that performed the verification. Supports audit and accountability requirements.

products.name: skill_trade
products.description: Reference classification of construction trade skills and craft disciplines (e.g., ironworker, pipefitter, electrician, carpenter, concrete finisher, heavy equipment operator, rigger, welder). Captures trade code, trade name, union jurisdiction, prevailing wage classification, and required certification types. Used for workforce planning, crew composition, and labor rate determination.

attributes.name: skill_trade_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the construction trade skill or craft discipline record. Primary key.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to hr.hr.org_unit_id

attributes.name: apprenticeship_duration_hours
attributes.description: Standard duration of apprenticeship training program in hours (e.g., 8000 hours for journeyman electrician). Used for workforce development planning and training program management.

attributes.name: apprenticeship_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal apprenticeship training is required or recommended for this trade skill. True if apprenticeship is a standard pathway; false otherwise.

attributes.name: average_hourly_rate_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Hourly Rate United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Average or benchmark hourly labor rate for journeyman-level workers in this trade, in US dollars. Used for project cost estimation and budget planning. Actual rates vary by geography, project type, and union agreements.

tag_set.value: Average Hourly Rate United States Dollars (USD)

attributes.name: bim_integration_level
attributes.description: Level of BIM (Building Information Modeling) technology integration and digital literacy expected for this trade (none, basic, intermediate, advanced). Used for technology training planning and digital construction readiness.

attributes.name: certification_issuing_body
attributes.description: Name of the organization or regulatory body that issues the required certification for this trade (e.g., NCCER, AWS, NCCCO, state licensing board). Used for credential verification and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: certification_type_required
attributes.description: Type of professional certification, license, or credential required to perform work in this trade (e.g., NCCER certification, state electrical license, AWS welding certification, NCCCO crane operator certification). Multiple certifications may be listed as comma-separated values.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this trade skill record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this trade skill classification was retired or became obsolete. Null for currently active trades. Used for temporal validity and historical analysis.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this trade skill classification became active and available for use in workforce planning and assignment. Used for temporal validity and historical tracking.

attributes.name: equipment_dependency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this trade requires specialized heavy equipment or machinery to perform work (e.g., crane operators require cranes, equipment operators require excavators). True if equipment-dependent; false if primarily manual labor.

attributes.name: hazard_exposure_level
attributes.description: Classification of typical occupational hazard exposure level for this trade (low, moderate, high, extreme). Used for risk assessment, insurance rating, and HSE planning.

attributes.name: labor_cost_code_id
attributes.description: add column labor_cost_code_id (BIGINT) with FK to workforce.labor_cost_code.labor_cost_code_id - skill trades typically map to a default labor cost code

attributes.name: labor_shortage_indicator
attributes.description: Current market assessment of labor availability for this trade (surplus, balanced, shortage, critical shortage). Used for strategic workforce planning and recruitment prioritization.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this trade skill record was last updated or modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: mep_discipline_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mechanical Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) Discipline Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this trade is part of the MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing) disciplines. True for electricians, pipefitters, HVAC technicians, plumbers; false for structural and civil trades.

tag_set.value: Mechanical Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) Discipline Flag

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special considerations related to this trade skill classification. May include regional variations, specialty sub-disciplines, or unique requirements.

attributes.name: osha_training_requirement
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Training Requirement
attributes.description: Specific OSHA training courses or certifications required for this trade (e.g., OSHA 10-hour, OSHA 30-hour, confined space, fall protection, scaffolding). Used for safety compliance and site access control.

tag_set.value: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Training Requirement

attributes.name: overtime_multiplier
attributes.description: Standard overtime pay multiplier for this trade (e.g., 1.5 for time-and-a-half, 2.0 for double-time). Used for labor cost calculation and payroll processing.

attributes.name: physical_demand_rating
attributes.description: Classification of physical exertion and strength requirements for this trade (light, medium, heavy, very heavy). Used for workforce health management and ergonomic planning.

attributes.name: ppe_requirements
attributes.description: Standard personal protective equipment required for workers in this trade (e.g., hard hat, safety glasses, steel-toed boots, gloves, fall protection harness, welding helmet). Used for safety planning and PPE procurement.

attributes.name: prevailing_wage_classification
attributes.description: Official wage classification code used for prevailing wage determination on public works projects, as defined by Davis-Bacon Act or state-specific prevailing wage laws. Critical for labor cost estimation and compliance on government-funded projects.

attributes.name: productivity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure used to track productivity for this trade (e.g., linear feet of pipe installed per day, cubic yards of concrete placed per hour, square feet of drywall hung per shift). Used for production tracking and earned value management (EVM).

attributes.name: seasonal_demand_pattern
attributes.description: Description of typical seasonal demand fluctuation for this trade (e.g., high demand in summer for outdoor trades, year-round for indoor MEP work). Used for workforce capacity planning and recruitment timing.

attributes.name: skill_level_tiers
attributes.description: Defined progression tiers or grades within this trade (e.g., apprentice, journeyman, foreman, general foreman, superintendent). Used for career path planning and labor rate determination. Typically stored as comma-separated hierarchy.

attributes.name: standard_crew_size
attributes.description: Typical or recommended crew size for efficient work execution in this trade (e.g., 4-person ironworker crew, 2-person electrician crew). Used for resource planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: trade_category
attributes.description: High-level classification grouping of the trade skill (structural, mechanical, electrical, civil, finishing, equipment operation, specialty). Used for workforce segmentation and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: structural|mechanical|electrical|civil|finishing|equipment_operation|specialty — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: trade_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code identifying the construction trade or craft discipline (e.g., IW for ironworker, EL for electrician, CP for carpenter). Used for workforce planning, labor rate determination, and crew composition.

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the construction trade or craft discipline (e.g., Ironworker, Pipefitter, Electrician, Carpenter, Concrete Finisher, Heavy Equipment Operator, Rigger, Welder).

attributes.name: trade_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the trade skill classification. Active trades are available for workforce planning and assignment; inactive trades are no longer used; obsolete trades are deprecated; emerging trades are newly recognized.

attributes.name: travel_requirement_typical
attributes.description: Typical geographic travel requirement for workers in this trade (none, local, regional, national, international). Used for workforce planning and per diem budgeting.

attributes.name: union_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the labor union or trade union that has jurisdiction over this craft discipline (e.g., IBEW for electricians, UA for pipefitters, IUOE for operators). Used for labor relations, collective bargaining, and compliance.

attributes.name: union_jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Full name of the labor union or trade union with jurisdiction over this craft (e.g., International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers, United Association of Plumbers and Pipefitters).

products.name: site_access_record
products.description: Transactional record of a craft worker or supervisor entering or exiting a project site. Captures worker identity, site gate, entry/exit timestamp, access method (badge scan, biometric, manual), access authorization status, visitor vs. direct hire classification, and PPE compliance check result. Supports HSE compliance, headcount tracking, and emergency muster reporting.

attributes.name: site_access_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the site access record. Primary key for tracking individual entry and exit events at construction project sites.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project where the access event occurred. Enables site-specific headcount tracking and project labor analytics.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the security officer or gate attendant who processed the access event. Supports accountability and manual entry verification.

attributes.name: firm_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.firm_profile. Business justification: Site access control: replace free‑text contractor name with FK to subcontractor firm for security audit and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: primary_site_craft_worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the craft worker or supervisor who accessed the site. Links to the workforce master data for personnel tracking and muster reporting.

attributes.name: access_denial_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why access was denied or flagged as unauthorized. Null for successful authorized entries. Supports security incident investigation.

attributes.name: access_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents a site entry or exit event. Critical for calculating current on-site headcount and emergency muster accuracy.

attributes.name: access_method
attributes.description: The technology or process used to record the access event. Distinguishes automated badge scans from manual security guard entries.

attributes.name: access_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by security personnel regarding the access event. May include special circumstances, exceptions, or observations.

attributes.name: access_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the worker entered or exited the site gate. Principal business event timestamp for time tracking and muster reporting.

attributes.name: access_zone
attributes.description: The specific zone or area of the construction site the worker is authorized to access (e.g., Zone A, Mechanical Area, Restricted Area). Supports zone-based access control and safety management.

attributes.name: actual_exit_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the worker exited the site. Paired with access_timestamp to calculate time on site. Null for entry records without matching exit.

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker had valid authorization to access the site at the time of entry. Supports security compliance and unauthorized access detection.

attributes.name: badge_number
attributes.description: The physical or digital badge identifier used by the worker to access the site. May be RFID card number, biometric ID, or manual entry code.

attributes.name: duration_on_site_minutes
attributes.description: Calculated duration in minutes between entry and exit timestamps. Used for labor hour tracking and productivity analysis. Null if exit has not yet occurred.

attributes.name: emergency_muster_status
attributes.description: Current status of the worker for emergency muster and evacuation purposes. Updated in real-time based on entry/exit events and emergency roll call procedures.

attributes.name: escort_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker requires an escort while on site. Typically true for visitors, inspectors, or personnel without full site authorization.

attributes.name: expected_exit_timestamp
attributes.description: The anticipated date and time when the worker is expected to exit the site. Used for visitor management and to flag overdue exits for safety follow-up.

attributes.name: health_screening_status
attributes.description: Result of health screening questionnaire or assessment performed at gate entry. Used during pandemic or outbreak situations to prevent spread of illness on site.

attributes.name: induction_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker has completed the required site safety induction or orientation before being granted access. Critical for HSE compliance and first-time visitor management.

attributes.name: photo_captured_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a photograph of the worker was captured at the gate for identity verification or visitor badge printing purposes.

attributes.name: ppe_compliance_status
attributes.description: Result of the PPE compliance check performed at the gate. Indicates whether the worker was wearing required safety equipment (hard hat, safety vest, boots) at time of entry.

attributes.name: ppe_items_verified
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of PPE items verified during the gate check (e.g., hard_hat, safety_vest, steel_toe_boots, safety_glasses, gloves). Supports detailed HSE compliance auditing.

attributes.name: purpose_of_visit
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for site access. Particularly relevant for visitors, inspectors, and non-routine personnel. Supports audit trails and security investigations.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this access record was first created in the database. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this access record was last modified. Tracks corrections, exit timestamp updates, and status changes.

attributes.name: signature_captured_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker provided a digital or physical signature acknowledging site safety rules and access terms at time of entry.

attributes.name: site_gate_code
attributes.description: Reference to the specific entry or exit gate where the access event was recorded. Supports multi-gate site layouts and zone-based access control.

attributes.name: temperature_reading
attributes.description: Body temperature measurement taken at gate entry for health screening purposes (e.g., pandemic protocols). Measured in degrees Celsius. May be null if health screening is not active.

attributes.name: vehicle_registration
attributes.description: License plate or registration number of the vehicle used by the worker to access the site. Supports parking management and vehicle tracking for security purposes.

attributes.name: worker_classification
attributes.description: Categorizes the type of personnel accessing the site. Distinguishes between direct employees, subcontractor labor, visitors, and other site personnel for reporting and compliance.

products.name: labor_mobilization
products.description: Transactional record tracking the mobilization or demobilization of a craft worker or supervisor to/from a project site. Captures mobilization type (initial, transfer, demobilization), origin and destination project, travel arrangement details, per diem entitlement, mobilization date, demobilization date, and associated cost. Supports project staffing planning and labor cost forecasting.

attributes.name: labor_mobilization_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the labor mobilization record. Primary key for tracking worker movement to/from project sites.

attributes.name: compliance_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Mobilizing labor to a site often depends on a site‑access or work permit; linking validates permit compliance before mobilization.

attributes.name: cost_code_id
attributes.description: Cost code to which mobilization expenses will be charged. Links to project cost accounting structure.

attributes.name: craft_worker_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the craft worker or supervisor being mobilized. Links to the workforce master record.

attributes.name: crew_assignment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the crew the worker is assigned to at the destination project. Null if not yet assigned.

attributes.name: destination_construction_project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the project site the worker is mobilizing to. Null for demobilizations.

attributes.name: firm_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.firm_profile. Business justification: Mobilization tracking: tie each labor mobilization record to the subcontractor providing the labor for cost and schedule analysis.

attributes.name: primary_labor_construction_project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the project site the worker is mobilizing from. Null for initial mobilizations.

attributes.name: primary_labor_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the project manager or supervisor who requested the mobilization.

attributes.name: accommodation_booking_reference
attributes.description: Booking confirmation number for temporary accommodation (hotel, camp, rental housing).

attributes.name: accommodation_cost_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated total cost of temporary accommodation for the mobilization period.

attributes.name: accommodation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether temporary accommodation is required at the destination site (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: actual_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time the worker arrived at the destination project site, recorded for compliance and payroll purposes.

attributes.name: actual_departure_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time the worker departed from the origin project site, recorded for compliance and payroll purposes.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date the mobilization request was formally approved by authorized personnel.

attributes.name: craft_code
attributes.description: Code representing the worker's primary trade or craft skill (e.g., CARP for carpenter, ELEC for electrician, WELD for welder).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the mobilization record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this mobilization record.

attributes.name: demobilization_date
attributes.description: Date the worker is scheduled to depart from the origin project site. Null for initial mobilizations.

attributes.name: hse_orientation_completed_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Orientation Completed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker has completed mandatory HSE (Health Safety and Environment) site orientation at the destination project (True) or not (False).

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Orientation Completed Flag

attributes.name: hse_orientation_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Orientation Date
attributes.description: Date the worker completed HSE (Health Safety and Environment) orientation training at the destination site.

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Orientation Date

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the mobilization record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: mobilization_date
attributes.description: Date the worker is scheduled to arrive at the destination project site and begin work.

attributes.name: mobilization_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the mobilization transaction. Format: MOB-YYYYMMDD followed by sequence number.

attributes.name: mobilization_reason
attributes.description: Business justification or reason for the mobilization (e.g., project ramp-up, skill shortage, emergency response, project closeout).

attributes.name: mobilization_status
attributes.description: Current status of the mobilization transaction in its lifecycle workflow.

attributes.name: mobilization_type
attributes.description: Type of mobilization event: initial (first assignment to project), transfer (move between projects), demobilization (release from project), remobilization (return after temporary leave).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments related to the mobilization transaction for operational reference.

attributes.name: per_diem_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of days the worker is entitled to receive per diem allowance.

attributes.name: per_diem_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is eligible for per diem allowance during mobilization (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: per_diem_rate
attributes.description: Daily per diem allowance rate in the project's currency for meals and incidental expenses.

attributes.name: site_access_badge_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a site access badge or credential has been issued to the worker at the destination site (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: special_requirements
attributes.description: Any special requirements or considerations for the mobilization such as medical accommodations, dietary restrictions, security clearances, or equipment transport needs.

attributes.name: total_mobilization_cost
attributes.description: Total estimated or actual cost of the mobilization including travel, accommodation, per diem, and administrative expenses.

attributes.name: travel_booking_reference
attributes.description: Booking confirmation number or reference code for travel arrangements (flight, train, rental car).

attributes.name: travel_cost_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated total cost of travel arrangements including airfare, ground transportation, and related expenses.

attributes.name: travel_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation arranged for the worker's mobilization journey.

products.name: production_rate
products.description: Transactional record capturing actual field production rates achieved by a crew on a specific activity, measured against planned/estimated production rates. Sourced from HCSS HeavyJob production tracking. Captures activity code, unit of measure (CY, LF, SF, EA, TON), planned quantity, actual quantity installed, earned hours, expended hours, and productivity factor. Enables historical productivity benchmarking for future estimates and real-time crew performance monitoring. Owned by workforce domain as it measures LABOR productivity — the output per labor-hour of a crew.

attributes.name: production_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the production rate record.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project where this production rate was recorded.

attributes.name: cost_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost code used for labor cost allocation for this production activity.

attributes.name: craft_worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the foreman or supervisor overseeing the crew during this production activity.

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Reference to the crew that performed the work and achieved this production rate.

attributes.name: project_baseline_id
attributes.description: Reference to the project baseline against which this production rate performance is being measured.

attributes.name: recorded_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Production reporting audit: the employee who records daily production rates must be captured for traceability.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the WBS element under which this production activity was performed.

attributes.name: activity_code
attributes.description: The unique code identifying the specific construction activity being measured (e.g., concrete pour, rebar installation, excavation). Sourced from project scheduling system.

attributes.name: activity_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the construction activity for which production rate is being tracked.

attributes.name: actual_production_rate
attributes.description: The actual production rate achieved (units per labor-hour), calculated as actual quantity divided by expended labor hours.

attributes.name: actual_quantity
attributes.description: The actual quantity of work completed or installed by the crew during this production period, measured in the specified unit of measure.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this production rate record was approved for use in cost and schedule reporting.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the supervisor or project manager who approved this production rate record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this production rate record was first created in the source system.

attributes.name: earned_hours
attributes.description: The labor hours that should have been required to complete the actual quantity based on the planned production rate. Used in Earned Value Management (EVM) calculations.

attributes.name: equipment_availability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required equipment was available and operational during the production period. True if equipment was fully available; False if equipment shortages or breakdowns occurred.

attributes.name: expended_hours
attributes.description: The actual labor hours expended by the crew to complete the work during this production period.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this production rate record was last updated or modified in the source system.

attributes.name: material_availability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required materials were available on-site during the production period. True if materials were fully available; False if material shortages or delays occurred.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context about the production activity, including any factors that affected productivity, lessons learned, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: planned_production_rate
attributes.description: The estimated or target production rate (units per labor-hour) that was planned for this activity based on historical data or estimating standards.

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of work planned or estimated to be completed during this production period, measured in the specified unit of measure.

attributes.name: productivity_factor
attributes.description: The ratio of earned hours to expended hours, indicating crew efficiency. A value of 1.0 means work was completed at planned productivity; >1.0 indicates better than planned; <1.0 indicates below planned productivity.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_status
attributes.description: The outcome of quality inspection for the work completed during this production period.

attributes.name: recorded_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who recorded this production rate entry (typically a foreman, superintendent, or timekeeper).

attributes.name: rework_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any portion of the work performed was rework or correction of previously completed work. True if rework was involved; False if all work was original installation.

attributes.name: safety_incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any safety incident occurred during this production period that may have impacted productivity. True if an incident occurred; False otherwise.

attributes.name: shift
attributes.description: The shift during which the production work was performed.

attributes.name: site_condition
attributes.description: The physical site condition or constraint that may have affected crew productivity during this production period.

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this production rate record in the source operational system, used for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: trade_category
attributes.description: The construction trade or craft category performing the work (e.g., concrete, carpentry, electrical, plumbing, steel erection, masonry). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: concrete|carpentry|electrical|plumbing|steel_erection|masonry|hvac|painting|roofing|excavation — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which production quantity is measured. Common construction units: CY (Cubic Yard), LF (Linear Foot), SF (Square Foot), EA (Each), TON (Ton), CYD (Cubic Yard), SY (Square Yard), LBS (Pounds), GAL (Gallon), HR (Hour). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CY|LF|SF|EA|TON|CYD|SY|LBS|GAL|HR — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: variance_hours
attributes.description: The difference between earned hours and expended hours (earned minus expended). Positive values indicate efficient performance; negative values indicate inefficient performance.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: The difference between actual quantity and planned quantity (actual minus planned). Positive values indicate over-performance; negative values indicate under-performance.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: The prevailing weather condition during the work period that may have impacted production rates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|rain|snow|wind|extreme_heat|extreme_cold|fog — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: work_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this production work was performed.

attributes.name: work_difficulty_rating
attributes.description: Subjective assessment of the difficulty level of the work performed, used to contextualize production rate performance.

products.name: staffing_plan
products.description: Master record for a project-level workforce staffing plan defining the planned headcount, trade mix, and labor hours required by project phase, WBS element, and time period. Captures planned vs. actual headcount, peak labor requirements, trade breakdown, source strategy (direct hire, subcontract, agency), ramp-up/ramp-down curves, and plan version. Supports workforce forecasting, labor procurement decisions, and project mobilization planning. Integrates with SAP SuccessFactors workforce planning.

attributes.name: staffing_plan_id
attributes.description: Primary key for staffing_plan

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: REQUIRED: Staffing plans are approved per contract agreement for budgeting and compliance; linking ensures plan totals roll up to the correct agreement.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project for which this staffing plan is defined.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Links staffing plan headcount to the cost center responsible for payroll budgeting, used in the Staffing Budget vs. Cost Center variance report.

attributes.name: firm_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.firm_profile. Business justification: Staffing plan: associate planned headcount with subcontractor to forecast labor supply and contractual obligations.

attributes.name: skill_trade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.skill_trade. Business justification: Connect staffing plan to skill_trade to capture required trade mix for planning.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the WBS element this staffing plan applies to, enabling phase-specific or activity-specific workforce planning.

attributes.name: accommodation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether worker accommodation (camps, hotels, per diem) is required for this staffing plan, typically true for remote or large-scale projects.

attributes.name: actual_headcount
attributes.description: Actual number of workers deployed as of the last reporting period, enabling planned vs. actual variance analysis.

attributes.name: actual_labor_hours
attributes.description: Actual labor hours worked as of the last reporting period, supporting Earned Value Management (EVM) and productivity tracking.

attributes.name: agency_headcount
attributes.description: Number of workers planned to be sourced through temporary staffing agencies or labor brokers.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this staffing plan was formally approved and authorized for execution.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the project manager, PMO lead, or executive who approved this staffing plan.

attributes.name: baseline_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this staffing plan is the approved baseline against which all future revisions and actuals will be compared.

attributes.name: craft_labor_headcount
attributes.description: Number of skilled trade workers (carpenters, electricians, welders, masons, etc.) planned for the period.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this staffing plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: direct_hire_headcount
attributes.description: Number of workers planned to be sourced through direct employment by the general contractor or project owner.

attributes.name: headcount_variance
attributes.description: Difference between planned and actual headcount (actual minus planned), indicating over- or under-staffing relative to the plan.

attributes.name: labor_hours_variance
attributes.description: Difference between planned and actual labor hours (actual minus planned), supporting cost and schedule performance analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this staffing plan record was last updated, supporting audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, assumptions, constraints, or special instructions related to this staffing plan.

attributes.name: peak_headcount
attributes.description: Maximum number of workers required at any single point during the planning period, critical for site logistics, accommodation, and safety planning.

attributes.name: peak_headcount_date
attributes.description: Date on which the peak headcount is expected to occur, enabling targeted resource mobilization and site readiness planning.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the staffing plan, often indicating the project phase, location, or scope (e.g., 'Foundation Phase Labor Plan', 'MEP Installation Crew Plan').

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the staffing plan, typically a human-readable code used in project documentation and workforce planning meetings.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the staffing plan indicating its approval state and operational validity.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the staffing plan indicating its purpose (baseline for original plan, forecast for updated projections, scenario for what-if analysis).

attributes.name: plan_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the staffing plan, enabling tracking of plan revisions and baseline comparisons (e.g., 'V1.0', 'V2.1', 'Baseline', 'Revised').

attributes.name: planning_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the time period covered by this staffing plan, defining the conclusion of the workforce deployment window.

attributes.name: planning_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the time period covered by this staffing plan, defining the beginning of the workforce deployment window.

attributes.name: ramp_down_end_date
attributes.description: Date when workforce demobilization is complete, marking the end of the labor deployment for this plan.

attributes.name: ramp_down_start_date
attributes.description: Date when workforce demobilization begins, marking the start of the labor reduction curve as project activities wind down.

attributes.name: ramp_up_end_date
attributes.description: Date when workforce reaches full planned strength, marking the end of the mobilization phase.

attributes.name: ramp_up_start_date
attributes.description: Date when workforce mobilization and ramp-up begins, marking the start of the labor deployment curve.

attributes.name: site_access_requirements
attributes.description: Description of site access prerequisites for workers (security clearances, background checks, client-specific badging), critical for mobilization planning.

attributes.name: skill_certification_requirements
attributes.description: Summary of mandatory certifications and qualifications required for workers in this staffing plan (e.g., 'OSHA 30, Confined Space, Rigging Level II'), supporting compliance and safety planning.

attributes.name: sourcing_strategy
attributes.description: Primary workforce sourcing approach for this staffing plan, defining how labor will be procured and managed.

attributes.name: subcontractor_headcount
attributes.description: Number of workers planned to be provided by subcontractors under contract to the general contractor.

attributes.name: supervision_headcount
attributes.description: Number of supervisory personnel (foremen, superintendents, site managers) planned for the period.

attributes.name: support_staff_headcount
attributes.description: Number of support personnel (site engineers, QA/QC inspectors, safety officers, administrative staff) planned for the period.

attributes.name: total_planned_headcount
attributes.description: Total number of workers planned across all trades and roles for this staffing plan period, representing the aggregate workforce requirement.

attributes.name: total_planned_labor_hours
attributes.description: Total labor hours planned across all workers and trades for the planning period, used for cost estimation and productivity forecasting.

attributes.name: trade_mix_breakdown
attributes.description: Structured breakdown of planned headcount by trade category (e.g., 'Concrete:50|Steel:30|Electrical:25|Plumbing:20'), supporting trade-specific procurement and scheduling.

attributes.name: transportation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether worker transportation (buses, flights, shuttles) is required for this staffing plan, impacting mobilization logistics and costs.

products.name: labor_agreement
products.description: Master record for collective bargaining agreements (CBAs), union agreements, project labor agreements (PLAs), and prevailing wage determinations governing craft labor on a project or region. Captures agreement type, union local, effective dates, wage scales by trade and classification, overtime rules, fringe benefit rates, and jurisdictional coverage. Distinct from commercial contracts owned by the contract domain.

attributes.name: labor_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the labor agreement record. Primary key for the labor agreement entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.account. Business justification: Labor agreements are negotiated per client (owner) and must be tracked against the client account for legal and financial audit.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific construction project to which this labor agreement applies, if it is a project-specific PLA. Null for general agreements.

attributes.name: contract_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Contract compliance: a designated HR employee manages and signs off labor agreements for each project.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Associates each labor agreement with the cost center charging wages, needed for payroll cost accounting and compliance with union wage reporting.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the labor agreement indicating its operational state and enforceability. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|active|expired|terminated|superseded|under_negotiation — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the labor agreement indicating its nature and scope. Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) covers union-negotiated terms, Project Labor Agreement (PLA) applies to specific projects, prevailing wage determination sets minimum wage rates for public works.

attributes.name: apprentice_ratio
attributes.description: Required ratio of apprentices to journeymen workers on projects covered by this labor agreement (e.g., 1:4 means one apprentice for every four journeymen).

attributes.name: arbitration_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether binding arbitration is required for dispute resolution under this labor agreement.

attributes.name: base_wage_rate
attributes.description: Standard hourly wage rate for the base classification under this labor agreement, excluding overtime premiums and fringe benefits.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this labor agreement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: double_time_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base wage rate for double-time hours, typically for work on Sundays or holidays (e.g., 2.0).

attributes.name: double_time_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked per day after which double-time rates apply, or indicator for specific days (e.g., 12 hours per day, Sundays, holidays).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the labor agreement becomes binding and enforceable.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the labor agreement terminates or expires. Null for open-ended agreements or those without a fixed end date.

attributes.name: fringe_benefit_rate
attributes.description: Total hourly rate for fringe benefits including health insurance, pension, training, and other benefits as specified in the labor agreement.

attributes.name: geographic_coverage
attributes.description: Description of the geographic area or region where this labor agreement is applicable (e.g., state, county, metropolitan area, or specific project site).

attributes.name: grievance_procedure_description
attributes.description: Summary of the grievance and dispute resolution procedures established in the labor agreement.

attributes.name: health_welfare_rate
attributes.description: Hourly contribution rate for health insurance and welfare benefits under this labor agreement.

attributes.name: hiring_hall_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether workers must be hired through the union hiring hall under this labor agreement.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_type
attributes.description: Scope of coverage defining where and how the labor agreement applies (geographic region, specific project, or organizational scope). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: geographic|project_specific|company_wide|multi_employer|national|regional|local — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this labor agreement record was last updated or modified in the system.

attributes.name: multi_employer_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a multi-employer agreement covering multiple contractors or a single-employer agreement.

attributes.name: no_strike_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the labor agreement includes a no-strike clause prohibiting work stoppages during the agreement term.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special provisions related to this labor agreement.

attributes.name: overtime_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base wage rate for overtime hours (e.g., 1.5 for time-and-a-half, 2.0 for double-time).

attributes.name: overtime_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked per day or week after which overtime rates apply (e.g., 8 hours per day, 40 hours per week).

attributes.name: pension_rate
attributes.description: Hourly contribution rate for pension or retirement benefits under this labor agreement.

attributes.name: prevailing_wage_determination_number
attributes.description: Official determination number issued by the Department of Labor for prevailing wage rates applicable to this agreement, if applicable to public works projects.

attributes.name: ratification_date
attributes.description: Date when the labor agreement was formally ratified or approved by the union membership and employer parties.

attributes.name: reporting_pay_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours guaranteed to be paid when a worker reports for work as scheduled.

attributes.name: shift_differential_rate
attributes.description: Additional hourly rate paid for work performed during non-standard shifts (e.g., night shift, swing shift).

attributes.name: show_up_time_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours guaranteed to be paid when a worker reports to the job site but cannot work due to weather or other conditions.

attributes.name: signatory_employer_name
attributes.description: Name of the employer or employer association that is signatory to this labor agreement.

attributes.name: trade_category
attributes.description: Primary craft or trade classification covered by this labor agreement (e.g., Carpenter, Electrician, Ironworker, Laborer, Operating Engineer, Pipefitter).

attributes.name: training_fund_rate

attributes.name: travel_subsistence_rate
attributes.description: Daily or hourly allowance for travel expenses and subsistence when workers are required to work outside their normal jurisdiction.

attributes.name: union_international_affiliation
attributes.description: Name of the international or national union body to which the local union is affiliated (e.g., AFL-CIO, International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers).

attributes.name: union_local_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the union local chapter or branch that is party to this labor agreement.

attributes.name: union_name
attributes.description: Full name of the labor union or trade organization that is party to this agreement.

attributes.name: union_security_clause
attributes.description: Type of union security arrangement specified in the agreement governing union membership requirements for workers.

attributes.name: vacation_holiday_rate
attributes.description: Hourly contribution rate for vacation and holiday pay under this labor agreement.

attributes.name: wage_rate_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all wage rates and monetary amounts in this agreement (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: wage_scale_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the detailed wage scale document or attachment that contains classification-specific wage rates and rules.

products.name: labor_rate
products.description: Reference record defining the all-in labor rates (base wage, fringe benefits, burden, overhead) for each trade classification under a specific labor agreement or project. Captures trade classification, effective date range, straight-time rate, overtime rate, double-time rate, fringe benefit rate, payroll burden percentage, and total loaded rate. Used for project cost estimation, bid pricing (BOQ), and job cost control.
products.reference: Prevailing Wage Rate / Loaded Labor Rate

attributes.name: labor_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the labor rate record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.account. Business justification: Rate tables are defined per client account to support project cost estimating and billing accuracy.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project for which this labor rate applies. Nullable for enterprise-wide or agreement-level rates that are not project-specific.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Connects labor rate definitions to the cost center that applies the rates, supporting the Labor Rate Master report used in payroll processing.

attributes.name: cost_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the labor cost code that categorizes this rate for job costing and financial reporting. Links to the WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) and SAP cost elements.

attributes.name: labor_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the labor agreement or collective bargaining agreement under which this rate is defined. Links to union contracts, prevailing wage determinations, or project-specific labor agreements.

attributes.name: labor_cost_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.labor_cost_code. Business justification: Link labor_rate to labor_cost_code to associate each rate with its cost code definition, enabling removal of duplicate cost code attributes from labor_rate.

attributes.name: apprentice_ratio
attributes.description: The maximum allowable ratio of apprentices to journeymen for this trade classification, as defined by union agreements or prevailing wage law (e.g., 1:3 means one apprentice per three journeymen). Nullable if not applicable.

attributes.name: base_hourly_rate
attributes.description: The straight-time hourly wage rate paid to the worker for regular hours (typically up to 8 hours per day or 40 hours per week). Excludes fringe benefits and burden.

attributes.name: certified_payroll_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate is subject to certified payroll reporting requirements under prevailing wage law (True) or not (False). Used to trigger compliance workflows in HCSS HeavyJob and Viewpoint Vista.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this labor rate record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency projects and international joint ventures.

attributes.name: double_time_hourly_rate
attributes.description: The hourly wage rate for double-time hours, typically 2.0x the base rate for hours worked on Sundays, holidays, or beyond a threshold (e.g., over 12 hours per day). Nullable if not applicable.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this labor rate expires or is superseded. Nullable for open-ended rates. Used to manage rate changes and contract renewals.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this labor rate becomes effective. Used for rate escalation tracking and historical cost analysis.

attributes.name: escalation_clause
attributes.description: Description of any contractual escalation provisions that adjust this rate over time (e.g., annual CPI adjustment, fixed percentage increase, renegotiation trigger). Nullable if no escalation applies.

attributes.name: fringe_benefit_rate
attributes.description: The hourly cost of fringe benefits (health insurance, pension, vacation, training funds, etc.) as defined by the labor agreement or prevailing wage determination. Added to base wage to calculate total compensation.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The geographic or contractual jurisdiction where this rate applies (e.g., Cook County IL, State of California, Federal Davis-Bacon). Used to enforce prevailing wage compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this labor rate record was last modified in the source system. Used for incremental data refresh and audit trail.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, or clarifications regarding this labor rate (e.g., project-specific adjustments, negotiated exceptions, compliance notes).

attributes.name: overhead_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage markup applied to cover indirect costs and general overhead (field supervision, small tools, consumables, field office, etc.). Used in bid pricing and Guaranteed Maximum Price (GMP) calculations. Nullable if not applicable.

attributes.name: overtime_hourly_rate
attributes.description: The hourly wage rate for overtime hours, typically 1.5x the base rate for hours beyond 8 per day or 40 per week, as defined by labor agreements or prevailing wage law.

attributes.name: payroll_burden_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage markup applied to gross wages to cover employer-paid payroll taxes (FICA, FUTA, SUTA, workers compensation insurance, general liability insurance). Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 35.50 for 35.5%).

attributes.name: per_diem_rate
attributes.description: Daily per diem allowance for meals and incidental expenses when workers are mobilized away from their home location. Nullable if not applicable. Used in labor mobilization cost calculations.

attributes.name: prevailing_wage_determination_number
attributes.description: The official reference number of the government-issued prevailing wage determination (e.g., Davis-Bacon wage decision number) that mandates this rate. Nullable for non-prevailing-wage projects.

attributes.name: profit_margin_percentage
attributes.description: The profit margin percentage applied to the fully burdened labor cost for bid pricing. Used in EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) and GMP (Guaranteed Maximum Price) contracts. Nullable if not applicable.

attributes.name: rate_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the labor rate. Typically a concatenation of trade classification, skill level, and agreement reference used in estimating and job costing systems.

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the labor rate record. Active rates are used in cost estimation and job costing. Expired or superseded rates are retained for historical cost analysis and audit trails.

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate basis: union (collective bargaining agreement), prevailing_wage (government-mandated), open_shop (non-union competitive), project_specific (negotiated for a single project), or market_rate (regional benchmark).

attributes.name: shift_differential_rate
attributes.description: Additional hourly premium paid for non-standard shifts (e.g., night shift, swing shift). Nullable if not applicable. Used in 24/7 operations and accelerated project schedules.

attributes.name: skill_level
attributes.description: The skill or seniority level within the trade classification. Determines the applicable wage scale and supervisory responsibility.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this labor rate record in the source operational system. Used for traceability and incremental data synchronization.

attributes.name: subsistence_rate
attributes.description: Daily subsistence allowance for lodging and living expenses when workers are required to stay overnight away from home. Nullable if not applicable. Used in remote project cost planning.

attributes.name: total_loaded_hourly_rate
attributes.description: The all-in hourly cost including base wage, fringe benefits, payroll burden, overhead, and profit. This is the rate used for project cost estimation, Bill of Quantities (BOQ) pricing, and Earned Value Management (EVM) calculations.

attributes.name: trade_classification
attributes.description: The craft or trade classification for which this rate applies (e.g., Carpenter, Electrician, Pipefitter, Ironworker, Heavy Equipment Operator, Laborer). Aligns with union jurisdictions and prevailing wage schedules.

attributes.name: travel_zone
attributes.description: The geographic travel zone or radius from the union hall or home base that determines eligibility for travel pay, per diem, and subsistence. Nullable if not applicable.

attributes.name: union_local
attributes.description: The union local or labor organization that governs this rate (e.g., IBEW Local 134, Carpenters Local 1). Nullable for non-union or open-shop rates.

products.name: agency_labor_order
products.description: Transactional record for a request placed with a labor hire agency or staffing firm to supply craft workers for a project. Captures agency identity, trade classification requested, number of workers, required qualifications, required start date, project and site, bill rate, markup percentage, PO reference, fulfillment status, and workers actually supplied. Tracks the full lifecycle from request through fulfillment. Distinct from subcontractor work orders — covers temporary staffing arrangements where workers report to the GC's supervision.

products.name: apprenticeship_progression
products.description: Transactional record tracking a craft worker's progression through a registered apprenticeship program (NCCER, union JATC, or state-registered). Captures current apprenticeship level/period, accumulated OJT (On-the-Job Training) hours by trade, related technical instruction hours completed, wage progression step, sponsoring JATC (Joint Apprenticeship Training Committee), expected journey-level completion date, and compliance status with DOL (Department of Labor) or state apprenticeship agency requirements. Supports Davis-Bacon Act apprentice-to-journeyman ratio compliance, certified payroll reporting of apprentice classifications, and union reporting of hours toward journeyman upgrade. Critical for contractors participating in federal/state prevailing wage projects where apprentice utilization ratios are audited.

domains.name: schedule
domains.description: Project scheduling domain managing CPM (Critical Path Method) networks, activity sequencing, resource leveling, critical path analysis, progress tracking, baseline comparisons, look-ahead plans, and schedule performance metrics (SPI). products.name: inspection
products.description: Transactional record of a physical quality inspection or checklist verification event conducted on site, at a factory, or workshop. Captures inspection date, location, inspector identity, ITP line reference, checklist template used, item-level verification results (pass/fail/N/A per check item with remarks), overall outcome (pass/fail/conditional), observations, non-conformances raised, digital sign-off, and attachments (photos, measurements). Covers all inspection types: hold-point inspections, witness-point inspections, pre-pour checks, structural inspections, MEP inspections, and any checklist-based quality verification. Each record serves as the auditable evidence trail for QA/QC compliance and may trigger NCR creation on failure.

attributes.name: modified_by

attributes.name: responsible_contractor_name

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the defect: critical (safety/structural risk, immediate action required), major (significant impact on functionality or performance), minor (limited impact, does not affect primary function), cosmetic (aesthetic only, no functional impact).

attributes.name: target_rectification_date
attributes.description: Target or planned date by which the defect should be rectified, often driven by DLP (Defects Liability Period) expiry or contractual milestones.

attributes.name: title

attributes.name: trade_discipline

attributes.name: verified_by

attributes.name: created_by

products.name: punch_list
products.description: Punch list (snagging list) master record grouping outstanding defects, incomplete works, and commissioning items requiring resolution before a project milestone (mechanical completion, practical completion, or handover). attributes.name: punch_list_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the punch list record. Primary key for the punch list entity.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Punch list close‑out is a contractual deliverable; linking to agreement tracks fulfillment of contract milestones.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.account. Business justification: Client oversees punch‑list during project handover; required for client‑focused punch‑list status reports.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project to which this punch list belongs.

attributes.name: firm_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to bid.firm_profile. Business justification: Punch list responsibility matrix must reference the subcontractor responsible for each item to drive close‑out.

attributes.name: prepared_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Punch list creation is logged with the employee who prepared it, required for traceability in handover documentation.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.wbs_element. Business justification: Punch lists are generated per WBS element to allocate cost and schedule impacts accurately.

attributes.name: actual_closeout_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the punch list was fully closed, indicating all items have been resolved and accepted. Nullable until closure is achieved.

attributes.name: client_representative
attributes.description: Name of the client or owner representative who is involved in the punch list review and acceptance process.

attributes.name: closed_items_count
attributes.description: The current count of punch list items that have been resolved and closed. Indicates progress toward full punch list closure.

attributes.name: completion_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of punch list items that have been closed, calculated as (closed_items_count / total_items_count) * 100. Provides a quick progress indicator.

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the contract or contract package under which this punch list is being managed. Links the punch list to contractual obligations and terms.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this punch list record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: critical_items_count
attributes.description: The count of items classified as critical or high-priority, typically those that block handover or pose safety/operational risks.

attributes.name: discipline
attributes.description: The engineering or construction discipline that this punch list primarily covers. Used to route items to the appropriate trade or subcontractor for resolution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: civil|structural|architectural|mechanical|electrical|plumbing|hvac|instrumentation|piping|general — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dlp_commencement_gate
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether closure of this punch list triggers the start of the Defects Liability Period (DLP). True means DLP clock starts upon punch list closure.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the formal punch list document, report, or file stored in the document management system (e.g., Aconex, BIM 360). Enables traceability to the source document.

attributes.name: handover_gate
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether closure of this punch list is a contractual gate for project handover. True means handover cannot proceed until this list is closed.

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the inspection was conducted that resulted in the creation of this punch list. Typically the date of the pre-handover or milestone inspection walk-through.

attributes.name: milestone_type
attributes.description: The project milestone or phase that this punch list is associated with. Defines the contractual stage at which defects and incomplete works are being tracked for resolution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mechanical_completion|practical_completion|substantial_completion|final_completion|handover|commissioning|pre_commissioning — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who last modified this punch list record. Part of the audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this punch list record was last modified or updated. Part of the audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: punch_list_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title for the punch list, often indicating the milestone, area, or phase it relates to (e.g., 'Mechanical Completion - Building A', 'Practical Completion - Zone 3').

attributes.name: open_items_count
attributes.description: The current count of punch list items that remain open or unresolved. Used to track progress toward close-out.

attributes.name: prepared_by
attributes.description: Name of the individual or role who prepared or compiled the punch list, typically a QA/QC inspector, project engineer, or commissioning manager.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Overall priority classification for the punch list, reflecting the urgency and impact of the items it contains. Critical punch lists may block handover or commissioning.

attributes.name: project_area
attributes.description: The physical area, zone, building, or section of the project to which this punch list applies (e.g., 'Building A', 'Zone 3', 'East Wing', 'Substation 2').

attributes.name: punch_list_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the punch list, typically a human-readable code or number used for tracking and reference in project documentation and handover processes.

attributes.name: punch_list_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the punch list. Indicates whether the list is being compiled, actively worked, under review, or closed out.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: General comments, notes, or observations related to the punch list. May include context on delays, coordination issues, or special conditions affecting close-out.

attributes.name: responsible_party_type
attributes.description: Classification of the party responsible for punch list resolution. Helps route accountability and track performance by party type.

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name of the individual or role who reviewed and approved the punch list for issuance, typically a project manager, client representative, or QA/QC manager.

attributes.name: specification_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the technical specification, design document, or quality standard against which the punch list items are being evaluated.

attributes.name: target_closeout_date
attributes.description: The planned or contractually required date by which all items on the punch list must be resolved and the list closed. Critical for handover and DLP (Defects Liability Period) commencement.

attributes.name: total_items_count
attributes.description: The total number of punch list items (defects, incomplete works, commissioning tasks) recorded on this punch list.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who created this punch list record in the system. Part of the audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: creation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the punch list was initially created or issued. Marks the start of the close-out tracking process for the associated milestone.

products.name: punch_item
products.description: Individual punch list item within a punch list record. Captures item number, description, location, category (structural, MEP, architectural, civil), responsible subcontractor, priority, target completion date, actual completion date, verification inspector, and closure status. Drives the close-out workflow for practical completion.

attributes.name: punch_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the punch list item. Primary key.

attributes.name: activity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to schedule.activity. Business justification: Punch list generation ties each punch item to its originating activity for close‑out verification and handover.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Each punch item must be traced to the governing contract for liability and final acceptance.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project where this punch item was identified. Enables project-level defect tracking and close-out reporting.

attributes.name: craft_worker_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.craft_worker. Business justification: Punch item assignment to a worker enables tracking of who will close the item.

attributes.name: drawing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.drawing. Business justification: Punch items track deficiencies on particular drawings; FK enables linkage to BIM models.

attributes.name: finance_cost_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_code. Business justification: Punch items often generate change order costs; linking each punch_item to a cost code enables precise cost tracking for close‑out.

attributes.name: firm_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subcontractor or trade contractor responsible for rectifying the punch item. Drives accountability and work assignment during close-out.

attributes.name: punch_list_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent punch list record that contains this item. Links the item to the overall punch list inspection event.

attributes.name: responsible_crew_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.crew. Business justification: Punch items can be assigned to a crew for coordinated resolution; supports crew workload tracking.

attributes.name: responsible_party_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Punch list items are assigned to a responsible employee; linking enables tracking of responsibility and performance.

attributes.name: technical_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.technical_specification. Business justification: Punch items may reference a spec clause; FK supports audit of spec compliance.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id

attributes.name: actual_completion_date

attributes.name: punch_item_category
attributes.description: Classification of the punch item by discipline or trade. attributes.name: client_representative_name

attributes.name: closure_status
attributes.description: Final disposition status of the punch item at project close-out. Accepted indicates satisfactory completion; rejected indicates non-conformance; deferred indicates item moved to DLP (Defects Liability Period) or post-handover.

attributes.name: corrective_action

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost impact amount. Enables multi-currency project tracking.

attributes.name: cost_impact
attributes.description: Estimated or actual cost incurred to rectify the punch item. Used for financial tracking and back-charge to responsible parties.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the punch item record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: deferred_to_dlp
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the punch item was deferred to the DLP (Defects Liability Period) for post-handover rectification. True if deferred; false otherwise.

attributes.name: dlp_end_date

attributes.name: identified_by
