attributes.description: Specific PPE items mandated for workers operating in proximity to this hazard (e.g., 'Hard hat, safety harness, hi-vis vest, safety glasses'). Supports PPE compliance checks during pre-start briefings and site inspections.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hazard requires formal notification to a regulatory authority (e.g., OSHA, EPA) due to its nature or severity. True = notification required. Supports regulatory compliance workflow management.

attributes.name: residual_consequence_rating
attributes.description: Numeric consequence/severity score after all control measures have been applied, on the same 1–5 scale as initial_consequence_rating. Reflects the effectiveness of controls in reducing severity of potential harm.

attributes.name: residual_likelihood_rating
attributes.description: Numeric likelihood score after all control measures have been applied, on the same 1–5 scale as initial_likelihood_rating. Reflects the effectiveness of controls in reducing probability of harm.

attributes.name: residual_risk_level
attributes.description: Qualitative risk band derived from the residual risk score after controls are applied. Determines whether the hazard is tolerable (low/medium) or requires escalation and further treatment (high/critical).

attributes.name: residual_risk_score
attributes.description: Post-control risk score calculated as residual_likelihood_rating × residual_consequence_rating. Represents the remaining risk after controls are applied. Used to determine if the risk is tolerable or requires further treatment.

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: Name or role of the individual or team accountable for implementing and maintaining the control measures for this hazard (e.g., 'Site Supervisor — Civil Works', 'HSE Manager'). Supports accountability tracking and corrective action follow-up.

attributes.name: site_zone
attributes.description: Designated zone, area, or work front on the construction site where the hazard is located (e.g., 'Zone A — Excavation', 'Level 4 — Formwork', 'Laydown Area 2'). Used for spatial hazard mapping and pre-start briefing targeting.

attributes.name: swms_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number of the Safe Work Method Statement (SWMS) that addresses this hazard and its control measures. Links the hazard register to the SWMS document library in Aconex or Procore.

attributes.name: target_closure_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the hazard is expected to be eliminated or reduced to a tolerable residual risk level. Used for corrective action scheduling and overdue hazard reporting.

attributes.name: tbm_topic_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hazard has been selected or is recommended as a topic for an upcoming Toolbox Meeting (TBM). True = flagged for TBM discussion. Supports automated TBM topic selection from the live hazard register.

products.name: environmental_monitoring
products.description: Environmental monitoring measurement records capturing periodic readings for air quality, noise levels, vibration, water quality, and soil contamination at construction sites. Captures monitoring parameter, measurement value, unit, threshold limit, exceedance flag, monitoring location, instrument used, and responsible party. Supports ISO 14001 environmental management and regulatory permit compliance.

attributes.name: environmental_monitoring_id
attributes.description: Primary key for environmental_monitoring

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project at which this environmental monitoring measurement was taken. Links monitoring records to project-level environmental compliance tracking.

attributes.name: hazard_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.hazard_register. Business justification: Environmental monitoring often targets a specific hazard; linking to hazard_register enables hazard‑centric reporting.

attributes.name: responsible_party_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Environmental monitoring must record the employee overseeing the measurement for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific construction site where the environmental measurement was recorded. Supports site-level environmental permit compliance and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: corrective_action_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the corrective action record raised in Intelex HSE management system in response to this monitoring exceedance. Provides traceability between the environmental measurement and the remediation workflow.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a corrective action has been raised or is required as a result of this monitoring record. True = corrective action initiated in Intelex; False = no corrective action required. Populated automatically when exceedance_flag is True or manually by the HSE officer.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this environmental monitoring record was first created and entered into the system (Intelex or source system). Audit trail field for data governance and regulatory record-keeping requirements.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Quality assurance flag indicating the reliability and validity of the measurement value. 'Suspect' indicates potential instrument malfunction or anomalous conditions; 'Below Detection Limit' indicates the parameter was not detectable at the instrument's minimum detection level. Used in QA/QC review.

attributes.name: detection_limit
attributes.description: The minimum detection limit (MDL) of the instrument or analytical method for this parameter, expressed in the same unit as measurement_value. Used to contextualise results flagged as 'below_detection_limit' and for regulatory reporting of non-detects.

attributes.name: exceedance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the recorded measurement value has exceeded (or fallen below, for minimum thresholds) the applicable regulatory or permit threshold limit. True = exceedance detected; False = within acceptable limits. Triggers corrective action workflow in Intelex.

attributes.name: exceedance_magnitude
attributes.description: The absolute difference between the measured value and the threshold limit when an exceedance is detected. Null when exceedance_flag is False. Used to prioritise severity of environmental non-compliance and escalation response.

attributes.name: instrument_calibration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the monitoring instrument was last calibrated prior to this measurement. Used to verify that measurements were taken with a calibrated instrument within the required calibration interval, supporting regulatory defensibility.

attributes.name: instrument_calibration_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the monitoring instrument must next be calibrated to remain within its valid calibration period. Measurements taken after this date may be flagged as non-compliant for regulatory reporting purposes.

attributes.name: instrument_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier or asset tag of the instrument, sensor, or analyser used to take the measurement (e.g., dust monitor serial number, noise meter ID, water quality probe ID). Supports instrument calibration traceability and equipment maintenance records.

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: Classification of the instrument or sensor type used for the measurement (e.g., 'Dust Monitor', 'Sound Level Meter', 'Vibration Meter', 'Multi-parameter Water Quality Probe', 'Gas Analyser'). Used for equipment management and calibration scheduling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dust_monitor|sound_level_meter|vibration_meter|water_quality_probe|gas_analyser|turbidimeter|pH_meter|portable_gas_detector — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: laboratory_name
attributes.description: Name of the accredited analytical laboratory that performed sample analysis, where applicable (e.g., for water quality, soil contamination, or chemical air quality samples sent for laboratory analysis). Null for field-measured parameters.

attributes.name: laboratory_report_number
attributes.description: The unique report or chain-of-custody number issued by the analytical laboratory for the sample analysis. Provides traceability from the field sample to the laboratory result and supports regulatory audit documentation.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this environmental monitoring record was most recently modified. Used for data lineage tracking, change auditing, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks silver layer.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the monitoring point where the measurement was taken. Supports GIS-based environmental impact mapping and spatial analytics.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the monitoring point where the measurement was taken. Supports GIS-based environmental impact mapping and spatial analytics.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time at which the environmental measurement or reading was taken in the field. This is the principal real-world event time, distinct from record creation audit timestamps. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the recorded measurement value (e.g., µg/m³, mg/L, dB(A), mm/s, NTU, pH, ppm, mg/kg). Must align with the unit specified in the applicable environmental permit or regulatory standard for the parameter. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: µg/m³|mg/L|dB(A)|mm/s|NTU|pH|ppm|mg/kg|µS/cm|°C — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: measurement_value
attributes.description: The numeric reading or measured value recorded for the environmental parameter at the monitoring location and timestamp. This is the principal quantitative observation for this record. Precision to 6 decimal places to accommodate trace-level contaminant readings.

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: The required or actual frequency at which measurements are taken at this monitoring location for this parameter, as specified in the environmental monitoring plan or regulatory permit. Used to verify compliance with permit monitoring schedules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: continuous|hourly|daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|event_triggered — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: monitoring_location_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the designated monitoring point or station as defined in the environmental monitoring plan or permit. Used as the externally-known identifier in regulatory submissions and Intelex records.

attributes.name: monitoring_location_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or label of the specific monitoring point or station where the measurement was taken (e.g., 'North Perimeter Fence Line', 'Discharge Point DP-01', 'Borehole BH-03'). Used in permit compliance reports and environmental monitoring plans.

attributes.name: monitoring_method
attributes.description: The analytical or measurement method used to obtain the reading (e.g., EPA Method 40 CFR Part 50, ISO 10523 for pH, AS/NZS 4360 for noise). Ensures traceability and regulatory defensibility of measurement results.

attributes.name: monitoring_parameter
attributes.description: The specific environmental parameter being measured at this monitoring point (e.g., PM10, PM2.5, NO2, SO2, noise level dB(A), vibration velocity, pH, turbidity, TSS, BOD, lead, arsenic). Aligned with EPA and ISO 14001 environmental monitoring parameter classifications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PM10|PM2.5|NO2|SO2|CO|noise_dba|vibration_velocity|pH|turbidity|TSS|BOD|COD|lead|arsenic|benzene|TPH — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: monitoring_record_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the environmental monitoring record within the Intelex HSE management system. Tracks the record through data entry, verification by the environmental manager, regulatory submission, and closure.

attributes.name: monitoring_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric reference number assigned to this monitoring record, used in regulatory submissions, permit compliance reports, and Intelex HSE management system. Format: ENV-{SITE_CODE}-{SEQUENCE}.

attributes.name: parameter_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the environmental monitoring parameter into the primary environmental media or impact category. Used for domain-level reporting and ISO 14001 environmental aspect categorisation.

attributes.name: permit_reference_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the environmental permit, consent, or licence under which this monitoring is required. Links the measurement to the specific regulatory instrument that mandates monitoring at this location for this parameter.

attributes.name: regulator_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the exceedance or monitoring result was formally notified to the relevant regulatory authority. Null if reported_to_regulator is False. Used to verify compliance with permit notification timeframes.

attributes.name: regulatory_standard_reference
attributes.description: The specific regulatory standard, guideline, or code of practice that defines the threshold limit for this parameter (e.g., 'EPA NAAQS PM10 150 µg/m³ 24-hr', 'OSHA PEL 1910.1000 Table Z-1', 'ISO 14001:2015 Clause 9.1.1'). Provides traceability for threshold values used in exceedance determination.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for the monitoring officer to record contextual observations, anomalies, site conditions, or explanatory notes relevant to this measurement (e.g., 'Elevated reading attributed to adjacent demolition activity', 'Instrument battery low during measurement'). Supports regulatory audit and investigation.

attributes.name: reported_to_regulator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this monitoring result (particularly exceedances) has been formally reported to the relevant regulatory authority (e.g., EPA, state environmental agency) as required by the environmental permit or applicable legislation.

attributes.name: sample_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The duration in minutes over which the sample or measurement was collected or averaged. Relevant for time-averaged parameters such as noise (LAeq), air quality (24-hour PM10), and vibration. Null for instantaneous grab samples.

attributes.name: sample_type
attributes.description: Indicates the sampling methodology used to obtain the measurement — whether it is a grab sample (instantaneous), composite sample (time-averaged), continuous real-time reading, passive diffusion sample, or integrated sample over a defined period. Affects interpretation of results.

attributes.name: threshold_limit
attributes.description: The maximum permissible value (or minimum, for parameters like pH) for the monitored parameter as defined by the applicable environmental permit, regulatory standard, or project-specific environmental management plan. Used to determine exceedance status.

attributes.name: threshold_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the threshold limit represents a maximum permissible value, minimum required value, action level trigger, or alert level for the monitored parameter. Determines the logic used to evaluate exceedance.

attributes.name: weather_conditions
attributes.description: Prevailing weather conditions at the time of measurement. Relevant for contextualising air quality, dust, and noise readings, as weather significantly influences environmental parameter levels and regulatory defensibility of results. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|cloudy|overcast|light_rain|heavy_rain|windy|foggy|storm — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: wind_direction
attributes.description: Cardinal or intercardinal wind direction at the time of measurement. Used in conjunction with wind speed for air quality dispersion analysis and to determine whether site activities are the source of elevated readings at downwind monitoring points. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: N|NE|E|SE|S|SW|W|NW — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: wind_speed_ms
attributes.description: Wind speed in metres per second recorded at or near the monitoring location at the time of measurement. Critical contextual data for air quality and dust dispersion modelling and for assessing whether exceedances are attributable to site activities.

products.name: training
products.description: Safety training and induction records for construction workers, capturing training type (site induction, OSHA 10/30, first aid, confined space, working at heights), delivery date, trainer, duration, competency assessment result, certification issued, expiry date, and compliance status. Distinct from general workforce training — this is the SSOT for HSE-specific training compliance. Sourced from Intelex and SAP SuccessFactors HSE training modules.

attributes.name: incident_id

attributes.name: trainer_employee_id

attributes.name: assessment_method

attributes.name: assessment_result
attributes.description: Overall result of the competency assessment: pass (met requirements), fail (did not meet requirements), conditional_pass (passed with conditions or retraining required), or not_assessed (no formal assessment conducted).

attributes.name: assessment_score
attributes.description: Numerical score achieved by the worker in the competency assessment (e.g., 85.50 out of 100). Null if no assessment was conducted.

attributes.name: attendance_status
attributes.description: Worker's attendance status for the training session: attended (full participation), absent (did not attend), partial (attended part of the session), or excused (authorized absence).

attributes.name: certificate_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the training certification expires and requires renewal or refresher training. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. Null if certification does not expire or was not issued.

attributes.name: certificate_issue_date

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique identification number printed on the issued training certificate or card (e.g., OSHA 10-hour card number). Null if no certificate was issued.

attributes.name: certification_issued
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal certificate or card was issued to the worker upon successful completion of the training. True if issued, False if not.

attributes.name: training_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the specific training course or module (e.g., OSHA10, OSHA30, INDUCT01, HEIGHTS01).

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or special circumstances related to the training session (e.g., 'Worker required additional coaching on fall protection harness fitting', 'Training postponed due to weather').

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the worker's training record: compliant (training valid and up-to-date), non_compliant (required training not completed or failed), expired (certification has expired), pending_renewal (approaching expiry, renewal in progress), or waived (exempted by authorized personnel).

attributes.name: cost
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for the training session, including instructor fees, materials, facility rental, and travel expenses. Null if cost tracking is not applicable.

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the training cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Null if cost is not tracked.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the training was delivered: classroom instruction, online e-learning, on-site field training, blended (combination), simulator-based, or hands-on practical demonstration.

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the training session in hours (e.g., 8.00 for an 8-hour OSHA course, 0.50 for a 30-minute toolbox talk).

attributes.name: end_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the training session ended. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: language_of_instruction
attributes.description: Primary language in which the training was delivered (e.g., English, Spanish, Mandarin). Important for multilingual workforce compliance.

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location where the training was conducted (e.g., site office, training center address, online platform name).

attributes.name: mandatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this training is mandatory for the worker's role or project assignment. True if mandatory, False if optional or voluntary.

attributes.name: materials_provided
attributes.description: Description of training materials provided to the worker (e.g., 'OSHA handbook, safety manual, PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) checklist, online access credentials').

attributes.name: next_refresher_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the worker must complete refresher training to maintain compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. Null if no refresher is required.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training record was first created in the source system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this training record was last modified in the source system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: refresher_frequency_months
attributes.description: Number of months between required refresher training sessions (e.g., 12 for annual refresher, 36 for three-year renewal). Null if no refresher is required.

attributes.name: refresher_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether periodic refresher training is required to maintain competency and compliance. True if refresher is required, False if one-time training is sufficient.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement
attributes.description: Specific regulatory standard or legal requirement that mandates this training (e.g., 'OSHA 29 CFR 1926.1053 - Ladder Safety', 'ISO 45001 Clause 7.2 - Competence', 'State-specific confined space regulation').

attributes.name: start_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the training session started. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: title

attributes.name: trainer_certification_number
attributes.description: Certification or accreditation number of the trainer, verifying their authorization to deliver the specific training (e.g., OSHA Outreach Trainer ID).

attributes.name: training_date
attributes.description: Date on which the training session was conducted or completed. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: training_type

attributes.name: workers_affected
attributes.description: Number of subcontractor workers affected.

domains.name: subcontractor
domains.description: Subcontractor and specialty trade management domain governing relationships with MEP (Mechanical Electrical Plumbing) contractors, civil works subcontractors, and specialty vendors. Owns subcontractor profiles, prequalification records, trade packages, scope-of-work agreements, insurance compliance certificates, performance scorecards, and payment applications. Distinct from procurement which owns the PO/award process.

products.name: back_charge
products.description: Back-charge records raised against subcontractors for costs incurred by the general contractor due to subcontractor default, defective work, damage to other trades, cleanup failures, or failure to perform contractual obligations. Captures back-charge number, subcontract reference, reason code (rework, damage, cleanup, schedule impact, third-party recovery), cost breakdown (labor, material, equipment), amount claimed, notification date, response deadline, dispute status, resolution outcome, and deduction applied in payment certification. Enables cost recovery tracking and feeds final account reconciliation.

attributes.name: back_charge_id
attributes.description: Primary key for back_charge

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project where the back-charge event occurred. Links to the project master record.

attributes.name: cost_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost account or cost code to which this back-charge is allocated for job costing and financial tracking.

attributes.name: payment_certificate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payment certificate or payment application in which the back-charge deduction was applied. Links to the subcontractor payment record. Nullable if not yet deducted.

attributes.name: primary_back_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user (project manager, site manager, or contracts administrator) who issued the back-charge notice. Links to the user or team member record.

attributes.name: subcontract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subcontract agreement under which this back-charge is raised. Links to the subcontract master record.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the back-charge was formally approved for deduction by the authorized approver. Nullable if not yet approved.

attributes.name: approved_amount
attributes.description: Final approved amount of the back-charge after any dispute resolution or negotiation. May differ from the total claimed amount if partially accepted or negotiated down.

attributes.name: back_charge_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique business identifier for the back-charge record, typically formatted per company standards (e.g., BC-2024-001234). Used in correspondence and payment deductions.

attributes.name: back_charge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the back-charge record. Tracks progression from draft through issuance, dispute resolution, approval, and final deduction or closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|issued|acknowledged|disputed|under_review|approved|rejected|deducted|closed|cancelled — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the back-charge record was closed, indicating that all financial recovery and dispute resolution activities are complete. Nullable if still open.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this back-charge record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this back-charge record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: deduction_applied_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount deducted from subcontractor payment certification or final account as a result of this back-charge. Reflects the financial recovery achieved.

attributes.name: deduction_date
attributes.description: Date on which the back-charge amount was deducted from the subcontractor's payment. Nullable if deduction has not yet occurred.

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subcontractor formally raised a dispute against the back-charge. Nullable if no dispute was raised.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the subcontractor has formally disputed this back-charge. True indicates an active or resolved dispute; False indicates acceptance or no dispute raised.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Subcontractor's stated reason for disputing the back-charge. Captures the basis of disagreement (e.g., work was not defective, damage was pre-existing, cost is excessive, liability is disputed).

attributes.name: equipment_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total equipment cost component of the back-charge, representing the cost of equipment usage (owned or rented) deployed to remedy the subcontractor default.

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: Date on which the event or condition giving rise to the back-charge occurred (e.g., date of damage, date defective work was discovered, date of cleanup failure).

attributes.name: labor_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total labor cost component of the back-charge, representing the cost of general contractor or third-party labor deployed to remedy the subcontractor default or defect.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this back-charge record was last updated. Audit trail field for data governance and change tracking.

attributes.name: material_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total material cost component of the back-charge, representing the cost of materials consumed to remedy the subcontractor default or replace damaged materials.

attributes.name: ncr_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the associated Non-Conformance Report (NCR) that documented the quality defect or deficiency giving rise to this back-charge. Nullable if no formal NCR was raised.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or internal observations related to the back-charge. Used for audit trail and knowledge capture.

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the back-charge notice was formally issued to the subcontractor. Establishes the start of the response period per contract terms.

attributes.name: overhead_cost_amount
attributes.description: Overhead and indirect cost component of the back-charge, including administrative costs, supervision, and markup applied per contract terms.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Categorical code identifying the primary reason for the back-charge. Common reasons include rework due to defective work, damage caused to other trades, failure to perform cleanup, schedule delays caused by subcontractor, safety violations, or third-party cost recovery. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rework|defective_work|damage_to_other_trades|cleanup_failure|schedule_impact|safety_violation|third_party_recovery|warranty_claim|material_waste|equipment_damage — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the circumstances and events that led to the back-charge. Includes specifics of the subcontractor default, defective work details, or damage caused.

attributes.name: resolution_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of the back-charge after any dispute resolution process. Indicates whether the charge was accepted in full, partially accepted, rejected, settled through negotiation, or resolved via arbitration or litigation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: accepted_full|accepted_partial|rejected|negotiated_settlement|arbitration_awarded|litigation_settled|withdrawn — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: response_deadline_date
attributes.description: Date by which the subcontractor must respond to the back-charge notice, either acknowledging the charge or raising a formal dispute. Typically contractually defined (e.g., 14 days from notification).

attributes.name: site_instruction_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the site instruction issued to the subcontractor directing remedial action or documenting the default. Nullable if no formal site instruction was issued.

attributes.name: supporting_documentation_path
attributes.description: File path or document management system reference to supporting documentation for the back-charge (photos, inspection reports, cost breakdowns, correspondence). Typically stored in Aconex or BIM 360 document control.

attributes.name: total_claimed_amount
attributes.description: Total amount claimed in the back-charge, representing the sum of all cost components (labor, material, equipment, overhead) that the general contractor seeks to recover from the subcontractor.

products.name: final_account
products.description: Final account settlement records for completed subcontracts, capturing the agreed final contract value after all change orders, back-charges, retention releases, and claims are resolved. Tracks original contract value, total approved change orders, total back-charges, final agreed value, settlement date, signatory details, and final account status (draft, agreed, disputed, closed). Represents the financial close-out milestone for each subcontract.

attributes.name: final_account_id
attributes.description: Primary key for final_account

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project under which this subcontract final account is settled.

attributes.name: prepared_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Final account preparation is done by an employee; linking supports financial audit and sign‑off records.

attributes.name: subcontract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent subcontract for which this final account settlement is being prepared. Links to the subcontract master record.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the final account was internally approved by the contractor before being presented to the subcontractor for agreement.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name of the senior manager or project director who approved the final account for signature and settlement.

attributes.name: claims_settled_value
attributes.description: Total value of subcontractor claims (for delays, disruptions, variations, or EOT-related costs) that were agreed and settled as part of the final account.

attributes.name: contractor_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized representative from the general contractor (GC) who signed the final account settlement.

attributes.name: contractor_signatory_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the contractor signatory (e.g., Project Manager, Contracts Manager, Commercial Director).

attributes.name: contractor_signature_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contractor signatory signed the final account document.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this final account record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this final account (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: defects_liability_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Defects Liability Period expires. Retention is typically released after this date and any defects are rectified.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for dispute if the final account status is disputed. Captures the nature of disagreement (e.g., valuation of variations, back-charge validity, claim rejection).

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the dispute was formally resolved and the final account was agreed, if initially disputed.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: The method being used or planned to resolve the final account dispute, if applicable. Aligns with contract dispute resolution clauses.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the physical or digital final account settlement document stored in the document management system (e.g., Aconex document ID).

attributes.name: final_account_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the final account settlement document. Typically follows organizational numbering convention (e.g., FA-2024-001234).

attributes.name: final_account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the final account settlement. Tracks progression from draft through agreement to closure or dispute resolution.

attributes.name: final_agreed_value
attributes.description: The final settled contract value after all adjustments: original value plus approved COs plus claims minus back-charges minus LDs plus retention released. Represents the total financial close-out amount.

attributes.name: final_payment_due_date
attributes.description: The contractual due date by which the final agreed value must be paid to the subcontractor. Typically defined in payment terms.

attributes.name: final_payment_made_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the final payment was made to the subcontractor. Confirms financial closure.

attributes.name: final_payment_reference
attributes.description: Payment transaction reference or remittance advice number for the final payment. Links to accounts payable records.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this final account record was last updated. Audit trail for record modifications.

attributes.name: liquidated_damages_deducted
attributes.description: Total liquidated damages deducted from the final account for delays or non-performance as per the subcontract terms.

attributes.name: original_contract_value
attributes.description: The initial awarded subcontract value before any change orders, variations, or adjustments. Baseline financial commitment.

attributes.name: performance_bond_release_date
attributes.description: Date on which the performance bond was formally released to the subcontractor or their surety.

attributes.name: performance_bond_released
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subcontractor performance bond or guarantee has been released as part of the final account settlement. True if released, False if still held.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to the final account settlement. Captures context not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: retention_released
attributes.description: Total retention amount released to the subcontractor upon satisfactory completion and expiry of the Defects Liability Period (DLP). Typically 5-10% of contract value.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the final account was formally agreed and signed by both parties. Marks the financial close-out milestone.

attributes.name: subcontractor_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized representative from the subcontractor who signed the final account settlement.

attributes.name: subcontractor_signatory_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the subcontractor signatory (e.g., Managing Director, Commercial Manager, Project Director).

attributes.name: subcontractor_signature_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subcontractor signatory signed the final account document.

attributes.name: total_approved_change_orders
attributes.description: Cumulative value of all approved change orders that increased or decreased the subcontract scope and value. Sum of all CO amounts.

attributes.name: total_back_charges
attributes.description: Cumulative value of all back-charges levied against the subcontractor for defects, delays, rework, or other contractual breaches. Reduces final payment.

products.name: performance_scorecard
products.description: Required product subcontractor.performance_scorecard ensured by structure enforcement.

attributes.name: performance_scorecard_id
attributes.description: Primary key for performance_scorecard.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Performance Scorecard evaluates subcontractor against a specific contract agreement, needing agreement_id to associate scores with that contract.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project for which this subcontractor performance is being evaluated.

attributes.name: evaluator_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Scorecard evaluations are conducted by a specific employee; linking enables traceability and performance analytics.

attributes.name: firm_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subcontractor being evaluated in this performance scorecard.

attributes.name: performance_esg_report_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.esg_report. Business justification: Scorecards evaluate subcontractor performance against ESG metrics; storing the ESG report used for assessment enables traceability.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the performance scorecard was formally approved by authorized management.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status of the performance scorecard document.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name of the senior manager or PMO director who approved the final performance scorecard.

attributes.name: bid_eligibility_status
attributes.description: Current bid eligibility status resulting from this performance evaluation: eligible for all future bids, restricted to certain project types, or ineligible for future bidding.

attributes.name: change_order_disputes
attributes.description: Number of disputed or contested change orders raised by or against the subcontractor during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: commercial_conduct_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0-100) representing the subcontractor's commercial conduct including responsiveness to instructions, cooperation, documentation quality, and change order management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance scorecard record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the performance scorecard assessment was completed and recorded.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the performance evaluation period for this scorecard.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the performance evaluation period for this scorecard.

attributes.name: evaluator_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments and observations from the evaluator providing additional context, specific incidents, or qualitative assessment details.

attributes.name: evaluator_role
attributes.description: The role or title of the person who conducted the evaluation (e.g., Project Manager, Construction Manager, PMO Director).

attributes.name: follow_up_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which follow-up actions or corrective measures must be completed and reviewed.

attributes.name: follow_up_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether follow-up actions, meetings, or corrective action plans are required based on this performance evaluation.

attributes.name: hse_compliance_violations
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Compliance Violations
attributes.description: Number of HSE compliance violations or safety infractions recorded during the evaluation period.

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Compliance Violations

attributes.name: hse_lti_count
attributes.description: Total number of Lost Time Injuries recorded for the subcontractor's workforce during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: hse_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Performance Score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0-100) representing the subcontractor's overall HSE compliance and safety performance during the evaluation period.

tag_set.value: Health Safety and Environment (HSE) Performance Score

attributes.name: hse_trir
attributes.description: Total Recordable Incident Rate calculated as (Number of OSHA recordable incidents × 200,000) / Total hours worked. Industry standard HSE metric.

attributes.name: improvement_areas
attributes.description: Detailed description of specific areas where the subcontractor needs to improve performance, including corrective actions required.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance scorecard record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: overall_rating
attributes.description: Overall categorical performance rating summarizing the subcontractor's performance across all evaluation dimensions.

attributes.name: overall_score
attributes.description: Weighted overall performance score (0-100) calculated from individual category scores (schedule, quality, HSE, productivity, commercial conduct).

attributes.name: prequalification_impact
attributes.description: Impact of this performance scorecard on the subcontractor's prequalification status for future projects: automatic renewal, conditional renewal, requires detailed review, or disqualification.

attributes.name: productivity_rate
attributes.description: Productivity rate measured as units completed per labor hour or per day during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: productivity_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0-100) representing the subcontractor's productivity and efficiency in completing assigned work during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: productivity_units_completed
attributes.description: Total quantity of work units completed by the subcontractor during the evaluation period (e.g., cubic meters of concrete, linear meters of pipe, square meters of formwork).

attributes.name: quality_ncr_count
attributes.description: Total number of Non-Conformance Reports issued against the subcontractor during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: quality_ncr_rate
attributes.description: Rate of Non-Conformance Reports per unit of work completed (e.g., NCRs per 1000 work hours or per million dollars of work).

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0-100) representing the subcontractor's overall quality conformance and workmanship during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: recommended_action
attributes.description: Recommended action based on the performance evaluation outcome: continue engagement, monitor closely, require improvement plan, place on watch-list, disqualify from future bids, or suspend from current work.

attributes.name: rfi_response_timeliness_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Request for Information (RFI) Response Timeliness Score
attributes.description: Score (0-100) measuring the subcontractor's timeliness in responding to RFIs and providing requested information.

tag_set.value: Request for Information (RFI) Response Timeliness Score

attributes.name: schedule_adherence_spi
attributes.description: Schedule Performance Index measuring the subcontractor's adherence to planned schedule. SPI = Earned Value / Planned Value. Values >1.0 indicate ahead of schedule, <1.0 indicate behind schedule.

attributes.name: schedule_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0-100) representing the subcontractor's overall schedule performance during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: strengths
attributes.description: Description of the subcontractor's key strengths and positive performance aspects observed during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: subcontractor_acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subcontractor acknowledged receipt and review of the performance scorecard.

attributes.name: subcontractor_response
attributes.description: Subcontractor's formal response or comments regarding the performance evaluation, including any disputes or corrective action commitments.

products.name: sub_time_extension
products.description: Extension of Time (EOT) claims submitted by subcontractors seeking schedule relief from contractual completion dates due to excusable delay events. Captures claim reference, subcontract reference, delay event description, cause category (employer risk, force majeure, concurrent delay, weather, design change), days claimed, days assessed, days granted, contemporaneous records references, determination date, determination authority, and impact on liquidated damages exposure. Links to schedule domain for programme impact analysis. [SSOT: distinct source of truth for subcontractor domain]

attributes.name: sub_time_extension_id
attributes.description: Primary key for eot_claim

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project affected by this EOT claim.

attributes.name: contract_eot_claim_id
attributes.description: SSOT reference to canonical contract.contract_eot_claim (single source of truth).

attributes.name: schedule_eot_claim_id
attributes.description: SSOT reference to canonical schedule.schedule_eot_claim (single source of truth).

attributes.name: subcontract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent subcontract agreement under which this EOT claim is submitted.

attributes.name: submitted_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: EOT claim submission is logged by the employee who files it; required for claim processing workflow.

attributes.name: assessed_by
attributes.description: Name and role of the project team member or consultant who conducted the technical assessment of the EOT claim.

attributes.name: baseline_schedule_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the approved baseline schedule used as the basis for delay analysis and EOT assessment.

attributes.name: claim_reference_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Extension of Time (EOT) Claim Reference Number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to this EOT claim for tracking and correspondence purposes.

tag_set.value: Extension of Time (EOT) Claim Reference Number

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the EOT claim in the review and determination workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|assessed|approved|rejected|withdrawn — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: claim_submission_method
attributes.description: Method or channel through which the subcontractor submitted the EOT claim to the main contractor.

attributes.name: concurrent_delay_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delay event occurred concurrently with other delays for which the subcontractor is responsible, affecting EOT entitlement.

attributes.name: contemporaneous_records_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifiers or document numbers for contemporaneous project records (daily logs, progress reports, site instructions, correspondence) supporting the EOT claim.

attributes.name: cost_claim_associated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subcontractor has submitted or intends to submit a separate cost claim for prolongation costs associated with this delay event.

attributes.name: critical_path_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delay event impacted activities on the project critical path, a key determinant of EOT entitlement.

attributes.name: days_assessed
attributes.description: Number of calendar days of schedule extension determined by the project management team or contract administrator during the assessment process.

attributes.name: days_claimed
attributes.description: Number of calendar days of schedule extension requested by the subcontractor in the EOT claim submission.

attributes.name: days_granted
attributes.description: Number of calendar days of schedule extension formally approved and granted to the subcontractor, adjusting the contractual completion date.

attributes.name: delay_cause_category
attributes.description: Classification of the root cause of the delay event determining entitlement and risk allocation under the subcontract terms.

attributes.name: delay_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the delay event ceased or was resolved, allowing work to resume on the affected activities.

attributes.name: delay_event_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the delay event or circumstances that form the basis of the EOT claim, including impact on critical path activities.

attributes.name: delay_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the delay event commenced and began impacting the subcontractor's ability to meet contractual completion dates.

attributes.name: determination_authority
attributes.description: Name and role of the individual or entity authorized to make the determination decision on the EOT claim (e.g., Project Manager, Contract Administrator, Engineer).

attributes.name: determination_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract administrator or project management office issued the formal determination decision on the EOT claim.

attributes.name: determination_rationale
attributes.description: Detailed explanation and justification for the determination decision, including reasons for any variance between days claimed and days granted.

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current status of any dispute arising from disagreement over the EOT claim determination.

attributes.name: ld_exposure_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of how the granted EOT affects the subcontractor's exposure to liquidated damages for late completion.

attributes.name: notice_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subcontractor complied with contractual notice requirements and timelines, which may affect claim entitlement.

attributes.name: notice_date
attributes.description: Date when the subcontractor provided initial notice of the delay event to the main contractor, as required by contract notice provisions.

attributes.name: original_completion_date
attributes.description: Contractual completion date for the subcontract scope of work prior to any EOT adjustments.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this EOT claim record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this EOT claim record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: revised_completion_date
attributes.description: Adjusted contractual completion date after granting the EOT, calculated by adding granted days to the original or previously revised completion date.

attributes.name: schedule_analysis_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to analyze the delay impact and quantify the time extension, following industry-standard delay analysis protocols.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the subcontractor formally submitted the EOT claim to the main contractor or project management office.

attributes.name: supporting_documentation_count
attributes.description: Number of supporting documents (schedules, correspondence, photos, reports) attached to the EOT claim submission.

products.name: sub_change_order
products.description: Change order records issued to subcontractors modifying the original subcontract scope, value, or schedule.
