attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the quantity is measured (e.g., hours, cubic meters, tons, each). Aligns with industry standard UOM codes.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user or system that created this cost transaction record. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

products.name: earned_value_record
products.description: Periodic EVM (Earned Value Management) snapshot record computed at the WBS/cost code level for each reporting period. Captures BCWS (Planned Value), BCWP (Earned Value), ACWP (Actual Cost), SV, CV, CPI, SPI, EAC, ETC (Estimate to Complete), VAC, and TCPI (To-Complete Performance Index). Includes cost engineer forecast inputs for remaining work quantities and rates. Integrates Oracle Primavera P6 schedule progress with SAP S/4HANA cost actuals. The authoritative source for EVM financial outputs and cost-to-complete analysis per PMI/ANSI 748 standard.
products.reference: EVM / ANSI 748 / PMI PMBOK Earned Value

attributes.name: earned_value_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the earned value management record. Primary key for the earned value snapshot.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent construction project. Links this EVM record to the overall project context.

attributes.name: cost_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost account or cost code for which this EVM record is calculated. Enables cost tracking at the granular control account level.

attributes.name: primavera_activity_id
attributes.description: The Oracle Primavera P6 activity identifier from which schedule progress data was sourced for this EVM record. Enables traceability to the source scheduling system.

attributes.name: project_baseline_id
attributes.description: Reference to the project baseline against which this EVM record is measured. Links to the approved baseline for performance measurement.

attributes.name: project_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.project_budget. Business justification: Earned value records are snapshots against an approved project budget; linking provides budget context.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the WBS element for which this EVM record is computed. Links to the project work breakdown structure hierarchy.

attributes.name: acwp_actual_cost
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Cost of Work Performed (ACWP) / Actual Cost (AC)
attributes.description: The actual costs incurred for the work performed during the reporting period. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA financial actuals.

tag_set.value: Actual Cost of Work Performed (ACWP) / Actual Cost (AC)

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this EVM record was approved by the project controls manager or PMO. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the project controls manager or PMO representative who approved this EVM record.

attributes.name: bac_budget_at_completion
attributes.description: The total authorized budget for the WBS element or cost account. Represents the baseline budget against which performance is measured.

attributes.name: bcwp_earned_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Budgeted Cost of Work Performed (BCWP) / Earned Value (EV)
attributes.description: The budgeted cost of work that has actually been completed as of the data date. Represents the value of work earned based on physical progress.

tag_set.value: Budgeted Cost of Work Performed (BCWP) / Earned Value (EV)

attributes.name: bcws_planned_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Budgeted Cost of Work Scheduled (BCWS) / Planned Value (PV)
attributes.description: The authorized budget assigned to scheduled work for this WBS element and reporting period. Represents the planned value of work that should have been completed by the data date.

tag_set.value: Budgeted Cost of Work Scheduled (BCWS) / Planned Value (PV)

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes from the cost engineer or project controls team regarding this EVM record. May include explanations of variances, forecast assumptions, or corrective actions.

attributes.name: cost_engineer_name
attributes.description: The name of the cost engineer responsible for providing forecast inputs (ETC, remaining quantities, and rates) for this EVM record.

attributes.name: cost_performance_index
attributes.description: The ratio of earned value to actual cost (BCWP / ACWP). A CPI less than 1.0 indicates cost overrun; greater than 1.0 indicates cost underrun. Key metric for cost efficiency.

attributes.name: cost_variance
attributes.description: The difference between earned value and actual cost (BCWP - ACWP). A negative value indicates cost overrun; a positive value indicates cost underrun.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this EVM record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this EVM record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: data_date
attributes.description: The as-of date for this EVM snapshot. Represents the point in time at which progress and cost data were captured for analysis.

attributes.name: eac_calculation_method
attributes.description: The method used to calculate the EAC for this record. Options include CPI-based projection, SPI/CPI composite, bottom-up cost engineer forecast, management estimate, or atypical variance adjustment.

attributes.name: eac_estimate_at_completion
attributes.description: The forecasted total cost of the WBS element or cost account at completion. Calculated using CPI-based or cost engineer forecast methods.

attributes.name: etc_estimate_to_complete
attributes.description: The forecasted cost required to complete the remaining work from the data date. Derived from cost engineer inputs for remaining quantities and rates.

attributes.name: forecast_confidence_level
attributes.description: The cost engineer's confidence level in the ETC and EAC forecast for this record. Indicates the reliability of the cost-to-complete estimate.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this EVM record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates.

attributes.name: percent_complete
attributes.description: The percentage of work completed for this WBS element or cost account as of the data date. Calculated as (BCWP / BAC) * 100.

attributes.name: percent_spent
attributes.description: The percentage of budget spent as of the data date. Calculated as (ACWP / BAC) * 100.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this EVM record. Indicates whether the record is in draft, submitted for review, approved, revised, or closed.

attributes.name: remaining_work_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of work remaining to be completed for this cost account. Input by cost engineers for ETC calculation. Units vary by work type (e.g., cubic meters, linear meters, hours).

attributes.name: remaining_work_unit_rate
attributes.description: The forecasted unit rate for remaining work. Input by cost engineers to calculate ETC. Represents cost per unit of work (e.g., cost per cubic meter, cost per hour).

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the reporting period for which this EVM snapshot was computed. Defines the close of the measurement window.

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the reporting period for which this EVM snapshot was computed. Defines the beginning of the measurement window.

attributes.name: sap_wbs_element_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) Element Code
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA WBS element code from which actual cost data (ACWP) was sourced. Enables traceability to the source ERP system.

tag_set.value: SAP Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) Element Code

attributes.name: schedule_performance_index
attributes.description: The ratio of earned value to planned value (BCWP / BCWS). An SPI less than 1.0 indicates the project is behind schedule; greater than 1.0 indicates ahead of schedule.

attributes.name: schedule_variance
attributes.description: The difference between earned value and planned value (BCWP - BCWS). A negative value indicates the project is behind schedule; a positive value indicates ahead of schedule.

attributes.name: tcpi_to_complete_performance_index
attributes.description: The cost performance index required to achieve the budget at completion or estimate at completion. Calculated as (BAC - BCWP) / (BAC - ACWP) or (BAC - BCWP) / (EAC - ACWP).

attributes.name: vac_variance_at_completion
attributes.description: The difference between the budget at completion and the estimate at completion (BAC - EAC). Indicates the expected cost overrun or underrun at project completion.

products.name: progress_billing
products.description: Construction progress billing, payment certification, and client AR invoice lifecycle record covering the full claim-to-collection cycle. Captures the payment application (AIA G702/G703 or FIDIC payment certificate) including scheduled value by WBS/BOQ line, percentage complete, amount earned to date, current period claim, retention withheld, and net amount due. Also owns the formal AR tax invoice raised after payment certificate approval — invoice number, client reference, contract reference, invoice date, due date, gross amount, VAT/GST, retention deducted, net receivable, payment status, aging bucket, and collection history. Sourced from Procore, SAP S/4HANA FI-AR, and Viewpoint Vista. The authoritative SSOT for all client-facing billing, accounts receivable invoices, and receivables management in construction.
products.reference: AIA G702 Payment Application / FIDIC Interim Payment Certificate

attributes.name: progress_billing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the progress billing record. Primary key for the progress billing entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account being billed for this progress payment.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contract under which this progress billing is issued.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project for which this progress billing is issued.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Progress billing amounts are charged to a cost center for cost tracking.

attributes.name: project_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.project_budget. Business justification: Progress billing should be associated with the underlying project budget for variance analysis.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the WBS element for which this progress billing is being claimed.

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: Accounts receivable aging classification based on days past due: current (not yet due), 1-30 days, 31-60 days, 61-90 days, over 90 days.

attributes.name: amount_received
attributes.description: Total amount received from the client against this invoice, including partial payments.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the billing period covered by this progress billing claim.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period covered by this progress billing claim.

attributes.name: certification_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment certificate was certified or approved by the engineer or client representative.

attributes.name: client_reference_number
attributes.description: Client-provided reference number or purchase order number associated with this payment application.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this progress billing record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this progress billing record.

attributes.name: current_period_claim
attributes.description: Amount claimed in the current billing period, calculated as work_completed_to_date minus previous_amount_billed.

attributes.name: cutoff_date
attributes.description: The measurement cutoff date for work completed and eligible for billing in this payment application.

attributes.name: engineer_approval_name
attributes.description: Name of the engineer or client representative who certified or approved the payment certificate.

attributes.name: gross_amount_due
attributes.description: Gross amount due before retention and taxes, equal to current_period_claim.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date when the formal AR invoice was issued to the client.

attributes.name: invoice_due_date
attributes.description: Payment due date for the invoice, typically calculated as invoice_date plus contract payment terms (e.g., Net 30, Net 60).

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Formal accounts receivable (AR) tax invoice number issued after payment certificate approval, used for financial accounting and collection tracking.

attributes.name: materials_stored_on_site
attributes.description: Value of materials delivered and stored on-site but not yet incorporated into the work, eligible for billing per contract terms.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this progress billing record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: net_amount_due
attributes.description: Net amount due after deducting retention, calculated as gross_amount_due minus retention_amount.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on this invoice, calculated as net_amount_due plus tax_amount minus amount_received.

attributes.name: payment_application_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the payment application (e.g., AIA G702 application number or FIDIC payment certificate number).

attributes.name: payment_certificate_type
attributes.description: Type of payment certificate being issued: interim (monthly progress), final (project completion), advance (mobilization), milestone (specific deliverable), retention_release (DLP completion), or variation (change order).

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: Date when payment was received from the client for this invoice.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the progress billing: draft (being prepared), submitted (sent to client), under_review (client reviewing), certified (approved by engineer), invoiced (AR invoice raised), partially_paid (partial payment received), paid (fully paid), overdue (past due date), disputed (under dispute), cancelled (voided). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|certified|invoiced|partially_paid|paid|overdue|disputed|cancelled — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date to payment due date as per contract payment terms (e.g., 30, 60, 90 days).

attributes.name: percentage_complete
attributes.description: Percentage of work completed for the billing line item as of the cutoff date, used for percentage-of-completion revenue recognition.

attributes.name: previous_amount_billed
attributes.description: Cumulative amount billed in all prior payment applications, used to calculate the current period claim.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or clarifications related to this progress billing, including dispute details or payment conditions.

attributes.name: retention_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of retention withheld from the current period claim, calculated as current_period_claim multiplied by retention_percentage.

attributes.name: retention_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the billed amount withheld by the client as retention (typically 5-10%) until project completion or DLP expiry.

attributes.name: scheduled_value
attributes.description: Total contract value or scheduled value for the work scope covered by this billing line (from BOQ or contract schedule).

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment application was submitted to the client or engineer for review and certification.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Value-added tax (VAT) or goods and services tax (GST) applied to the net amount due, per local tax regulations.

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Tax rate percentage applied to calculate the tax amount (e.g., VAT or GST rate).

attributes.name: work_completed_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative value of work completed from project start through the current billing period cutoff date.

products.name: revenue_recognition_entry
products.description: Periodic revenue recognition record applying the percentage-of-completion (POC) method per IFRS 15 / ASC 606 to each construction contract. Captures the recognition period, contract value, cumulative costs incurred, estimated total costs, completion percentage (cost-to-cost method), revenue recognized to date, revenue recognized in period, and deferred/unbilled revenue balance. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) module. The authoritative SSOT for construction revenue recognition compliance.
products.reference: IFRS 15 / ASC 606 Percentage of Completion / SAP RAR

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the revenue recognition entry record.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction contract for which revenue is being recognized.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project associated with this revenue recognition entry.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Revenue recognition entries need to be allocated to a cost center for reporting.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Revenue recognition entries are created by finance staff; employee link enables accountability and IFRS/GAAP audit.

attributes.name: project_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.project_budget. Business justification: Revenue recognition entries need to reference the project budget to align recognized revenue with budgeted amounts.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the WBS element for which revenue is being recognized, enabling granular revenue tracking at the work package level.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for any adjustment made to a previously posted revenue recognition entry, including changes to cost estimates, contract modifications, or error corrections.

attributes.name: auditor_reviewed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revenue recognition entry has been reviewed and validated by internal or external auditors as part of financial statement audit procedures.

attributes.name: billed_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative amount billed to the client from contract inception through the end of the current recognition period, based on progress billing milestones or payment schedules.

attributes.name: change_order_value_included
attributes.description: Cumulative value of approved change orders included in the contract value for this recognition period. Change orders modify the transaction price and must be accounted for under IFRS 15 / ASC 606 contract modification guidance.

attributes.name: completion_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of contract completion calculated using the cost-to-cost method (cumulative costs incurred divided by estimated total costs), expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). This is the primary input for revenue recognition under the percentage-of-completion method.

attributes.name: contract_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the contract value and all monetary amounts in this entry.

attributes.name: contract_value
attributes.description: The total contract value (transaction price) as defined under IFRS 15 / ASC 606, representing the amount of consideration the entity expects to be entitled to in exchange for transferring promised goods or services.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this revenue recognition entry record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_costs_incurred
attributes.description: Total costs incurred to date on the contract, including direct labor, materials, equipment, subcontractor costs, and allocable indirect costs. Used as the numerator in the cost-to-cost percentage-of-completion calculation.

attributes.name: deferred_revenue
attributes.description: Amount billed to the client but not yet recognized as revenue (contract liability), representing advance payments or over-billing relative to work performed. Calculated as billed to date minus revenue recognized to date when billed exceeds recognized revenue.

attributes.name: estimated_gross_profit_at_completion
attributes.description: Forecasted total gross profit for the contract at completion, calculated as contract value minus estimated total costs. Used for forward-looking profitability analysis and loss recognition.

attributes.name: estimated_total_costs
attributes.description: The current estimate of total costs expected to complete the contract, including all direct and indirect costs. Used as the denominator in the cost-to-cost percentage-of-completion calculation. Updated periodically based on project forecasts.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (1-12 or 1-13 for companies with 13-period calendars) within the fiscal year to which this revenue recognition entry belongs.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this revenue recognition entry belongs, supporting multi-year contract revenue tracking and financial reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger account code to which the revenue recognized in period is posted in the financial accounting system.

attributes.name: gross_profit_percentage
attributes.description: Gross profit margin to date expressed as a percentage of revenue recognized to date, calculated as (gross profit to date / revenue recognized to date) * 100.

attributes.name: gross_profit_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative gross profit recognized on the contract to date, calculated as revenue recognized to date minus cumulative costs incurred.

attributes.name: loss_provision
attributes.description: Provision for anticipated loss on the contract if estimated total costs exceed contract value. Under IFRS 15 / ASC 606, losses on onerous contracts must be recognized immediately in full.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this revenue recognition entry record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this revenue recognition entry record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding this revenue recognition entry, including explanations of significant variances, estimate changes, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: performance_obligation_description
attributes.description: Description of the distinct performance obligation(s) within the contract for which revenue is being recognized, as defined under IFRS 15 / ASC 606.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the revenue recognition entry was posted to the General Ledger, which may differ from the recognition date due to period-end close processes.

attributes.name: prior_period_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this entry represents a correction or adjustment to revenue recognized in a prior accounting period, requiring disclosure under IFRS / GAAP.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The profit center code associated with this revenue recognition entry, enabling P&L and EBITDA reporting by business segment or division.

attributes.name: recognition_date
attributes.description: The specific date on which the revenue recognition entry was recorded in the financial system.

attributes.name: recognition_method
attributes.description: The method used to measure progress toward complete satisfaction of the performance obligation. Cost-to-cost is the primary method for construction contracts, but other methods may be used when appropriate.

attributes.name: recognition_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (YYYY-MM format) for which revenue is being recognized under the percentage-of-completion method.

attributes.name: retention_held_by_client
attributes.description: Cumulative retention amount withheld by the client from progress billings, typically released upon contract completion or after the Defects Liability Period (DLP). Represents a contract asset under IFRS 15.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_status
attributes.description: Current status of the revenue recognition entry in the financial workflow. Draft entries are pending review; posted entries are committed to the GL; adjusted entries have been modified; reversed entries have been backed out; final entries are locked after contract completion.

attributes.name: revenue_recognized_in_period
attributes.description: Revenue recognized in the current accounting period, calculated as the difference between revenue recognized to date and revenue recognized in all prior periods. This is the amount posted to the General Ledger (GL) for the period.

attributes.name: revenue_recognized_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative revenue recognized from contract inception through the end of the current recognition period, calculated as contract value multiplied by completion percentage.

attributes.name: source_document_number
attributes.description: The document number or reference identifier in the source system (e.g., SAP RAR document number) that generated this revenue recognition entry.

attributes.name: unbilled_revenue
attributes.description: Revenue recognized but not yet billed to the client (contract asset), calculated as revenue recognized to date minus billed to date. A positive value indicates work performed ahead of billing; a negative value indicates over-billing (contract liability).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this revenue recognition entry record.

products.name: invoice
products.description: Vendor and subcontractor invoice record in the Accounts Payable (AP) ledger, capturing the full supplier billing lifecycle from receipt through approval to payment. Records invoice number, vendor/subcontractor reference, PO/subcontract reference, invoice date, due date, gross amount, tax/VAT amount, retention withheld, net payable, payment terms, approval workflow status, three-way match status (PO-GR-Invoice), and dispute/hold flags. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI-AP and Viewpoint Vista AP module. Covers supplier invoices for materials, equipment hire, professional services, and subcontractor progress claims. The authoritative SSOT for all accounts payable obligations in the construction enterprise.
products.reference: SAP FI-AP Vendor Invoice / Three-Way Match

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Primary key for invoice

attributes.name: compliance_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Invoices for permit fees must reference the specific permit to satisfy audit and regulatory reconciliation.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project to which this invoice is charged. Enables job costing and project-level financial reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Accounts payable invoices must be assigned to a cost center for budget control and reporting.

attributes.name: finance_cost_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_code. Business justification: Invoice cost_code column is denormalized; linking to cost_code table enables accurate cost‑code reporting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Accounts payable invoice must be associated with a GL account for posting; FK replaces code string.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order or subcontract against which this invoice is submitted. Used for three-way match validation (PO-GR-Invoice).

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or subcontractor who issued this invoice. Links to the vendor master data in the procurement domain.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current status of the invoice in the approval workflow. Tracks whether the invoice has been reviewed and approved by authorized personnel per delegation of authority (DOA) matrix.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the person who approved the invoice for payment. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was approved for payment. Used for workflow metrics and audit trail.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this invoice record was first created in the accounts payable system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the invoice is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Used for multi-currency accounting and foreign exchange management.

attributes.name: invoice_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the goods or services covered by this invoice. Provides context for the invoice line items and supports audit and review processes.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Any early payment discount or negotiated discount applied to the invoice. Reduces the net payable amount.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the invoice is currently under dispute. True if there is a disagreement on invoice accuracy, pricing, or delivery that must be resolved before payment.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for the invoice dispute. Captures details of pricing discrepancies, quantity mismatches, quality issues, or other disagreements.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment is due per the payment terms. Used for cash flow forecasting, aging reports, and late payment penalty calculation.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year to which this invoice is allocated. Used for monthly/quarterly financial reporting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this invoice is allocated for financial reporting purposes. Used for annual P&L, EBITDA, and budget vs. actual analysis.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total invoice amount before tax, retention, and other adjustments. Represents the base value of goods or services invoiced.

attributes.name: hold_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the invoice is on hold pending additional information or resolution of issues. True if payment is temporarily suspended.

attributes.name: hold_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason the invoice is on hold. May include missing documentation, pending approvals, or compliance issues.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was issued by the vendor or subcontractor. This is the principal business event timestamp for the invoice and is used for aging analysis and payment term calculation.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique invoice number assigned by the vendor or subcontractor. This is the business identifier used for correspondence, payment reference, and three-way matching.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice in the accounts payable workflow. Tracks progression from receipt through approval to payment or dispute resolution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|pending_approval|approved|disputed|on_hold|paid|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice type. Standard invoices are for completed deliveries; progress claims are for work-in-progress per percentage of completion; credit/debit notes are adjustments; prepayments are advance payments; final invoices close out a contract.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this invoice record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: net_payable_amount
attributes.description: The final amount payable to the vendor after applying tax, retention, discounts, and other adjustments. This is the amount that will be paid or has been paid.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date payment was made to the vendor or subcontractor. Null if invoice is unpaid. Used for cash flow analysis and Days Payable Outstanding (DPO) calculation.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or method used to pay this invoice (e.g., wire transfer, check, ACH, credit card, letter of credit). Used for cash management and reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: The unique reference number or transaction ID for the payment made against this invoice. Used for bank reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The agreed payment terms for this invoice (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30). Defines the payment schedule and any early payment discount conditions.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was received and recorded in the accounts payable system. Used for internal processing metrics and aging analysis.

attributes.name: retention_amount
attributes.description: The amount withheld from payment as retention per contract terms. Typically held until project completion or Defects Liability Period (DLP) expiry. Common in construction contracts per FIDIC terms.

attributes.name: retention_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the invoice amount withheld as retention per contract terms. Typically 5-10% in construction contracts per FIDIC conditions.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax or Value Added Tax (VAT) amount applied to the invoice. Used for tax reporting and compliance with local tax regulations.

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: The tax or VAT rate applied to this invoice, expressed as a percentage. Used for tax calculation and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Status of the three-way match validation between Purchase Order (PO), Goods Receipt (GR), and Invoice. Ensures invoice accuracy and prevents overpayment.

products.name: accounts_receivable_invoice
products.description: Client-facing AR (Accounts Receivable) invoice record issued to project owners/clients for certified work, milestone payments, or variation orders. Captures invoice number, client reference, contract reference, invoice date, due date, gross amount, VAT/tax, retention deducted, net receivable, payment status, and aging bucket. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI-AR. Distinct from progress_billing (the claim submitted) — this is the formal tax invoice raised after payment certificate approval.
products.reference: SAP FI-AR Customer Invoice / Tax Invoice

attributes.name: accounts_receivable_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the accounts receivable invoice record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client (project owner) to whom this invoice is issued. Links to the client master data product.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction contract under which this invoice is raised. Links to the contract master agreement product.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project for which work is being billed. Links to the construction project master data product.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Accounts receivable invoices should be linked to a cost center for reporting and allocation purposes.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Accounts receivable invoice posts to GL; FK provides authoritative account data.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific WBS element being billed. Enables detailed cost tracking and revenue allocation at the work package level.

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice based on the number of days past the due date. Used for accounts receivable aging analysis and collection prioritization.

attributes.name: amount_paid_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative amount received from the client against this invoice. Updated as partial or full payments are applied.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the work period covered by this invoice. Defines the cutoff for work included in this billing cycle.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the work period covered by this invoice. Used for progress billing and percentage-of-completion revenue recognition.

attributes.name: client_reference_number
attributes.description: Client-provided reference number or purchase order number that must appear on the invoice for their accounts payable processing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this invoice (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, AED).

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the invoice is overdue. Calculated as current date minus due date for unpaid invoices past their due date.

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date the client formally raised a dispute against this invoice. Null if no dispute exists.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the invoice is currently under dispute by the client. True if disputed, False otherwise.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason the client has disputed this invoice. Null if no dispute exists.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The contractual date by which payment is expected from the client. Used for aging bucket classification and late payment penalty calculations.

attributes.name: gl_document_number
attributes.description: Document number assigned by the ERP system when the invoice was posted to the general ledger. Used for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: Date the invoice was posted to the general ledger in the ERP system. Used for financial period reconciliation.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount before tax and retention deductions. Represents the certified value of work completed or milestone achieved.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was formally issued to the client. This is the principal business event timestamp for revenue recognition and aging calculations.

attributes.name: invoice_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the work or milestone being billed. Provides context for the invoice line items and supports client review.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique invoice number issued to the client. This is the business identifier printed on the invoice document and referenced in payment correspondence.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice in the accounts receivable workflow. Tracks progression from draft through payment to closure or dispute resolution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|issued|partially_paid|paid|overdue|disputed|cancelled|written_off — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice based on the billing trigger and contract terms. Distinguishes between regular progress claims, milestone payments, variation orders, and retention releases. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: progress_billing|milestone|advance_payment|retention_release|variation_order|final_account|credit_note|debit_note — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment received against this invoice. Null if no payments have been received.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice record was last modified. Updated whenever any field changes. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_receivable_amount
attributes.description: Net amount receivable from the client after deducting retention and adding tax. This is the amount expected to be paid by the due date.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on the invoice. Calculated as net receivable amount minus amount paid to date.

attributes.name: payment_certificate_date
attributes.description: Date the payment certificate was issued by the engineer or client representative. Typically precedes the invoice date.

attributes.name: payment_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the payment certificate issued by the engineer or client representative approving the work value. This certificate authorizes the invoice issuance.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or method used by the client to settle this invoice (e.g., bank transfer, wire transfer, check, letter of credit).

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment terms agreed with the client, defining the number of days from invoice date to due date (e.g., Net 30 means payment due within 30 days). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: net_7|net_15|net_30|net_45|net_60|net_90|due_on_receipt|custom — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: retention_amount
attributes.description: Amount withheld by the client as retention per contract terms. Typically a percentage of the gross amount held until project completion or defects liability period (DLP) expiry.

attributes.name: retention_rate_percent
attributes.description: The percentage of the gross amount withheld as retention. Typically ranges from 5% to 10% per FIDIC standard contract terms.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used for revenue recognition on this invoice. Construction typically uses percentage-of-completion per IFRS 15 and GAAP ASC 606.

attributes.name: revenue_recognized_amount
attributes.description: Amount of revenue recognized in the financial statements for this invoice. May differ from gross amount based on revenue recognition method and contract terms.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax (VAT, GST, or sales tax) applied to the invoice. Calculated based on applicable tax rates and jurisdictional rules.

attributes.name: tax_rate_percent
attributes.description: The tax rate percentage applied to calculate the tax amount. Varies by jurisdiction and project location.

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Amount written off as uncollectible bad debt. Null if not written off.

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: Date the outstanding balance was written off as bad debt. Null if not written off.

attributes.name: write_off_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outstanding balance has been written off as uncollectible. True if written off, False otherwise.

products.name: payment_record
products.description: Financial payment transaction record capturing both outgoing payments to vendors/subcontractors (AP disbursements) and incoming receipts from clients (AR collections). Captures payment date, payment method (wire transfer, cheque, ACH, LC drawdown), bank account, amount paid/received, currency, exchange rate, invoice references cleared, bank clearing status, and remittance advice details. Supports multi-currency payment runs, partial payments, and bank reconciliation. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI payment runs and Viewpoint Vista.
products.reference: SAP FI Payment Document / Bank Payment

attributes.name: payment_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment transaction record. Primary key for the payment_record product.

attributes.name: carbon_offset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.carbon_offset. Business justification: Payments for carbon offsets need to reference the specific offset transaction for reconciliation.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project for which this payment is made or received, enabling project-level cash flow tracking.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Payments are allocated to cost centers for cash‑flow forecasting and cost‑center performance tracking.

attributes.name: invoice_accounts_payable_invoice_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Invoice Accounts Payable Invoice Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.invoice. Business justification: Payments are applied to a specific AP invoice; FK provides direct linkage for reconciliation.

tag_set.value: Invoice Accounts Payable Invoice Id (Foreign Key)

attributes.name: payment_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch payment run in which this payment was processed, used for grouping and reconciliation of multiple payments.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Payments of regulatory penalties need to be tied to the originating obligation for traceability and reporting.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or subcontractor receiving the outgoing payment (AP disbursement). Null for incoming payments.

attributes.name: advance_payment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment is an advance payment made before work completion or goods delivery.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was approved by the authorized approver, marking a key lifecycle event.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved the payment transaction, for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: bank_charges
attributes.description: Bank fees and transaction charges incurred for processing the payment, may be borne by payer or payee.

attributes.name: bank_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number assigned by the bank for the payment transaction, used for bank reconciliation and clearing.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was cleared and confirmed by the bank, indicating successful fund transfer.

attributes.name: clearing_status
attributes.description: Status of the payment in the bank clearing process, indicating whether funds have been successfully transferred.

attributes.name: cost_code
attributes.description: Construction cost code for categorizing the payment within the project cost structure and WBS (Work Breakdown Structure).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment record was first created in the system, for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Early payment discount or cash discount amount deducted from the gross payment amount, if applicable.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The contractual due date by which the payment should be made or received, based on invoice date and payment terms.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert the payment amount to the company's functional currency, if multi-currency transaction.

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: Payment amount converted to the company's functional currency using the exchange rate, for consolidated financial reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the payment transaction is posted for financial accounting and P&L reporting.

attributes.name: invoice_references
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of invoice document numbers that are cleared or partially cleared by this payment transaction.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment record was last modified or updated, for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: The final net amount paid or received after all adjustments, discounts, withholding taxes, and bank charges.

attributes.name: partial_payment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a partial payment that does not fully settle the referenced invoices or obligations.

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary value of the payment transaction in the transaction currency, before any adjustments or fees.

attributes.name: payment_approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the payment, indicating whether it has been authorized by the appropriate authority levels.

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: The interface or system channel through which the payment was initiated or received (e.g., ERP system, banking portal, manual entry).

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the payment was executed or received. This is the principal business event timestamp for the transaction.

attributes.name: payment_document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique payment document number assigned by the ERP system (SAP S/4HANA or Viewpoint Vista). Used for reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The financial instrument or mechanism used to execute the payment (e.g., wire transfer, ACH, cheque, cash, LC drawdown).

attributes.name: payment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the payment transaction, capturing special instructions or contextual information.

attributes.name: payment_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the payment for processing sequence and cash flow management.

attributes.name: payment_purpose
attributes.description: Business purpose or reason for the payment (e.g., material supply, subcontractor labor, equipment rental, progress billing).

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment transaction in the payment processing workflow.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment terms applicable to this transaction (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30), governing due dates and discounts.

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of payment direction: outgoing payments to vendors/subcontractors (AP disbursements) or incoming receipts from clients (AR collections).

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Purchase order number associated with the payment, typically for vendor payments linked to procurement transactions.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was successfully reconciled with the bank statement during the bank reconciliation process.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of bank reconciliation for this payment, indicating whether it has been matched with bank statement entries.

attributes.name: remittance_advice
attributes.description: Detailed remittance information sent to the payee explaining which invoices or obligations are being settled by this payment.

attributes.name: retention_amount
attributes.description: Amount withheld from the payment as retention per contract terms, to be released upon project completion or defects liability period.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The effective date when funds are available or debited in the bank account, used for cash flow and liquidity management.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount withheld at source as per local tax regulations, deducted from the gross payment amount.

products.name: finance_retention_ledger
products.description: Tracks retention (retainage) balances held by clients against the contractor and held by the contractor against subcontractors. Captures retention withheld per billing period, cumulative retention balance, DLP (Defects Liability Period) release schedule, partial release events, and final release upon practical completion certificate. Manages both receivable retention (client owes contractor) and payable retention (contractor owes subcontractor) in a single ledger. Critical for FIDIC and GMP contract financial management. [SSOT: distinct source of truth for finance domain]
products.reference: Retention / Retainage / DLP Release / FIDIC Clause 14

attributes.name: finance_retention_ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the retention ledger entry. Primary key for the finance retention ledger.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contract under which this retention is held or owed.

attributes.name: billing_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing period during which this retention was withheld or released.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project to which this retention entry applies.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Retention ledger entries should reference the owning cost center for allocation and reporting.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the counterparty (client for receivable retention, subcontractor for payable retention).

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the WBS element to which this retention entry is allocated for cost control and reporting.

attributes.name: cost_code
attributes.description: The cost code associated with this retention entry for job costing and financial tracking.

attributes.name: cumulative_retention_balance
attributes.description: The total accumulated retention balance held or owed as of this ledger entry date.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this retention ledger entry.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this retention entry is under dispute (True if disputed, False otherwise).

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for retention dispute if the dispute flag is set.

attributes.name: dlp_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the Defects Liability Period, after which final retention is typically released.

attributes.name: dlp_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the Defects Liability Period, typically commencing at practical completion.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year to which this retention transaction is allocated.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this retention transaction is allocated for financial reporting and budgeting.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger account code to which this retention entry is posted for financial reporting.

attributes.name: gross_invoice_amount
attributes.description: The total invoice amount before retention is withheld.

attributes.name: invoice_reference_number
attributes.description: The invoice number or payment application reference associated with this retention withholding or release.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding this retention ledger entry, including special conditions or release approvals.

attributes.name: payment_certificate_number
attributes.description: The payment certificate number issued by the engineer or client authorizing payment and retention withholding.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which this retention entry was posted to the General Ledger for financial reporting.

attributes.name: practical_completion_certificate_date
attributes.description: The date on which the practical completion certificate was issued, triggering partial retention release and DLP commencement.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this retention ledger record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this retention ledger record was last updated in the data platform.

attributes.name: retention_account_id
attributes.description: SSOT reference to canonical contract.contract_retention_ledger (single source of truth).

attributes.name: retention_bond_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a retention bond was provided in lieu of cash retention (True if bond provided, False otherwise).

attributes.name: retention_bond_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the retention bond if provided in lieu of cash retention.

attributes.name: retention_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the invoice or payment amount withheld as retention (e.g., 5.00 for 5% retention).

attributes.name: retention_release_amount
attributes.description: The amount of retention released in this transaction (partial or full release).

attributes.name: retention_release_date
attributes.description: The date on which retention was released to the contractor or subcontractor.

attributes.name: retention_release_type
attributes.description: The type of retention release event: partial release, final release upon practical completion, DLP expiry release, or milestone-based release.

attributes.name: retention_status
attributes.description: Current status of the retention balance: withheld, partially released, fully released, or disputed.

attributes.name: retention_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is retention receivable (client owes contractor) or retention payable (contractor owes subcontractor).

attributes.name: retention_withheld_amount
attributes.description: The amount withheld as retention for this billing period or transaction.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this retention ledger entry in the source operational system.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The business date on which this retention ledger transaction occurred (withholding or release event).

products.name: cash_flow_forecast
products.description: Forward-looking cash flow projection record for construction projects and the corporate entity, capturing forecast inflows (client milestone payments, retention releases, advance drawdowns) and outflows (subcontractor payments, material procurement, payroll, equipment hire, bond premiums) by period (weekly/monthly). Includes S-curve cash flow profile, cumulative cash position, peak funding requirement, working capital gap analysis, and variance to prior forecast. Supports both project-level forecasting for contract cash management and corporate-level treasury forecasting for bonding capacity and credit facility utilization.
products.reference: Project Cash Flow S-Curve / Treasury Forecast

attributes.name: cash_flow_forecast_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cash flow forecast record.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Required for cash flow forecasting per contract to align financing with project cash needs; contracts define payment terms used in cash flow models.

attributes.name: climate_risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.climate_risk_assessment. Business justification: Cash‑flow forecasts must incorporate quantified climate‑risk financial impacts for risk‑adjusted planning.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project for which this cash flow forecast is prepared. Null for corporate-level forecasts.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cash flow forecasts are prepared per cost center to track cash impact of cost allocations.

attributes.name: prepared_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Cash‑flow forecasts are prepared by a finance analyst; linking to employee enables responsibility tracking and variance analysis.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific WBS element if the forecast is prepared at a granular work package level. Null for project-level or corporate-level forecasts.

attributes.name: advance_drawdown_amount
attributes.description: Forecasted drawdown of advance payments or mobilization advances from the client, typically secured by advance payment guarantees.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the forecast was formally approved for use in financial planning and decision-making.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who approved the forecast, typically the project manager, finance director, or CFO.

attributes.name: bond_premium_amount
attributes.description: Forecasted payments for performance bonds, advance payment guarantees, and other surety instruments required by the contract.

attributes.name: bonding_capacity_utilization
attributes.description: Percentage of total bonding capacity utilized by this forecast, relevant for corporate-level forecasts to monitor surety capacity constraints.

attributes.name: closing_cash_balance
attributes.description: Projected cash balance at the end of the forecast period, calculated as opening balance plus net cash flow.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this forecast record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_facility_utilization
attributes.description: Percentage of available credit facility or working capital line utilized to meet the peak funding requirement, relevant for corporate treasury management.

attributes.name: cumulative_cash_position
attributes.description: Cumulative cash position at the end of the forecast period, representing the running total of net cash flows from project inception or corporate fiscal year start.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this forecast (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: equipment_hire_amount
attributes.description: Forecasted payments for equipment rental and hire charges, including plant, machinery, and temporary facilities.

attributes.name: forecast_assumptions
attributes.description: Key assumptions underlying the forecast, including payment term assumptions, progress rate assumptions, inflation factors, and risk contingencies.

attributes.name: forecast_date
attributes.description: The date on which this forecast was prepared or last updated, representing the as-of date for the forecast assumptions.

attributes.name: forecast_granularity
attributes.description: The time interval granularity at which cash flows are forecasted: daily for short-term liquidity management, weekly for near-term project cash planning, monthly for standard project forecasting, or quarterly for long-term corporate planning.

attributes.name: forecast_identifier
attributes.description: Business-readable identifier for the forecast, typically combining project code, forecast period, and version (e.g., PRJ-2024-001-V3).

attributes.name: forecast_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the period covered by this cash flow forecast.

attributes.name: forecast_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the period covered by this cash flow forecast.

attributes.name: forecast_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the forecast: draft for work-in-progress, submitted for review, approved for active use, superseded when replaced by a newer version, or archived for historical reference.

attributes.name: forecast_type
attributes.description: Classification of the forecast scope: project-level for individual construction projects, corporate-level for enterprise-wide treasury forecasting, WBS-level for granular work package forecasts, or contract-level for specific contract cash management.

attributes.name: forecast_version
attributes.description: Version number of the forecast, incremented with each revision to track forecast evolution and variance analysis over time.

attributes.name: forecasted_inflow_amount
attributes.description: Total projected cash inflows for the forecast period, including client milestone payments, retention releases, advance drawdowns, and other receipts.

attributes.name: forecasted_outflow_amount
attributes.description: Total projected cash outflows for the forecast period, including subcontractor payments, material procurement, payroll, equipment hire, bond premiums, and other disbursements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this forecast record was last updated, supporting audit trail and version control.

attributes.name: material_procurement_amount
attributes.description: Forecasted payments for material purchases and procurement, based on Purchase Orders (PO) and supplier payment terms.

attributes.name: milestone_payment_amount
attributes.description: Forecasted client milestone payments expected during the period, based on contract payment schedules and progress billing milestones.

attributes.name: net_cash_flow_amount
attributes.description: Net cash flow for the forecast period, calculated as forecasted inflows minus forecasted outflows, indicating the expected cash position change.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or explanations regarding the forecast, including significant changes from prior versions or special circumstances.

attributes.name: opening_cash_balance
attributes.description: Cash balance at the beginning of the forecast period, serving as the starting point for the period's cash flow projection.

attributes.name: payroll_amount
attributes.description: Forecasted payroll disbursements for direct labor and site personnel, including wages, benefits, and statutory contributions.

attributes.name: peak_funding_requirement
attributes.description: Maximum negative cash position expected during the forecast period, indicating the highest working capital or credit facility draw required.

attributes.name: prepared_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or team who prepared the forecast, typically the project controls team or corporate treasury analyst.

attributes.name: retention_release_amount
attributes.description: Forecasted release of retention amounts held by the client, typically released upon project completion or after the Defects Liability Period (DLP).

attributes.name: s_curve_profile_indicator
attributes.description: Classification of the cash flow profile shape: front-loaded for projects with high early expenditure, linear for steady cash flow, back-loaded for projects with late-stage heavy spending, or custom for non-standard profiles.

attributes.name: subcontractor_payment_amount
attributes.description: Forecasted payments to subcontractors for work performed, based on subcontract payment terms and progress certificates.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage variance between current and prior forecast, calculated as (current - prior) / prior * 100, indicating forecast volatility.

attributes.name: variance_to_prior_forecast
attributes.description: Difference between the current forecast net cash flow and the previous forecast version for the same period, used for forecast accuracy tracking and trend analysis.

attributes.name: working_capital_gap
attributes.description: Difference between forecasted outflows and inflows timing, representing the working capital financing need to bridge payment obligations before receipt of client payments.

products.name: financial_guarantee
products.description: Master record for all financial instruments and guarantees issued or received in connection with construction contracts — performance bonds, advance payment guarantees, retention bonds, bid bonds, parent company guarantees, and letters of credit. Captures instrument type, issuing bank/surety, beneficiary, face value, currency, issue date, expiry date, call conditions, amendment history, premium/fee schedule, and current status (active/expired/called/released). Critical for bonding capacity management, surety relationship tracking, FIDIC/EPC contract compliance, and financial risk exposure reporting.
products.reference: Performance Bond / Advance Payment Guarantee / Letter of Credit / FIDIC Bond

attributes.name: financial_guarantee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the financial guarantee record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction contract for which this guarantee is issued or received.

attributes.name: construction_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the construction project associated with this financial guarantee.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Financial guarantees are tied to a cost center for budgeting and exposure tracking.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to hr.employee. Business justification: Guarantee issuance is recorded by a responsible employee; linking supports traceability and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Number of amendments or modifications made to the original financial guarantee terms.

attributes.name: beneficiary_name
attributes.description: Name of the party entitled to call or claim against the financial guarantee (typically the client or contractor).

attributes.name: beneficiary_type
attributes.description: Classification of the beneficiary party: client, contractor, subcontractor, supplier, or joint venture (JV).

attributes.name: bonding_capacity_impact_amount
attributes.description: Amount by which this guarantee reduces the organization's available bonding capacity with the surety.

attributes.name: call_conditions
attributes.description: Detailed description of the conditions under which the beneficiary may call or claim against the financial guarantee.

attributes.name: call_type
attributes.description: Type of call mechanism: on-demand (unconditional), conditional (requires proof of default), or documentary (requires specific documents).

attributes.name: claim_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount claimed by the beneficiary against the financial guarantee, if a call was made.

attributes.name: claim_date
attributes.description: Date on which the beneficiary called or claimed against the financial guarantee, if applicable.

attributes.name: collateral_description
attributes.description: Description of any collateral or security provided to the issuer (e.g., cash deposit, property lien, parent company indemnity).

attributes.name: collateral_required_flag

Integrates with Salesforce CRM for opportunity tracking and pipeline forecasting. Tracks bid-to-award conversion rates across market segments.

products.name: firm_profile
products.description: Master profile of each subcontracting firm engaged or seeking engagement on construction projects. Captures legal entity name, ABN/EIN/company registration number, trade classifications (MEP, civil, structural, specialty), business registration details, bonding capacity, union affiliations, geographic coverage areas, minority/women-owned business enterprise (MBE/WBE/DBE) certifications, NAICS/SIC codes, annual revenue band, EMR (Experience Modification Rate), and financial standing indicators. This is the SSOT for subcontractor firm identity, distinct from the procurement domain's vendor master which governs purchase order relationships.
